title: Director, Area Asset Manager
description: Who we are For more than 40 years, Reworld has been a leader in sustainable waste solutions, providing our customers with innovative solutions that help them achieve carbon-negative outcomes. Our Vision Reworld is leading the charge to a carbon-negative future through revolutionary sustainable materials management solutions that reduce, reuse, recycle and reimagine waste for the benefit of society and the environment. Our Business Reworld partners with businesses by offering cutting-edge engineering and innovative solutions, to help customers reduce, reuse, recycle and recover value from waste streams and meet or exceed their sustainability goals. Our Value Reworld's differentiator comes from our ecosystem of technology, facilities and partnerships, trusted by the world’s largest organizations to reimagine waste management for a smarter, more sustainable world. All that we’re missing is you. Apply today! About the role The Director, Area Asset Manager position will have responsibility for meeting and exceeding EBITDA and Free Cash Flow targets for the asset base under their direction. They will also lead asset management and development activities across a regional base of assets (primarily Energy-from-Waste facilities). The role entails direct oversight of revenue generating activities including service agreements, merchant waste as well as expense and capital items related to facility operations, improvements, and operational byproducts (residues). They will also have shared responsibilities in the areas of energy sales development and contracting, as well as residue management and revenue related thereof. Working closely with the Area Operations Manager, a significant part of the role is coordinating activities across operational, financial, energy, legal, business development, engineering, construction, environmental, government relations, and human resources disciplines and departments. It is anticipated that the primary focus of the Director workload will be (i) regional financial performance, and (ii) regional asset development and asset improvement related activities that can further advance the entire company portfolio. Notable areas of identified opportunities include moving up the waste hierarchy, bolt on treatment technologies to support the growth of our Environmental Solutions (profiled) waste business, effective ash management/reuse, enhanced metals recovery, and enhancement of our energy portfolio capabilities (profitability/efficiency/diversity of energy production). The Director must be able to originate and task a goal-oriented team of multi-disciplined managers in a way to harmoniously effectuate revenue growth and profit improvement of our asset base. This role will be the principal point of contact for reporting and discussing financial performance of the asset base within their jurisdiction. The Director must be able to engage in constructive dialogue and have a sound decision making process to achieve success in the role and for the company. On regular occasions, the Director will report to the Chief Commercial Officer on assets and financial performance. DUTIES/RESPONSIBILITIES · Profit and Loss management Asset Improvement & Asset Development focused on revenue and margin growth · Contract oversight & compliance Effective and prompt service delivery to Reworld customer base Implementation of market strategy, including merchant waste and client agreement contracting strategies Ability to manage and direct stakeholders at all levels – including internal and external senior executive and/or elected level decision makers. · Risk management Strategy development, Business Development and/or strategy implementation REQUIREMENTS (Education, Skills, Certificate, Licenses, Experience): Education: Business degree or strong technical degree combined with a well-developed operating background required. MBA with a bachelor’s in engineering or business/ finance preferred. Minimum of 7 years of waste/energy/production related industry experience in a senior management role required · Prior knowledge and experience managing profit and loss, budgets and forecasts in an industrial/production environment or commensurate experience in our existing Energy-from-Waste business required. Must possess strong business acumen Solid analytical, planning and organizational skills and ability to multi-task Highly developed verbal and written communication and negotiation skills Proactive thinking with detail-oriented and creative problem-solving approach Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships Exceptionally strong planning and interpersonal skills Developed executive presence; engaging personality and the confidence to make decisions Ability to build and maintain strong relationships with partners and government officials Strong strategic thinker with well-practiced negotiation skills Strong manager, team player with commensurate leadership skills Demonstrated ability to coordinate and execute in an operating business · Goal-oriented mindset What Reworld Offers You: Health Care Benefits - start 1st day of employment Performance based Annual Incentive Plan Wellness Program Incentives & Rewards · 401k - match up to 7% Paid Time Off (Vacation & Holiday) · Paid Parental Leave Short-Term & Long-Term Disability Benefits · Tuition Reimbursement · Employee Referral Bonus In addition to salary, this role is eligible for benefits. The benefits would include medical, prescription drug, vision, and dental plans; 401(k) plan; paid parental leave; paid time off; and paid holidays. Additional details are available at . title: (USA) Data Analyst II
description: Position Summary... What you'll do... Role summary: As a Data Analyst II, you will combine technical expertise and business acumen to support testing, release validation, and cross-product quality assurance. You will identify and analyze data discrepancies before deployment, helping prevent issues that impact Suppliers, Merchants, and other business partners. Working closely with Product, Engineering, and Support teams, you will validate business-critical metrics, translate complex defects into actionable solutions, and drive resolution efforts. Success in this role requires strong analytical skills, attention to detail, adaptability in a fast-paced environment, and a passion for advancing automation through agentic AI and innovative testing practices. About the team: The Data Quality and Testing teams at Data Ventures ensure data integrity and system resilience through thorough validations and comprehensive testing frameworks. Leveraging advanced machine learning, anomaly detection, and automation, they proactively identify irregularities and validate global data pipelines. Their certification and monitoring processes support continuous quality assurance and timely issue resolution across Walmart’s ecosystem. Collaborating with global stakeholders, these teams drive process enhancements, strengthen data governance, and accelerate innovation by delivering automated testing and data quality solutions that enable reliable, data-driven decision-making and support business growth. What you'll do: Support release validation, cross-product testing, and data quality assurance activities. Identify and analyze data discrepancies before deployment to prevent business-impacting issues. Validate business-critical metrics and investigate defects to ensure product quality and reliability. Partner with Product, Engineering, and Support teams to translate findings into actionable solutions and drive issue resolution. Leverage data analysis, automation, and agentic AI tools to improve testing efficiency and accelerate delivery. What you'll bring: Experience with software testing, release validation, and test automation using Playwright . Strong proficiency in SQL , Python , and cloud-based data platforms such as BigQuery . Ability to analyze data, identify defects, and validate business-critical metrics. Strong problem-solving and communication skills, with the ability to translate technical issues into actionable solutions. Experience working in cross-functional teams and a passion for automation, AI-driven tools, and continuous improvement. title: Lead Validation Engineer | Luma
description: Our Why At Dotmatics At Dotmatics , a Siemens company, we believe science, data, and decision-making must be deeply intertwined for innovation to thrive. Our Portfolio includes Luma, LumaLab Connect, ELN Platform, Graphpad Prism, Geneious, SnapGene, Protein Metrics, OMIQ, FCS Express, LabArchives, NQuery, EasyPanel, SoftGenetics and Virscidian. We have a vision for a new Lab of the Future that will change the future of scientific research. We have created the world’s most comprehensive digital science platform – best-of-breed software applications already used by more than 2 million scientists, together in a single ecosystem united by a powerful, flexible enterprise data platform. This is not flat data buried away in digital graveyards. This is dynamic, multi-dimensional decision-making. Scientific enterprises need a new level of effectiveness to achieve tomorrow’s breakthroughs. Illness will not wait. The biosphere will not wait. We are tireless in our vision, because the time for innovation is now. Shaping the Future of Science At Dotmatics Our global team of more than 800 colleagues are dedicated to supporting our customers in over 180 countries. Together, with our scientific community of users, we accelerate scientific innovation in order to make the world a healthier, cleaner, and safer place to live. You’ll join a collaborative, global team pushing the boundaries of scientific innovation. Your ideas and efforts will have a tangible impact, accelerating scientific progress and discovery. We offer a dynamic, remote-friendly environment that fosters high integrity and collaboration, empowering you to excel. Dotmatics is a company built by scientists, for scientists. Combined, we are now the world’s largest cloud-based scientific research R&D platform. We need your help to keep growing and pioneering the future. We are Science Driven. We are Customer Centric. We are Better Together. What do we need: As a Validation Lead, you will be responsible for leading validation activities for the Dotmatics Luma platform and its internal systems operating under GxP requirements. Serving as the subject matter expert for computer system validation (CSV) and ensures that software development, testing, and release activities comply with applicable regulations and standards including 21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11, GAMP 5, ICH Q10, and ISO 9001 as applicable. The Validation Lead partners closely with Product, Engineering, and Quality Management teams to drive validation best practices throughout the software development lifecycle (SDLC), ensuring traceable, audit ready deliverables that meet customer and regulatory expectations. In this role you will get to: Author, review, and approve validation lifecycle documentation including Validation Master Plans, URS, FRS, Traceability Matrix, Risk Assessments, IQ, OQ, PQ protocols and reports following GAMP 5 principles, including risk-based approaches to validation activities Working with the software quality team and devops to leverage automated tools such as Cypress to develop, review and run IQ, OQ, and PQ protocols. Apply GAMP 5 framework to determine appropriate validation strategies and documentation requirements. Mentor/lead junior validation team members and QA staff on validation methodologies and documentation best practices. Serve as Luma subject matter expert for GAMP5, 21 CFR Part, EU Annex 11, and applicable ISO standards. Provide validation guidance and training to engineers, QA analysts, and project managers on CSV principles, IQ/OQ/PQ expectations, and 21 CFR Part 11 controls. We are looking for people who can support customer-facing validation activities, coordinate validation testing and defect resolution, assist with CAPA investigations and audit responses, and collaborate with the Quality Management team to maintain document control, periodic reviews, and overall audit readiness for validation artefacts. The key skills we are looking for: Deep working knowledge of GAMP 5, 21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11, and GxP requirements as they apply to software systems Familiarity with ISO 9001quality management system principles Demonstrated experience authoring and executing IQ/OQ/PQ protocols, traceability matrices, and validation summary reports, including use of automated testing tools (e.g., Cypress, Playwright) to generate and capture test evidence Understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC) and Agile methodologies. Experience with validation of cloud-based systems, SaaS applications, or commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) software You may also have: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Biology, Chemistry, Engineering, or a related field (preferred but not required). Background in regulated life sciences environments, such as pharmaceutical, biotech, or medical device industries. Research shows us the confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting outstanding candidates, so please don’t hesitate to apply — we’d love to hear from you. By submitting your application, you agree that Dotmatics may collect your personal data for recruiting, global organization planning, and related purposes. Dotmatics Privacy Notice explains what personal information we may process, where we may process your personal information, our purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over Dotmatics use of your personal information. Dotmatics is an equal opportunity employer. We are a welcoming place for everyone, and we do our best to make sure all people feel supported and connected at work. Originally posted on Himalayas

title: Patient Strategy & Experience, Customer Experience Lead
description: Join us as we transform immunology and deliver medicines that help autoimmune patients get their lives back. argenx is preparing for multi-dimensional expansion to reach more patients through a rich pipeline of differentiated assets, led by VYVGART, our first-in-class neonatal Fc receptor blocker approved for the treatment of gMG, and with the potential to treat patients across dozens of severe autoimmune diseases. We are building a new kind of biotech company, one that maintains its roots as a science-based start-up and pushes our commitment to innovate across all corners of our business. We strive to inspire and grow our company, our partnerships, our science, and our people, because when we do, we deliver more for patients. As the Patient Customer Experience (CX) Lead, you are accountable for building and leading the discipline within the argenx Patient Strategy & Experience. You will establish how argenx understands, designs, delivers, and continuously improves the end-to-end experience of patients and caregivers across the enterprise portfolio, therapeutica areas, indications, brands, and stages of the patient journey. You will create the frameworks, methods, standards, and capabilities that enable argenx to translate patient needs, behaviors, and experiences into meaningful experience-related and business decisions. Through end-to-end journey design, voice-of-patient insights, Design Thinking (DT), Human-Centered Design (HCD), co-creation, experimentation, and rapid prototyping, you will identify the moments that matter most and help Patient Marketing and Engagement Strategy, Patient Support Services, Field Clinical Educators, Patient Advocacy, Media, and other cross-functional partners design optimal stakeholder experiences. As a member of the Patient Strategy & Experience leadership team, you will serve as the senior integrator of CX across communities. You will also connect with CX leaders and capabilities across argenx communities to share insights, build & strengthen repeatable models, and help advance a more connected experience across customer groups. This is a new capability for argenx , requiring a leader who can bring structure to ambiguity, build the discipline from the ground up, and influence leaders across the organization to translate patient insight into measurable improvements in the experience argenx delivers. ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES: Customer Experience Strategy & Voice of Patient Define and lead CX strategy and establish the CX discipline across all argenx patient services and communities. Develop and maintain an integrated, portfolio-level understanding of patient and caregiver journeys across disease areas, patient populations, and lifecycle stages. Establish repeatable approaches for journey mapping, patient personas, touchpoint and channel assessment, and identification of the moments that matter most across the patient experience. Define how patient insight and voice-of-patient inputs are gathered, synthesized, prioritized, and translated into strategic priorities and experience decisions. Identify experience opportunities, unmet needs, friction points, and gaps across patient journeys and translate them into clear recommendations for relevant communities and teams. Maintain a portfolio-level view of evolving patient needs and experiences, helping leadership determine where focused attention and investment can create the greatest impact. Ensure CX strategy remains connected to evolving patient, disease, market, scientific, and portfolio dynamics. Codify CX approaches and learnings into scalable frameworks and practices that can support patient-facing teams and, where relevant, inform broader CX efforts across argenx . Design Thinking, Experience Design & Experimentation Establish HCD/DT, including empathy research, co-creation workshops, and design sprints, as a core approach for developing, prototyping, testing, and improving CX concepts before they are deployed at scale. Lead journey design, concept development, co-creation, prototyping, and structured testing approaches that enable argenx to learn directly from patients and caregivers. Translate ambiguous or emerging opportunities into clearly defined experience challenges, hypotheses, pilots, and success measures. Build an experimentation model that allows new CX concepts to be tested, refined, and de-risked before broader investment and implementation. Identify opportunities to create differentiated patient experiences as argenx expands into new disease areas and patient populations. Partner with patient-facing teams and external specialists to apply experience design approaches where they can create the greatest value. Connect emerging scientific, medical, and portfolio developments to CX planning, so future experience needs are considered early rather than after strategies and programs are established. Bring a forward-looking perspective on experience innovation, identifying new approaches, technologies, and capabilities that could meaningfully improve how patients engage with argenx and our medicines. Cross-Community & Executive Leadership Serve as the senior CX integrator across Patient Marketing and Engagement Strategy, Patient Support Services, Field Clinical Educators, Patient Advocacy, and other relevant communities and teams. Translate patient journeys, voice-of-patient insights, and experience testing into clear, actionable recommendations for the teams responsible for designing and delivering patient programs and interactions. Influence leaders to act on CX opportunities while preserving clear accountability within individual communities and teams for strategy and execution. Partner closely with the Vice President, Patient Strategy & Experience, and represent CX directly in enterprise-wide strategic planning, portfolio governance, and executive leadership forums. Connect with CX leaders and capabilities across argenx communities to share insights, contribute to common experience principles and practices, and identify opportunities to strengthen consistency and connectivity across customer journeys. Build strong partnerships across Commercial, Medical, Digital & Technology, Insights & Analytics, Legal, Regulatory, Compliance, Clinical Trials, and other relevant communities and capabilities. Create effective ways of working across patient-facing teams to strengthen alignment, reduce experience fragmentation, and create a more connected end-to-end patient journey. Translate CX opportunities and insights into compelling business cases and recommendations that enable leadership action and investment decisions. Champion patient-centered thinking across the organization and help build understanding of how decisions made across communities contribute to the overall experience patients have with argenx and our medicines. Measurement, Technology & Customer Experience Capability Building Define the measurement approach for CX, establishing the outcomes and indicators needed to understand experience quality, impact, and improvement across the portfolio. Establish consistent approaches for measuring CX while allowing metrics to flex based on disease area, patient population, journey stage, and experience objective. Use CX data, qualitative insight, behavioral signals, and other relevant measures to identify opportunities for continuous improvement across key touchpoints and journeys. Bring an analytical and portfolio-level perspective to experience prioritization, ensuring resources and effort are focused where they can create the greatest patient and business impact. Partner with Digital & Technology and other teams to identify, design, and deploy technology and AI-enabled solutions that can meaningfully improve the experiences patients have with argenx and our medicines. Define the tools, frameworks, standards, and ways of working required to build a scalable CX capability, aligning with and contributing to broader customer experience approaches across argenx communities, where relevant. Build CX and HCD capability across patient-facing teams through training, coaching, and hands-on facilitation, so teams can increasingly apply patient-centered approaches within their own work. Establish external partnerships and specialist resources where needed to supplement internal capability and accelerate development of the discipline. Foster a culture of patient-centeredness, curiosity, experimentation, learning, and continuous improvement. SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES: Deep understanding of customer and CX strategy, experience design, Design Thinking (DT), and Human-Centered Design (HCD) within healthcare, life sciences, or other complex customer environments. Ability to develop end-to-end patient journeys and translate patient needs, behaviors, insights, and pain points into clear experience priorities and strategic recommendations. Strong practitioner fluency in DT/HCD approaches, including empathy mapping, journey mapping, persona development, co-creation, prototyping, testing, and iterative experience design. Ability to bring structure and strategic direction to ambiguous, early-stage opportunities where no established playbook exists. Strong portfolio thinking, with the ability to identify common experience needs while recognizing meaningful differences across disease areas and patient populations. Demonstrated ability to influence senior and executive stakeholders and leaders across communities without formal authority and align teams around shared CX priorities. Strong analytical orientation and ability to connect qualitative and quantitative patient insight to decisions, investment priorities, and measurable outcomes. Ability to translate complex CX findings into compelling, actionable business recommendations for senior leaders. Strong understanding of the opportunities and considerations associated with digital, data, technology, and AI in healthcare experience design. Strong understanding of the regulatory, legal, compliance, and privacy considerations associated with designing patient experiences in biotechnology and pharmaceutical environments. Strong communication, facilitation, and storytelling skills, with the ability to bring the CX strategies and opportunities to life for a range of audiences. Executive-level communication and presence, with the ability to represent CX in enterprise governance and portfolio forums. Entrepreneurial mindset and demonstrated ability to build new capabilities, approaches, or disciplines in an evolving organization. EDUCATION, EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS: BA/BS required; advanced degree preferred. Approximately 12-15+ years of relevant experience across Customer Experience, Human-Centered Design, Design Thinking, innovation, or related disciplines. Pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or healthcare experience required, with meaningful experience working in patient-facing environments strongly preferred. Demonstrated experience setting and leading CX, Innovation, or Human-Centered Design strategy within a complex organization. Track record of building or scaling a new capability, discipline, program, or way of working from the ground up. Significant experience applying HCD, journey mapping, patient/customer insight, and experimentation to improve experiences. Demonstrated success influencing senior leaders and cross-community teams in a highly matrixed environment. Experience translating customer or patient insight into strategic recommendations, business cases, and organizational action. Experience establishing measurement approaches and using insight and performance data to guide prioritization and continuous improvement. Experience partnering with Legal, Regulatory, Compliance, Medical, Digital/Technology, and other teams within a regulated environment. Innovation, entrepreneurial, or capability-building experience strongly preferred. CX and/or Human-Centered Design credentials are a plus but are not a substitute for demonstrated strategic leadership and experience. ‎ For applicants in the United States: The annual base salary hiring range for this position is $240,000.00 - $330,000.00 USD. This range reflects our good faith estimate at the time of posting. Individual compensation is determined using objective, inclusive, and job-related criteria such as relevant experience, skills, demonstrated competencies and internal equity. This means actual pay may differ from the posted range when justified by these factors. Because market conditions evolve, pay ranges are reviewed regularly and may be adjusted to remain aligned with external benchmarks. This job is eligible to participate in our short-term and long-term incentive programs, subject to the terms and conditions of those plans and applicable policies. It also includes a comprehensive benefits package, including but not limited to retirement savings plans, health benefits and other benefits subject to the terms of the applicable plans and program guidelines. title: Technical Consultant
description: Cayenta, a division of Harris ; is seeking a Technical Consultant who will join our Cayenta Managed Services (CMS) team within Managed Services & Technical Operations. As a Technical Consultant, you will help manage and maintain the technical environments that support our customers' Cayenta ERP and Customer Information Systems. You will work across system administration, database administration, troubleshooting, maintenance, monitoring, customer support, and eventually cloud infrastructure. This is a hands-on technical role for someone who enjoys solving problems, learning how systems work, and taking ownership of customer environments. You will initially focus primarily on on-premises customer environments, with opportunities to expand into Microsoft Azure infrastructure and cloud operations as the Managed Services offering continues to grow. You will work closely with other Managed Services team members as well as Cayenta Support, Technical Services, Development, Business Intelligence, and other teams to maintain reliable, secure, and stable customer environments. This may be the most important section of this job description. Read it carefully before applying. Technical knowledge can be developed. Curiosity, resourcefulness, and ownership are much harder to teach. We are looking for someone who is hungry to learn, willing to dig, and comfortable solving problems that don't come with step-by-step instructions. In Managed Services, you will encounter unfamiliar configurations, technical issues you haven't seen before, incomplete documentation, and situations where the first answer you try doesn't work. When you hit that wall, we don't expect you to already know everything. We do expect you to keep going. Search the internal knowledge base. Read the product and vendor documentation. Review previous tickets. Look at logs. Compare environments. Test safely. Ask knowledgeable teammates better questions. Use AI tools responsibly to help research, reason through possibilities, interpret information, and accelerate troubleshooting. If one path doesn't work, try another. And when you solve something new, document what you learned so the next person doesn't have to start from zero. We are not looking for someone whose troubleshooting process ends with "I checked the KB and couldn't find it." We are looking for someone who sees that as the beginning of the investigation. Ask yourself: when you last encountered a technical problem with no obvious answer, what did you do next? If your instinct was to follow every reasonable lead until you understood what was happening, you may be exactly who we're looking for. We are committed to using emerging technologies to improve how we work, solve problems, and support our customers. The successful candidate will be comfortable incorporating AI-enabled tools, copilots, chat-based assistants, scripting, and automation into their everyday work where appropriate. AI should accelerate good technical thinking-not replace it. Team members are expected to validate outputs, protect customer and company information, and follow applicable security, privacy, and compliance requirements. You will serve as a primary or secondary technical consultant for multiple Cayenta Managed Services customers and help ensure their environments remain reliable, secure, stable, and well maintained. This remote role welcomes candidates anywhere in Canada and the US. Salary: 75K - 85K CAD 53K - 61K USD AI & Innovation Mindset We are committed to leveraging emerging technologies to improve how we work, serve our customers, and drive business outcomes. The successful candidate will demonstrate curiosity and a willingness to actively adopt and leverage AI tools to improve workflows, solve problems, and increase efficiency. Candidates should be comfortable using AI enabled technologies, including copilots, chat based AI assistants, and automation tools, as part of their everyday work while maintaining appropriate judgment, security, and compliance standards. What your impact will be: Manage multiple Cayenta ERP and/or Customer Information System environments simultaneously. Perform SQL Server database administration and support environments that may also include Oracle. Perform system administration for customer application and infrastructure environments. Monitor customer environments and proactively address conditions that could affect availability, reliability, security, or performance. Troubleshoot technical issues, identify root causes, and coordinate resolution across teams when necessary. Manage technical work through our ticketing systems and maintain clear, accurate updates. Perform regular system administration activities including product releases, patching, updates, configuration changes, and maintenance. Build a strong understanding of each assigned customer's environment, configuration, dependencies, and operational requirements. Identify recurring problems and look for opportunities to eliminate them through better processes, automation, monitoring, or documentation. Build productive, long-term customer relationships and communicate technical information clearly and professionally. Prepare and deliver customer reporting containing relevant information about environment health, maintenance, risks, and activities when required. Participate in the team's 24x7 on-call rotation when required. Perform scheduled evening or weekend activities when customer maintenance windows require them. Growing Into Cloud Operations Help administer highly available Azure infrastructure supporting Cayenta applications. Maintain Linux and Windows virtual machines and related Azure services. Support Azure database, storage, networking, and security services. Configure and maintain services such as Azure Storage, Key Vault, Microsoft Entra ID, and single sign-on. Help ensure cloud environments are designed and administered with an emphasis on availability, reliability, security, recoverability, and scalability. Develop scripts and automation for deployment, monitoring, administration, and maintenance. Configure and maintain Windows Server and desktop operating systems. Support or co-lead disaster recovery planning, testing, and execution for Azure environments. Manage user access, permissions, authentication, and password management. Support Active Directory Group Policy and Microsoft Azure/Entra policies such as Conditional Access. Monitor cloud environments and help identify performance, capacity, security, and reliability concerns. Participate in cloud implementation or migration projects as your experience grows. Knowledge Sharing & Continuous Improvement Create, update, and improve internal technical documentation, runbooks, troubleshooting guides, and procedures. Document new solutions and lessons learned from unusual or complex technical issues. Participate in daily team discussions related to service delivery, deployments, customer environments, and operational improvements. Prepare and participate in knowledge-transfer and training sessions with other team members. Share discoveries and technical approaches that could benefit other customer environments. Look for processes that can be standardized, simplified, automated, or eliminated. Participate in internal projects that improve Managed Services tools, processes, monitoring, automation, or service delivery. Work collaboratively with Cayenta Support, Technical Services, Business Intelligence, Development, Product, and other teams to investigate and resolve complex issues. AI & Innovation Mindset Research an unfamiliar technical issue. Analyze logs or error messages. Develop or review scripts. Explore possible root causes. Improve documentation. Summarize technical findings. Automate repetitive administrative work. Identify better ways to monitor or maintain customer environments. What we are looking for: 3+ years of experience in technical support, system administration, managed services, infrastructure, database administration, or a related technical role; equivalent education and experience will also be considered. Experience with or strong working knowledge of Microsoft SQL Server. Working knowledge of system administration concepts in Windows and/or Linux environments. Some experience with or knowledge of Microsoft Azure. Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills. A demonstrated ability to investigate technical problems independently and work through unfamiliar issues. Curiosity and a desire to understand why something is happening rather than simply applying a workaround. Ability to work independently with minimal supervision while knowing when collaboration or escalation is appropriate. Strong customer-service mindset and the ability to develop trusted customer relationships. Comfort balancing multiple customer environments, priorities, and deadlines. Experience with Apache Tomcat, including configuration, hardening, and SSL certificates. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Strong time-management and organizational skills. Experience using Jira, TeamSupport, or comparable ticketing/work-management systems. Willingness to participate in weekend schedules or alternative workweeks when required, including Tuesday-Saturday or Sunday-Thursday schedules. Willingness to participate in an on-call rotation when required. A commitment to continuous learning, documentation, knowledge sharing, and improvement. Comfort responsibly using AI-assisted tools as part of technical investigation, research, scripting, documentation, and everyday work. What would make you stand out: Previous experience working in a Managed Services environment. Experience administering both Microsoft SQL Server and Oracle. Microsoft Azure administration or cloud infrastructure experience. Certifications such as CompTIA A+, Network+, Security+, Microsoft AZ-104, or AZ-305. Experience with virtualization technologies. Experience supporting highly available enterprise applications. Experience with scripting or automation using PowerShell, shell scripting, Azure CLI, or similar tools. Experience with infrastructure or application monitoring tools. Knowledge of TCP/IP networking, firewalls, certificates, DNS, and related infrastructure concepts. Experience supporting or delivering Azure implementations or migrations. Experience with identity and access management, including Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID. Experience explaining technical concepts to non-technical customers or stakeholders. Previous experience with enterprise software, ERP, CIS, or utility technology. Previous experience in the utility industry. What we can offer: 3 weeks’ vacation and 5 personal days Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits starting from your first day of employment Employee stock ownership and RRSP/401k matching programs Lifestyle rewards Remote work and more! About Cayenta: Cayenta is a leading provider of enterprise resource management solutions in the local government, utility and financial industries. Cayenta’s products, services and customer relationships provide the foundation for continued innovation and growth. About Harris : Harris is a leading provider of mission critical software to the public sector in North America. As a wholly owned subsidiary of Constellation Software Inc. (“CSI”, symbol CSU on the TSX), Harris has become the cornerstone for CSI’s investment in utility, local government, school districts, public safety, and healthcare software verticals. Our success has been realized through investments in our proprietary software and market expertise. This focus, combined with acquiring businesses that build upon or complement our offerings, has helped drive our success. Harris will continue to growth through reinvestment – both in the people and products that we offer and making investments in acquiring new businesses. Originally posted on Himalayas

description: Worley is a global professional services company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia. Preparation of specifications and provide procurement support. Discuss technical problems and communicate effectively with other project personnel and outside customers. Perform independent audits and reviews of technical work. Interface with other departmental staff, project management, and with outside customers. Ability to travel to job sites to perform site walkdown. Responsible for the quality assurance of the documents to the applicable drawing standards and responsible for the proper document management procedures are followed. Highly effective technical and practical engineering skills and ability to consistently deliver quality, accurate and timely work to Worley and its customers. A sound knowledge of the fundamental requirements of the electrical engineering, and the basic requirements of other engineering fields. A sound knowledge of applicable local and international standards and statutory and regulatory requirements. Competent use of electrical engineering specific software. Competent use of relevant software such as MS Office Suite. Substantial technical land practical experience in electrical engineering in the same or similar industry including experience in working in multi-disciplinary projects and teams. Experience working in project leadership role. Experience in estimating project costs and writing proposal content. Ideal candidate should have strong interpersonal and written communication skills that permit working efficiently alongside other senior substation engineers and designers in a team setting. Education – Qualifications, Accreditation, Training: Required: Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering and12 or more years of experience in substation design including supervisory experience. Coordinate contract-related deliverables, approvals, milestones, and stakeholder activities to ensure timely execution. Escalate issues proactively to minimize impact on timelines and business objectives. Manage action items and stakeholder follow-through to maintain deal velocity. Support overall contract pipeline health through accurate tracking, reporting, and operational discipline. Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Teams. Strong organizational, project management, and prioritization skills. Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to interact effectively across all organizational levels. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with a proactive approach to issue resolution. Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining exceptional attention to detail. Ability to maintain accurate documentation, reporting, and compliance records within enterprise systems. Experience supporting commercial contracts, customer-facing agreements, software/SaaS contracts, healthcare contracts, or procurement agreements. Experience working within regulated industries or highly governed business environments. Familiarity with contract review processes, governance frameworks, approval workflows, and compliance requirements. Experience with Agiloft or similar CLM platforms. Experience with Salesforce or comparable CRM systems. Experience supporting operational excellence, process improvement, or business transformation initiatives. Foster transparency, alignment, and shared accountability to move contracts efficiently through the lifecycle. Inspire Create trust through clear communication, proactive follow-up, and professional stakeholder engagement. Influence decisions and drive progress through collaboration and credibility rather than authority. Develop Continuously expand your contract management, compliance, and business operations expertise. Share best practices and contribute to a culture of learning and operational excellence. Execute Take ownership of outcomes, manage competing priorities effectively, and deliver on commitments. Ensure contracts progress efficiently while maintaining compliance, accuracy, and quality standards. Impact Identify process improvements that increase efficiency, reduce contract cycle times, and enhance stakeholder experiences. Contribute to scalable workflows and operational solutions that support company growth and customer success. Compliance with governance requirements and approval processes. High stakeholder satisfaction through proactive communication and coordination. Strong Agiloft data quality and record integrity. Regular collaboration with cross-functional teams across multiple time zones. Occasional participation in meetings outside standard business hours based on business needs. description: Horizon Blue Cross Blue Shield of New Jersey empowers our members to achieve their best health. For over 90 years , we have been New Jersey’s health solutions leader driving innovations that improve health care quality, affordability, and member experience. Our members are our neighbors, our friends, and our families. It is this understanding that drives us to better serve and care for the 3.5 million people who place their trust in us. When our employees bring their best and succeed, the Company succeeds. About the Role This role works closely with the Enterprise Business and Technology Solutions (EBTS) Division to develop, implement, and enhance processes that identify, assess, and remediate vulnerabilities across Horizon’s technology environment. The analyst is responsible for performing internal and external vulnerability assessments, managing vulnerability scanning programs, establishing security standards, and evaluating exceptions and false-positive findings. The position plays a key role in reducing organizational risk by partnering with technology teams to prioritize and remediate vulnerabilities, developing long-term security solutions, and supporting threat intelligence and threat hunting initiatives. The incumbent will stay current on emerging threats, industry standards, and security trends, providing regular updates and recommendations to leadership regarding risks requiring remediation. What You'll Do Develop and enhance vulnerability scanning strategies to ensure comprehensive coverage across Horizon’s enterprise environment. Conduct internal and external vulnerability assessments and validate scan results. Apply established vulnerability management standards to classify vulnerabilities based on severity, exploitability, and business risk. Categorize and prioritize assets according to criticality and organizational impact. Partner with EBTS teams to develop and execute vulnerability remediation plans in accordance with established service level agreements (SLAs). Track and report remediation activities to ensure timely resolution of identified vulnerabilities. Analyze emerging cyber threats and assess potential impacts to Horizon’s technology environment. Communicate current risk exposure, remediation efforts, and security recommendations to senior leadership and key stakeholders. Develop, maintain, and present weekly and monthly vulnerability management metrics and executive reports. Create, update, and maintain policies, standards, procedures, and process documentation related to vulnerability management and threat intelligence operations. Ensure security controls, policies, and standards are operating effectively to satisfy audit and regulatory requirements. Assist in the development and maturation of a threat hunting program by documenting threat scenarios, response playbooks, and use cases. Collaborate with internal teams to investigate, validate, and resolve vulnerability findings, false positives, and remediation exceptions. Support continuous improvement initiatives aimed at strengthening the organization’s overall cybersecurity posture What You Bring Education/Experience: High School Diploma or GED required. Bachelor's degree in Information Security, Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field preferred. Relevant experience may be considered in lieu of a degree. Experience: Minimum of five (5) years of Information Security experience required. At least three (3) years of experience focused on vulnerability identification, assessment, and remediation. Experience working within a large enterprise environment preferred. Experience supporting security audits, regulatory compliance reviews, and risk management programs preferred. Certifications: One or more of the following certifications is required or strongly preferred: CISSP (Certified Information Systems Security Professional) GCTI (GIAC Cyber Threat Intelligence) GIAC certifications CompTIA Security+ Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH) Knowledge: Strong understanding of cybersecurity frameworks and methodologies, including Cyber Kill Chain, Defense-in-Depth, and related security models. Comprehensive knowledge of vulnerability management and patch management processes and their respective remediation approaches. Deep understanding of indicators of compromise (IOCs), advanced persistent threats (APTs), cybercrime techniques, and attacker tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs). Knowledge of operating systems including Windows, Linux/Unix, and macOS. Experience with vulnerability management platforms such as Nessus, Qualys, InsightVM (Nexpose), or similar solutions. Knowledge of Center for Internet Security (CIS) benchmarks and Critical Security Controls. Familiarity with threat intelligence platforms and sources such as Recorded Future, ThreatConnect/ThreatStream, H-ISAC, NJCCIC, and similar resources. Understanding of audit, regulatory, and compliance requirements related to cybersecurity programs. Skills & Abilities: Proven ability to prioritize vulnerabilities and systems based on risk, asset criticality, and business impact. Experience utilizing CVSS scoring and risk-based vulnerability management methodologies. Strong analytical, investigative, and problem-solving skills. Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to present technical information to both technical and non-technical audiences. Experience creating executive-level dashboards, scorecards, and presentations using tools such as Microsoft PowerPoint, Visio, and Excel. Experience developing and documenting security processes, standards, and procedures. Ability to facilitate cross-functional collaboration and drive vulnerability remediation efforts across multiple teams. Experience negotiating remediation plans, exception requests, SLA extensions, and false-positive determinations. Strong project management, organizational, and time-management skills. Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. Demonstrated attention to detail and commitment to operational excellence. Self-motivated and capable of working independently while maintaining effective communication with stakeholders. Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build partnerships and influence outcomes across the organization. ​ Why Horizon? title: Manager, Production Services
description: When our values align, there's no limit to what we can achieve. At Parexel , we all share the same goal - to improve the world's health. Oversee clinical trial supply production workflows, ensuring projects remain on schedule and deliverables are achieved. Monitor operational progress, manage priorities, and provide escalation support for complex supply chain challenges. Support packaging, labeling, manufacturing support, batch documentation, and production planning activities. Ensure compliance with Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), Good Distribution Practices (GDP), regulatory requirements, and departmental procedures. Drive problem solving and mitigation planning to address project risks and timeline challenges. Support supplier compliance, quality metrics, training compliance, audits, inspections, CAPA activities, and continuous improvement initiatives. Contribute to operational excellence, process improvement initiatives, and lean management practices. Support business growth through participation in internal initiatives, client-facing activities, and strategic operational planning. Candidate Profile You'll thrive in this role if you bring: Strong leadership, problem-solving, and operational decision-making skills. Expertise in clinical trial supply chain operations and GMP-regulated environments. Experience supporting packaging, labeling, production planning, and clinical supply activities. The ability to influence teams, prioritize competing demands, and navigate operational challenges. Strong communication and collaboration skills with global cross-functional teams. A customer-focused mindset with a passion for delivering solutions that ultimately support patients. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Logistics, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent experience. Approximately 6 to 10+ years of experience in clinical trial supply chain, pharmaceutical production, clinical logistics, or a related regulated environment. Strong knowledge of Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) requirements and clinical supply chain operations. Experience with production planning, packaging design, labeling operations, and supply chain execution. Ability to identify risks, resolve operational issues, and implement mitigation strategies. Strong project management, organizational, and stakeholder management skills. Fluent English communication skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience within a Contract Manufacturing Organization (CMO) supporting clinical trial supplies. Previous people leadership or team management experience. Pharmaceutical Sciences educational background or equivalent pharmaceutical industry expertise. Experience leading global or geographically dispersed teams. Financial, budgeting, profitability, KPI, and forecasting experience. We offer a comprehensive benefits package to eligible employees, which includes paid time off, a 401(k) match, life insurance, health insurance, and additional benefit offerings in accordance with the terms of our applicable plans. title: KIPP Foundation, Senior Vice President, Growth
description: ABOUT THE ORGANIZATION KIPP Public Schools is a national network of tuition-free public charter schools that prepares students with the skills and confidence to create the future they want for themselves, their communities, and us all. We are a network of 279 schools, nearly 16,500 educators, and nearly 210,000 students and alumni. Our mission: Together with families and communities, we create joyful, academically excellent schools that prepare students with the skills and confidence to pursue the paths they choose—college, career, and beyond—so they can lead fulfilling lives and build a more just world. Our vision: Every child grows up free to create the future they want for themselves and their communities. The KIPP Foundation is a nonprofit organization that supports KIPP public charter schools across the country. The KIPP Foundation helps to develop outstanding educators to lead KIPP schools; provides tools and resources for excellent teaching and learning; promotes innovation; and facilitates the exchange of insights and ideas across KIPP and other public schools and organizations. To learn more about the KIPP Foundation, please visit . ABOUT OUR VALUES Excellent Results for Students: We value results over effort and know that our work is not finished until all students thrive. We maintain high expectations for self, team, and students. We drive outcomes by operating with agility, removing barriers, differentiating support, and prioritizing student-centered solutions—especially for those at the margins. Collective Impact: We are one team. We win together. We embody a one-team mindset by working collaboratively across teams, aligning goals, and leveraging the strengths of all teammates. We build trust-based relationships and ensure inclusive decision-making by engaging those closest to the work. We provide clarity through simple, repeatable systems and goals that enable transformational outcomes. Courageous Action: Our belief in what we can achieve is unwavering, fueling our optimism and commitment to overcome any challenge. We demonstrate an unwavering belief in students' potential and a commitment to addressing systemic inequities. We approach challenges with resilience, a solutions-focused mindset, and adaptability. We foster a psychologically safe environment centered on trust and accountability where feedback is encouraged. We leverage data to reflect on progress, own setbacks, celebrate successes, and continuously improve to maximize impact. ABOUT THE POSITION The SVP, Growth is a role with direct accountability for the success of work that impacts the entire KIPP network. This role sets the vision, goals, and strategy for KIPP’s growth function - stewarding the criteria and readiness frameworks that determine where growth should happen, shaping the long-term portfolio plan, and holding the network accountable for growing with rigor. Every new school, every expanded region, and every scale decision must be grounded in evidence, anchored in student outcomes, and designed to hold up over the long term. Reporting to the Chief Executive Officer, this role operates as a senior partner to the Chief Schools Officer and CEO—setting vision and strategy for the growth function and making network-level decisions on growth policy and priorities. The SVP is accountable for both defining the vision and ensuring its execution through their team. The SVP, Growth holds network-wide strategic accountability, partners with Chief-level leaders to make consequential organization-wide decisions, and manages one Senior Director of Growth. RESPONSIBILITIES Enterprise Growth Strategy & Vision Define and own KIPP’s enterprise-wide growth and scale strategy—including multi-year targets, portfolio priorities, and the conditions required for sustainable expansion. Set the vision and standards for how KIPP grows as a network, ensuring every scale decision is evidence-based, equity-centered, and aligned with the One KIPP strategy. Establish the methodology and criteria by which regions are tagged as viability risks and oversee an assessment of those regions to determine what’s required for long term sustainability and success. Serve as the primary senior voice on growth to the Chief Schools Officer, Chief of Regional Impact, CEO, and Board—providing strategic counsel, synthesizing landscape intelligence, and driving organizational alignment around growth priorities. Shape and steward cross-functional planning across the Office of the Chief Schools Officer and Chief of Regional Impact, ensuring that growth considerations are integrated into organizational and financial planning cycles. Regional Growth Leadership & Accountability Lead the Foundation’s partnership with regions pursuing opportunistic growth—driving strategy, ensuring accountability, and working through peer leaders for thought partnership and analytical support to translate ambition into executable plans. Establish and lead the progress-monitoring systems that keep growth plans on track; exercise sound judgment about when course correction is needed and escalate risks to the Chief of Regional Impact and C-suite. Identify cross-regional growth patterns, scale effective practices across the portfolio, and address systemic gaps—ensuring that what works in one region becomes a learning opportunity for the full network. Serve as the senior escalation point for regions on growth-related matters, exercising judgment about when issues require the attention of the Chief of Regional Impact, Chief Schools Officer, or CEO. People Management & Development Lead, develop and manage the performance of the Senior Director of Growth to drive regional growth partnerships, readiness assessment, and landscape analysis. Build a culture of accountability, learning, and continuous improvement. Represent the Growth function in executive decision-making forums, cross-functional planning, and Board-level growth updates—serving as a credible, compelling senior presence. SKILLS & MINDSETS Mission and Student Focus: Demonstrates passion and commitment to KIPP’s mission and possesses the desire and ability to uphold KIPP’s core values (Focus on Excellent Results, Collective Impact, and Courageous Action). Self Management: Demonstrated record of setting and achieving ambitious goals for their departments in complex or ambiguous environment; uses data, research, and analysis to set a high bar of excellence for goal setting; effectively distributes and redistributes work among direct reports, teammates, and teams to optimizes goal attainments; effectively sets and fosters a culture that enables and celebrates teammates’ achievements and goals attainment. Work Management: Sets a clear vision that ensures alignment of the team's work to organizational goals. Effectively prioritize and deliver work products that ensure sustainability and scalability of work. Develops and implements agile project plans that ensure cross functional collaboration and resource sharing to ensure achieving organizational goals; create and ensure systems are in place for knowledge management. Process Management: Able to build and align goals and project plans with organization priorities; Develops and codifies processes that promote coordination, efficiency and efficacy across KF and the Network; Prioritizes processes that ensure sustainability and scalability; ensures team is finding efficiencies through process implementation and improvement, resource sharing, or other methods. Data-Driven Actions and Decisions: Effectively uses data to shape teamwide decisions and the learning agenda or evaluation of a function or significant initiative. Able to generate, implement, and evaluate solutions with a focus on scalability and sustainability. Communication and Change Management: Effectively articulates case for change to multiple functions, teams, and/or offices through clear and compelling presentations, tailoring communications and engagement approach for different audiences. Effectively translates vision into actionable plans among across team stakeholders; Champions KF and networkwide change with all stakeholders. Collaboration: Identifies and leverages opportunities with both internal and external stakeholders to increase impact. Leads successful collaboration across functions and evolves plans to get strong results. Has the interpersonal, diplomatic, relationships building and communication skills to connect and compel teammates across different functions to collaborate effectively toward shared goals. People Management & Development: Effectively ensures strong professional development and coaching for teammates directly and through layers. Proficient in the mechanics of succession management and performance management for teammates. Skilled at fostering a positive team culture in which teammates feel ownership and accountability for their own and the broader team’s work and results. Requirements EXPERIENCE & QUALIFICATIONS 12+ years of progressive experience in strategy, growth, and network development, or related enterprise leadership roles, ideally in K-12 education or a comparable mission-driven environment. Proven track record of managing and developing people managers across nested teams of 4 or more direct reports with measurable impact on their performance and the organizational outcomes they drive. Demonstrated ability to set vision, goals, and strategy for a function or multiple functions with executive-level autonomy, and to translate that vision into accountable execution through a team. Direct accountability for network-wide strategic priorities with demonstrated outcomes that impacted all regions or the full network. Proven track record of designing and maintaining readiness or assessment frameworks grounded in data, and translating quantitative and qualitative inputs into clear recommendations that drive network-wide organizational accountability. Strong analytical and strategic skills, including landscape analysis, financial modeling, and the ability to synthesize complex information into crisp strategic narratives for executive and Board audiences. Demonstrated executive presence and ability to make network-level decisions with autonomy while serving as a credible senior thought partner to C-suite leaders and regional boards. Demonstrated record of partnering with regional or field-based leaders to translate national strategy into executable plans tailored to local context, while maintaining network-wide coherence. Experience in K-12 education, charter school growth, or a comparable mission-driven environment strongly preferred. WORK CONDITIONS Travel requirements: High Travel: 21-30% (40-60 days per year) Job Type: Full time, Exempt LOCATION It is preferred, but not mandatory for this role to be based out of a KIPP Foundation office. This role has the option of working from a remote office full-time. KIPP Foundation offices are in NYC and Chicago. Benefits COMPENSATION & BENEFITS In compliance with local law, we are disclosing the compensation, or a range thereof, for roles in locations where legally required. Actual salaries will vary based on several factors, including but not limited to external market data, internal equity, and relevant experience. The salary range for this position is $249,600 - $295,000. In addition, KIPP Foundation provides a variety of benefits to employees, including: 25 holidays for + 18 days additional flexible PTO days (flexible PTO increases to 23 days for years 3 and 4 and to 28 days for years 5+). 100% paid parental leave 100% coverage of the premium for employees and 75% for employee + family’s medical/dental/vision plans. Wellness benefits such as fitness reimbursements, discounted tickets to theme parks/attractions, backup care support for children and adults/elders, and our employee assistance program Finance Security benefits include such as a 401K retirement plan with 4% match, employer-sponsored legal plans, life/disability insurance, and flexible spending accounts TO APPLY Please submit a resume online at KIPP Foundation embraces the opportunity to build a workforce that reflects the diversity of the students and communities with whom we work and the world that’s around them. Being an equal opportunity employer means that we take seriously our responsibility to consider qualified candidates on the basis of merit, without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, mental or physical disability, and genetic information, marital status, citizenship status, military status, protected veteran status or any other category protected by law. title: National Coordinator

This national role operates within multiple markets across the country and requires a high degree of professional judgment, industry knowledge, and the ability to coordinate effectively across internal partners, customers, and third-party vendors. Overtime opportunities may be available based on business needs and operational demand. While overtime is not a regular requirement of the role, employees may occasionally be asked to work additional hours. Essential Responsibilities Service Coordination and Dispatch Manage the complete event lifecycle for preventative maintenance, towing, and unscheduled/emergency service events, from initial client request to repair-completion Ensure that technicians receive all service events quickly, and request additional work when needed Re-assign previous events that were not completed during the first assignment Assess each service event and dispatch to achieve the best results for the client Assign work with an eye toward time-based KPIs Identify gaps in KPI performance, and work with local leaders to address those gaps Audit open work requests across multiple markets for compliance with daily-update requirements Monitor open events, track estimated arrival times, and communicate proactively with customers and leadership regarding delays or service concerns Customer and Stakeholder Communication Communicate with all parties to ensure work is prioritized and completed, and that all parties remain fully informed on status along the way. The right candidate could also have a different combination, such as any level degree/certification beyond a HS diploma/GED and 3 years’ experience. Working knowledge of fleet maintenance operations, trucking industry standards, and transportation logistics Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities Proficient oral and written communication skills with the ability to interact professionally across all levels of the organization Demonstrated ability to manage multiple concurrent service events and shifting priorities in a remote, fast-paced environment Strong interpersonal and diplomacy skills; able to build productive relationships and influence outcomes across varied stakeholder groups without direct authority Ability to remain composed and solution-oriented when managing frustrated customers or complex service scenarios Proficiency with MS Office applications, email platforms, and dispatch or fleet management systems Basic mathematical competency including calculation with whole numbers, fractions, and decimals Strong organizational skills with attention to detail and consistent follow-through across multiple simultaneous tasks Preferred Qualifications Experience in the automotive repair, fleet maintenance, or trucking and transportation industry Familiarity with Cox Automotive platforms or Cox Fleet operational systems Experience operating across multiple geographic markets or service regions Drug Testing To be employed in this role, you’ll need to clear a pre-employment drug test. However, we are a drug-free workplace, so the possession, use or being under the influence of drugs illegal under federal or state law during work hours, on company property and/or in company vehicles is prohibited. Benefits Employees are eligible to receive a minimum of 6.67 hours of paid time off every month and seven paid holidays throughout the calendar year. Employees are also eligible for additional paid time off in the form of bereavement leave, time off to vote, jury duty leave, volunteer time off, military leave, and parental leave. Cox Automotive employees get to work on iconic consumer brands like Autotrader and Kelley Blue Book and industry-leading dealer-facing companies like vAuto and Manheim, all while enjoying the people-centered atmosphere that is central to our life at Cox. title: AI Solutions Engineer
description: We believe in bold ideas, diverse perspectives, and the drive to transform knowledge into impact. We are a culture that obsesses over impact, challenges, and drives what’s next to power infinite possibilities for our customers, colleagues and society at large. About the Role: Wiley Research is building new AI-powered capabilities across its operations — but the gap between deploying enterprise AI tools and genuinely changing how the business works remains large. Closing that gap requires someone who can move between business problem and technical solution: a developer who understands what the business needs, knows how to build it, and can deliver working tools quickly enough to prove their value before momentum is lost. The Engineer, Business Solutions is that person. Working within the Business Management & Strategic Programs team, this role designs, builds, and deploys AI-powered tools and workflow automations that address real operational problems identified by the BMSP team and its partners across Research. The focus is on practical impact: automations that reduce manual effort, AI-assisted tools that improve decision quality, integrations that connect systems that currently require human intermediation, and rapid prototypes that let business teams test new approaches before committing to them at scale. This role operates at the core of the BMSP team's crew model — working in 90-day sprints alongside the Associate Directors and Project Manager to identify problems, build solutions, and release them to the business. The developer is the technical engine of that model: the person who takes a well-scoped problem from the team and turns it into a working tool in weeks, not quarters. Speed, pragmatism, and business empathy are as important here as technical skill. The right candidate is a developer who is genuinely excited about the intersection of AI and business operations — someone who finds as much satisfaction in solving a workflow problem for a publishing team as in writing clean code. They are comfortable working with non-technical stakeholders, translating vague business needs into defined requirements, and explaining technical trade-offs in plain language. They bring strong hands-on experience with LLM APIs, automation platforms, and the Microsoft 365 ecosystem, and are energized by a team that moves fast and iterates constantly. Responsibilities 1. AI Tool Development & Deployment Design, build, and deploy AI-powered tools and workflow automations that address business problems identified by the BMSP team and Research leadership — delivering working solutions within the 90-day sprint cadence. Develop integrations between Wiley 's existing systems (SharePoint, Teams, CRM, publishing platforms) and AI capabilities — enabling automated data flows, intelligent document processing, and AI-assisted decision support. Build rapid prototypes and minimum viable products that allow business teams to validate new approaches quickly, before full development investment is committed. Ensure that deployed tools are reliable, well-documented, and maintainable — with clear handoff to operational teams who will sustain them beyond the sprint in which they were built. 2. Business Problem Analysis & Solution Design Work closely with the Associate Directors and Project Manager to understand business problems, translate them into technical requirements, and design solutions that are both technically sound and practically adoptable. Participate in sprint planning and retrospectives — contributing the technical perspective to problem scoping, effort estimation, and solution evaluation, and helping the team make informed decisions about what to build and what to defer. Identify where automation and AI can reduce low-value manual effort across Research operations — proactively surfacing opportunities to the team and building the business case for development investment. Evaluate and recommend AI tools, platforms, and third-party services that could accelerate BMSP's solution delivery — balancing capability, cost, security, and ease of integration with Wiley 's enterprise environment. 3. Cross-Functional Collaboration & Delivery Partner with teams across Research — Publishing Operations, AI & Data Analytics, Finance, and others — to understand their workflows, identify integration points, and build solutions that work within the constraints of their existing systems. Coordinate with Wiley 's Technology & Operations teams to ensure that BMSP-developed tools comply with enterprise security, data governance, and IT standards — navigating the approval and deployment process without losing development momentum. Communicate technical concepts, trade-offs, and progress clearly to non-technical stakeholders — ensuring that business partners understand what is being built, what it will and will not do, and when it will be ready. 4. Learning, Documentation & Continuous Improvement Stay current with the rapidly evolving AI tooling landscape — evaluating new models, frameworks, and platforms as they emerge and identifying those most relevant to Wiley Research's use cases. Document solutions, architectures, and integration patterns clearly — building a technical knowledge base that supports future development and allows other team members to understand and maintain what has been built. Contribute to the BMSP team's retrospective practice — capturing lessons from each sprint, identifying what accelerated or impeded delivery, and recommending adjustments to improve the team's development velocity over time. Requirements Mandatory 3–6 years of software development experience, with increasing focus on AI and automation tooling in an enterprise environment. Strong proficiency in dataflow programming or frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, Caffe, MXNet, or Cognitive Toolkit, and may develop scripts in Python, Java, C++, Go, or equivalent languages; experience building and deploying web-based tools, APIs, or automated workflows in a business context. Hands-on experience with large language model APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI, or equivalent) — including prompt engineering, RAG architectures, function calling, and agent frameworks. Experience with automation and integration platforms (Microsoft Power Automate, n8n, Zapier, or equivalent) and comfort working within the Microsoft 365 ecosystem (SharePoint, Teams, Power Platform). Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous business problems into defined technical requirements and working solutions — without requiring a formal specification to get started. Strong communication skills: able to explain technical concepts and trade-offs to non-technical audiences clearly and without condescension. Comfort working in a fast-paced, iterative environment where requirements evolve and speed of delivery matters as much as technical elegance. Preferred Experience with vector databases, embeddings, and retrieval-augmented generation for enterprise knowledge management or search applications. Familiarity with MLOps practices and tools (containerization, cloud deployment, monitoring) for maintaining AI tools in production. Experience in publishing, media, information services, or a comparable content-driven industry — familiarity with editorial, content production, or rights management workflows is an advantage. Experience with data visualization and dashboard tooling (Power BI, Tableau, or equivalent) to support analytics and reporting use cases. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline — or equivalent practical experience. We power infinite possibilities. For more than 200 years, we've transformed knowledge into discoveries that shape the world. Today, our global team of innovators, creators, and experts is driving what's next in science, education, and publishing—creating impact that reaches everywhere. We're not just observers of progress. We're the ones accelerating scientific breakthroughs, advancing learning, and sparking innovation that redefines entire fields and improves lives. Here, your talent matters.
