title: VP, Data Strategy & Governance
description: Become a part of our caring community The Vice President, Data Strategy & Governance is a senior executive accountable for defining, advancing, and operationalizing the enterprise data strategy. This leader drives the full lifecycle of data governance — from policy design and sensitive data management to technology enablement, data quality, and regulatory compliance. Serving as a strategic advisor to executive stakeholders across all business units and technology functions, the VP partners closely with Cybersecurity, Enterprise Architecture, and line-of-business leaders cultivate a data-rich, AI-ready environment grounded in trust, quality, and accountability. The VP is a visionary organizational builder who attracts and develops world-class talent, shapes data culture, and influences enterprise-wide change. This individual would need to partner across business and technology leaders to drive a product mindset and promote adoption to realize business outcomes. This leader will promote a data product operating model by embedding accountability for data quality, metadata, lineage, access, and data lifecycle management across the enterprise. This leader brings deep command of applied data governance practices, data protection strategies, emerging ML/AI-based governance tools, and the legislative landscape governing personal and sensitive data. Their work directly enables the organization's digital and analytics ambitions while fortifying its cyber-breach resistance posture. Key Responsibilities Strategic Initiatives & Program Outcomes Establish and own the enterprise data strategy, translating organizational goals into a continuously evolving roadmap of data capabilities spanning people, process, technology, and budget. Lead portfolio governance of enterprise data programs, ensuring initiatives are prioritized, resourced, and delivering measurable business outcomes aligned to financial and strategic objectives. Partner with the Chief Data & Analytics Officer and executive peers to articulate the value of data assets, influence investment decisions, and embed data thinking into enterprise planning cycles. Drive enterprise-scale data science and AI readiness by ensuring foundational data infrastructure, lineage, quality, and accessibility meet the demands of advanced analytics and generative AI use cases. Develop and maintain a data product mindset across the organization — enabling reusable, trusted, and well-documented data assets that accelerate time-to-insight across business units. Team Building & Organizational Development Build, lead, and continuously develop a high-performing, world-class team of experts spanning sensitive data governance, data lineage and mapping, data enrichment, data quality, data democratization, and program management. Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, and continuous learning; champion data literacy initiatives that upskill the broader organization and democratize access to trusted data. Act as a Culture Shaper and Talent Builder — recruiting diverse, senior talent, establishing clear career pathways, and mentoring future data leaders across the enterprise. Operate as a cross-functional influencer and collaborator, building strong relationships across Technology, Cybersecurity, Legal, Compliance, Finance, and business unit stakeholders to drive data governance adoption at scale. Define team operating models, performance metrics, and OKRs that demonstrate the strategic and financial impact of the data governance function. Technology Implementations & Tools Lead evaluation, selection, and implementation of enterprise data governance platforms, data catalog and marketplace solutions, data quality tooling, and metadata management systems. Modernize data scanning, automated tagging, and labeling capabilities to improve governance efficiency, enable proactive data classification, and strengthen data loss prevention (DLP) outcomes. Partner with Security Architecture and Enterprise Architecture to design and deploy solutions that deliver integrated data governance and data security at scale — on-premises and across cloud environments. Invest in and operationalize innovative ML/AI-based approaches for data governance, including automated lineage discovery, anomaly detection, synthetic data generation, and differential privacy techniques. Maintain awareness of the evolving data governance technology landscape; drive a buy/build/partner strategy that balances innovation with cost discipline and commercial accountability. Data Governance Process Improvements Operate and continuously enhance enterprise data governance capabilities — including metadata management, data lineage, data quality standards, master data management, and access governance — through a structured and measurable capability roadmap. Define, publish, and enforce enterprise data policies, standards, and controls ensuring consistent, compliant, and high-quality data usage across all business domains. Champion data democratization by enabling self-service data access models backed by robust governance guardrails, role-based access controls, and data marketplace infrastructure. Establish data stewardship programs and data domain ownership models that distribute accountability for data quality and governance across the enterprise. Drive continuous improvement of data anonymization, de-identification, and synthetic data capabilities to enable broader analytics use while protecting sensitive information. Risk Management & Compliance Lead the enterprise Data Risk Assessment program, identifying, measuring, and managing data security risks across applications, platforms, and business and technology initiatives. Ensure the organization's data practices comply with applicable data privacy regulations and industry standards, including HIPAA, CCPA/CPRA, GDPR, and other relevant legislation governing personal and sensitive data. Collaborate with Legal, Compliance, and Cybersecurity to proactively identify regulatory changes, assess their data governance implications, and implement controls before compliance deadlines. Strengthen data protection strategy and execution — including encryption, tokenization, data masking, data loss prevention, and access control frameworks — to improve cyber-breach resistance. Provide executive reporting and Board-level transparency on data governance risk posture, compliance status, and program maturity metrics on a recurring basis. Use your skills to make an impact Key Requirements Experience 10+ years of senior leadership experience in data governance, data management, or data strategy roles within large, complex, matrixed corporate environments. 10+ years of hands-on data governance experience, including both on-premises and cloud-native environments (AWS, Azure, GCP or equivalent). Demonstrated track record of building and scaling data governance programs from concept through enterprise adoption, with measurable improvements in data quality, compliance, and business outcomes. Proven experience managing and delivering large, multi-workstream programs — including strategic initiatives, technology implementations, and organizational transformation — on time and within budget. Prior hands-on experience and/or leadership responsibility for technical data governance tools, including data catalogs, data lineage platforms, data marketplace systems, and data quality frameworks. Relevant experience in consumer goods, healthcare, financial services, or technology industries strongly preferred. Technical & Domain Knowledge Deep expertise in data architecture, data warehousing, data quality processes, and enterprise data modeling. Relevant experience with data protection strategies, including encryption, tokenization, data masking, data loss prevention, and role-based access control design. Working knowledge of cybersecurity assessment methodologies and data security controls, with experience partnering with CISO and Security/Enterprise Architecture functions. Familiarity with ML/AI-based data governance approaches, including automated metadata tagging, anomaly detection, synthetic data generation, and differential privacy. Strong command of data privacy regulations including HIPAA, CCPA/CPRA, GDPR, and related legislative frameworks. Champion and drive a product mindset across the enterprise data and analytics, treat data as a strategic asset and managing data products through their full lifecycle to maximize business value, adoption, quality and reuse. Leadership & Influence A visionary Culture Shaper, Talent Builder, Results Driver, Systems Thinker, and Accountability Partner who engages and aligns the broad enterprise toward common data goals. Exceptional executive presence and communication skills; able to translate complex data concepts into clear, compelling narratives for C-suite, Board, and business stakeholders. Strong evidence of the ability to introduce emerging technologies and develop analytics-based capabilities while maintaining cost awareness and commercial strategy. Proven ability to drive enterprise-wide change in matrixed organizations through influence, coalition-building, and stakeholder management without direct authority. Leadership Competencies Culture Shaper Actively builds an inclusive, high-trust data culture. Champions data literacy, promotes ethical data use, and sets behavioral expectations that reinforce accountability and transparency. Talent Builder Recruits, develops, and retains diverse, world-class talent. Creates clear career pathways, coaches emerging leaders, and builds bench strength across the data governance organization. Results Driver Sets ambitious goals and holds self and team accountable. Translates strategy into executable plans, tracks progress with rigor, and delivers measurable financial and operational impact. Systems Thinker Understands interconnections across data, technology, process, and people. Designs holistic governance frameworks that scale and anticipate second-order effects on the enterprise. Influential Collaborator Builds trust and credibility across business and technology functions. Uses data to persuade, aligns diverse stakeholders around shared priorities, and navigates complex political dynamics with integrity. Strategic Innovator Brings intellectual curiosity and market awareness. Proactively identifies emerging technologies and governance practices, translating external trends into competitive organizational advantage. Education Advanced degree (Master's or higher) in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Management, Statistics, Mathematics, Law, Cybersecurity, or a related field required. Will work with internal resources and external agencies to develop cases and corrective actions as well as respond to requests for data and support. An investigator uses good judgment and may work independently with minimum supervision and direction. The investigator also may work as part of a team as there may be times when the investigator needs to work with state and/or federal investigators and other personnel. An investigator handles multiple caseload assignments concurrently; organizes and analyzes complex evidentiary patterns; interviews and obtains statements from witnesses and others. Investigators may also be required to complete complex investigative reports that apply regulations or rules to the program(s) affected by the behavior being investigated. There may also be times when the investigator will need to apply federal or state laws. Investigators are expected to research and understand the relevant offenses being investigated; conduct efficient and effective investigations concerning those alleged offenses and detect or verify suspected violations; obtain information and evidence by observation, record examination, and interview. Investigators then analyze the results of the investigation to ascertain if the allegations have been corroborated and work with others to determine the appropriate steps that need to be taken to address the issues. As part of an investigation, the investigator will need to prepare correspondence; be objective and accurate and communicate with others with tact. There may be times when investigators need to react to unplanned situations, be flexible in planning their activities and adopt effective courses of action. As investigators will be working with health privacy information, they also must maintain confidentiality and understand all the laws, rules and regulations concerning health privacy. title: Member of Technical Staff, Agentic AI Architect
description: Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all . Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever. Job Summary – Member of Technical Staff - Agentic AI Architect, Smart Manufacturing AI Pathfinding & Innovation (AIPI) Join an inclusive team passionate about one thing: using their expertise in the relentless pursuit of innovation for customers and partners. The memory solutions we build help make everything from virtual reality experiences to breakthroughs in neural networks possible. We do it all while committing to integrity, sustainability, and giving back to our communities. Because doing so can fuel the very innovation we are pursuing. The Smart Manufacturing and AI team at Micron Technology is looking for an ambitious engineer (Member of Technical Staff | MTS) to deliver industry-winning Agentic AI solutions that power Micron’s dominance in the highly competitive memory solutions market. This role sits at the intersection of applied Agentic AI engineering and production systems work: you will architect autonomous AI Agents and the agentic and data pipelines that power them, build robust CI/CD deployment paths to Kubernetes and containers, and push the limits of agent performance profiling and evaluation to turn massive data and compute into measurable manufacturing impact. Qualified applicants will have experience across data/cloud technologies and systems engineering, with extensive practice modeling data, querying, and deploying scalable pipelines to execute AI agents. You will collaborate with Data Scientists, Data Engineers and expert users to build and deploy scalable Agentic AI solutions that drive value and insight from Micron’s manufacturing processes and systems. If you enjoy solving hard problems at scale, thrive on turning speculative research into production-grade systems, and want to see your work drive silicon to market, this is the team for you. Responsibilities include, but not limited to: Design and develop autonomous AI Agents capable of multi-step reasoning, planning, and tool execution to automate complex manufacturing workflows. Implement Agentic frameworks to orchestrate LLM interactions with internal APIs, databases, and software tools. Build and maintain agent evaluation harnesses to benchmark agent accuracy, reliability, and task success across complex, multi-step workflows. Analyze and profile agent and inference workloads (e.g., tool-calling latency, multi-agent orchestration) to identify and resolve bottlenecks in compute and latency, using agent observability and profiling tools (e.g., PyTorch Profiler, LangSmith, OpenTelemetry). Implement interoperable multi-agent systems using the Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocol and the Model Context Protocol (MCP), including MCP tools, plugins, and skills. Create/maintain CI/CD pipelines for deploying AI Agents to Kubernetes and containerized environments in the cloud. Design and implement security controls for autonomous AI Agents, including sandboxing, access control, and mitigation of prompt-injection and tool-misuse risks. Mentor engineers on agentic system design paradigms and optimization techniques. Education Qualifications: Technical Degree required (Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, Statistics, or a related field). Ph.D. is a plus. Minimum Qualifications: Experience optimizing inference engines (vLLM, TensorRT-LLM) for autonomous AI Agent and LLM workloads. Experience developing GenAI applications and AI Agents using one or more frameworks. Microsoft Agent Framework or Google Agent Development Kit preferred. Proficiency with Large Language Models (LLMs), including prompt engineering, function calling/tool use, and Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning. Experience designing and implementing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, including document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, and vector search. Experience building and operating end-to-end systems that automate the testing, evaluation, and deployment of autonomous AI Agents. Familiarity with MCP (Model Context Protocol) tools, plugins, and skills, and the Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocol for building interoperable multi-agent systems. Understanding of AI Agent security practices, including sandboxing, access control, and mitigating prompt-injection and tool-misuse risks. Familiarity with machine learning frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn, etc). Strong scripting and programming skills, with software development skills and a desire to work in a cloud environment. 8+ years of relevant industry experience, spanning large-scale data/ML pipelines and/or production Agentic AI systems. Outstanding analytical thinking, interpersonal, oral, and written communication skills. Ability to prioritize and meet critical project timelines in a fast-paced environment. Experience with Kubernetes for orchestrating containerized applications, including deployment and scaling of AI Agent workloads. Preferred Qualifications: Experience designing and coordinating Multi-Agent Systems, including collaboration between specialized agents. Experience designing and operating agent swarms for distributed, parallelized task execution. Experience with agent profiling and evaluation tooling to identify performance regressions and bottlenecks across agent pipelines. Hands-on experience with LangChain, LangGraph, or CrewAI. Proficiency in TypeScript and/or Rust. Demonstrated ability to study and transform data science prototypes into production solutions. Knowledge of computer vision and/or signal processing, including techniques for classification and feature extraction. As a world leader in the semiconductor industry, Micron is dedicated to your personal wellbeing and professional growth. Micron benefits are designed to help you stay well, provide peace of mind and help you prepare for the future. We offer a choice of medical, dental and vision plans in all locations enabling team members to select the plans that best meet their family healthcare needs and budget. Micron also provides benefit programs that help protect your income if you are unable to work due to illness or injury, and paid family leave. title: Talent Acquisition Coordinator
description: Epoch AI is looking for a Talent Acquisition Coordinator to keep our hiring accurate, organized, and responsive as we grow. About the Role We are looking for a Talent Acquisition Coordinator to own the administrative and data backbone of hiring at Epoch. You will report to the Head of People and work alongside our recruiters, hiring managers, and our People Operations and Finance teams. Epoch has grown from roughly 20 people to 70 during 2026, with staff employed across North and South America and Europe. That pace produces a large volume of candidates, interviews, work tests, and records, and the quality of our hiring decisions depends on that volume being handled carefully. Much of your first year will go to making our applicant tracking system reliable, our reporting usable, and our candidate experience consistent. The role covers data hygiene and reporting in our applicant tracking system, candidate communications, administration of work tests and skills assessments, and administrative support to recruiters as needed. As you settle in, you will have the opportunity to take on application review and talent sourcing, which makes this a strong fit for someone who wants to move into a recruiter role over time. Recruiting volume ebbs and flows. When hiring slows, you will support the People Operations team as the organization's needs shift, which will give you exposure to the wider employee lifecycle. Practicalities Location Global Remote Work Hours Flexible, with availability required from 8:30AM - 10:00 AM PST/ 5:30PM - 7:00PM CET Travel Requirement Employees are expected to attend our 3 in-person retreats each year Compensation Annual salary of $78k - $95k USD. Exact salary will reflect experience and location. Salaries are not restricted to USD; contracts and payments are usually in local currencies, converted at one-year average exchange rates Benefits Comprehensive health insurance program, including supplemental benefits specific to a local country, as available and mandated by local law Life insurance and retirement contributions plan, if applicable in your country Unlimited PTO with a recommend minimum of 30 days off per year (including public local holidays and vacation time) Unlimited personal and sick leave Parental leave — up to 4 months of paid leave for permanent staff with at least 12 months of tenure, prorated for those with less tenure, to be taken within the first year after a child’s birth or adoption A flexible and generous expense policy for you to spend on equipment and a large range of productivity tools or learning/development opportunities you might find valuable, subject to regulations and manager approval. Other benefits as allowed at the discretion of Epoch AI ’s leadership and local availability Reports to Head of People Start Date As soon as the successful candidate is available Application Deadline Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. We encourage you to apply early What You'll Own Applicant tracking system and reporting Own the accuracy of our applicant tracking system: duplicate records, stalled pipelines, missing feedback, mislabelled stages, and candidates sitting in the wrong place Set up each hiring round in the system, including stages, interview kits, feedback forms, and permissions Maintain and improve templates Post roles to our careers page and to external boards and communities Maintain an up-to-date hiring tracker Produce regular reporting on pipeline volume, time to hire, stage conversion, and source of applicants Own ATS integrations with support from the IT team Work tests and skills assessments Own the administration of work tests and skills assessments end to end: issuing them, tracking what comes back, getting responses in front of reviewers, and ensuring candidates get paid Assist with the drafting, formatting and filing of skills assessments Administrative support to recruiters Manage the careers inbox: answer basic candidate questions, route what needs a decision, and ensure timely responses to candidates Assist recruiters with sending status updates, rejections, and next-step instructions to candidates as required Schedule interviews across time zones, working around interviewer calendars and candidate constraints Take on other administrative work that keeps active rounds moving Growth into recruiting, and People Operations support As you settle in, gain exposure to application review against agreed criteria and to sourcing candidates for open roles As recruitment volume ebbs and flows, as capacity allows you will assist the People Operation team, offering exposure to the full employee lifecycle. About You Must Haves 1-3 years in a coordination, administrative, or operations role, ideally supporting hiring Hands-on experience working in an applicant tracking system, CRM, or similar software You find keeping data clean and current satisfying Comfort with spreadsheets and basic reporting Clear, warm written communication Strong organization and attention to detail Discretion with confidential candidate and employee information Comfort with remote work and with asynchronous communication across time zones Nice-to-Haves Prior familiarity with and interest in Epoch's mission Experience using Lever or a comparable applicant tracking system Experience at a small organization that grew quickly Exposure to sourcing, application review, or other recruiting work Experience coordinating hiring across multiple countries Comfort automating repetitive work, using Claude and other integrations An interest in moving into a recruiter role over time If you don't tick all these boxes but think you would be a great fit, please consider applying anyway! Additional Information Please submit all of your application materials in English and note that we require professional level English proficiency. Please do not include a cover letter, photograph, or headshot of yourself, or any personal information that is not relevant to the role for which you're applying (including marital status, age, identity traits, etc.). Epoch is committed to building an inclusive, equitable, and supportive community for you to thrive and do your best work. We're committed to finding the best people for our team, so please don't hesitate to apply for a role regardless of your age, gender identity/expression, political identity, personal preferences, physical abilities, veteran status, neurodiversity or any other background. Please if you have any questions about this role, accessibility requests, or if you want to request an extension to the application deadline. However, we will not review applications submitted to this email address; please submit your application through the link on this page. Our mission is to develop a comprehensive, publicly accessible knowledge base on AI that informs policymakers, industry leaders, and society at large. We strive to achieve both rigor and accessibility to our work, as exemplified by some of our most successful projects, including our database of AI models and our AI trends dashboard. title: Document Control Supervisor
description: In a world of possibilities, pursue one with endless opportunities. Imagine Next!At Parsons, you can imagine a career where you thrive, work with exceptional people, and be yourself. Guided by our leadership vision of valuing people, embracing agility, and fostering growth, we cultivate an innovative culture that empowers you to achieve your full potential. Unleash your talent and redefine what’s possible. Job Description: Position Summary We are seeking a hands-on Document Control Supervisor to lead document control activities supporting construction, engineering, quality, procurement, subcontractors, suppliers, and project management functions. This role will oversee document control processes, systems, governance, and personnel for construction programs and projects. The supervisor will ensure that controlled documents and project records are received, processed, reviewed, approved, distributed, retrieved, retained, and protected in accordance with project procedures, the project Quality Management System, contractual requirements, client standards, and applicable regulatory requirements. The successful candidate will build order out of complexity, strengthen document control practices across field and office teams, and serve as a trusted partner to Project Managers, Construction Managers, Engineering, Quality, and Operations leaders. This position will also administer and improve systems such as Procore and SharePoint, provide training and user support, and drive continuous improvement throughout the project lifecycle. Key Responsibilities Document Control and Records Management Lead project document control activities supporting construction, engineering, quality, procurement, project management, subcontractors, suppliers, and field operations. Develop, maintain, and administer document control processes and procedures for identifying, receiving, processing, reviewing, approving, revising, distributing, filing, preserving, retrieving, and retaining controlled documents and records. Administer controlled documents in accordance with the project Quality Management System, applicable ASME NQA-1 requirements, project procedures, client requirements, and contractual obligations. Control engineering and project documents, including drawings, specifications, procedures, work packages, vendor documents, quality records, change requests, RFIs/RFPs, and construction documentation. Ensure personnel have access to the current, approved revisions of drawings, specifications, procedures, work packages, and other controlled documents. Maintain document registers, revision histories, document status information, distribution records, transmittals, and other required tracking tools. Process new and revised documents through established review and approval workflows. Identify and prevent the unintended use of obsolete, superseded, or unapproved documents. Maintain document traceability and ensure controlled records are complete, legible, accurate, retrievable, secure, and protected from unauthorized access or alteration. Ensure the collection and retention of construction documentation throughout the project lifecycle. Manage the as-built documentation process and support the preparation, compilation, and turnover of final project records and closeout packages. Coordinate the handover of documents and records to Operations during construction and project closeout. Systems Administration and Governance Administer, configure, and improve document management platforms, including Procore, SharePoint, and related electronic document management systems. Establish and maintain project repositories, file structures, naming conventions, metadata, permissions, workflows, document numbering, revision control, and distribution requirements. Provide oversight of employees, contractors, subcontractors, and other users operating within Procore and other project repositories. Perform quality control reviews of metadata, document content, cross-references, required signatures, revision status, and associated records. Manage user access, permissions, administrative controls, and periodic access audits. Ensure document control systems and records management practices align with client standards, project requirements, governance policies, and applicable legal, contractual, regulatory, and quality obligations. Safeguard confidential and protected information through appropriate storage, handling, distribution, access, and retention practices. Work with IT and project stakeholders to troubleshoot system issues, resolve access or workflow problems, and support system enhancements. Project and Stakeholder Support Coordinate document control activities with Quality, Engineering, Construction, Procurement, Supply Chain, Contracts, project management, subcontractors, suppliers, and external client representatives. Partner with Project Managers, Construction Managers, and Operations leaders to tailor document control solutions to project needs while maintaining consistent standards. Monitor document workflows and resolve outstanding reviews, approvals, distribution issues, missing information, and other document control discrepancies. Ensure Document Control Coordinators regularly engage with site teams to confirm compliance with client standards, document numbering requirements, turnover requirements, and project procedures. Support audits, surveillances, assessments, inspections, and compliance reviews by retrieving controlled documents, records, and objective evidence. Verify that document control activities and records meet applicable project, quality, contractual, and client requirements. Identify process gaps and recommend practical improvements that enhance accuracy, efficiency, traceability, and user adoption. Leadership, Training, and Continuous Improvement Provide direction, work coordination, supervision, mentoring, and performance support to Document Control Coordinators and other assigned personnel. Assign work, establish service expectations, monitor performance, and ensure timely and accurate document control support to active projects. Develop and deliver training for Document Controllers, field personnel, project teams, and system users. Prepare clear training materials, user guides, standard operating procedures, and onboarding resources that support quick and consistent adoption. Coach project teams and reinforce disciplined document management practices through regular communication, touchpoints, and feedback. Revise existing processes and procedures when project, client, system, or regulatory requirements change. Capture lessons learned and implement continuous improvements across the document control function. Stay current on emerging document management technologies, automation, and AI-enabled tools that may reduce manual effort and improve quality, accuracy, and accessibility. Required Qualifications and Experience Typically 10 years of related experience, including 3 in a supervisory or management role in document control, records management, project controls, quality records, project information management, or a related discipline. Experience supporting industrial construction, engineering, infrastructure, transportation, energy, DOE, nuclear, federal, or other highly regulated projects. Experience administering controlled technical documents and revision processes. Experience with Procore; experience administering or supporting SharePoint is also required or strongly preferred. Experience with electronic document management systems, document repositories, and document workflow processes. Working knowledge of document numbering, revision control, distribution, transmittals, records retention, document status tracking, and access control. Experience supporting engineering drawings, specifications, procedures, work packages, vendor documents, construction records, and/or quality records. Experience with construction documentation such as change requests, RFIs, RFPs, submittals, work packages, and as-built records. Experience developing and maintaining document control processes, procedures, standard operating procedures, training materials, user guides, or governance documentation. Experience leading, supervising, or coordinating Document Control Coordinators, contractors, or other system users. Familiarity with construction closeout documentation, project turnover, audit readiness, records retrieval, retention requirements, and compliance reporting. Excellent computer skills, including advanced proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, particularly Word, Excel, Outlook, and SharePoint. Familiarity with Adobe Acrobat and/or Bluebeam. Strong troubleshooting, problem-solving, and analytical skills. Excellent written, verbal, presentation, client service, and stakeholder communication skills. Ability to manage competing priorities, changing requirements, multiple stakeholders, and time-sensitive deadlines. Ability to work independently while also contributing effectively as part of a multidisciplinary team. High level of discretion, dependability, professionalism, accountability, and reliability when handling confidential or protected information. Preferred Qualifications Associate’s or bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Construction Management, Quality, Information Management, Engineering, or a related field; equivalent education and experience may be considered. Experience working under an ASME NQA-1, DOE, USACE, or comparable quality program. Previous EPC, nuclear, energy, industrial construction, infrastructure, or large-scale construction experience. Experience supporting federal or highly regulated clients. Experience with USACE RMS or similar client-mandated project management and reporting systems. Membership or certification through ARMA, an Enterprise Content Management organization, or a related professional organization. Experience administering SharePoint sites, libraries, workflows, metadata, permissions, and document templates. Experience supporting project turnover and final records packages. Familiarity with quality audits, surveillances, assessments, and objective evidence retrieval. Experience using workflow automation, reporting tools, or AI-enabled solutions to improve document control performance. Core Competencies The successful candidate will demonstrate: Process Leadership: Ability to design, standardize, implement, and improve practical document control processes. Quality and Compliance: Strong understanding of controlled documents, quality records, traceability, revision control, and retention requirements. Systems Proficiency: Ability to administer and support Procore, SharePoint, and related document management systems. Attention to Detail: Consistent focus on accuracy, completeness, metadata quality, signatures, cross-references, and document status. Communication: Ability to make complex requirements clear and practical for field personnel, project teams, clients, and senior leaders. Problem Solving: Sound business judgment and the ability to resolve complex issues with appropriate escalation and follow-through. Leadership: Ability to lead, coach, train, and develop a small team while coordinating work across multiple project stakeholders. Adaptability: Ability to respond effectively to changing projects, clients, systems, and regulatory requirements. Accountability: Demonstrated dependability, punctuality, focus, ownership of assigned work, and ability to meet deadlines. Teamwork: Professional attitude and ability to work effectively both independently and collaboratively. Key Relationships Reports To: Operations Matrixed Alignment: Director, Quality Supervises: Document Control Coordinators and assigned document control personnel Internal Partners: Project Managers, Construction Managers, Engineering, Quality, Procurement, Supply Chain, Contracts, IT, Operations, and field teams External Partners: Clients, subcontractors, suppliers, vendors, and external auditors or assessors Success Measures Success in this role will be demonstrated through: Consistent use of approved document control processes across assigned projects. Timely processing, review, approval, distribution, and retrieval of project documents. Accurate document registers, metadata, revision histories, transmittals, and status records. Effective prevention of obsolete or superseded document use. Strong Procore, SharePoint, and repository governance. Audit-ready project records and successful closeout and turnover packages. Effective training, adoption, and support for field and project teams. Timely resolution of workflow, access, quality, and compliance issues. Improved efficiency, traceability, and user experience across the document control function. A minimum of eight (8) years of increasing responsibility in data analytics, business intelligence, or operations analytics, with demonstrated expertise in cross-functional business and financial data. Strong data visualization and communication skills using Power BI and/or Tableau, with demonstrated ability to translate insights into compelling data storytelling and presentations for organizational leadership. Excellent analytical skills and understanding of statistical concepts with the ability to collect, organize, analyze, and disseminate significant amounts of information with attention to detail and accuracy. Experience with evaluation of statistical significance, variance analysis, funnel and/or lifecycle analysis, A/B testing and performance optimization. Demonstrated ability to partner with business unit leaders and cross-functional stakeholders to influence decision-making through data as well as to communicate technical findings for executive and non-technical audiences. title: Senior Editor, Thought Leadership
description: As Senior Editor, Thought Leadership, you will be a hands-on editorial force at the heart of ServiceNow 's content engine — equal parts strategist, storyteller, and operator. You will shape the ideas we pursue, the angles we take, and the quality of what we publish — primarily for Workflow, ServiceNow 's proprietary thought leadership hub. This is not a pure management role. You will write, pitch, edit, and produce — developing original thought leadership that reflects the most important conversations happening in enterprise technology and AI. You will also help define and maintain the editorial infrastructure that keeps our content calendar running with precision and purpose. You will report to the Head of Editorial & Thought Leadership and work closely with integrated marketing, digital experience, research, and executive teams to ensure our thought leadership earns attention — and keeps it. Key Responsibilities: Strategic Planning Shape content pillars and storylines for thought leadership, ensuring themes are tightly connected to ServiceNow 's value proposition and business priorities Partner with integrated marketing leads to ensure the editorial strategy flexes across buying groups and audiences — and identify opportunities to weave or connect these narratives into content into other editorial and research content Bring an outside-in perspective to content planning: translate news, trends, and cultural shifts into differentiated editorial ideas Uncovers the story beneath the story by asking the questions that go beyond the briefing doc to surface unexpected insights, tensions, and perspectives that make thought leadership worth reading Editorial Management Define and maintain the editorial calendar for Workflow, ensuring the right mix of cadence, format, and topic to build a consistent publishing rhythm on the platform Uphold quality standards and editorial rigor across all content, serving as an active editor for work produced by internal writers, contributors, and external partners Content Development Develop and pitch compelling story ideas grounded in original research, customer insights, SME perspectives, and market signals Conduct interviews, write, and edit long-form articles, executive bylines, human interest pieces, and SEO content destined for Workflow — with the editorial range to see how a feature story could translate into a 90-second video script or social-first format Brief and prep executives and SME contributors for content participation, making the process easy and the output strong Assess content performance and translate data into actionable editorial recommendations — identifying what's resonating, what isn't, and what to do about it Core Competencies: Editorial Craft — Exceptional writing, editing, and story development skills; able to work across formats and adapt voice to different audiences and contexts Strategic Thinking — Connects individual stories to broader content strategy and business objectives; thinks in themes and narratives, not just individual pieces Tech & AI Fluency — Solid grasp of enterprise technology, AI, and the evolving SaaS landscape; comfortable translating complex topics into clear, compelling content Pitching & Ideation — Proactively generates strong story ideas and brings them to the table with clear editorial rationale Collaborative Instinct — Knows how to work with stakeholders, executives, and cross-functional partners without losing editorial independence Perpetual Curiosity – Voracious consumer of AI news, research, and emerging trends; title: Global Head of Go To Markets
description: Global Head of Go-to-Market Remote, Americas, Full Time, Director, +8 years of experience Who We Are At Yuno , we are building the payment infrastructure that allows all companies to participate in the global market. Founded by seasoned experts from the payments and tech industries, our technology provides access to leading payment capabilities, enabling companies to engage customers confidently and maintain global operations through seamless integrations. We empower high-performing teams at brands like InDrive, McDonald’s, Rappi, and Viva Aerobus to integrate over 1,000 payment methods via a single API. By leveraging advanced AI and the latest technologies, we orchestrate smart routing and fraud prevention across 80+ countries. About The Role We are orchestrating the best high-performing team! We're looking for a Global Head of Go-to-Market to own the engine that turns Yuno 's market position into predictable, compounding revenue. Marketing, SDR, Revenue Operations, and Sales Enablement will report to you. You won't be running four functions in parallel — you'll be building one system in which demand generation, pipeline creation, seller capability, and operational rigor reinforce each other. Yuno serves 450+ partners across 200+ countries, powering payments for companies like McDonald's LATAM, NetEase Games, GoFundMe, InDrive, and Rappi. The buyer is technical, the sales cycle is long, and the competitive set is regional — this is a role for someone with real ambition, who dreams in terms of what this business can become rather than optimizing for what it already is. Growth here won't come from spending more. It will come from designing a motion that scales without linear headcount, and from bringing quality and rigor to every layer of the funnel — from the first touch in marketing to the numbers the board reviews every quarter. You'll be the source of truth for what's actually happening in the pipeline, and that only works if the standard you hold for data, forecasting, and reporting is uncompromising. None of this happens in a silo. You'll need to align Marketing, SDR, Enablement, and RevOps around a single GTM architecture, and get sellers who can hold their own in a room with a payments architect. That means building real collaboration across teams that have historically moved independently, translating priorities across functions, and making sure everyone is rowing in the same direction toward the same numbers. If you're a builder who doesn't need an existing playbook, and you're excited to define what “exponential” looks like for a company operating across 80+ countries, we want to talk to you. Your contribution will be Own positioning, demand generation, content, events, and product marketing Build and scale an SDR motion, including territory design, ICP definition, and the handoff to enterprise sales Design onboarding, ramp time, certification, and competitive intelligence for the sales team Own pipeline hygiene, forecasting, tooling, comp design, and revenue reporting Define GTM architecture, including segmentation, pricing motion, and channel and partnership leverage Sequence where the business invests next across all revenue functions Build a system where marketing, sales, enablement, and operations reinforce one another Translate Yuno 's technical differentiation into language that resonates with both engineers and CFOs Skills You Need Minimum Qualifications Fluent English 8+ years in GTM leadership, with direct ownership of at least two of: marketing, SDR, enablement, or RevOps Track record scaling a B2B company through a step-change in revenue Fluency in enterprise sales cycles with technical buyers; payments, fintech, or infrastructure background strongly preferred Strong quantitative skills, with the ability to defend assumptions like CAC payback in front of a board Comfortable operating across regions with different competitive dynamics and buying behavior Builder instinct and high level of ownership, with no need for an existing playbook What We Offer at Yuno Competitive Compensation Remote Work – You can work from everywhere! Home Office Bonus – A one-time allowance to help you create your ideal home office. Work Equipment Stock Options Health Plan wherever you are. Flexible Days Off Originally posted on Himalayas

Strong understanding of machine learning, deep learning, NLP, MLOps, and LLMOps. Strong understanding of AI security, governance, compliance, observability, and model monitoring. Excellent client-facing communication, technical leadership, and stakeholder-management skills. Familiarity with LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, CrewAI, AutoGen, or MCP. Experience with vector databases such as Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus, Qdrant, Chroma, or pgvector. Experience integrating AI solutions with platforms such as Salesforce, ServiceNow, SAP, Workday, or Microsoft applications. Snowflake, AWS, Azure, or AI/ML certifications. Consulting experience within regulated industries such as financial services, healthcare, or manufacturing. title: Field Marketing Manager

What You'll Do Own and execute regional field marketing strategies aligned with pipeline, revenue, and business objectives, Plan and deliver integrated regional marketing programs, including industry conferences, trade shows, executive dinners, roundtables, channel marketing initiatives, sponsorships, and customer engagement programs, Partner closely with Sales, Channel, Marketing, Finance, and Operations teams to align regional priorities and maximize business impact, Own regional marketing budget, forecasting, vendor management, and performance tracking to ensure efficient investment and measurable ROI, Develop and execute regional marketing plans while ensuring operational excellence across planning, logistics, timelines, and stakeholder management, Measure and report campaign performance, pipeline contribution, ROI, and key business metrics, continuously optimizing programs based on data and insights, Manage relationships with external vendors, agencies, event organizers, and strategic partners to ensure successful program execution. Stay informed on regional market trends, customer needs, and competitive activity to continuously refine regional marketing strategy. What You Have 4–7 years of B2B field marketing experience, preferably in cybersecurity, SaaS, or enterprise technology, Proven experience managing regional marketing programs, including industry conferences, executive events, customer engagement, and channel marketing initiatives, Strong partnership with Sales and the ability to align marketing programs with pipeline and business objectives, Experience managing marketing budgets, forecasts, and vendor relationships, Strong analytical skills with experience measuring campaign performance, pipeline contribution, ROI, and marketing effectiveness, Excellent project management and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment, Strong communication and collaboration skills across cross-functional teams, Willingness to travel within the assigned region, Candidates preferred to be based in the Central or Eastern regions of the United States to support collaboration with our EMEA team. You understand how business users think, what friction looks like in real workflows, and how to communicate technical solutions in ways that land with non-technical users. business value Lead, mentor, and stay hands-on with a small team of data scientists: writing code and reviewing methodology, not just roadmaps Oversee the design of robust, production-grade solutions utilizing core cloud systems, vector databases, and agentic workflows Champion the adoption and continuous improvement of AI development tools across technical teams Scale MLOps/LLMOPs practices, ensuring data observability, governance, model safety, and ethical AI compliance Collaborate cross-functionally with Business Intelligence, Data Engineering, Analytics Engineering, Development, and Product teams to drive technical innovation, prioritize initiatives, ship MVPs fast and iterate based on usage data Design and run rigorous experiments to validate hypotheses and guide business decisions Translate statistical and technical work into business language for executive stakeholders and make the case for where data science investment should go next Define success metrics for internal tools and AI initiatives, and track adoption, usage, and business impact over time Document tools, workflows, and best practices to scale impact beyond individual engagements Stay informed on industry trends, viral content, and emerging platforms to identify new opportunities You have: (aka Qualifications) 7+ years in data science, including leading or managing a technical team Strong foundation in core data science Deep, hands-on fluency in Google Cloud Platform: BigQuery, Vertex AI, and building/deploying production models in a GCP environment Proficiency deploying custom Gemini Enterprise Agents via Agent Engine Fluency in AI tools such as Claude, CoPilot and ChatGPT Strong Python and SQL skills and experience in applied AI A bias for action About this team: The Data Science team is a small but mighty group sitting at the center of the organization. We're a centralized team, which means we work across nearly every department: from Marketing and Creative to BI, Engineering, Product, and beyond. If there's a workflow to improve, a tool to build, or a data problem worth solving, chances are we're involved. Our work is practical by design. We build internal tools and data products that make real work easier, not to chase trends, but because the right solution at the right moment can meaningfully change how an entire team operates. We use AI where it genuinely helps, and we're skeptical of hype for its own sake. That pragmatic instinct is part of what makes us effective. As a team, we move fast and stay scrappy. We're not a big org with lengthy approval chains. We prototype, iterate, and ship. We collaborate constantly, both within the team and across the business, and we're at our best when we're working alongside stakeholders to understand their problems firsthand rather than solving in a vacuum. If you're joining us, you're joining a team that values curiosity, initiative, and craft. Our team genuinely believes the most impactful data work happens when technical depth meets real business context. Our Benefits: We value our people and offer a collaborative and engaging culture. Becoming an expert in our internal systems and tools so you can troubleshoot issues and propose clear improvements to system logic. Owning key operational metrics, building reporting that surfaces trends and bottlenecks, and using data to guide decisions. Ensuring credentialing operations remain compliant with CMS, AAAHC, and state requirements as processes and tools evolve. Partnering cross-functionally with internal leadership, network and contracting teams, providers, vendors, and offshore partners. Required skills and experience: 3-5+ years in operations, process improvement, or consulting. A true operator with a bias toward action. Strong communicator who can work with cross-functional stakeholders and drive alignment. Data, systems, and tech savvy, with the ability to build reporting that improves decision-making. Desired skills and experience: Healthcare experience. Familiarity with credentialing standards and CMS requirements. Hands-on experience building and deploying AI tools to improve workflows, or a strong track record of applying technology and automation to operational problems. Experience with process improvement methodologies. title: Payment Variance Auditor I
description: Here at Savista , we enable our clients to navigate the biggest challenges in healthcare: quality clinical care with positive patient experiences and optimal financial results. This position is responsible for reviewing claims and payment information and underpayment identification systems to identify potential individual underpayments and underpayment trends. Develop and maintain Apex classes, triggers, batch and scheduled jobs, Queueable Apex, and asynchronous processing solutions. Build and optimize Lightning Web Components (LWCs) using JavaScript, Apex, and Salesforce platform services to create responsive, user-friendly applications. Configure and enhance Salesforce functionality using Flows, validation rules, approval processes, dynamic forms, record types, page layouts, and custom metadata. Apply both programmatic and declarative development approaches to deliver efficient, maintainable solutions. Design, develop, and maintain integrations between Salesforce and external enterprise systems using REST/SOAP APIs, middleware, and web services. Develop and execute unit tests, integration tests, and deployment validation activities while maintaining Salesforce coding standards and appropriate test coverage. Configure and maintain Salesforce security controls, including Profiles, Permission Sets, Permission Set Groups, Roles, Sharing Rules, and Organization-Wide Defaults. Support data migration, transformation, cleansing, and bulk data management using Data Loader, Workbench, and related integration tools. Collaborate with Solution Architects, Business Analysts, QA teams, Project Managers, and client stakeholders to refine requirements, validate technical approaches, and support successful delivery. Participate in client-facing workshops, technical discussions, and solution reviews, providing insight into development options, feasibility, and Salesforce best practices. Contribute to Agile/Scrum activities, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily standups, retrospectives, and release planning. Support version control, automated deployments, and CI/CD processes using Git, Gearset, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or comparable tools. Maintain technical documentation, development estimates, solution specifications, and project delivery records. Ensure development practices align with Salesforce standards for security, scalability, performance, governance, and compliance within government and regulated environments. What You'll Bring You will likely be successful in this role if you have: Active and valid Salesforce certifications, with Salesforce Certified Platform Developer I required. 5–8+ years of hands-on Salesforce development experience supporting enterprise applications and complex implementations. Demonstrated experience delivering Salesforce solutions for Public Sector clients, including Government Cloud implementations. Advanced Salesforce development expertise, including Apex classes, triggers, batch processing, asynchronous processing, and Lightning Web Components. Strong experience building complex Salesforce Flows and using declarative automation to support business processes. Hands-on development and configuration experience across Salesforce Government Cloud, Service Cloud, and Experience Cloud. Strong understanding of Salesforce architecture, data modeling, object relationships, application design, and platform development patterns. Experience developing and supporting integrations using REST/SOAP APIs, middleware technologies, and web services. Knowledge of Salesforce governor limits, platform constraints, performance optimization, and development best practices. Experience configuring Salesforce security architecture, including Profiles, Roles, Permission Sets, Sharing Rules, Organization-Wide Defaults, and field-level security. Proficiency with JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and modern front-end development practices. Experience participating in Agile/Scrum delivery environments and collaborating across technical and functional teams. Strong communication skills and the ability to engage confidently with client stakeholders, technical teams, and business users. Ability to combine hands-on technical execution with thoughtful solution design and consultative problem-solving. How You Work The ideal candidate will: Take ownership of development activities, bringing a proactive and solutions-focused approach from requirements through implementation. Navigate complex technical challenges with sound judgment, creativity, and a strong understanding of Salesforce platform capabilities. Collaborate effectively across distributed delivery teams, client stakeholders, and technical disciplines while maintaining clear communication and accountability. Balance development speed with quality, security, maintainability, and long-term platform performance. Adapt comfortably to evolving requirements, competing priorities, and the delivery expectations of government and regulated client environments. Cannabis industry experience, particularly within regulated programs or government environments, is highly preferred. Experience delivering Salesforce solutions within a consulting firm, systems integrator, or professional services organization. Experience supporting federal, state, or local government agencies. Exposure to MuleSoft or other enterprise integration platforms. Experience with Salesforce DevOps and CI/CD tools such as Gearset, Git, Jenkins, Copado, or Azure DevOps. Experience developing Experience Cloud portals, digital experiences, and Salesforce CMS capabilities. Exposure to Salesforce AI technologies, including Einstein AI, Agentforce, or generative AI capabilities. Experience supporting complex Salesforce migrations, modernization projects, or multi-org implementations. Familiarity with secure development standards, governance, and compliance practices for government Salesforce environments. Technical designs, custom development, integrations, and declarative configurations meet project expectations and Salesforce best practices. Client stakeholders and delivery teams benefit from clear technical communication, thoughtful solution recommendations, and reliable execution. title: Senior Frontend Developer (Angular)
description: Description MEDvidi is an AI-powered mental healthcare platform setting a new standard for safe, effective, and scalable psychiatric care in the United States. MEDvidi 's technology automates charting, follow-ups, and treatment planning, freeing providers to focus on patient care while improving efficiency and clinical quality. Your work sits at the intersection of a large, actively evolving Angular codebase and our AI-first product surface - patient-facing applications, internal tools for doctors and administrators, and the frontend for AI-powered features like our AI clinical assistant and AI receptionist. Deep hands-on work on AI-powered clinical and administrative products, with AI-assisted development as a first-class part of the engineering culture (Claude Code, Cursor, and beyond). Responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain product features end-to-end within a cross-functional team, from requirement refinement to production release. Take ownership of existing Angular codebase areas after the departing engineer: understand, stabilize, and improve them without slowing down the roadmap. Write clean, maintainable, well-tested code: code reviews, unit tests (Vitest), and lightweight design documentation as part of the daily routine. Contribute to frontend architecture decisions and platform health: performance, framework upgrades, NX monorepo structure, CI/CD improvements. Drive AI adoption on both fronts: building frontend for AI-powered product features, and integrating AI tooling into the development workflow itself. Actively contribute to the continuous improvement of engineering processes and tooling across the community. ﻿This role is not for you if: You're waiting for someone else to define what to build,we expect you to come up with ideas, take them through discovery and development, ship them, and own the results after launch. You need a fully-specced ticket queue and a PM/BA translating everything for you You see AI coding agents as a novelty rather than a core part of how modern frontend work gets done. Requirements 3+ years of commercial experience with Angular(latest versions preferred). Experience owning a product end-to-end, including analysing the metrics that tell you whether it actually worked. Strong product and UX judgment, you can recognize when an interaction doesn't feel right and propose a better solution. Fluency in modern Angular: standalone components, signals, current change detection and DI patterns, not experience from several years ago followed by a switch to another framework. Advanced RxJS and TypeScript in real production scenarios: confident design and debugging of complex reactive flows (stream composition, cancellation, race conditions, error handling) and fluency in a strictly typed codebase. Proven expertise in designing and implementing complex Angular application architectures at scale, module and component boundaries, decisions that hold up as the codebase grows. Hands-on experience with unit testing (Vitest preferred, Jest acceptable) as a regular part of the daily routine, not an afterthought. Hands-on experience with agentic AI development. Comfort working across the backend boundary: writing or fixing a SQL query, adjusting endpoint validation, or tracing an issue through the API layer. You don't need to be a backend engineer, but stopping at the frontend border isn't an option. Intermediate English (B1+) and fluent Russian. Full overlap with CET working hours. Would be a plus: Experience building UI for AI/LLM-powered features. Deep understanding of responsive design, our patients access the platform primarily from mobile devices, and interfaces must be flawless across screen sizes. Proficiency in optimizing web application performance across different surfaces: patient-facing product and internal tools for doctors, managers, and admins (data-heavy interfaces, large tables and lists, real-time updates). Health & wellness: Health insurance after the probation period, plus sports & wellness compensation. Career development: Clear growth opportunities, including personalized English lessons via Preply. Culture: Thoughtful gifts for key life events and offline corporate events. ﻿Ready to make an impact? title: Senior Associate, BPIA - Compliance & Governance
description: Senior Associate, BPIA - Compliance & Governance About Creador Creador is a leading private equity firm in South and Southeast Asia, focused on investing in growth companies. We are committed to fostering growth and unlocking potential in our portfolio companies. Our medium to long term approach centers on strategic initiatives that empower companies to innovate, expand and lead in their markets. To learn more about Creador , please visit our website at . Role Overview: The BPIA function serves as a second-line oversight function across the investment lifecycle — from pre-investment integrity due diligence to post-investment governance strengthening and firm-wide compliance. BPIA reports directly to the CEO and supports the General Partner's compliance obligations to institutional Limited Partners (LPs). Creador is seeking a Senior Associate, Compliance & Governance that will own and execute Creador 's compliance programme — specifically AML/CFT, sanctions, anti-bribery and anti-corruption (ABAC), and LP compliance obligations — across the firm and its portfolio companies. The role also provides oversight of Creador 's outsourced Integrity Due Diligence (IDD) consultant. What Makes This Role Unique: Not a typical compliance desk job — you will work across the full investment lifecycle, from pre-deal screening to post-investment governance building to LP reporting for a PE fund with institutional investors. You fill a critical gap. The BPIA team has deep audit and accounting expertise. You bring the compliance lens — AML, sanctions, ABAC, regulatory, compliance — that the team currently needs. Regional exposure across Malaysia, Philippines, India, Indonesia, Vietnam portfolio companies at various stages of governance maturity. Build something. You will shape and operationalise compliance programmes, not just maintain them. Reports to: Head of BPIA & Compliance Key Responsibilities: Creador Firm-Wide Compliance (30%) Own the end-to-end policy lifecycle (draft, review, approval, roll-out, training, annual attestation) for all Creador compliance policies including Anti Money Laundering (AML) /Counter Financing Terrorism (CFT), Anti Bribery Anti Corruption (ABAC), Personal Investment Policy (PIP), Insider Trading Policy, Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA), Business Continuity Plan, and others. Manage MyComplianceOffice (MCO) system operations, including PIP pre-clearance workflow, compliance monitoring, tracking for any non compliances and reporting. Conduct periodic compliance audits; document findings, recommend corrective actions, reporting, and track remediation to closure. Prepare LP-required compliance documentation responses. Monitor regulatory developments across Malaysia, Philippines, India, Indonesia, Vietnam; recommend policy updates accordingly. Portfolio Company Compliance & Internal Audit Strengthening (60%) Pre-Investment: Engage and oversee external consultants conducting AML/CFT, sanctions, PEP, ABAC, and adverse media due diligence on investment targets and UBOs; prepare risk-focused findings decks for Investment Committee presentation/ reporting. Coordinate and review Wolfsberg-based AML/CFT assessments for financial institution targets. Conduct Corporate Hygiene Baseline Assessment on Targets; translate outcomes into prioritised action plans. Post-Investment: Support portfolio companies in establishing internal audit functions: develop sample templates e.g. IA charters, coach/ guide IA team on risk-based auditing. Conduct risk-based thematic internal control health check reviews (finance controls, month-end closing, procurement) to strengthen controls to prepare for IPO readiness. Track Baseline Assessments to closure and IDD Findings and action plans with time-bound remediation. Deliver or coordinate Integrity, AML, and ABAC training to portfolio company management teams. Maintain/ Track and Report on any Integrity and Key Incident/ Concern and Governance Action Plans (GAP), including annual governance survey responses and risk heat maps IT Outsourced Operations Oversight (10%) Provide oversight (not hands-on execution) of Creador 's outsourced IT function. Act as the informed intermediary between the business and the outsourced IT Senior Executive: scope what needs to be done, research and self-educate on relevant IT, cybersecurity, and data-protection topics (including using AI tools and external references), translate business and LP requirements into clear instructions, and direct the consultant to execute. This is not a role built around posting content just to stay active. The work should help owners, operations leaders, and facility teams understand the problems Bedrock solves and give our sales team more qualified conversations. What We Are Looking For Three or more years of experience in B2B growth marketing, demand generation, digital marketing, content marketing, or a related role. Experience with email marketing, landing pages, SEO, social media, and campaign reporting. Experience using a CRM and marketing automation platform such as HubSpot or Brevo. Ability to connect marketing activity to qualified leads, meetings, and pipeline. Comfort working with website analytics, conversion rates, campaign metrics, and spreadsheets. We care about the quality of your work, your judgment, and whether you can show how your marketing contributed to a business result. Compensation This is a full time W2 position with a competitive base salary and a target performance bonus. The base salary range is displayed on this posting. Equal Opportunity Bedrock Facility Solutions is an equal opportunity employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law. title: Principal Architect, System Software - Orbital Data Center
description: Space-1 is NVIDIA 's first Orbital Data Center (ODC) module — a Vera Rubin–class compute platform engineered for low-Earth orbit mission. We are looking for a strong technical architect to own end-to-end system software architecture for Space-1 and successor orbital platforms. You will architect the full stack — application to libraries, from data center stack to BMC and BIOS firmware, manageability, and telemetry through the host OS, GPU and CPU drivers, and CUDA — to deliver a production-ready inference platform that operates reliably in the radiation, thermal-cycling, and remote-operations environment of LEO. You will partner closely with the orbital hardware system architecture team, drive customer use cases with constellation operators, align architecture with mission requirements, and bring the best orbital AI products to market. Join us at the forefront of technological advancement. What you'll be doing: Own system architecture for inference stack and other applications running on this class of products and make it resilient to any fault happening in space. Co-architect with the orbital hardware system architecture team to define interfaces, partitioning, and trade-offs across silicon, board, firmware, OS, and AI workload layers for 5-year LEO missions. Own end-to-end system software architecture for Space-1 and successor Orbital Data Center modules — covering data center stack, BMC firmware, BIOS, host OS, GPU/CPU drivers, CUDA, DCGM, and manageability telemetry as a single integrated stack. Define the manageability architecture for an unreachable, autonomous data center: remote bring-up, in-orbit firmware update, dual-module redundancy, fault containment, recovery from SEU/SEFI events, and telemetry for fleets ranging from tens to millions of nodes. Architect rad-tolerant system software behaviors — ECC handling, memory scrubbing, latch-up mitigation, deterministic recovery, and graceful degradation through 5 years and up to ~8,000 thermal cycles in dawn–dusk sun-synchronous orbit. Drive Redfish, MCTP, PLDM, and constellation-level management protocols across BMC, BIOS, and host software so customers can operate orbital fleets with the same tools they use on the ground. Define minimum BMC feature set, pin budget, boot architecture (rugged M.2 / VPX-class options), and dual-module redundancy strategy in partnership with platform and mechanical engineering. Partner with cloud and constellation customers (SpaceX, Blue Origin, Starcloud, Planet, Cowboy Space, and others) to translate mission requirements — orbit, duty cycle, NSA PHIPs security, post-quantum networking (CX9), inference SLAs — into actionable platform software architecture. Drive reliability and optimization in the system software architecture from an orbital data center viewpoint, including correct operation through eclipse periods and idle-power retention strategies. Work closely with the bring-up team and resolve issues at Speed of Light from first silicon through first launch.Own quality, reliability, and telemetry performance of the system software delivered with each ODC module shipped to customers. What we need to see: 15+ years of relevant experience in server/platform system software — spanning compute libraries, BMC firmware, BIOS, host OS, drivers, and manageability BS, MS, or PhD in EE/CS or related field of education (or equivalent experience). Working experience in building AI infrastructure and systems in space. Proven record of architecting and delivering platform software for large-scale data centers or mission-critical embedded systems. Strong knowledge of server architecture, data center manageability, and full-stack integration of firmware with OS and accelerator software. Hands-on experience with data center health management workflows, telemetry, and fault management at scale. Solid understanding of hardware management interfaces (USB, SMBus/I2C, PCIe) and proficiency with modern management protocols including Redfish, MCTP, and PLDM. Strong and demonstrable skill in C/C++ and Python. Experience programming and debugging server platforms, including pre-silicon and platform bring-up environments. Experience in SCM (e.g. Git, Perforce) and project management tools like Jira. Excellent written and oral communication skills, good work ethics, high sense of team-work, love to produce quality work, and commitment to finish your tasks every single day. You are a self-starter who loves to find creative solutions to complicated problems and hands on with coding. Ways to stand out from the crowd: Experience architecting platform software for space, aerospace, defense, or other radiation, thermal, and vibration-constrained environments — including SEU/SEFI mitigation, ECC strategy, TID/SEE qualification, and rad-hard design partitioning. Being a part of a start up or initiative directly related to space data centers. Hands-on experience with autonomous, remote, or unreachable data center operations — in-orbit or in-field firmware update, dual-module redundancy, and recovery without physical access. Hands-on with x86 or ARM (Grace/Vera) system architecture and the NVIDIA AI software stack (CUDA, DCGM, DOCA/OFED, GPU drivers, DGX OS). Familiarity with NSA PHIPs security, post-quantum networking, and aerospace standards (VPX, MIL-STD shock/vibe, NASA EEE-INST-002). Proven technical leadership driving large complex programs with 50+ engineers across firmware, OS, driver, and AI stack teams. Skilled in reviewing hardware schematics and PCB layouts for debugging, design verification, and collaboration with hardware engineers. NVIDIA 's invention of the GPU in 1999 sparked the growth of the PC gaming market, redefined modern computer graphics, and revolutionized parallel computing. More recently, GPU deep learning ignited modern deep learning — the next era of computing — with the GPU acting as the brain of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can perceive and understand the world. Today, we are increasingly known as “the AI computing company.” We're looking to grow our company and establish teams with the most thoughtful people in the world. Our work opens up new universes to explore, enables amazing creativity and discovery, and powers what were once science fiction inventions from artificial intelligence to autonomous cars. NVIDIA is seeking exceptional individuals like you to help us drive the next wave of artificial intelligence.
