title: Staff Scientist, Bioinformatics/RWD
description: Natera is seeking an innovative and driven bioinformatics scientist to lead and conduct cutting-edge real-world evidence (RWE) analyses and predictive analytics across oncology, organ health, and women’s health datasets. This unique role blends expertise in bioinformatics, artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning (ML), and the manipulation of complex real-world data (RWD). Candidate will leverage advanced AI methodologies to extract actionable clinical insights from vast multimodal datasets (genomics, clinical, demographic), driving impactful data visualization and advancing our application of genomics in a real-world clinical setting. The ideal candidate should have strong project management skills, and a keen eye for visualizing complex data in an impactful way to advance our understanding and application of genomics in a real-world setting. Key Responsibilities: Bioinformatics & Genomic Analysis: Lead the analysis of large-scale cancer and germline multi-omics datasets to extract meaningful insights. Utilize and augment traditional bioinformatics tools with AI-driven techniques to interpret genomic data within the context of RWE studies RWD/RWE Analysis: Lead the extraction, curation, and analysis of large-scale RWD sources, including Electronic Health Records (EHR), claims data, and patient registries. Design and execute robust RWE studies to support clinical, commercial, and regulatory objectives. Data Integration and Management: Facilitate the integration of omics data with other types of data (clinical, demographic, etc.) to enrich the analyses. Manage large datasets and ensure data integrity and confidentiality. AI & Predictive Analytics: Develop, train, and deploy advanced artificial intelligence and machine learning models (e.g., Deep Learning, NLP, ensemble methods) to forecast trends, patient outcomes, and biomarker discovery using RWD and genomics data. Apply state-of-the-art AI frameworks to identify hidden patterns that inform clinical decision-making and product strategy. Unstructured Data Integration: Facilitate the integration of highly complex, multimodal datasets. Utilize NLP and LLMs to extract valuable structured insights from unstructured clinical notes, pathology reports, and other disparate RWD sources. Manage large datasets while ensuring strict data integrity and confidentiality. Project Management: Oversee and manage RWD and genomics projects from inception to completion. Ensure that projects are completed on time, within budget, and meet high-quality standards. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with other departments such as R&D, Data Science, Business Development, Medical Affairs, Product Management, and Engineering to integrate genomics and clinical data into broader research and development initiatives. Reporting and Communication: Present complex RWE data and analyses in a clear and comprehensible manner to a variety of audiences, including non-experts. Prepare detailed reports and publications. Innovation and Development: Stay abreast of the latest developments in genomics and bioinformatics. Propose and develop new methods and technologies for advanced data analysis. Stakeholder Engagement: Engage with key stakeholders to define project goals, report progress, and discuss findings. Act as a liaison between the technical team and non-technical stakeholders. Desired qualifications: Ph.D. in Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Genetics, or a related field At least 10 years of relevant experience Proven expertise in bioinformatics, particularly in genomics data analysis. Demonstrated expertise in cancer genomics, including genomic alterations, molecular pathways, and cancer biology Expert knowledge of bioinformatics tools including mapping, variant calling, CNV analysis and statistical methods Strong experience in managing, querying, and analyzing massive-scale genomic and healthcare datasets using SQL, Python, or R, and data visualization tools Additional expertise in germline genetics, particularly in relation to organ health and prenatal health, is a significant plus. AI/ML Expertise: Proficiency in predictive analytics, advanced machine learning, deep learning, and statistical modeling. Strong hands-on experience with AI frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, Keras, etc. Understanding of real-world clinical data, such as electronic health records, claims data, patient registries, health surveys. Familiarity with common data models (e.g., OMOP) and experience utilizing NLP/LLM to parse unstructured clinical data. Ability to interpret clinical endpoints, understand patient cohorts, and collaborate with clinical stakeholders Knowledge of translational medicine and/or early discovery in the biotech or pharmaceutical industry is a plus Excellent project management skills with a proven track record in leading successful projects Experience managing one or more direct/indirect reports. Exceptional communication skills, demonstrating the ability to translate complex models and RWD findings to both technical and clinical/non-technical stakeholders. Ability to produce high quality written documentation for varying audiences Proven experience collaborating with cross-functional teams including clinicians, scientists, biostatisticians, regulatory and stakeholders. title: Enterprise Account Executive
description: About RiskExec RiskExec provides regulatory compliance, lending analytics and increasingly AI-enabled intelligence to financial institutions operating in one of the most demanding regulatory environments in the economy. What We’re Building Our next phase of growth requires deeper penetration of larger financial institutions: organizations with complex regulatory obligations, multiple stakeholders, established technology environments and buying processes that extend across Compliance, Lending, Risk, IT, Security, Procurement, Legal and executive leadership. Role Overview This is a strategic new-logo role with responsibility for a defined portfolio of high-value accounts. You will determine where RiskExec has the strongest right to win, build relationships across those institutions, create opportunities where none exist today and orchestrate complex evaluations from first engagement through signature. This is not an inbound order-taking role, and it is not a volume-prospecting role with a larger quota. You are expected to combine account strategy, executive-level selling, regulatory credibility, disciplined deal management and persistent pipeline creation. As RiskExec expands its AI-native capabilities, including Integrity, you will also help sophisticated financial institutions understand where AI can improve compliance workflows while maintaining appropriate human judgment, governance and control. We are currently considering remote candidates based in Eastern and Central time zones. What You Will Own Enterprise new ARR. You are accountable for winning new strategic customers and delivering your annual bookings commitment. Named-account strategy. For each priority institution, you will develop a clear view of organizational structure, business priorities, regulatory pressures, incumbent solutions, competitive position, relevant stakeholders and realistic paths to entry. Pipeline creation within your portfolio. BDR, Marketing and executive resources will support you; responsibility for creating enough enterprise pipeline to make the territory successful remains yours. Complex deal orchestration. You own the opportunity from initial engagement through discovery, evaluation, security and diligence processes, business case, procurement, negotiation and signature. Executive and multi-threaded relationships. You will build relationships beyond a single champion and engage compliance executives, business leaders, technology stakeholders and economic buyers at the appropriate stages of the process. Strategic platform selling. You will position RiskExec as a platform rather than a collection of isolated modules, connecting HMDA, CRA, Fair Lending, Redlining, Fair Servicing and AI-enabled capabilities to the institution's broader operating priorities. Commercial strategy and negotiation. You will make thoughtful decisions about packaging, sequencing, stakeholder engagement and use of internal resources while protecting long-term account value. Pipeline and forecast data in HubSpot. Opportunity structure, stakeholder maps, next steps and close dates live in HubSpot and stay current. A forecast is only as credible as the record behind it. Customer Success owns implementation, adoption and account health following handoff. You will remain strategically involved where executive relationships, expansion strategy or commercial action requires it. Selling Integrity, RiskExec's AI-Native Module Enterprise institutions will scrutinize Integrity harder than any other part of the platform, and that scrutiny will come from Risk, Legal, IT and Security rather than from your compliance champion. You own that conversation in the deal. Develop a working command of what Integrity does, what data it uses, how its outputs are produced and where human review sits. No AI or ML background is required, and claiming more technical depth than you have will cost you credibility with the people who evaluate it. Position Integrity inside the platform conversation rather than as a standalone product, connecting it to the institution's existing HMDA, CRA, Fair Lending and Redlining work and to the compliance capacity a lean team is trying to protect. Carry Integrity through model risk management and third-party AI governance diligence. Larger institutions increasingly run this as a formal review track, and it will slow or stop a deal if you are not prepared for it. Answer practical questions on data handling, explainability and human review points in front of technical and legal stakeholders. Route anything that requires a definitive commitment to Product or Legal rather than improvising an answer under pressure. Bring what you hear back to Product. Enterprise objections to Integrity are the earliest signal of what the module needs next. How You Will Drive Impact Enterprise productivity comes from focus. Your job is not to treat every institution in your portfolio equally. You will segment your portfolio, concentrate company resources on accounts with meaningful potential and pursue them with a deliberate point of view. You will: Build and maintain strategic account plans for priority institutions. Create customer-specific hypotheses before outreach rather than relying on generic sequences. Develop relationships across the buying organization before and during active opportunities. Qualify rigorously and disengage from opportunities that do not have a credible path to a decision. Build quantified business cases around risk reduction, operating efficiency, analytical capability and customer value. Navigate security, legal, procurement and AI-governance diligence without losing commercial momentum. Mobilize RiskExec executives, Product, Solutions, Customer Success and subject-matter experts when their participation changes the probability or size of a win. Maintain evidence-based forecasts with transparent risks, dependencies and next actions. Run account research and meeting preparation on the tools RiskExec has deployed: Waypoint for account and contact intelligence, Clay and LinkedIn Sales Navigator for enrichment and stakeholder mapping, Nooks for outbound dialing and call intelligence, and Claude for research synthesis, call preparation and drafting. Use HubSpot Notetaker and Claude to turn calls into logged summaries and next steps in HubSpot. The expected result is better-prepared executive conversations and less administrative drag, not a higher activity count. Performance will be measured by enterprise ARR, quota attainment, qualified pipeline, strategic account penetration, conversion, forecast accuracy and the quality and durability of new customer relationships. Cross-Functional and Executive Interfaces You will work closely with: BDR: You set account priorities and penetration strategy; BDR resources extend your coverage and execution. Marketing: You partner on account-based campaigns, executive programs, events and regulatory narratives that create access to priority institutions. Product and Solutions: You bring them into opportunities where product depth, regulatory expertise, data architecture or AI capabilities materially influence the outcome. Security and Legal: You coordinate customer diligence and contracting while maintaining clear commercial ownership. Customer Success: You establish a disciplined handoff and remain involved in strategic commercial opportunities without taking over account-management responsibility. Executive Leadership: You use CEO, President and executive relationships selectively to advance strategic opportunities and deepen RiskExec's position in major accounts. Enterprise sellers at RiskExec are expected to use internal resources deliberately. Escalating everything is not enterprise selling; knowing when senior involvement changes the outcome is. Qualifications Required 7+ years of successful quota-carrying B2B software or technology sales experience, including meaningful enterprise responsibility. Demonstrated success closing complex, multi-stakeholder opportunities with substantial contract value and extended buying processes. Proven ability to create enterprise pipeline through account development, executive networking, referrals and disciplined outbound, not solely through inbound or SDR-generated opportunities. Strong account-planning, discovery, negotiation and executive-presentation capability. Experience navigating security, legal, procurement and other enterprise diligence processes. Strong commercial judgment and a history of accurate forecasting. Ability to learn complex regulatory and technical concepts and communicate them credibly without overstating expertise. Working fluency with HubSpot or a comparable enterprise CRM, and daily use of AI research and outbound tools as part of how you sell. Experience with our specific stack is not required; working this way is. Willingness to travel for high-value customer meetings and industry events. Preferred Experience selling into banks, credit unions, lenders or other regulated financial institutions. Experience in RegTech, lending technology, data/analytics, governance, risk or compliance software. Familiarity with HMDA, CRA, Fair Lending, model governance or related compliance disciplines. Direct experience with Claude, Clay, Nooks, LinkedIn Sales Navigator or comparable tools in a daily outbound and account-research workflow. Experience selling enterprise platforms with multiple modules, use cases and expansion paths. Experience competing against established incumbents and displacing legacy workflows or consultants. Traits That Win at RiskExec You think in accounts, not leads. You understand how organizations make decisions and how influence moves through them. You create demand. You can build an opportunity before a formal buying process exists. You are patient without being passive. Enterprise cycles take time; enterprise sellers still create momentum every week. You are credible with executives and practitioners. You can move between strategy and operating detail without pretending to know what you do not know. You protect company resources. You know which deals deserve executive, technical and product investment. You use AI as leverage. Better intelligence and preparation should translate into higher-quality selling, not simply more automated activity. You forecast with integrity. You distinguish what you want to happen from what the evidence says will happen. You own the number. Territory, pipeline, deal execution and results are ultimately your responsibility. Compensation and Benefits A competitive compensation package with a 50/50 base and variable split, plus benefits including group health, dental and vision plans and a 401(k) with company match. Why this Role Matters Enterprise growth is strategically important to RiskExec. Larger institutions create substantial revenue opportunity, expand the platform's market position and pressure-test RiskExec against the most demanding regulatory, technical and operational requirements in financial services. The strongest Enterprise AE will do more than close several large transactions. You will help RiskExec establish durable executive relationships with major institutions, expand adoption of our platform and AI capabilities, and build a repeatable model for winning complex enterprise business. RiskExec is a private-equity-backed software company with high expectations for growth, efficiency and execution. The opportunity is substantial, but so is the accountability. RiskExec's Core Values We Put Clients First: We earn trust through responsiveness, expertise and a focus on meaningful customer outcomes. We Innovate With Purpose: We apply technology, including AI, to real customer problems rather than innovation for its own sake. We Are Fast: We move with urgency and precision. We Act With Integrity: We tell the truth, make responsible commitments and protect the trust our customers place in us. We Succeed Together: We operate as one company and solve problems across functional boundaries. We Grow as a Team: We learn quickly, address issues directly and improve the system rather than assigning blame. Originally posted on Himalayas

title: Senior Medical Scientist
description: This position is remote-based. Salary range for US-based candidate is $165,000.00 to $180,000.00. Compensation for this position will be determined by the prevailing market rate in the employee's country and the applicable statutory laws, in addition to Ipas 's own pay philosophy and other factors, such as the employee's experience level and expertise. Position may work remotely from any of the following US states: AZ, CA, CO, DC, FL, GA, MD, MA, MI, NJ, NY, NC, PA, SC, TX, VA, WA. Additionally, the position may work remotely from any of the following countries outside of the US: Bangladesh, Bolivia, Canada, Democratic Republic of the Congo, Cote d’Ivoire, Ethiopia, Indonesia, Kenya, Malawi, Mexico, Mozambique, Myanmar, Nepal, Nigeria, South Africa, and Zambia. The Senior Medical Scientist will provide technical leadership to help ensure that the best available evidence supports quality and continuous improvement in safe abortion, contraception, and gender-based violence management across development and humanitarian contexts. This role will strengthen abortion availability, accessibility, acceptability and quality through formal health systems and self-care pathways by establishing and enhancing global technical tools, standards, processes, monitoring mechanisms, and partnerships that contribute to a sustainable abortion ecosystem. Summary of Responsibilities The Senior Medical Scientist is a subject matter expert, using clinical expertise, evolving evidence and strategic partnerships to advance Ipas ’s mission at the global level. In collaboration with key staff across the organization, Senior Medical Scientist will advance innovative initiatives and provide strategic guidance and technical assistance on safe abortion, contraception and GBV care quality and access. The Senior Medical Scientist disseminates new evidence through publications and presentations; conducts training; represents Ipas externally, advocating for the organization’s mission within the broader reproductive health field; and builds partnerships with colleague organizations to maximize impact. Organizational Leadership and Strategy: Provides technical leadership to develop and test innovative approaches to improve quality abortion and contraception care (e.g., global quality indicators, quality improvement processes) and to integrate safe abortion and postabortion contraception into SRHR programming for Ipas support programs and in emergency crisis settings Program, technical, or functional content of the job: Provide and/or analyze evidence based technical content used for advocacy opportunities related to safe abortion for Ipas supported programs and external coalitions Develop technical tools and resources translating evidence based clinical updates into health services Provides technical leadership on quality and regulatory processes pertinent to the Ipas MVA product line, as well as infection prevention and MVA processing Supports training of Ipas supported sites and partners on content such as VCAT, clinical management of abortion and contraception care, trauma-informed care, legal risk assessment, etc. Leads and/or significant participation in clinical/technical research and technical evidence dissemination for abortion/contraception clinical practice improvement Prepare and/or analyze service delivery data and issue clinical recommendations for continuous improvement of quality of care across the pathways to care. Resource mobilization: Supports fundraising initiatives by contributing to donor proposals and preparation/review of donor reports Communications & representation: Write periodic evidence summaries for internal communications with technical staff across the network Provides external leadership, Ipas representation, and advocacy as required at national, regional and international conferences and events Disseminates evidence externally through presentations and publications Position Requirements A deep commitment to sexual and reproductive health and rights, especially abortion, contraception and GBV care access Demonstrated contribution to the development of technical tools, standards, guidelines, and SRHR research. Professional-level fluency in English (speaking, reading, and writing) Proven ability to support and strengthen the capacity of teams, including through training, supportive supervision, strong communication, nonhierarchical leadership approaches, and modeling the Ipas core values. Demonstrated capacity and commitment to good stewardship of funds, including strong skills in work planning, budgeting, financial monitoring, and data-driven problem solving. Proven ability to build positive working relationships in a multicultural and complex implementation contexts with diverse internal teams and external partners Education Advanced clinical degree (e.g nursing, midwifery) Experience 10+ years’ experience in clinical practice including reproductive health care and experience applying scientific clinical information to practical training and programs Substantive experience with evaluation of quality in clinical care and quality improvement. Substantive knowledge and experience of international reproductive health programs and systems in low-resource and humanitarian settings Knowledge of key partners and influencers in our field Experience working in multicultural teams Preferred Qualifications PhD or DrPH and/or significant experience in research Strong clinical background Experience working in humanitarian contexts and/or working with humanitarian implementing agencies Established relationships with non-profit organizations and advocacy groups Proficiency with at least one Ipas working language, such as French, Portuguese, or Spanish. Strong preference for advanced practice midwife or nurse Working environment: Ability to travel up to 20% of the time internationally, including in crisis settings Ipas is strongly committed to providing a work environment that is free from all forms of harassment, discrimination, and inequity. We recruit, employ, train, promote, and compensate our personnel without regard to race, age, sex, religion, national origin, color, creed, ancestry, citizenship, caste, ethnicity, regional identity, tribal identity, marital status, veteran status, disability, genetic information, gender identity, transgender status, sexual orientation, or any other personal characteristic protected by law or outlined by Ipas policy. Ipas acknowledges that these personal characteristics may differ in different contexts. Originally posted on Himalayas

title: Manager, Global Engagement
description: Based in the US and reporting directly to the CEO, the Manager, Global Engagement will shape how Aceli tells its story to international audiences, including funders, investors, development finance institutions, policymakers, and sector peers. The Manager will be a writer, editor, project manager, and thought partner to the CEO and Executive team, identifying, producing, and presenting the many layers of Aceli's story. Working closely with the Kenya-based Communications team, the Manager will keep Aceli’s communications strategy aligned with the organisation’s overall strategy, while owning Aceli’s messaging framework and brand. The role will also lead the thought leadership calendar and digital channels, and shape the narrative for Aceli’s fundraising. It works in close partnership with Aceli's Communications team, which focuses on communications with Aceli’s partners in Africa and handles in person and virtual events in our focus countries, internal communications, and capacity building on communications for the Aceli team. The ideal candidate is a skilled writer and project manager with experience in thought leadership and communications for international development, impact investing, philanthropy, and/or financial services. S/he must be able to translate complex, data-rich work into narratives that resonate with senior global audiences, especially donors. Key Responsibilities 1. Thought Leadership & Editorial Draft and co-author thought leadership content, including articles, op-eds, reports, speeches, and talking points, and serve as a writing thought partner to the CEO and senior leaders as they develop and refine their ideas. Own Aceli's thought leadership calendar, planning and sequencing publications around key organizational milestones and international sector events. Help team members shape narratives around their work (e.g., climate, economic opportunities for women and youth, nutrition) that can be developed into thought leadership pieces for international audiences. Advise the CEO on the narrative approach for Aceli's publications; review final drafts and provide copyedits and recommendations to make messaging clear and compelling to a general audience. Manage design partners from procurement through publication, leading feedback cycles and owning final quality control. Work with the regional Communications team to build internal skills through training and templates, in line with Aceli’s writing style, tone, and editorial conventions. 2. External messaging and brand Lead the development and maintenance of a set of clear, consistent key messages that staff should use to tell Aceli's story; in partnership with Communications team, ensure Aceli staff are familiar with these messages and provide capacity building as needed Partner with the regional Communications team to maintain Aceli's visual brand standards and ensure all public-facing collateral reflects a consistent, professional identity. Serve as a trusted thought partner to the Executive team and the regional Communications team on key decisions about Aceli's external brand and messaging. Build on existing engagement analytics to assess how key messages and stories land with funders, partners, and other priority international audiences, and refine the key messages based on what resonates. 3. Fundraising Partner with the fundraising team to shape the narrative in funder proposals, reports, and pitch materials so Aceli's data and human impact reinforce each other for an external audience. Provide input and writing support for funder proposals and external materials as needed Maintain a close partnership with the regional Communications team to ensure collateral such as quotes, photography, and videos meet the needs of international and funder audiences. Support the regional Communications team to identify and develop high quality and effective collateral for sharing the human stories behind Aceli's data that will be most compelling to funder audiences and provide editorial support so these stories work for both local and international audiences. 4. Digital Platforms Execute website content updates and oversee technical maintenance to ensure security and an optimal user experience. Design quarterly newsletters and publication announcements, and execute campaign delivery optimized to Aceli's audiences. Develop and disseminate messaging and content optimized for LinkedIn, working closely with the regional Communications team to maximize audience engagement. Track analytics across the website, newsletter, and LinkedIn to measure audience engagement and inform Aceli's broader communications strategy. Support regional Communications team with digital communications relating to events e.g. invitations using MailChimp Bachelor's degree in Communications, Journalism, International Development, Economics, or a related field. Minimum of 7 years of experience in strategic communications, thought leadership, editorial, or brand roles, of which at least 3 years in international development, impact investing, philanthropy, or financial services. Familiarity with agricultural finance, SME finance, or blended finance, ideally in African markets. Demonstrated track record writing and publishing thought leadership (reports, articles, op-eds, briefs) for senior international audiences. Exceptional English writing and editing skills, with the ability to translate complex financial and data-heavy content into clear, compelling narratives. Experience advising senior executives on messaging, positioning, and narrative strategy. Experience developing messaging frameworks, style guides, or brand standards, and managing external design and creative partners. Proficiency with website content management systems, email marketing platforms, LinkedIn, and web and social analytics tools. Strong attention to detail and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple publications and priorities simultaneously. Team player with a collaborative spirit and strong work ethic, able to work effectively and independently within a remote, multi-country team. Willingness to travel to East Africa, Europe, and Washington, DC. Preferred Experience developing fundraising communications for bilateral and philanthropic donors. Experience with data storytelling and data visualization. Experience building communications or storytelling capacity across distributed teams. Working knowledge of design tools for producing on-brand collateral. Aceli is an equal opportunity employer. Please share an updated CV, cover letter, and two writing samples by 10 November 2026 . Applications without a Cover Letter and writing sample will not be considered. Aceli Africa is a market catalyst that unlocks private sector lending for agricultural enterprises. Drawing upon new data that explains the credit gap for small- and medium-enterprises (SMEs) in the agriculture sector, Aceli offers financial incentives to a marketplace of 50+ commercial banks and innovative finance companies to share in the risk and defray the high transaction costs of lending to agricultural SMEs. Since launching in 2020, Aceli has mobilized $585M in lending to 7,000+ agricultural enterprises providing market access for 2.7M smallholder farmers across Kenya, Rwanda, Tanzania, Uganda, and Zambia. With access to finance, agricultural SMEs are accessing loans for the first time, growing their businesses, increasing their purchases from farmers, and creating more jobs. Building on learning to date, Aceli plans to mobilize $2 billion in financing for agri-SMEs and improve livelihoods for 5 million farmers and workers by 2030. Originally posted on Himalayas

title: Product Manager - Translational Biology Services
description: Ready to turn scientific innovation into real-world impact? Come join our dynamic and growing team as a Product Manager, Translational Biology Services and lead a portfolio of advanced in vitro human biology models that help researchers accelerate breakthrough therapies. From oncology and immunology to cardiovascular and fibrosis research, you'll drive strategy, commercialization, and innovation for solutions that mirror human biology and deliver critical insights. Working across science, operations, sales, marketing, and client services, you'll transform customer needs into market-leading offerings that fuel growth and advance discovery. Here's what you'll do: Owns the overall success and commercial performance of the Translational Biology Services product line, including responsibility for growth, revenue generation, profitability, innovation, product strategy, positioning, roadmap, lifecycle decisions, and key performance metrics. Develops and implements portfolio strategy using market research, competitive intelligence, industry trends, voice-of-customer insights, and input from key opinion leaders. Drives growth and innovation by identifying unmet customer needs, market opportunities, and new or enhanced offerings, and translating them into prioritized initiatives that strengthen revenue, profitability, and long-term portfolio value. Defines product requirements, features, specifications, value propositions, and positioning for existing and in-development services in alignment with business strategy and market needs. Prioritizes product development initiatives and coordinates cross-functional teams to deliver agreed milestones, technical documentation, and market-ready offerings. Develops and executes commercialization and launch plans, ensuring timely readiness across Study Director team, operations, sales, marketing, technical support, and client services. Creates portfolio presentations, sales tools, training materials, and core technical and positioning content for customers, commercial teams, and marketing campaigns. Supports global and regional commercial efforts through sales training, voice of the customer, scientific presentations, and active participation in the sales process. Owns and monitors product performance, customer feedback, market dynamics, industry trends, and the competitive landscape; reports insights and recommended actions to business leadership. Identifies and evaluates new markets, customer segments, strategic collaborations, and other business-development opportunities. Strengthens market visibility and scientific credibility through external presentations, thought leadership, industry engagement, and brand-building activities. May support preparation of proposals, custom pricing, and cost analyses in collaboration with client services and pricing teams. The ideal candidate: M.A. or M.S. with 4 years’ relevant experience Ph.D. with 2-year relevant experience Combination of Education and Relevant Experience Demonstrated experience in product management (2 years) role with sole ownership and accountability of product line(s) in a life sciences company A minimum of 4 years of experience in life sciences, pharma or biotech industry Demonstrated successful product management and commercialization skills in life sciences Has a thorough understanding of the drug discovery and development process, market requirements and customer needs, with scientific expertise in the areas of: cellular biology, oncology, in vitro assays, biomarker discovery, immunology, stem cell biology, or related methods and applications. Requires strong and efficient organizational skills to multitask effectively Individual initiative, strategic and creative thinking, and problem-solving skills Ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver high quality results in a time-driven manner. Strong communication and presentation skills, both verbal and written The position is full-time, Monday-Friday, 8 a.m.- 5 p.m., with overtime as needed. What we offer: Excellent full time benefits including comprehensive medical coverage, dental, and vision options Life and disability insurance 401(k) with company match Paid vacation and holidays Eurofins USA Discovery Services is a Disabled and Veteran Equal Employment Opportunity employer. Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate. The Eurofins network of companies is the global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in agroscience Contract Research Organization services. It is one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and in the support of clinical studies, as well as having an emerging global presence in Contract Development and Manufacturing Organizations. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialized and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in-vitro diagnostic products. In over 30 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to 58,000 staff across a decentralized and entrepreneurial network of 900 laboratories in over 54 countries. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products. In 2024, Eurofins generated total revenues of EUR € 6,515 billion, and has been among the best performing stocks in Europe over the past 20 years. Originally posted on Himalayas

title: Partner Solution Architect - SAI

Own the Securiti.ai technical strategy, solution architecture and pre-sales motion within each partner relationship, while the Veeam Channel Manager retains ownership of the overall relationship. Jointly engage partner technical leaders with Veeam teams to align on priority use cases, solution roadmaps and technical investments. Equip Veeam Systems Engineers and Channel Managers with the technical messaging, demo assets and training needed to introduce Securiti.ai into partner and customer conversations. Set clear rules of engagement for technical support, opportunity handoffs and escalations so partners experience Veeam and Securiti.ai as one team. Assess partner technical maturity, including security expertise, cloud and platform skills, services capacity and integration capabilities. Incorporate Securiti.ai technical priorities into existing Veeam partner plans and quarterly business reviews. Identify the lab, demo, training and technical resources each partner requires and review readiness on a regular cadence with Veeam and partner stakeholders. Lead the technical build-out of partner Data Security, DSPM and AI Governance practices, defining reference architectures, delivery methodologies, skills and certification paths. Deliver technical training, workshops and hands-on labs that enable partner and Veeam teams to demonstrate and position Securiti.ai Data Security, DSPM, AI Security, AI Governance, Privacy and GRC capabilities. Help partners design repeatable technical assessments, workshops, managed services and implementation offerings. Architect joint solutions that integrate Securiti.ai with the partner’s own services and their existing Veeam portfolio, creating differentiated, repeatable solutions for their customers. Create and maintain technical assets, including demo environments, reference architectures, solution briefs, discovery guides and competitive technical positioning. Pre-Sales and Opportunity Support Lead technical discovery, solution design, demonstrations and proofs of value with partners for priority customer opportunities. Align Veeam, Securiti.ai and partner technical teams around priority customers, supporting opportunities from technical qualification through close. Respond to technical requirements, RFPs and security questionnaires, and address architecture, integration and compliance questions from customer stakeholders. Support a smooth transition from sale to implementation, ensuring partner delivery teams are prepared for successful deployment and adoption. Measures of Success Securiti.ai pipeline and revenue influenced through partner technical engagement. Number of partner engineers trained and certified on Securiti.ai and partners able to independently demonstrate, sell and deliver solutions. Technical win rate and conversion of proofs of value into closed business. Number of joint solutions, reference architectures and partner-led assessments and services brought to market. Customer deployment success, partner satisfaction and strength of alignment with Veeam channel and technical teams. What You’ll Bring 7+ years of experience in pre-sales engineering, solutions architecture, sales engineering or technical consulting for enterprise technology. Demonstrated success in a channel-facing, partner technical or overlay pre-sales role. Proven ability to collaborate with existing account and relationship owners while leading the technical sale for a specialized solution portfolio. Experience enabling and supporting technical teams at VARs, solution providers, MSPs, integrators, or advisory partners. Strong ability to lead technical discovery, solution design, product demonstrations and proofs of value. 5+ years of hands-on experience in cybersecurity, data security, data governance, privacy or AI security. Working knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), SaaS applications, data platforms and identity and access management. Ability to translate technical capabilities into business outcomes, architectures and use cases that both sales and technical audiences can act on. Ability to influence internal and external stakeholders without relying on direct authority. Strong communication, presentation, whiteboarding and technical writing skills. Ability to manage multiple partner and customer engagements while maintaining accountability for measurable results. Willingness to travel for partner meetings, enablement sessions, customer engagements and industry events. Bonus Skills Hands-on experience with Securiti.ai or comparable DSPM, data discovery and classification, AI governance, privacy management, or GRC platforms. Experience designing partner-led assessments, managed services, workshops, or professional services offerings. description: Pension Analyst Specialist II - (Documentation/Requirements SME) Pension Plan Requirements Owner & Documentation SME Do you have extensive experience with Defined Benefit Pension Plans? About the Role As a Pension Benefits Administration Services Analyst II, you will serve as a key Pension Plan Requirements Owner and Documentation Subject Matter Expert (SME) while supporting the ongoing administration of Defined Benefit pension plans. You will be responsible for ensuring pension plan requirements and supporting documentation accurately reflect plan provisions and are clearly translated into operational and system requirements. Responsibilities Plan Requirements Ownership & Documentation Serve as a Plan Requirements Owner and Documentation SME for assigned Defined Benefit pension plans. Interpret pension plan provisions and translate them into clear business, operational, calculation, and system requirements. Develop, review, maintain, and update Business Requirements Documents (BRDs) and other pension plan requirements documentation. Maintain accurate plan documentation, procedures, calculation requirements, work instructions, and supporting materials. Ensure requirements documentation remains aligned with current pension plan provisions and approved plan changes. Identify gaps, inconsistencies, or ambiguities in pension requirements and work with appropriate stakeholders to resolve them. Support the documentation of new requirements and changes resulting from plan amendments, operational changes, system updates, or identified defects. Serve as a point of reference for questions regarding documented pension plan requirements, calculations, and administrative procedures. Pension Administration & Analysis Research and respond to complex participant issues, including eligibility, pension calculations, credited service, benefit commencement, and service delivery issues. Research system and calculation issues to determine whether results adhere to documented plan requirements. Review pension benefit calculations and outputs for accuracy and consistency with plan provisions and established requirements. Process and review retirement benefit applications and verify the accuracy and completeness of participant information. Research historical service, eligibility, benefit credits, and other information needed to support accurate pension calculations. Perform data analysis and use SQL, reporting tools, and other resources to research pension administration and system issues. Testing, Audit & Quality Support Support testing and validation of pension system changes, calculation updates, defects, and requirements changes. Validate system results against approved pension plan requirements and expected calculation outcomes. Support internal and external audits by researching requests, providing documentation, and validating pension calculations and supporting data. Maintain complete and accurate documentation, work papers, and supporting records to provide a clear audit trail. Identify documentation or process improvements that strengthen accuracy, consistency, and quality. SME & Stakeholder Support Serve as a pension requirements and documentation resource for plan administrators and other team members. Partner with business, operational, and technical teams to clarify pension requirements and resolve issues. Communicate directly with client Human Resources personnel and vendor/support teams regarding pension plan requirements and administrative issues as needed. Prepare and deliver training to team members regarding pension plan provisions, requirements, calculations, procedures, and documentation. Work collaboratively with plan administrators and other team members to complete projects, resolve issues, and ensure consistent delivery of pension administration services. Requirements 5+ years of hands-on Defined Benefit pension experience required. This position is specifically focused on pension/Defined Benefit plan administration. Expert knowledge of Defined Benefit pension plan administration, plan provisions, eligibility, and benefit calculations. Demonstrated experience serving as a requirements owner, business requirements analyst, plan documentation SME, or similar role within pension administration. Strong experience interpreting pension plan documents and translating plan provisions into business, calculation, operational, and/or system requirements. Experience creating, reviewing, and maintaining Business Requirements Documents (BRDs), requirements documentation, procedures, and work instructions. Intermediate to advanced experience with pension calculations and audit support. Experience researching and resolving pension calculation, participant, data, and system issues. Experience supporting system requirements, change requests, testing, validation, or defect resolution within a pension administration environment. Experience with SQL, reporting, and data analysis. Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Word, and Outlook. Strong written communication and documentation skills with excellent attention to detail. Ability to communicate confidently with clients regarding pension plan provisions, requirements, calculations, and administrative issues. Ability to work across operational, business, and technical teams and clearly communicate complex pension requirements. Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting multiple Defined Benefit pension plans with varying plan provisions and calculation rules. Experience with pension administration platforms or benefits administration systems. Experience with requirements traceability, User Acceptance Testing (UAT), regression testing, calculation validation, and system implementation/change initiatives. Experience supporting client-facing pension administration environments. Pay Transparency Laws in some locations require disclosure of compensation and/or benefits-related information. description: Description MEDvidi is an AI-powered mental healthcare platform setting a new standard for safe, effective, and scalable psychiatric care in the United States. We combine licensed providers with proprietary AI tools to deliver consistent, outcomes-driven treatment for conditions like ADHD, anxiety, depression, and more. MEDvidi 's technology automates charting, follow-ups, and treatment planning, freeing providers to focus on patient care while improving efficiency and clinical quality. As a product-focused Senior Frontend Developer on our AI track, you'll own frontend delivery end-to-end for products that directly affect how patients access mental health care and how our clinicians and staff work day-to-day. Your work sits at the intersection of a large, actively evolving Angular codebase and our AI-first product surface - patient-facing applications, internal tools for doctors and administrators, and the frontend for AI-powered features like our AI clinical assistant and AI receptionist. You'll work in a small cross-functional product team, taking features from requirement refinement through production release. ﻿Why this role: Real product ownership in autonomous cross-functional team, you shape what gets built, not just how. Deep hands-on work on AI-powered clinical and administrative products, with AI-assisted development as a first-class part of the engineering culture (Claude Code, Cursor, and beyond). Modern Angular at scale: an actively evolving monorepo on the latest Angular versions, not a legacy graveyard. Responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain product features end-to-end within a cross-functional team, from requirement refinement to production release. Take ownership of existing Angular codebase areas after the departing engineer: understand, stabilize, and improve them without slowing down the roadmap. Write clean, maintainable, well-tested code: code reviews, unit tests (Vitest), and lightweight design documentation as part of the daily routine. Contribute to frontend architecture decisions and platform health: performance, framework upgrades, NX monorepo structure, CI/CD improvements. Drive AI adoption on both fronts: building frontend for AI-powered product features, and integrating AI tooling into the development workflow itself. Actively contribute to the continuous improvement of engineering processes and tooling across the community. ﻿This role is not for you if: You're waiting for someone else to define what to build,we expect you to come up with ideas, take them through discovery and development, ship them, and own the results after launch. You need a fully-specced ticket queue and a PM/BA translating everything for you You see AI coding agents as a novelty rather than a core part of how modern frontend work gets done. Requirements 3+ years of commercial experience with Angular(latest versions preferred). Experience owning a product end-to-end, including analysing the metrics that tell you whether it actually worked. Strong product and UX judgment, you can recognize when an interaction doesn't feel right and propose a better solution. Fluency in modern Angular: standalone components, signals, current change detection and DI patterns, not experience from several years ago followed by a switch to another framework. Advanced RxJS and TypeScript in real production scenarios: confident design and debugging of complex reactive flows (stream composition, cancellation, race conditions, error handling) and fluency in a strictly typed codebase. title: Junior Social Media Video Editor
description: About High Scale We’re High Scale — a future-focused, data-obsessed agency revolutionizing video advertising on TV and social media. You will be responsible for taking raw influencer content and studio footage and turning it into snappy, engaging, and high-converting assets for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts. Your work determines if a user stops scrolling or keeps moving. If you are obsessed with pacing, trends, and creating content that feels authentic to the platform, this is your launchpad. Master the art of the "hook"—editing the first 3 seconds to grab attention instantly using visual disruption, text overlays, and sound. Implement trending audio, native text styles, and platform-specific stickers to make ads feel organic. Remix & Iterate Take successful ad concepts and create fresh iterations by swapping hooks, changing music, or re-ordering footage to combat creative fatigue. Turn long-form content (YouTube videos, podcasts) into bite-sized, viral social clips. Polish & Enhance Apply dynamic captions (Alex Hormozi style, karaoke style, etc.) that increase watch time and retention. Perform basic color correction and audio mixing to ensure mobile-viewing quality. Add basic motion graphics and transitions to keep the energy high. Familiarity with After Effects (for motion text) and CapCut (for specific trending effects) is a major plus. You understand aspect ratios, safe zones, and export settings for all social platforms. Fast & Creative You can turn around an edit in hours, not days. You thrive on the speed of social media. You have a good sense of rhythm and timing—your cuts land perfectly on the beat. Detail-Oriented You double-check spelling in captions and ensure audio levels are balanced for phone speakers. You are organized with your file management and project structures. Excellent Communicator Strong English proficiency is required. You can clearly articulate why you made a creative choice and collaborate effectively with Art Directors remotely. Relentless Innovation Culture: Move fast, test constantly, and collaborate with some of the most creative minds in social media and video production. High Scale is an Equal Opportunity Employer. title: Sr Scrum Master- MSI
description: Why MSI? We thrive on solving challenges. As a leading MGA, MSI combines deep underwriting expertise with insurer risk capacity to create specialized insurance solutions that empower distribution partners to meet customers’ unique needs. We have a passion for crafting solutions for the important risks facing individuals and businesses. We offer an expanding suite of products – from fully-digital embedded renters coverage to high-value homeowners insurance to sophisticated commercial coverages, such as cyber liability and habitational property – delivered through agents, brokers, wholesalers and other brand partners. Our partners and customers count on us to deliver exceptional service through a dedicated team that makes rapid resolutions a priority. We simplify the insurance experience through our advanced technology platform that supports every phase of the policy lifecycle. Bring on your challenges and let us show you how we build insurance better. The Problem Platform Architecture is our most overloaded cross-cutting team. Priorities are pushed down onto them from every direction. They're also the final gate in the PR approval chain (Platform Review → Staff Engineering → Platform Architecture) — not the only reviewers, but the ones who carry the heaviest review load and have the most influence over how that process is designed — which makes them a bottleneck with limited ability to control their own inbound work. Infrastructure has a related but distinct problem. They just stood up a formal SDLC and are early in adopting ADO, and teams with dependencies on them often reach out at the last minute rather than planning ahead — disrupting their flow of work the same way competing top-down asks disrupt Platform Architecture's. They also need to get better at communicating outward: proactively flagging when scrum and product teams need to test architectural changes or enhancements, rather than that falling through the cracks after the fact. Both teams need their capacity protected from poorly-timed, uncoordinated demands, and both need a partner who can build the two-way communication habits — inbound planning lead time and outbound impact visibility — that neither currently has. We also want dedicated Agile coaching capacity across the broader team eventually — someone who can dig into how each team runs planning, standups, and retros, and help our strategic Agile plan translate into practice, not just theory. That's not this role's starting focus: given the depth of what's already being asked for Platform Architecture and Infrastructure, we don't want to set this person up to juggle too much on day one. We see broader coaching as a natural growth path for this role once the Platform Architecture and Infrastructure work is stable, and only if/when they have the capacity for it. The Role Reports to the Head of Agile or Head of AI Enabled Delivery with a dotted line to the other. Serves as the embedded Scrum Master for Platform Architecture and Infrastructure, and acts as mentor/lead to the other Scrum Masters across the organization to drive consistent execution of our Agile strategy. No direct reports. Key Responsibilities Core Responsibilities (Day One) Prioritization gatekeeping: Push back on stakeholders, convene cross-team prioritization sessions, and protect Platform Architecture and Infrastructure capacity from competing top-down asks, maintaining clear cross-portfolio dependency maps so trade-offs are visible to stakeholders. Cross-team visibility & coaching: Coach Platform Architecture and Infrastructure to proactively communicate their work, roadmap, and potential downstream impact to dependent scrum and product teams; facilitate a recurring cross-team forum until this becomes routine practice, and use it to support prioritization decisions. Capacity protection for bottleneck relief: Influence and partner with Platform Architecture leadership to reduce the volume of competing top-down asks landing directly on their team, freeing their capacity to redesign the release-approval process they anchor (Platform Review → Staff Engineering → Platform Architecture). This role does not own that approval process itself — it protects the time Platform Architecture needs to fix it. Ceremony-level coaching: Run and coach ceremonies for both teams, tailoring facilitation and training to each team's specific needs and maturity rather than a one-size-fits-all approach. Strategic accountability: Report directly to the Heads of Agile on team health, blockers, and adherence to the strategic plan. Compliance & documentation: Ensure delivery routines for Platform Architecture and Infrastructure align with applicable security, risk, and governance requirements across Baldwin partner organizations; support accurate delivery documentation and audit/accreditation readiness where required. Growth Opportunity (As Capacity Allows) SM mentorship: Provide informal lead guidance to the Scrum Masters on other teams, ensuring our strategic Agile plan is executed consistently across the org. Qualifications Proven experience as an embedded Scrum Master or Agile Coach supporting highly technical, cross-cutting engineering or infrastructure teams. Strong negotiation and stakeholder-alignment skills, with the ability to balance competing priorities and drive alignment across business units and portfolios. Working knowledge of Azure DevOps (ADO); familiarity with DevSecOps, multi-cloud, or CI/CD delivery environments a plus. Experience with cross-portfolio dependency mapping, OKRs, and delivery/quality metrics reporting. Agile certification (CSM, PSM, SAFe SSM/Advanced SM, or equivalent) preferred. Success Metrics (6–12 Months) Platform Architecture reports measurably more protected capacity (e.g., reduced ad hoc/competing asks), enabling them to own redesign of their release-approval process. Recurring cross-stakeholder prioritization cadence established and adopted. Recurring roadmap/impact forum between Platform Architecture, Infrastructure, and dependent teams established and running independently of this role. Visible execution of the Heads of Agile's strategic plan across team ceremonies. Growth Opportunity (As Capacity Allows) Tailored coaching plans rolled out for Scrum Masters. Informal coaching practices shared with Scrum Masters on other teams, if bandwidth allows once core scope is stable. Click here for some insight into our culture! with IB clustering, troubleshooting/debugging, understanding the ecosystem of fibers+transceivers+NICs+switches and all the things that could possibly fail in them Experience about shared filesystems description: Our Benefits: Competitive compensation Paid time off for vacations, holidays, and illness Comprehensive health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription) 401(k) retirement savings plan Education support and student loan assistance Life and disability insurance Flexible spending account As a Director, Change Management at Community Health Systems (CHS) – Shared Business Operations, you’ll play a vital role in supporting our purpose to help people get well and live healthier by providing safe, quality healthcare, building enduring relationships with our patients, and providing value for the people and communities we serve. Our team members enjoy a robust benefits package including: Job Summary The Director, Change Management - PMO is responsible for developing and leading enterprise change management strategies that support successful adoption of organizational transformation initiatives. This role establishes change management methodologies, tools, and standards and partners with executive leaders, project teams, Human Resources, Communications, and operational stakeholders to assess organizational impacts, prepare employees and leaders for change, and strengthen adoption and sustainability. Leads change management planning and execution for complex, enterprise-wide transformation initiatives. Collaborates with project, transformation, Human Resources, Communications, Learning and Development, and operational teams to integrate change management into initiative planning and execution. Establishes change readiness, adoption, engagement, and sustainability measures and monitors performance throughout implementation. Identifies resistance and adoption barriers and develops strategies to address organizational and stakeholder concerns. Builds change management capability by developing tools, resources, education, and coaching for leaders and project teams. Leads change networks, champions, or other stakeholder engagement structures supporting major organizational initiatives. Provides strategic guidance regarding the cumulative impact of organizational changes and supports coordination across concurrent initiatives. Evaluates change management effectiveness and incorporates lessons learned into future transformation efforts. Performs other duties as assigned. Maintains regular and reliable attendance. Complies with all policies and standards. This is a remote opportunity with 15% travel (primarily to the Nashville, TN area) Requirements: Bachelor's Degree in Organizational Development, Human Resources, Business Administration, Communications, Psychology, or a related field required 8-10 years of experience in change management, organizational development, transformation, consulting, or a related field required 5-7 years of experience leading complex organizational change initiatives required Preferences: Certified Change Management Professional highly preferred Demonstrated leadership experience, including the management, mentorship, and professional development of direct reports highly preferred Experience supporting enterprise-wide transformation in a large, complex organization highly preferred Healthcare industry experience preferred Master's Degree preferred Knowledge, Skills and Abilities Comprehensive knowledge of organizational change management principles, methodologies, and adoption strategies. Ability to develop enterprise change strategies and translate transformation objectives into actionable change plans. Strong consulting, facilitation, coaching, and influencing skills with the ability to engage leaders at all organizational levels. Ability to assess organizational impacts and identify barriers to adoption and sustainability. Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills. Strong analytical skills with the ability to develop and interpret change readiness and adoption measures. Ability to manage multiple complex change initiatives in a highly matrixed environment. title: Remote Psychologist
description: Are you a U.S.-licensed psychologist passionate about leveraging technology to provide accessible, high-quality mental health care? We are a premier telehealth platform dedicated to connecting skilled psychologists with individuals, couples, and families seeking professional support. We are seeking compassionate and autonomous professionals to join our expanding network. Our platform is designed for practitioners who value independence and flexibility. We handle the client acquisition, so you can dedicate your energy to what you do best: fostering healing and growth. Build your ideal private practice from anywhere in the U.S., on your own terms. Key Responsibilities: Provide High-Quality Teletherapy: Conduct evidence-based psychological services for individuals, couples, or families via a secure, HIPAA-compliant video platform, consistent with your scope of licensure and clinical expertise. Maintain Compliant Clinical Records: Ensure all clinical documentation is accurate, comprehensive, and completed in a timely manner, adhering to HIPAA standards and the regulations of your licensing state(s). Uphold Ethical & Legal Standards: Strictly adhere to the APA's Ethical Principles of Psychologists and Code of Conduct, all applicable state and federal laws, and best practices for telehealth confidentiality and security. Manage Client Relationships: Foster a professional therapeutic environment by clearly communicating your practice policies, session fees, and scheduling directly with your clients. Direct Financial Management: Independently establish your session rates, and manage all aspects of billing and payment directly with your clientele. Requirements: Education: A Doctoral degree (Ph.D. or Psy.D.) in Clinical, Counseling, or School Psychology from a program accredited by the American Psychological Association (APA). Licensure: A current, unrestricted license to practice psychology independently in at least one state within the U.S. You are responsible for maintaining compliance with all inter-state telehealth laws and regulations. Experience: A minimum of two years of post-licensure experience delivering psychotherapy and/or psychological assessments. Telehealth Proficiency: Demonstrated competence in using secure telehealth technologies (e.g., SimplePractice, Doxy.me, Zoom for Healthcare) and experience with Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems. Professional Liability: Must maintain an active professional liability (malpractice) insurance policy with coverage appropriate for your practice. Independent Contractor Readiness: Must be prepared to operate as an independent contractor, managing your own schedule, taxes, and business-related expenses. Required Skills: Exceptional clinical, diagnostic, and case conceptualization skills. Superior interpersonal and communication skills, with an emphasis on building therapeutic rapport remotely. Deep empathy, cultural humility, and unwavering professionalism. Excellent organizational and time-management abilities. A strong commitment to continuous professional growth and ethical practice. What We Offer: Complete Autonomy: You are in full control. Set your own schedule, determine your caseload, and work the hours that fit your life (from 5 to 30+ hours per week). Financial Control: Set your own session fees based on your expertise and market. Clients pay you directly, ensuring you retain 100% of your earnings. We take no commission. Steady Stream of Referrals: Gain access to a diverse pool of clients actively seeking therapy. Our marketing efforts connect you with clients who are a good fit for your specialties, at no cost to you. Work From Anywhere: Enjoy the freedom to work from your home or office, as long as you are located in a state where you are licensed to practice. Focus on Clinical Excellence: We reduce your administrative burden by managing client outreach and platform technology, allowing you to concentrate on providing outstanding clinical care. Free & Transparent Partnership: There are no sign-up costs, membership fees, or hidden charges. Our goal is to support your practice, not profit from it. How to Join Our Network: Submit Your Application: Complete our online application form and create your professional profile, highlighting your qualifications, specialties, and therapeutic approach. Credential Verification: Upload your verification documents, including your doctoral degree, state license(s), and proof of liability insurance, for review by our credentialing team. Onboarding: Once verified, you will be invited to an onboarding session to familiarize yourself with the platform and best practices. Start Connecting: Set your availability and begin receiving client requests. You will manage all communications, scheduling, and payments directly. If you are a driven, licensed psychologist ready to embrace the future of mental healthcare and build a thriving remote practice, we encourage you to apply and join our community of dedicated professionals. Salary: $50 – $100 / hour Originally posted on Himalayas

title: Virtualization / Automation Engineer (Journeyman)
description: Computer World Services, Corp. (CWS) seeks a Virtualization / Automation Engineer to operate, maintain, automate, and improve the virtualization and Software-Defined Data Center (SDDC) platforms supporting the USMEPCOM ENLIST program, including VMware vSphere, ESXi, vCenter, vSAN, NSX, Site Recovery Manager (SRM), and associated Infrastructure as Code capabilities. The role focuses on the hypervisor and SDDC platform layers across production, development, test, COOP, disaster-recovery, and hybrid-hosting environments; guest operating systems, applications, databases, and cloud workloads remain with their respective teams. The engineer also supports the transition of applicable services to centralized DISA-hosting platforms through discovery, migration support, validation, and stabilization. Key Tasks & Responsibilities Configure, administer, and maintain virtualization clusters, including vSphere HA, DRS, resource pools, hosts, datastores, and distributed switches, and manage ESXi and vCenter patching, upgrades, and certificates. Monitor platform capacity, availability, performance, and compliance, and recommend scaling, balancing, or remediation actions. Configure and support vSAN clusters, storage policies, and fault domains, and troubleshoot vSAN performance, resynchronization, and policy-compliance issues. Configure and support NSX segments, transport zones, gateways, routing, and distributed security controls, coordinating changes with network and cybersecurity teams. Administer SRM protection groups and recovery plans, execute and document failover and failback tests, and support quarterly COOP exercises and continuity events. Develop and maintain infrastructure automation using Terraform, Ansible, PowerCLI, or APIs, with version control, peer review, testing, rollback, secrets protection, and drift detection. Coordinate with workload owners on resource requirements, placement, templates, and snapshots, preserving the division between platform and workload ownership. Provide advanced engineering support for cross-platform incidents, isolate platform faults during outages, and collect evidence for root-cause analysis and implement corrective actions. Maintain platform configuration backups, apply DISA STIGs and security baselines, and support RMF evidence, vulnerability remediation, and vendor-advisory reviews. Support technology refreshes and modernization; contribute to capacity, lifecycle, and modernization assessments. Support DISA-hosting transitions through discovery, dependency documentation, readiness assessment, test and rollback plans, cutover, and post-migration stabilization. Maintain architecture diagrams, as-built documentation, SOPs, and recovery procedures, and provide platform metrics and modernization status for program reporting. Education & Experience Required: Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience where permitted by the labor category. Minimum of six (6) years of relevant experience in virtualization, systems engineering, data-center infrastructure, platform engineering, or infrastructure automation. Hands-on experience with VMware vSphere, ESXi, and vCenter and with vSAN, NSX, SRM, or comparable software-defined storage, network-virtualization, and disaster-recovery technologies. Experience developing or maintaining infrastructure-automation solutions and troubleshooting issues across compute, storage, network, virtualization, and automation layers. Knowledge of high availability, disaster recovery, backup and restoration, capacity management, and lifecycle practices. Strong written, verbal, analytical, and technical problem-solving skills. Preferred: Formal Terraform and Ansible training. Experience with VMware Cloud Foundation or VMware Aria, and PowerCLI, PowerShell, Python, or REST APIs. Experience supporting federal or DoD virtualization environments and migrations to DISA enterprise-hosting platforms. Experience with DISA STIGs, RMF controls, vulnerability remediation, and configuration compliance. Experience developing Infrastructure as Code within CI/CD and Git workflows with automated testing and code scanning. Certifications Required: None. Preferred: VMware Certified Professional, HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate, Red Hat Certified Specialist in Ansible Automation, ITIL 4 Foundation, or relevant cloud, security, storage, or network certification. Security Clearance Active Secret clearance or higher is required. Other (Travel, Work Environment, DoD 8570 Requirements, Administrative Notes, etc.) Work Environment / Travel: Remote position; Chicago, IL–area candidates preferred. Occasional on-site support, after-hours maintenance, disaster-recovery exercises, incident response, and travel may be required. description: Updated/Reviewed 04.17.26 Interviewer Job Industry: Charity / Social Services / Non- Profit Organization Position Name: Volunteer Interviewer for Dog Rescue - Volunteer (Unpaid) Job Location: Spokane, Washington, United States Job Type: Part Time Office Setting: Fully Remote Remote: Yes Compensation: Volunteer Hours Per Week: 5 (flexible) Role Mission Path of Hope relies on volunteers heavily to achieve our mission. Due to the nature of volunteering, we have a high turnover of candidates. Your role is to support the continuous flow of qualified volunteers to fill open roles in the Rescue. You will interview candidates and assess whether they can integrate into the Rescue and effectively complete the role and duties as assigned. What Winning Looks Like Key Results Area #1 - Roles Familiar with organization structure of the Rescue Familiar with job descriptions and seeks to understand the purpose of each role in order to offer alternative roles, when it's determined that skills would be better suited to a different role Key Results Area #2 - Self Motivated Work Ethic Keep and update your personal schedule Adherence to interview schedules with minimal rescheduling Daily check ins with remote platform and leader Key Results Area #2 - Interview Process Conduct 30-minute phone interviews effectively, ensuring all key questions are covered while maintaining a professional and engaging experience for candidates. Timely follow-up with team leads for role placement within 24 hours of the interview. Needed Skills Must love dogs and people. We can't save dogs without talented people. Active listening with conversational style. Ability to listen for context clues on what type of role would be a good fit. Self motivated without needing a leader to keep you on task Manage your schedule and keep up to date. Daily check ins via remote chat Unique Company Culture and Mission Our Mission At Path of Hope Rescue we save pregnant dogs and puppies from high kill shelters in the Southern United States. Our Spokane, Washington based Rescue strives to decrease the euthanasia rate of high risk dogs in the southern United States by transporting pregnant dogs and puppies to the Pacific Northwest to find adoptive homes. We do not have a kennel or building location and are 100% foster based. We currently have two paid employees and rely heavily on volunteers and fosters as we work to build out our paid staff roles. Our Vision. Eliminating euthanasia of dogs in the South by decreasing the amount of dogs breeding unchecked and becoming the number one 'dog destination' in Spokane by capitalizing on Spokane's love of Rescue Dogs. Core Values: Transparency - sharing the good with the bad Community - dog loving people who treat each other well Integrity - doing what you say will do Golden Rule - treating others how you would want to be treated Our Company Culture We are freedom loving American Patriots who love dogs, love freedom and love Jesus. No NGO status here, we don't take a single penny from the government. We are 100% funded by small donors and our adoption program, with a few small private grants here and there. We built this organization from the ground up in 2018 with $87. We are built tough and believe that hard work pays off. We're about rolling up our sleeves and taking responsibility for our own actions. We don't do drama. There are no victims here and the system isn't out to get you, the only thing standing in your way is you and your attitude. We reward merit, not DEI or pronouns. We don't bend to the cultural rot out there. At the core of who we are, we love dogs. At PHR you will find people who recognize your dog before they recognize you. Where it's normal for your dog to have his own Instagram and people who expect to be invited to your dog's birthday party. We are focused on building a strong, positive community, one dog and one person at a time. We know dogs are family and should be treated that way. And we are driven by a shared passion to make sure every dog who isn't being loved, finds their way to a family. We care for each other and have created a community of people who love making a difference in this world. Originally posted on Himalayas
