title: Developer Research Coordinator (Contract)
location: Brazil, India, United Kingdom, United States
description: AI is changing how we solve problems with software. But some fundamentals remain. Whether the audience is an experienced developer, a newly minted builder, or a coding agent, there is often a gap between what a team assumes will work and what its users can understand, adopt, and use successfully. MLH’s Developer Intelligence Network exists to bridge that gap. Using quantitative research, such as surveys, and qualitative research, such as interviews, we give technology companies insights that help them decide what to build, how to bring it to market, and where the developer experience needs to improve. As our Developer Research Coordinator , you will help make that research possible. You will coordinate studies, manage our developer participant panel, and turn raw research material into organized, analysis-ready evidence. You’ll learn developer experience research by doing it while supporting companies ranging from startups to some of the world’s best-known technology brands. Major League Hacking ’s mission is to empower hackers. Each year, more than 100,000 young technologists and innovators around the world attend MLH events and join our community. MLH recently acquired DEV (dev.to), an online community for software developers. Together, our ecosystem supports millions of creators at every stage of their journey. What you'll do: Coordinate research studies, including participant invitations, scheduling, reminders, follow-ups, and other logistics from start to finish. Support roughly one substantive study each month, typically involving 10–20 participants. Keep overlapping stages of research moving, including recruiting for upcoming studies, coordinating active fieldwork, and processing recently completed research. Clean transcripts, organize responses, tag useful quotes, and identify initial themes and patterns using established LLM-assisted workflows. Review AI-generated outputs critically, verify themes against the source material, and flag conclusions that are inaccurate, overstated, or unsupported. Produce an analysis-ready evidence pack for each study that the lead researcher can interpret and turn into final findings. Run the developer panel day to day, including recruitment, onboarding, profile maintenance, participant matching, regular communication, and responding to participant questions. Test onboarding experiences, documentation, code examples, and developer workflows, recording points of confusion or friction. Support the quarterly MLH Census, including processing and conducting initial analysis across thousands of responses. Requirements Organized and reliable, with the ability to take ownership of a defined piece of work and keep it moving without being chased. Able to manage research participant logistics from beginning to end. Experienced using LLMs to work through qualitative material and able to evaluate their output critically rather than accepting it at face value. Comfortable navigating developer tools, documentation, GitHub, and code well enough to understand what research participants are describing. Experience with a particular programming language or technology stack is not required. Genuinely interested in developer tools, developer relations, technical education, online communities, or how people learn and build with technology. A clear, proactive communicator who is comfortable working independently in a remote environment. Available to overlap with UK working hours for a few hours each workday. Bonus: Experience supporting research studies, surveys, interviews, focus groups, participant panels, or community programs Bonus: Familiarity with MLH or DEV, community management experience, and comfort writing code or experimenting with developer tools Compensation, Hours and Location Weekly commitment: ~20 hours per week Location: This is a fully remote opportunity open to candidates globally who can overlap with UK working hours for at least a few hours each workday. Compensation: The hourly rate will vary by location and will reflect the successful candidate’s experience and local market. Originally posted on Himalayas

title: Odoo Delivery Manager (Part-Time/ Remote)
description: MAT Research is a pioneering company in the field of pyrogen testing, committed to ushering in a new era of ethical and accurate diagnostics. Since 2016, we have been leading the development of the Monocyte Activation Test (MAT), an animal-free alternative to traditional Rabbit Pyrogen Tests. Our ready-to-use MAT kits offer a robust and highly reliable method for detecting a broad range of pyrogens in parenteral drugs. ISO:9001:2015 certified, we uphold the highest standards of quality in all our products and services. By focusing on in-vitro human-based testing, we aim to drastically increase patient safety while saving hundreds of thousands of animal lives each year. We are steadfast supporters of the European Pharmacopoeia's vision to replace animal-based tests with MAT by 2026.For more details, go to our job page. Our ERP system ( v18) is the backbone of our operations, streamlining CRM, Sales, Accounting, Helpdesk, Inventory, Purchase, and Manufacturing. As our Odoo Delivery Manager , you’ll ensure it runs smoothly, evolves with our needs, and supports every team in delivering high-impact scientific work. You’ll be the bridge between business stakeholders and developers, making sure improvements are delivered on time, to spec, and with minimal disruption. Requirements Delivery & Project Management Own the end-to-end delivery pipeline: maintenance, enhancements, bug fixes, and new features. Manage and prioritise the Asana board, ensuring clarity and business value alignment. Coordinate part-time/freelance developers, tracking timelines, risks, and dependencies. Maintain a living roadmap of ERP improvements. Requirement Gathering & Solution Design Capture, refine, and translate stakeholder needs into actionable developer tasks. Analyse workflows to ensure solutions align with operational processes. Define acceptance criteria and validate all deliverables. Challenge unnecessary customisations, favouring standard Odoo features. Quality Assurance Plan and execute QA cycles for all developments. Conduct functional tests, validate data flows, and oversee UAT sign-offs. Track and resolve defects promptly. Documentation & Training Maintain clear records of workflows, configurations, and customisations. Create user guides and quick-reference materials. title: Senior Platform Engineer
description: About seQura seQura provides innovative, flexible and easy-to-use payment technologies that help merchants acquire, convert and retain more customers. We make a difference in sales performance by tailoring our solutions to different sectors, to address their unique pain points and deliver superior results in Retail, Education, Eyewear, Repairs and Travel. We also empower smart shopping to consumers who seek more value, convenience, and flexibility in their shopping, with new payment experiences that allow them to save, access interest-free credit, or pay in small, comfortable installments of up to 24 months. Born in Barcelona, seQura is a privately-owned fintech, currently expanding throughout southern Europe and Latin America, growing above 50% CAGR. Over 6000 businesses, almost 3 million shoppers, and almost 400 employees continue to rate us as one of the most loved and trusted fintechs out there, with an NPS of 87%, a Trustpilot rating of 4.7/5, and a Glassdoor rating of 4.1/5. About the role 🤓 We're looking for a Senior Platform Engineer to join our Platform team and help us build the platform that lets every engineer at seQura ship safely, quickly, and on their own. seQura is expanding into new international markets, and the platform has to grow with it without growing its cost at the same pace. At the same time, AI is changing how infrastructure is built and run. We already put AI agents to work on our everyday platform work, from reviewing infrastructure changes and explaining plans to helping engineers resolve incidents on their own. Our goal is to go much further: independent agents working across the whole scope of the platform, with engineers who decide what matters and own the outcome. You'll work in a cloud-native AWS environment, in a regulated fintech, where security, compliance, and reliability are part of the product we offer to the rest of engineering. How we build at seQura 🤖 AI-assisted development is how our engineers work every day. We use AI agents to think through problems, write, review and iterate on code, and we're looking for engineers who already work this way, or are actively making the shift. What matters to us isn't whether you know the syntax and idioms of your preferred programming language or tech stack by heart. It's whether you understand the problem you're solving, can explain the business logic behind it, and own every line you ship, no matter who (or what) wrote it first. AI helps you move faster, challenge assumptions, explore different approaches and improve your solutions. But knowing which questions to ask, making sound technical and product decisions, and taking responsibility for the outcome is always up to you. Our technical interviews reflect this approach: you'll use your own AI tools, and we'll ask you to walk us through your solution, both the business reasoning and the code. If you're only interested in technical challenges without engaging in the product decisions behind them, or you'd rather not work with AI, this probably isn't the right role for you. About the Platform team 🧩 Team Mission To empower engineers with secure, efficient, and compliant infrastructure, while continuously improving through automation and collaboration. What we own Our multi-account AWS foundation and the Kubernetes (EKS) clusters where seQura's products run Infrastructure as Code with Terragrunt, delivered through pull requests and Atlantis Deployment and GitOps tooling: Helm charts, shared deploy configuration, and CI/CD pipelines The observability stack used across engineering: metrics, logs, traces, and alerting Security and compliance foundations: secrets management, access control, PCI DSS, and the controls required to operate regulated entities across multiple countries under regulations such as DORA, NIS2 and those still to come. Internal developer tooling, including the AI agents and Claude Code plugins that engineers use to work with our platform on their own How we work We're enablers: internal teams are our customers, and we measure success by how much they can do without us We're autonomous end-to-end: we code, deploy, observe, improve, and document what we build Everything as code, everything through a pull request, everything reviewed, and every important decision written down in an ADR Strong opinions, held weakly; collaborators over rock stars; blameless by default We plan by quarter and choose initiatives by their impact on users and on the business We work closely with every product engineering team, with Security, with the Data Platform team, and with Compliance. What challenges you'll be solving 🚀 International expansion : help seQura launch in multiple new markets, with the isolation, compliance, and reliability each one requires AI-native platform : move from AI that assists us to independent agents that operate across the whole scope of the platform, from infrastructure changes to support and incident response Keeping up with open source in the AI era : define new strategies to adopt, upgrade, and secure the open source software we depend on, now that it moves faster than ever Scale without raising our baseline cost : design the strategies that let the business keep growing while our base infrastructure cost stays flat What to expect in the next 90 days 🏁 Month 1: Learn the terrain 🧭 You'll join initiatives the team already has in motion, pairing with your teammates and shipping your first changes to production. You'll learn how we work, why we made the decisions we made, and what the rest of engineering expects from us. By the end of the month: you've shipped to production and you know who to ask for what. Month 2: Own your first mission 🎯 We'll hand you an opportunity the team has already identified, and it's yours: from the technical design to running it in production. You'll keep discovering seQura along the way, and we'll be there whenever you need context. By the end of the month: you've delivered an initiative end-to-end and you have your own opinion on where the platform should go next. Month 3: Shape what comes next 🚀 With more context, you'll be the one finding the opportunity. description: About Nebius : Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure. Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI. Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D. The role We run a large-scale GPU cloud and AI infrastructure platform. Fraud and abuse — stolen payment cards, fake sign-ups, compute mining, credential abuse, and coordinated free-tier exploitation — directly threaten platform economics, capacity availability for legitimate customers, and our standing with payment providers and cloud partners. As Product Manager, Anti-Fraud, you own the product roadmap for the systems that detect, prevent, and respond to fraud and abuse across the customer lifecycle — from onboarding and payment through to ongoing consumption. You sit at the intersection of Trust & Safety, Payments/Billing, Risk, Data Science, and Product Engineering, and you balance two goals in constant tension: stop bad actors and keep friction near zero for real customers. Your responsibilities will include: Own the end-to-end anti-fraud product roadmap: signup/KYC checks, payment fraud detection, account takeover protection, and compute-abuse (e.g., crypto mining, resource reselling) prevention. Own the rules and risk-scoring surfaces — the tooling that lets analysts and data scientists define, test, and deploy detection rules and ML models with clear guardrails and audit trails. Own the manual review and case-management experience for the Trust & Safety operations team, including queues, evidence views, and action workflows (block, limit, step-up verification, release). Own customer-facing friction points — verification flows, step-up challenges, and appeals — designed to minimize false positives and protect the legitimate user experience. Identify fraud and abuse incidents early — define the signals, alerts, and thresholds that surface incidents before they scale, and own the detection surface that flags them. Participate in incident reviews and post-mortems, capturing root causes and turning each finding into concrete improvements to detection rules, models, and the roadmap. Ensure timely response to active incidents — drive fast triage, clear ownership, and mitigation, working alongside Trust & Safety, Engineering, and Data Science to contain impact. Write clear PRDs and specs that translate fuzzy risk problems into shippable engineering and data-science work. Partner with Analytics team on detection models — defining the problem, labels, and success criteria, and deciding where rules vs. ML are the right tool. Run experiments and monitor rollouts, watching both fraud-catch metrics and false-positive / customer-friction impact. Work with Legal/Compliance to keep detection and enforcement aligned with payment-network rules, KYC/AML expectations, and data-privacy requirements. Track and report on fraud loss, chargeback rate, false-positive rate, review throughput, and time-to-detection. We expect you to have: Proven product management experience in fraud, risk, trust & safety, or payments. Strong analytical skills — comfortable with data, SQL or equivalent, and reasoning about precision/recall trade-offs and metrics. Ability to make decisions under ambiguity and to balance security, business, and customer-experience priorities. Solid collaboration with engineering and data science; you can hold a technical conversation about signals, features, and model behavior. Exposure to cloud, SaaS, marketplace, fintech, or infrastructure products. Understanding payment fraud, chargebacks, KYC/AML, or device/network signals (fingerprinting, velocity, IP reputation). It would be an added bonus if you have: Familiarity with ML-based detection systems and their operational lifecycle (drift, retraining, monitoring). Experience with abuse patterns specific to compute or GPU platforms (mining, credential stuffing, free-tier farming). Benefits & Perks: Competitive compensation Career growth and learning opportunities Flexibility and ownership Collaborative and innovative culture Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects International environment and talented teams What's it like to work at Nebius : Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI Equal Opportunity Statement: Nebius is an equal opportunity employer. title: Head of People
description: About Us There are 55 million Americans over 65 living at home, and their families are anxious in ways that go far beyond "I hope mom's alright." We built a phone that works out of the box, AI check-in calls that surface how she's really doing, and a family app that replaces daily dread with peace of mind. Families tell us they used to wake up with a knot in their stomach. They don't anymore. We are customer-obsessed to an unusual degree. When we had a major network outage, everyone, including recruiters, engineers, and marketers, got on the phone with customers. That's not a policy. It's just who we are. It is working, with tens of thousands of families trusting us. We are looking for an executive partner on people: a peer to the co-founders who owns talent, culture and recruiting across the company. There is plenty still to build here, but this is not an HR business partner role. You will co-author, with the co-founders, who we hire, who we keep and grow, who we part ways with, and what it feels like to work here. If building the team that brings peace of mind to millions of seniors and their families is how you want to spend the next few years, we'd love to talk. What you'll own Hire the top 1% You know what extraordinary looks like. You can explain why someone is exceptional rather than merely good, and hold every hiring manager, including the co-founders, to that bar. You'll build and lead the recruiting team: at least two recruiters, one for technical and senior roles and one for high-volume customer-facing roles. Initially you run searches yourself while you build out your team. Down the line, you may be hands on recruiting for executive roles. You'll grow us to about 150 to 160 people by the end of 2027, adding 12 to 20 non-rep roles and 25 to 30 reps. You'll run your recruiters to tight funnel metrics like pass-through rates and time to hire, and you'll also measure the quality of hires after they start: are the people your team hired still here and excelling a year later? You'll make sure we hire the right people at the right time, not just the roles hiring managers announce they need, and that the people we hire are connected to our mission and likely to grow and succeed here. You'll be well-networked and able to deliver world-class hiring, not just high-volume recruiting. You bring in people we couldn't otherwise reach, you know what sells the best people on Community Phone and what keeps them here, and you make sure every candidate hears it. Keep extraordinary people, and only them You'll be the primary voice of culture alongside the co-founders. You'll make sure everyone understands the mission, what part of the system they're in, what their work feeds into, how their performance is evaluated, and why it matters. You'll make sure our most remarkable people stay: that they have the space, control and authority to do great work, that they feel pushed, capable and cared for, and that they get bigger scope before someone else offers it. You'll make sure we don't keep the people we shouldn't. You'll run a talent review with every leader each quarter (who is exceptional, who is solid, who should not be here in six months), track regretted and non-regretted attrition by team, and push managers to part ways when they need to, fairly and clearly, coaching them through direct feedback, clear expectations, performance plans and well-documented exits. You'll tell any leader, including the CEO, when they're hiring below the bar, protecting a weak performer, or avoiding a hard conversation. You'll ensure our culture scales as we scale globally. You believe in the value of international and remote work. Our team is distributed across 12+ countries. Build the leadership bench and the systems behind it You'll partner with the executive team to build a bench of phenomenal leaders. We're building our leadership bench; your job is to make sure that in 18 months we have the leaders we need, whether we grow them or hire them. You'll keep the leadership team on the same page: what stage each department is in, what it needs most right now, and where we need to align. You'll make our four (typically international) offsites per year count. You'll understand why we're there, what each department would benefit most from, and how we make the most of our time together. The executive assistant, who reports to you, runs the logistics. You'll make onboarding phenomenal, especially for leaders, so new people are effective and feel the mission in their first weeks. You'll build the strategies and systems that let us do all of this at scale: how we level and compensate people, replacing case-by-case decisions; how we review performance; and how we part ways fairly, predictably and without delay. Our recruiters, our executive assistants, and our (now-fractional) HR Business Partner will report to you. What we're looking for You have 8+ years in people leadership, including a seat at the executive table at a company of 250+ people, where you owned talent and culture rather than administered them. You can identify extraordinary talent and explain what makes it so. You've personally brought in people other companies couldn't get, you're well-networked enough to do it again, and you've hired and managed recruiters who could too. You're an author of culture, and you take that responsibility seriously. You know what a strong culture feels like from the inside, you can name the handful of things that make it so, and you hold the company to them. You're direct, firm and hard to talk out of a position, and you want to push and be pushed by the co-founders as a peer. You're a strategic, systematic executive, not an HR business partner. The ATS, HRIS and payroll are already running; your work is the thinking behind compensation, leadership, performance and retention, and the judgment to make clear calls and see them through. You've designed comp philosophies, grown first-time managers into real leaders, and made exits fair and fast. How we work We're a fast-growing, YC-backed company built on curiosity, a bias toward action, and a founder mindset. We'd rather ship something small and learn than debate it for a month. You'll report directly to Ellie Lasater-Guttmann, a cofounder. You will sit on the leadership team. Originally posted on Himalayas

title: Security Engineer (m/w/d)
description: Shopware ist ein führendes E-Commerce-System , das es Unternehmen weltweit ermöglicht, im digitalen Handel schnell und effizient zu skalieren. Als zukunftsweisende Open-Source-Lösung wird Shopware bereits von einigen der größten europäischen Marken, Einzelhändlern und Herstellern im B2C- und B2B-Bereich eingesetzt. Hilf dabei, Shopware-Produkte sicherer zu machen, indem du während der gesamten Produktentwicklung Sicherheitsrisiken aufdeckst und reduzierst. Du arbeitest mit den Produktentwicklungsteams daran, Schwachstellen zu untersuchen, sichere Konzepte und Tests zu verbessern und praxisnahe Maßnahmen aufzubauen, die wiederkehrende Probleme in Commerce Core, Services und angrenzenden Produktbereichen verhindern. Product Security Engineering ist eine Engineering-Funktion . Die Produktteams bleiben dafür verantwortlich, ihren eigenen Code zu korrigieren und zu testen. Dieses Team bringt gezielte Sicherheitsexpertise, eine gemeinsame Roadmap zur Prävention und eine klare Koordination für produktübergreifende Sicherheitsarbeit ein. Requirements Untersuche Schwachstellenmeldungen, Sicherheitswarnungen, interne Findings und Nacharbeiten zu Sicherheitsvorfällen . Bewerte die technischen Auswirkungen und unterstütze dabei, bestätigte Aufgaben an die zuständigen Product Owner weiterzuleiten. Arbeite direkt mit Entwicklerinnen und Entwicklern an sicherem Design, Threat Models, Code Reviews, Ursachenanalysen, Fixes und Regressionstests für besonders risikoreiche Produktbereiche. Entwickle und verbessere wiederverwendbare Sicherheitskontrollen , Leitfäden für Entwicklerinnen und Entwickler, Tests für Missbrauchsszenarien und praxisnahe Automatisierung zur Erkennung und Behebung von Schwachstellen. Unterstütze dabei, für Product-Security-Findings klare Verantwortlichkeiten, Schweregrade, Reaktionsziele, betroffene Versionen und Nachweise zum Abschluss festzuhalten. Arbeite mit den Engineering-Teams von Commerce Core und Services an Sicherheitsaufgaben über verschiedene Repositories, unterstützte Versionen, APIs, Integrationen und das Extension-Ökosystem hinweg . Unterstütze koordinierte Sicherheits-Releases : Ermittle betroffene Bereiche, prüfe technische Behebungen und stimme dich mit Engineering, Product Operations, Quality, InfoSec und DevRel ab. Überführe Erkenntnisse aus Sicherheitsvorfällen und Releases in konkrete Änderungen am Engineering, Tests oder Tools. Verfolge anschließend nach, ob diese Maßnahmen übernommen werden. Kommuniziere bei zeitkritischen Aufgaben klar und dokumentiere Entscheidungen in den vereinbarten GitHub- und Confluence-Einträgen, damit Teams den Status nicht aus Slack-Verläufen rekonstruieren müssen. Wirke an gemeinsamen Teampraktiken mit und vertrete bei Bedarf den anderen Produktbereich. Das bringst du mit: Fundierte Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung und Interesse an Produkt- oder Anwendungssicherheit. Praktische Kenntnisse typischer Risiken in der Anwendungssicherheit , etwa Schwachstellen bei Authentifizierung und Autorisierung, Zugriffskontrolle, Datentrennung, API-Sicherheit, Umgang mit Zugangsdaten, Injection und Abhängigkeiten. Die Fähigkeit, produktiven Code und Tests zu lesen und zu ändern , Risiken für Entwicklerinnen und Entwickler verständlich zu erklären und wartbare Fixes mit umzusetzen. Erfahrung mit Threat Modeling, Sicherheitstests, Schwachstellenanalysen oder Secure Code Reviews ; in einigen Bereichen bringst du fundiertes Wissen mit, in anderen möchtest du dich weiterentwickeln. Gutes Urteilsvermögen bei der Einschätzung von Schweregrad, Auswirkungen auf Kundinnen und Kunden und Ausnutzbarkeit sowie bei der Frage, wann ein Problem sofort eskaliert werden muss. Klare schriftliche Kommunikation und die Fähigkeit, bei unklaren oder dringenden Aufgaben teamübergreifend zusammenzuarbeiten. Kenntnisse von PHP sowie mit Shopwares Produkten, Services oder dem Extension-Ökosystem sind hilfreich. Erfahrung mit Sicherheitsautomatisierung , etwa Dependency Scanning, SAST, Fuzzing oder Tests für Missbrauchsszenarien, ist ein Plus. Woran du deinen Erfolg erkennst: Findings werden einheitlich bewertet , schnell an die zuständigen Verantwortlichen weitergeleitet und mit einem sichtbaren Reaktionsziel und Abschlussnachweis versehen. Produktteams erhalten zeitnah praxisnahe Unterstützung bei Sicherheitsthemen und behalten zugleich die Verantwortung für die Umsetzung. Sicherheitsprüfungen und Tests erkennen relevante Risiken vor dem Release . Wo sinnvoll, enthalten Fixes passende Regressionstests. Aus Nacharbeiten zu Sicherheitsvorfällen und Releases entstehen konkrete, verantwortete Präventionsmaßnahmen statt ausschließlich einmaliger Patches. Umfang von Sicherheits-Releases, betroffene Versionen, technische Verantwortliche und Validierungsbedarf sind für Engineering, Product Operations, Quality, InfoSec und DevRel klar dokumentiert . Im primären Produktbereich des Engineers wächst die Sicherheitsexpertise . Gleichzeitig teilt das Team Standards und unterstützt sich bei Bedarf über Produktgrenzen hinweg. Das bieten wir dir: Unternehmenskultur: Offene Kultur, flache Hierarchien, Eigeninitiative wird gefördert. Arbeitsverträge: Unbefristete Anstellungen bieten langfristige Sicherheit. Flexibilität: Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Optionen für mobiles Arbeiten und Full-Remote-Verträge. Ausstattung: Freie Wahl der Arbeits-Hardware. Onboarding: Gut strukturiertes Onboarding mit Unterstützung durch einen persönlichen "Buddy". Arbeitsumfeld: Inspirierendes Umfeld mit engagierten Kollegen und einer dynamischen Gemeinschaft. Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten: Vielfältige Chancen für persönliches Wachstum und Entwicklung. Zusatzleistungen: Attraktive Benefits wie betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Gesundheitsprogramme und regelmäßige Teamevents. ... und vieles mehr! Einen detaillierten Einblick bekommst du auf unserer Karriereseite. Deine Ansprechperson für diese Stelle ist Josephine Scheffler und steht dir bei Fragen gerne zur Verfügung! Der Schutz deiner persönlichen Daten hat für uns oberste Priorität. Unsere Bewerberinformationen findest du hier. Originally posted on Himalayas

description: About Discovered Labs Discovered Labs is an SEO and answer engine optimisation (AEO) agency built by a Stanford rocket scientist turned AI researcher (Ben Moore) and a demand gen marketer with experience scaling B2B SaaS companies to 8-figures in ARR (Liam Dunne). We're a team of ML engineers, data scientists and senior marketers trusted by companies including Instantly, Granola, Composio and other Series A+ B2B SaaS businesses to help generate leads and customers through Google and AI assistants like ChatGPT. We do this through content marketing, technical optimisations and off-site brand amplification, including PR, backlinks and Reddit marketing. View recent case studies at . High-level overview of our approach: AI-powered operations: Our ML team builds internal tools that remove repetitive work and give marketers more time for judgement and execution. Senior judgement: Experienced marketers set the strategy and quality bar, and remain responsible for the work our tools help produce. Full-stack execution: We work across content, technical SEO/AEO and off-site amplification to give clients better outcomes. Note: If you want to stand out, please include a Loom video showing a tool, system or deliverable you've produced and are proud of. We'd love to see it! This role SEO/AEO is already Discovered Labs' top pipeline driver. We're hiring an experienced SEO/AEO Manager who can work confidently with data, run our content workflows, off-page programs and personally ship website improvements (using coding agents like Codex or Claude Code) to grow the qualified opportunities it generates. You'll report to Liam and agree commercial goals and quarterly direction with him. You'll own day-to-day prioritisation, delivery and reporting. Using and improving our existing methodology, proprietary tools and workflows, you'll diagnose performance, choose priorities and carry work through implementation and measurement. Your primary outcome is qualified inbound pipeline: relevant buyers discovering us through search and becoming sales opportunities. Keyword positions, relevant organic traffic and AI visibility help you understand whether the work is moving in the right direction. This is a full-time individual contributor role with no direct reports. The role is fully remote, ideally within ±4 hours of GMT. Everyone on the Discovered Labs team is tech savvy and data-driven, even if they didn’t start that way. If you have curiosity and the willingness to learn, you’ll thrive here. What you'll do You'll run our SEO/AEO programme to generate qualified inbound pipeline, with new content, refreshes and off-page campaigns tied to our pillar and cluster strategy. Develop our pillar and cluster strategy: Maintain our money-keyword universe, group queries by search intent and map priority clusters to target pages, using semantic clustering where useful. Close topic gaps with new content: Run the weekly content loop through our proprietary tools, keeping at least two weeks of approved assignments scheduled against editorial capacity and resolving SEO issues in briefs and drafts. Editors handle QA and publishing. Manage content refreshes: Diagnose content decay, underperformance and cannibalisation. Prepare blog refresh briefs covering keyword targeting, topic coverage and internal linking, then verify the changes and measure results. Build and optimise landing pages: Personally create and improve pages using coding agents and our GitHub repository. Submit tested pull requests and verify live changes. Fix technical SEO issues: Diagnose and fix issues with crawlability, indexation, internal linking, metadata and structured data. Test changes, verify live results and escalate complex engineering work. Own our off-page strategy: Define how targeted link building, Reddit and YouTube support our priority topics and objectives. Brief the specialists who produce the deliverables, review their work and use results to refine the strategy. Close AI visibility and citation gaps: Use embeddings and entity analysis where useful to investigate how AI answers represent and cite Discovered Labs. Test changes against the gaps you find. Build tools that improve delivery: Create and validate scripts, automations and AI workflows for recurring research, analysis and measurement. Connect every action to an objective: Tie each tactic to an overarching strategy and a clear objective: improving performance on commercial keywords, earning AI Overview placements, strengthening brand positioning or generating qualified pipeline. Measure progress against those objectives and use results to decide what to prioritise next. The ideal person for this role You make commercial SEO decisions. You can choose whether to create, refresh or consolidate content by weighing search intent, existing performance and relevance to the buyers we want to reach. You investigate before concluding. When performance changes, you check competing explanations across content, technical and off-page factors, and distinguish evidence from a plausible story. You turn investigation into implementation. You can take an SEO problem through analysis, a tested website change or a completed content workflow, and measurement of the result. You know which work needs editorial QA or engineering support and arrive with the work ready for that handoff. You enjoy the technical detail. You're curious about embeddings, entities and how content relates semantically. You explore the data, build small tools to test ideas and judge the work by whether it improves a useful decision or outcome. Requirements Demonstrated SEO execution, with examples of work you personally diagnosed, prioritised and implemented, the results and how you measured them. Experience independently translating business goals into search strategy and a practical delivery plan. Working fluency in Google Search Console, GA4, Ahrefs or an equivalent research tool, and a crawler such as Screaming Frog. You use them to investigate performance and check figures at source. Practical ability to build and improve website pages and make technical SEO changes using coding agents and GitHub, demonstrated through previous work or an exercise. An AI-assisted tool, script or workflow you've built or materially adapted to solve a real problem. Explain the decisions you made, what AI contributed, how you verified the code, data or output, and what improved. Evidence of rigorous SEO analysis that led to an implemented change: explain the data you used, the competing explanations you checked, your decision and how you measured the result. Reliable delivery tracking in a project management tool such as ClickUp, with clear actions, complete handoffs and documentation others can use. Excellent verbal and written English. Nice-to-haves (not required) Familiarity with B2B or B2B SaaS. Strong candidates from other SEO backgrounds are welcome. Agency experience or experience coordinating editors and specialist contributors. Deeper Python, SQL, statistics or applied machine-learning skills. Experience measuring AI visibility, analysing citations or running link-building and Reddit programmes. This role is not for you if… Your work ends with an audit or plan. We need someone who implements changes, resolves blockers and checks what happened afterwards. You treat traffic or citation counts as the final result. We expect you to connect search performance to relevant buyers and qualified opportunities. You ship AI output you cannot explain or verify. You remain responsible for the analysis, recommendations and code you use. Culture fit You'll thrive here if: You like small teams, direct feedback and a high degree of autonomy. You're curious about how search is changing and willing to test ideas against evidence. You communicate risks early and welcome a clear challenge to your recommendation. You won't thrive here if: You need heavy management or wait for perfect instructions before acting. You protect a perfect plan instead of delivering, learning and improving. You need a large team around you before you can produce useful work. What's in it for you Compensation: $30K - $75K USD (or EUR/GBP equivalent), DOE Fully remote: Work from where you do your best work, ideally within ±4 hours of GMT. Real autonomy: Make daily prioritisation and execution decisions, with direct access to Liam for strategic direction. Our in-house tools and methodology: Learn the proprietary SEO/AEO systems built by our engineers, apply them to our own growth and help improve them. We'll teach you our systems. Depth and visible impact: Build expertise across organic growth, technical SEO and applied analysis through sustained ownership of a programme whose results you can follow over time. Paid leave holidays Interview process Async assessment (15 minutes) 30 minute call with founder 90 minute deep-dive into career history and work 3 hour paid assessment Reference checks with former peers and managers. To apply Please complete the short form on the platform where you see this job ad. Be specific as possible when answering questions - we love detail. Please do not use sloppy AI to auto-apply for this role. It’s obvious and will result in us not progressing with your application for this role and future roles. Originally posted on Himalayas

In this role, you will work closely with the founders, engineers, designers, researchers, and other members of the team to decide what we should build and help turn ambiguous ideas into exceptional products. We're looking for someone who is unusually technical for a product manager. You don't need to be the engineer implementing every feature, but you should be comfortable understanding how the systems behind our products work, exploring data yourself, discussing architecture and technical tradeoffs with engineers, and rapidly prototyping ideas using modern AI and development tools. You should be deeply curious about users, obsessive about product quality, comfortable making decisions with imperfect information, and capable of independently taking a problem from an unclear opportunity to a shipped product with measurable impact. Write clear product specifications that communicate the problem, intended outcome, constraints, edge cases, and important product decisions without unnecessarily prescribing implementation. Work directly with engineers throughout development to resolve tradeoffs, answer product questions, and maintain a high quality bar. Collaborate closely with design and engineering to ensure the final product is functional, intuitive, delightful, and polished. Design and evaluate experiments, including feature flags and A/B tests, when experimentation is appropriate. Talk directly to users and develop a deep understanding of how Muslims around the world read, memorize, understand, and interact with the Quran. Proactively identify problems and opportunities across the product rather than waiting for a roadmap or requirements to be handed to you. Help shape Tarteel's broader product strategy and determine where our technology can create experiences that were previously impossible. Strong technical fluency and the ability to work directly with engineers on technically complex products. Regularly interpret, analyze, and execute tasks based on given instructions. BASIC QUALIFICATIONS: Master’s or PhD in physics or a highly related field. Expertise in one or more subdomains of physics, including but not limited to: condensed matter physics, high energy physics, nuclear physics, atomic/molecular/optical physics, quantum computing and information, computational physics, mathematical physics, and interdisciplinary physics (such as biophysics). Strong passion for and commitment to technological advancements and innovation. Teaching experience (as a professor, teacher, or tutor). Experience in technical writing, journalism, or a professional writing setting. title: Senior Product Designer (TinyMCE)
description: With software used by millions of developers, and thousands of products worldwide, Tiny creates some of the world's most popular open source software. Most developers would be familiar with TinyMCE, the flexible open source rich text editor used by companies such as Atlassian, Accelo, Drift and more. We are part of Tiugo Technologies , a launchpad for new developer platforms, helping software companies accelerate growth, increase operating efficiency and scale their business. Tiugo contains a suite of brands which are API-first, market-leading developer platforms focused on content creation and digital collaboration. Tiugo’s current family of brands include CKEditor, TinyMCE, ButterCMS and Uploadcare. Together our products have powered millions of software applications and websites. Enabling content and communication in everything from Microsoft to NASA, you might not know our name, but you’ve probably used our software. Your role: As the Senior Product Designer for TinyMCE, your work will have a direct impact on millions of users all over the world, literally. As a member of the TinyMCE product team, you will be involved throughout the development journey, from identifying the problems or opportunities to defining and designing the solution. You will be responsible for core design deliverables such as wireframes, prototypes, and UI designs, but also the broader experience for users, developers, and customers, for example how the editor should behave or if there are best practices that should be followed. TinyMCE is a widely used component that is integrated into customers' web apps. The design work is often highly functional, almost architectural, with a strong emphasis on research, usability, and user experience for all types of end-users. Empathy for both developers implementing TinyMCE and their end users is a must. You will partner closely with engineers from early exploration through release, using a strong understanding of modern web capabilities and constraints to assess feasibility, navigate technical tradeoffs, and ensure the shipped experience matches the design intent. You do not need to write production code, but you should be comfortable discussing complex implementation details, including HTML, CSS, accessibility, keyboard and focus behavior, and component architecture. You will also help maintain and evolve the TinyMCE design system across design and code. Tiny is a fully remote organization with team members in a dozen different countries across multiple continents. We emphasize communication skills. You must communicate design briefs, documentation, and ideas clearly in written or video form in English. Key responsibilities: Own cross-functional design initiatives from discovery to delivery, partnering with product management to frame problems and shape design requirements Validate design directions through prototyping, critique, and stakeholder feedback Drive alignment and tradeoff decisions with product, engineering, and design peers Continuously improve interaction patterns, accessibility, and consistency across the editor and its features Partner directly with engineers on feasibility and constraints, and follow designs through implementation to ensure the shipped result matches design intent Maintain and evolve the TinyMCE design system, from design source through its implementation in code Proactively identify experience gaps through customer feedback and research into industry trends and competitors, and propose improvements Requirements To be successful in this role you need the following: 5+ years of product design experience working with software development teams, including experience with cross-functional initiatives A track record of turning product goals into UX strategy with measurable outcomes Experience validating design directions through prototyping and user or stakeholder feedback. Strong interaction design and information architecture skills for complex, constraint-heavy flows Strong understanding of modern web capabilities and constraints, plus the ability to grasp complex technical concepts to drive a design from idea to release. Deep familiarity with accessibility standards and their impact on design decisions, especially keyboard and focus behavior Experience maintaining and evolving design systems and componentized designs Experience facilitating critiques, workshops, and stakeholder alignment, with strong communication skills At least four working hours of overlap with the CET timezone Comfortable speaking and writing in English Why join us: B2B contract-based monthly remuneration is 21.600 - 26.400 PLN + VAT or its equivalent on the employment contract. Flexible schedule and the possibility to work fully remotely. Professional development resources (up to 5 days of additional leave and 6 000 PLN yearly). LinkedIn Learning access. Extra leave for Tiugo Day – our company’s foundation day and your birthday. English lessons with a native speaker and an online language platform where you can learn English, Spanish, and German. Access to a mental health and well-being platform with 24/7 dedicated psychological support. Private medical care (Enel Med or Medicover) and Multisport card. 2 weeks of paid parental leave for our contractors. Originally posted on Himalayas

title: Mobile Engineer - React Native (100% Remote)
description: Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction. Innovate with Tether Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services. But that’s just the beginning: Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities. Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing. Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity. Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways. Why Join Us? Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry. If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you. Are you ready to be part of the future? About the job We have launched Keet Mobile on iOS and Android, bringing our full P2P technology stack to everyone. Keet Mobile is not your average app: it’s heavy lifting is performed by a custom JS runtime specially designed for peer-to-peer usage (in fact, it reuses 100% of Keet Desktop’s code!). The UI logic, on the other hand, is 100% React Native, giving us flexibility and the ability to iterate quickly. We believe this pattern opens the door to huge possibilities in the future, and we need your help getting there! Responsibilities In this role, you will develop and maintain Keet Mobile, our peer-to-peer chat and calling app for iOS and Android. Keet Mobile is built with React Native and Expo, and its P2P core runs on the device itself in a Bare worklet. You'll own features end to end, from UI/UX implementation to using the P2P core apis. You will: - Build and polish features across chat, voice and video calls, media sharing, device pairing and identity backup - Integrate native platform capabilities such as push notifications, camera, bio-metrics and background tasks on both iOS and Android - Profile and optimise performance on real devices, including startup time, long chats, media handling, battery and network use - Write unit and end-to-end tests, and help keep releases stable through CI and crash reporting - Work closely with the core P2P, design and product teams, and review code with a high bar for quality Requirements Significant experience with React Native, Redux for state management and Redux-Saga Highly proficient in JavaScript and ES6+. Experienced with WebSockets, RESTful based APIs. Knowledge in native languages (Swift/Kotlin) and familiarity with native build tools (Xcode/Android Studio) is advantageous. Experience working with a remote team Interested in modernizing and optimizing different mobile or web applications. Bonus points if you have any built something amazing on any p2p frameworks . Important information for candidates Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles: Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website. Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms. Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ or @ We will never request payment or financial details. About the role We're looking for a Growth Product Manager to drive product-led growth across the customer lifecycle: acquisition, conversion, retention and expansion. You'll sit in our Revenue organization and own the product levers behind our self-serve motion, with an impact that reaches across the wider customer base. You'll work with the leadership team to set measurable goals, build and run the growth roadmap, and work closely with engineering, design and data to ship experiments and product changes that move revenue metrics. Own the growth roadmap and the metrics it is meant to move, from conversion through to retention and expansion. Identify and prioritize high-impact growth opportunities using product data, funnel analysis and user insight. Use LLMs and AI tools to prototype and demo ideas quickly, then write clear product requirements and partner with engineering and design to take initiatives from discovery through launch and post-release optimization. Bring a point of view on the biggest opportunities across the customer lifecycle, from conversion through to retention and expansion, and make the case for larger bets backed by evidence. Collaborate across product, engineering, design, data, marketing and customer-facing teams to deliver measurable outcomes. What success looks like Clear ownership of growth metrics. Core KPIs across conversion, retention and expansion have agreed definitions and a regular reporting rhythm, and you can explain not just how they moved but why. A disciplined experimentation program. Experiments run on a steady cadence, each with a clear hypothesis, success criteria and a documented readout that leads to a decision. Reliable delivery. You consistently ship what you commit to and keep stakeholders aligned along the way. Evidence-backed bets. You make the case for larger bets, take them through to delivery, and measure their impact against what was predicted, including the misses. Measurable business impact. Improvements in conversion, retention and expansion can be traced to the work you led. Requirements What you bring Product management experience in B2B SaaS, with a focus on growth. A proven track record in a product-led growth or self-serve organization, owning KPIs such as trial-to-paid conversion, retention and expansion. Experience with product analytics tools such as Amplitude, Mixpanel or similar. Clear written communication, from product requirements to stakeholder updates. Experience working closely with engineers and designers, and leading cross-functional work through influence. Fluency with AI tools and LLMs, including using them to prototype and demo ideas quickly, and a habit of using them in day-to-day product work: research, analysis, specs and delivery. Our values Time Doctor is fully remote and async-first. Three values shape how we work, and they matter even more in a role that sits across so many teams. Remote Rockstar. You thrive in a remote setting. You communicate clearly in writing, keep your work visible, and stay focused and productive without an office around you, so the team stays aligned across time zones. Self-guided Missile. In a remote team, work only keeps moving when people can drive it themselves. You set direction, make decisions with the information you have, and push initiatives forward without waiting to be told. Teamwork Titan. Growth depends on product, engineering, design, data and revenue teams pulling together. You build strong partnerships, share context and credit, and bring people along to deliver results as one team. Why this role You own the product levers behind our self-serve motion, with a direct line from your work to revenue. You shape the growth strategy with the Director of Growth and the Chief Revenue Officer, not just execute it. You work AI-first, on a team where prototyping, analysis and specs with LLMs are already part of how product work gets done. We are profitable and bootstrapped. Your budget comes from customers, not from a burn rate. Fully remote and flexible, working with talented people in 30+ countries. Our hiring approach Because experimentation and AI are core to this role, our process asks you to show us real work rather than describe it. Expect to walk us through a growth experiment you designed, what you learned and the decision it led to, and how you have used AI tools to prototype, analyze or ship product work faster. This is a full-time, 100% remote role. We are an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity and inclusion. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status or disability. title: Head of Paid Social, Insurance
description: WHO ARE WE? Launch Potato is the discovery and conversion company. We reach tens of millions of people every month through our brands, including FinanceBuzz, All About Cookies, and OnlyInYourState. We turn that attention into real outcomes for our partners, some of the world's leading companies. Our mission: create predictable, high-value customer acquisition at scale by connecting discovery, intent, and performance across category-leading consumer brands in finance, travel, and entertainment. We run profitable and bootstrapped, with a South Florida HQ and a remote-first team across 18 countries. WHY JOIN US? You own outcomes here, not tasks. We measure work by impact, not activity. The pace is real, and change is constant, so the people who do best turn change into opportunity instead of waiting for it to settle. Feedback runs direct and lands with respect. Ordinary people make themselves extraordinary at Launch Potato . Auto insurance on paid social is one of our highest-potential channels and you would own it end to end taking it to the next level. This is a hands-on seat. You are in Ads Manager daily, pulling your own numbers, setting the testing agenda with the creative team, and staying with a test through launch, read, and post-mortem. If you are looking to hand a strategy deck to someone else to execute, this is not it. The honest trade: the channel has proven scale and a real ceiling. Creative fatigues fast, attribution is noisy, and regulation reshapes what you can say and where you can send traffic. Those problems are yours. Nobody is going to solve them above you. Why This Seat You own a vertical, not a slice. Meta and TikTok spend for auto insurance, end to end, from budget and bid strategy to the creative roadmap to live margin performance. One owner, and it is you. Margin is the metric. Not impressions, not a ROAS number handed down without context. You decide when to push into a lower ROAS for contribution dollars and when to pull back, and you are trusted to make that call. The mandate is scale, not maintenance. The plan is to grow this channel to roughly 2.5x its current monthly spend without giving up margin. That is the job. If you want a channel that is already solved, this is the wrong one. The interesting part is unsolved. Creative fatigue cycles, attribution noise, and compliance constraints on a vertical with real headroom. You will not be maintaining someone else's playbook. You will be writing the one the rest of the team runs. Short line to the people who decide. You work directly with the Senior Director who owns paid marketing, the GM of Auto Insurance, compliance, and product. No layers to route a recommendation through. Profitable and bootstrapped. Spend decisions here get made on margin, not against a burn plan set by someone else's timeline. What You'll Bring Paid social bought at scale in performance marketing, affiliate, or leadgen. Not brand work and not agency-of-record media planning. Deep hands-on Meta expertise: campaign structure, bid and budget strategy, audience and placement testing, and diagnosing a performance shift caused by a platform or attribution change rather than by your campaigns. Real TikTok scale, not test budgets. You have managed meaningful spend through allowlisting, vertical restrictions, and landing page requirements. Direct accountability for CPA, ROAS, or contribution margin on monthly spend of $250,000 or more. Experience in a compliance-heavy vertical such as insurance, lending, credit, or health, where creative and landing page claims are constrained. Fluency with tracking and attribution: pixel and server-side event setup, postbacks, conversion QA, and the judgment to spot when the data is lying to you. Four or more years in a hands-on, in-the-weeds buying role with direct margin accountability. How we work, and what we look for in how you work: Focus and Win. You start from the P&L and the metric, not the tactic, and you are relentless about why performance moved. You do not stop at the first explanation. Better Every Day. You seek feedback and turn it into visible change, and you write down what you learn so the next buyer does not relearn it. Stronger Together. You brief the creative team clearly, give specific feedback, and treat them as partners in the testing agenda rather than a request queue. You surface a problem early with a recommendation attached instead of waiting to be asked. Embrace Change. When a platform policy or a compliance constraint moves, you find the compliant path to scale rather than stopping at no. Nice to Have Auto insurance, or another regulated leadgen domain Advertorial or direct-response landing page funnels and conversion rate testing Working knowledge of AI creative generation tooling Familiarity with Looker What You'll Own Meta and TikTok spend for auto insurance, end to end, with measurable margin impact. You have a teammate on the buying team who can support execution when volume calls for it, and the ownership stays with you. Pacing and margin targets, including the judgment call on when lower ROAS is the right trade for contribution dollars. The creative testing roadmap, built with the Creative Strategist and the creative team and turned into shipped concepts at high velocity. A documented, repeatable playbook other buyers on the team can run. Direct relationships with Meta and TikTok reps, and the allowlisting, beta access, and escalation paths a restricted vertical depends on. The working partnership with the GM of Auto Insurance, compliance, and product on funnel, landing page, and offer strategy. What Great Looks Like By the end of your first year: Auto insurance paid social hits its margin and pacing targets consistently, and you can explain every miss without being asked. Monthly spend is materially higher than when you started, and margin held. Creative test velocity is up and the win rate is better, because the roadmap is deliberate instead of reactive. Your testing playbook is in use by other buyers on the team. Meta and TikTok reps take your call, and you have unlocked at least one thing for this vertical that the team did not have access to before. Compliance and product treat you as a partner on funnel and offer strategy rather than as a request coming in. This Isn't the Right Seat If You Want to set strategy and hand execution to someone else. This role is in the account daily. Have only bought inside an agency with no accountability for margin or profit. Need a stable platform environment. Policy, creative fatigue, and attribution all shift here, sometimes in the same week. Treat compliance as the reason something cannot be done rather than a constraint to solve within. Prefer to work a problem quietly and present a finished answer. We would rather hear it early and rough. Want to accelerate your career? Apply now! description: About Tarteel Tarteel was founded with one mission: to strengthen the relationship Muslims have with the Quran. This goal has been at the very heart of Tarteel since its creation, and we continue to strive to provide the proper tools to empower the Muslim ummah to better connect with the words of Allah SWT, nourishing their faith in doing so. Inspired by the Islamic Golden Age, we saw untapped potential in the area of religious technology. We built Tarteel to help Muslims improve their Quranic study using the best digital tools. The Quran is a journey, and Tarteel is your companion. The Tarteel app has more than 20M downloads and is powered by our state of the art models. As a company we've established relationships with leading AI companies such as Nvidia, who has us as a featured customer: . We currently have a core team of 20 exceptionally talented individuals. What we're looking for Tarteel is building the tools and resources to support and accelerate the work of the next generation of Muslim developers. Our primary open source toolkit, Quranic Universal Library (QUL), provides developers with all the resources and assets they need to build Islamic applications and is currently used by 100s of apps serving millions of users around the world. As a developer advocate, you’ll help developers make the most of QUL by providing them with guides, tutorials, and platform improvements that will help them utilize the resources to their full potential. You’ll encourage others to get involved in the ecosystem by administrating grants for project bounties, as well as champion those who have added value to the ecosystem. You are someone that has strong communication skills, both oral and written, and ideally have existing experience working with developers. You should also be able to collect and provide feedback from external stakeholders and share them internally to help scope and prioritize our open source resources roadmap and development. Responsibilities Design and administer a grants program. This will include writing and reviewing project proposals and selection/acceptance criteria, identifying ways to attract applicants, and keeping them in close contact during and after the grant period. Create technical content demonstrating how to quickly build real projects on top of Tarteel’s open source software (OSS), including blog posts, tutorials, and sample code. Identify and create documentation and functional changes that improve usability of QUL. Champion the community and highlight community members’ work. Evangelize Tarteel’s OSS and the broader ecosystem by creating content such as short posts and videos for distribution on X and other networked channels. Engage with developers through forums, social media, and webinars. Identify and prioritize resource gaps within the Islamic software ecosystem. Represent Tarteel at Muslim developer events and hackathons. Independently seek and discover novel opportunities for collaboration with other developers in the ecosystem and encourage their usage of and contribution to Tarteel’s OSS. Increase discoverability of Tarteel’s OSS, such as by making QUL the top repo when searching for “Quran” on GitHub. Qualifications 2+ years working in a developer relations role or similar Fluent English Proficiency Strong verbal and written communication skills Experience creating digital content (videos, presentations, etc.) Familiarity with Github Issues and Projects Proficiency with a frontend-based framework for demos (React, React Native, Vue, etc.) Ability to work independently and in a team-oriented environment Availability for meetings from Monday to Thursday between 8am and 12pm Eastern Preferred Qualifications Professional Arabic Proficiency Familiarity with Ruby on Rails Experience with open source software or large volunteer-driven projects Experience with AI-based tools for content generation and automation Benefits Fully remote work - Work anytime, anywhere Dunya + Akhira — Islamic work week + Islamic Holidays and culture Unlimited time off with manager approval Yearly team retreats and off-sites Ability to work in your thobe/abaya or traditional clothes in the comfort of your own home Work directly with the core founding team, reporting to the CTO Interview Process Our interview process for this role consists of three stages: 60-minute screener 60-minute technical interview diving into more depth than the screener and also including a live coding problem 60-minute culture fit interview focused on situational scenarios and personal perspectives Originally posted on Himalayas

description: SE Ranking , an all-in-one SEO and digital marketing platform, is seeking a Senior Product Manager to scale our Data Product - our API and MCP offering - from early traction into a repeatable, scalable revenue line. We've already gone from 0 to 1: we have paying API customers, a fast-growing MCP that recently overtook our classic API in daily unique users, and partners building agentic workflows on top of our data. Now we need someone to own the entire revenue funnel and turn that momentum into further growth of MCP usage and Data MRR. If you get excited about turning a data & developer product into a growth engine - and about making SE Ranking the marketing intelligence infrastructure for AI agents - then this role is for you. Key Responsibilities: You will report directly to Mike Korenugin , VP of Product, and own the entire funnel for the Data Product (API + MCP) : from acquisition and activation, to sales enablement, to onboarding, retention, and expansion. You'll drive two connected revenue engines - net-new MRR from API and Data customers, and net dollar retention (NDR) by embedding MCP and agentic workflows into the core SEO jobs our customers do every day. You'll lead a focused squad with Aleksander Germatsky as your Engineering Manager and Senior Engineers Dominik Stypula and Mikhail Liubushkin shipping the endpoints, infrastructure, and developer experience that make the product sell and stick. On go-to-market, you'll partner daily with Valentyna Havryliuk , our PMM driving API & MCP adoption, and with Alexey Trusevich , the dedicated Account Executive for the Data Product. Beyond your squad, you'll work closely with Demand Gen, SEO, Growth, and PR on getting the product discovered and promoted; with Sales & Success and Support on closing and retaining customers; and with the Data team on coverage, accuracy, and the endpoints customers ask for. Your job is to connect all of these into one growth motion. Initial Focus Areas: Craft a strategy for Data Product with two goals in mind Grow Data revenue : understand our current packaging and pricing gaps across plans & products, the PAYG funnel, and credit packs; define a clear, repeatable motion for upmarket deals. Define the inputs (acquisition, activation, expansion) that move the number and hold the product to them. Drive MCP usage and capabilities: own the MCP adoption track as a strong NDR lever. Scale the adoption flows and lifecycle upsells, close capability gaps customers hit, and make the Claude, ChatGPT, and n8n connector experiences feel amazing. Ramp up solution engineering for Sales & Success: we’ve got a new person starting as solution engineer and strong L3 technical support, but they would often need your help and insight to unblock AEs and CSMs on credit provisioning, key generation, quota changes, connector troubleshooting; and translating prospect requirements into solutions that win deals. Learn how Demand Gen & Outbound is connected to Product: partner with PMM and Demand Gen to scale what's working - workshops and MCP bootcamps, ABM, spokespeople and influencer content, PR, and SEO - and to sharpen the website. Help us find exciting API/MCP use cases from top clients and influencers and turn them into content and sales enablement assets. Long-Term Responsibilities: Make the Data Product a repeatable, scalable revenue line: evolve packaging, pricing, and the self-serve funnel so growth doesn't depend on heroics. Use signals from won and lost deals, usage, and feedback to generate strong hypotheses and continuously improve win rates, activation, and expansion. Grow MCP into the default "agentic SEO" workflow: keep MCP workflows healthy and lead the move from data to action, so customers believe SE Ranking is the way to automate SEO with AI agents - defending NDR and opening natural paths to expansion and win-back. Build a real solution-engineering function: grow from firefighting into a system - documentation, tooling, and onboarding that let customers discover and integrate our API and MCP, and let Sales & Success move fast without engineering in the loop. Expand endpoint & data coverage from the voice of the customer: translate prospect and customer feedback into a prioritized roadmap for new endpoints and data (e.g. URL-level GSC, prompt generation, Local Marketing and AIRT coverage), and partner with the Data team on accuracy and the questions buyers ask about how the data is sourced and validated. Be a strategic GTM partner across teams: surface trade-offs, unblock cross-team dependencies, and keep Product, Demand Gen, Sales, Success, and Data aligned as priorities and timelines shift. We are destined to be if you have: Launched new B2B products and taken them from 0 to 1 , leading Sales Enablement and deeply engaging with Demand Gen to achieve GTM success. Owned a revenue funnel end to end - acquisition, activation, sales enablement, onboarding, retention, and expansion - and know how to grow TOFU and help close deals. Built API-first or data products that offer a great self-served developer experience but don't completely puzzle out business stakeholders. Hands-on, practical AI experience and genuine excitement about MCP and agentic workflows - and ideas about how a data product becomes the tool of choice inside tools like Claude and Codex. Acted as a technical partner to Sales & Success , supporting demos, prospect setups, and troubleshooting, and turning that into product and tooling improvements. Either direct experience in SEO / AI Search , or a track record of ramping quickly in a new and technical domain - and the appetite to do so here. Explained complex concepts and strategies so that your team, fellow PMs, Designers, Senior Leaders, Support, Success, and Sales reps as well as users all understood you easily. Managed stakeholders' expectations with grace as delivery dates shift and plans change. Embraced the constant change of a startup. Great spoken English. * If you feel strongly that you have what it takes for this role but don't technically tick all the boxes - apply anyway, just highlight what you'd bring to the table. Tools we use for work: Self-served product analytics: Amplitude, PowerBI, Grafana In-app guides and surveys: Amplitude, Typeform Session replay: LogRocket User feedback: Enterpret, Avoma, Zendesk tickets & NPS, Brightback Tasks, roadmaps, documentation: Linear, Miro, Notion Communication: Slack Claude Code / Cowork to bring it all together. What we offer: 22 days of paid time off, plus your local national holidays Flexible work hours and a culture that trusts you to manage your time Private medical insurance or a medical allowance (depending on your location) Extended paid sick leave so you can fully recover without worry Career map with growth opportunities Support for wellbeing and L&D Best hardware for your work (team Apple) An award-winning product loved by thousands of customers worldwide A transparent, flexible culture with people at the core of everything we do Events that are actually fun Originally posted on Himalayas
