description: SE Ranking is a profitable, growing B2B SaaS business - around 200 people, remote-first and globally distributed. As the business has scaled into a more complex multi-entity, multi-currency structure, we're hiring a senior controllership leader to own the integrity, accuracy, and audit-readiness of our books. This is a hands-on, build-oriented role for someone who takes real pride in well-controlled, audit-grade financials - and who wants to mature the accounting function as the company's structure and ambitions grow. You'll own the accounting backbone: multi-entity consolidation, internal controls, compliance, and the path to a clean external audit. You'll report to the CFO and work closely with the wider leadership team. If you're energised by raising the bar on how a scaling, multi-entity business runs its numbers, in a fast-moving, low-ego, global team, this is your role. What you'll do Own the integrity and audit-quality of the financials. Take ownership of the company's accounting integrity and ensure financial reporting is accurate, compliant, and defensible across all entities — in partnership with the accounting team that runs the day-to-day close and statements. Own multi-entity consolidation and the controls around the close. Own clean, accurate multi-entity, multi-currency consolidation and the control framework that sits around the monthly close, so the numbers are dependable and audit-grade. Drive audit readiness. Document internal controls, implement defensible revenue recognition, and bring the company to a point where it can confidently face an external audit. Design and oversee the ERP migration. Lead the design of the QuickBooks-to-NetSuite (or equivalent) migration as the backbone of a more mature, audit-grade finance infrastructure, partnering with the accounting team and NetSuite consultants on execution. Build the control environment. Establish the accounting policies, internal controls, and process documentation a scaling, internationally distributed business needs. Own compliance, transfer pricing, and IP. Own multi-jurisdiction statutory compliance and international tax, and lead transfer pricing and the tracking of IP flows across entities for the group's structure — working closely with external advisors. Own key external relationships. Own the relationships with the company's banks, CPA firm, auditors, and core finance and accounting vendors, including bank communications and reporting. Lead a lean controllership team. Develop the dedicated support this function needs so controls, compliance, and consolidation scale with the business. We're looking for someone who has Senior experience. At a B2B SaaS or comparable technology company. You've built or materially upgraded an accounting function, not just maintained a mature one. Audit pedigree and qualification. A Big Four (or comparable) background with roughly 10+ years in audit and controls, and an ACCA (preferred) or CPA qualification. You've prepared for or managed an external audit of consolidated entities specifically and you know what audit-ready actually means in practice. ERP migration experience. You've led or played a central role in a finance systems upgrade. You understand what it takes to get from growing to audit-grade maturity. Multi-currency and international finance experience. Managing books across multiple countries, entities, and currencies is second nature to you. European experience is a strong plus (VAT, local statutory regimes), and you're comfortable with international tax, transfer pricing, multi-jurisdiction compliance, and bridging GAAP and IFRS. Ownership of a control environment. You've built the controls, documentation, and consolidation discipline behind a dependable close. Modern, tech-forward mindset. You're comfortable in an async-first, globally distributed environment where Slack and clear written communication are the default. Bonus points, if you have Experience integrating finance teams or functions post-acquisition. Experience building and experimenting with AI solutions. You've designed and implemented AI-assisted workflows or automations in a finance context, not just adopted existing tools. Familiarity with SaaS metrics. NDR, GRR, deferred revenue, and how the accounting supports them. What we offer 22 days of paid time off, plus your local national holidays Flexible work hours and a culture that trusts you to manage your time Private medical insurance or a medical allowance (depending on your location) Extended paid sick leave so you can fully recover without worry AI investment. We invest heavily in AI so you'll have the opportunity to build skills that matter for the next decade of your career, not just this role. A quarterly learning budget for courses, books, or anything that helps you grow professionally A quarterly wellbeing budget you can use for sport, therapy, or even a good novel A quarterly co-working budget so you can work from wherever feels right Best hardware for your work (team Apple) A transparent, flexible culture with people at the core of everything we do Originally posted on Himalayas

description: Canonical is a leading provider of open-source software and operating systems for global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in more than 80 countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder led, profitable and growing. We are hiring a Golang Engineering Manager , who strives for accountability for the development of an internal product, who has high engineering quality standards, continuously develops their skills as well as skills of their direct reports, and who has the drive to deliver. This is an exciting opportunity to work with great people and exciting open-source solutions on innovative engineering solutions supporting Canonical 's growth. The Commercial Systems unit is conceived as six engineering teams that closely collaborate with other engineering and business teams at Canonical . Services designed, developed, and operated by the Commercial Systems unit are at the heart of Canonical business and Golang plays an integral role in it. We are looking for software engineering managers for these teams: The Billing team designs, develops, and operates a Golang service that provides a standardized and scalable capability to turn metrics into billable amounts, enable customers to see their current spend with Canonical at any time, and ensure accurate, reliable, and timely billing. The service further integrates with other engineering, business, payment systems. This team is an excellent match for those interested in growing their skills in the billing and payment processing domain. The Livepatch team designs and develops a service for the delivery of Linux kernel patches to shrink the exploit window for critical and high severity Linux kernel vulnerabilities, by patching the Linux kernel between security maintenance windows, while the system runs. The engineering team behind this product develops Golang based client and backend components, while another Canonical team, the Kernel team, develops the security patches. This team is a great opportunity for those interested in security and with a strong focus on engineering quality and reliability. Location : This role will be based remotely in the EMEA region. The role entails Accountability for the design and development of an internal product Leading a team of software engineers working in Golang Developing the skills and capabilities of direct reports Seeking improvements to established processes, designs, and solutions Building an understanding of business neds to deliver the most impact What we are looking for in you Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university Undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path Track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to achieve outstanding results Experience with software development in a high-level language (Golang, Python, Java, ...) Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration. Secrets & Encryption: Manage secrets and key rotation using Vault, define and enforce encryption protocols for data both in transit and at rest, and manage certificates via Traefik. Abuse Prevention: Implement and monitor controls for API rate limiting, Web Application Firewall (WAF) rules, and traffic monitoring to prevent abuse and denial-of-service attacks. Incident Response: Develop and practice incident investigation and response protocols. Conduct security awareness training for development and operations teams. Required Technologies & Tools Candidates must possess hands-on security experience with our core stack and compliance tools: Platform Security: Node.js/NestJS security best practices, Next.js/React security, PostgreSQL RLS. Compliance Focus: Experience with PCI-DSS and GDPR controls and auditing. Authentication & Access: OAuth 2.0, SAML, JWT, Authentik/Ory Kratos. Secrets & Infrastructure: HashiCorp Vault, Docker, Terraform. Monitoring & Assessment: Tools for Static/Dynamic Application Security Testing (SAST/DAST). AI Agent Security You will be responsible for securing the emerging AI ecosystem. Agent Trust Framework: Establish security boundaries for the AI agent interfaces, ensuring agents (built with LangChain/AutoGen) operate within strict permissions when accessing supply chain data (WMS, OMS). Prompt Injection Prevention: Implement validation and sanitization techniques to mitigate prompt injection and data exfiltration risks in user-facing LLM interactions. Success Metrics & Career Path Performance will be measured by: Security Scorecard: Reduction in identified vulnerabilities from assessments and code reviews (SAST/DAST). Compliance Audits: Successful passing of regular PCI-DSS and GDPR audits. Incident Handling: Speed and effectiveness of security incident investigation and remediation. Mentorship Structure: Reports to the Solution Architect or Head of Technology, working closely with the development and DevOps teams to embed security into the CI/CD pipeline. description: Overview This position is responsible for protecting Bio-Rad’s data and cloud estate and for leading high-severity security incident response outside US hours. This position is responsible for protecting Bio-Rad’s data and cloud estate and for leading high-severity security incident response outside US hours. DLP program – reviewing what the system blocked, tuning policies, and working through exception requests from the business Communicating specific security needs and recommending appropriate security measures. Reviewiong configuration of security tools such as firewalls, intrusion detection systems, and encryption technologies to protect our networks and data. Be the escalation point the business relies on outside US hours, leading High and Critical incidents from detection to documented closure within SLA. Make the L2 team materially stronger through SOPs, coaching and automation playbooks that shift work left and reduce escalations. Keep Information Security operations audit-ready against ISO 27001, data privacy regulations and customer commitments. What the Candidate Brings: (Top 5 required attributes, skills, and work experience) Deep, hands-on data protection experience – enterprise DLP policy design, tuning and exception management, plus data classification and labeling, ideally with Microsoft Purview. Strong Azure cloud security skills – assessment, secure configuration, identity and workload protection, remediation at scale, and automation via Graph API and scripting. Proven incident response leadership at L2 support team with an MSSP or 24x7 SOC, owning High and Critical cases end to end. Excellent judgment and communication – able to explain risk and trade-offs to Legal, business stakeholders and executives, and to write SOPs that others can follow. Qualifications: Eight (8) or more years of relevant information security experience, including hands-on ownership of an enterprise security program. Bachelor’s degree in Information Security, Computer Science or a related field; or equivalent work experience required. Demonstrated experience owning an enterprise DLP program – Microsoft Purview DLP and Information Protection preferred – including policy authoring, tuning, exception management and sensitivity labeling of Confidential and Restricted data. Hands-on incident response experience at L2/L3, including ownership of High and Critical cases through closure alongside an MSSP or 24x7 SOC partner, and authorship of SOPs, runbooks and automation/SOAR playbooks. Incident report writing skills. Working knowledge of Microsoft Graph API and scripting automation (PowerShell, Python) applied to security operations. Knowledge of information security and data privacy laws and frameworks – ISO 27001, GDPR and similar – and experience supporting internal and external audits. Professional certification preferred: CISSP, CCSP, AZ-500, SC-400, GCIH or equivalent. Eight or more years in information security, with working knowledge of ISO 27001 and data privacy requirements, and willingness to cover non-US-hours escalation for global incidents. Strong written and verbal communication; able to work with Legal, business stakeholders and global IT teams, and available to cover High and Critical escalations in the non-US time zone. title: Senior Java Developer (Platform Modernization)
description: Addepto is a leading AI consulting () and data engineering () company that builds scalable, ROI-focused AI solutions for some of the world's largest enterprises and pioneering startups, including Rolls Royce, Continental, Porsche, ABB, and WGU. With an exclusive focus on Artificial Intelligence and Big Data, Addepto helps organizations unlock the full potential of their data through systems designed for measurable business impact and long-term growth. The company's work extends beyond client engagements. Drawing from real-world challenges and insights, Addepto has developed its own product - ContextClue - and actively contributes open-source solutions to the AI community. This commitment to transforming practical experience into scalable innovation has earned Addepto recognition by Forbes as one of the top 10 AI consulting companies worldwide. As part of KMS Technology, a US-based global technology group, Addepto combines deep AI specialization with enterprise-scale delivery capabilities—enabling the partnership to move clients from AI experimentation to production impact, securely and at scale. We are modernizing a large, business-critical operational platform that has evolved over many years and combines application logic, database-level rules, and partly manual operational processes. The project involves transitioning the existing solution towards a modern, cloud-native architecture , delivered by a small senior team working with heavy AI leverage. As a Senior Java Developer , you will join the team at the moment when requirements and target architecture are in place and the build starts. This is a hands-on implementation role — the large majority of your time goes into writing, testing, and shipping production code, not into high-level design or governance. Here is what the project involves: Re-implementing legacy logic. Working through existing Java/Spring code, Oracle schemas, and PL/SQL, extracting the business rules that actually run the operation, and rebuilding them as clean, well-tested Spring Boot services. Building the new platform on Azure. Implementing services, integrations, and APIs on Azure with PostgreSQL as the operational database and Databricks for analytics and reporting data. Migrating without stopping operations. Moving data and functionality from Oracle to the new stack in a way that supports parallel run, reconciliation, and a safe cutover for a system that cannot go down. 🚀 Your main responsibilities: Design and implement backend services in Java and Spring Boot, from domain model and business logic through persistence and API layers. Analyze legacy Java/Spring code and Oracle PL/SQL, and re-implement business logic in the new services, with tests that prove behavioural parity. Build the PostgreSQL data layer: schema design, JPA/Hibernate mappings, versioned migrations (Flyway / Liquibase), and query performance tuning. Implement Oracle → PostgreSQL data migration and reconciliation tooling to support parallel run and cutover. Develop REST APIs (contract-first, OpenAPI) consumed by operational portals and integrated systems. Implement asynchronous integrations and event flows (e.g. Azure Service Bus, Kafka), including retries, idempotency, and error handling. Deliver data feeds from the operational platform into Databricks in cooperation with data engineers. Write automated tests at every level (JUnit, integration tests with Testcontainers, contract tests) and keep the codebase production-ready. Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, containerization, and deployment to Azure across DEV / TEST / PROD environments. Build in logging, monitoring, and alerting so the system can be run 24/7; take part in troubleshooting and production readiness ahead of go-live. Work closely with the Business Analyst / Product Owner on user stories and acceptance criteria, and do code reviews within the team. Requirements 🎯 What you'll need to succeed in this role: At least 5+ years of commercial experience as a Java backend developer, with hands-on coding as your main activity in recent projects . Strong programming skills in Java (5+) , Spring Boot , and the Spring ecosystem (Spring Data, Spring Security, Spring Integration a plus). Solid relational database skills: PostgreSQL and Oracle , including SQL, JPA/Hibernate, schema migrations, and performance tuning; ability to read and understand PL/SQL. Experience working with legacy codebases — reading, refactoring, and migrating existing logic safely. Experience building REST APIs and asynchronous, message-driven integrations (Kafka, Azure Service Bus, RabbitMQ, or IBM MQ). Working knowledge of Azure (e.g. AKS or App Service, Azure Functions, Service Bus, Key Vault, Entra ID) and containerization with Docker / Kubernetes. Strong testing discipline: unit, integration, and contract testing as a standard part of delivery. Experience with business-critical, high-availability systems where reliability and correctness matter. Experience using AI coding assistants / agentic workflows as part of day-to-day delivery. Good communication skills in English and a pragmatic, get-it-built attitude. 🎁 Discover our perks & benefits: Work in a supportive team of passionate enthusiasts of AI & Big Data. Engage with top-tier global enterprises and cutting-edge startups on international projects. Enjoy flexible work arrangements, allowing you to work remotely or from modern offices and coworking spaces. Accelerate your professional growth through career development paths, knowledge-sharing initiatives, language classes, and sponsored training and conferences . Benefit from partnerships with Databricks and Anthropic , which provide access to industry-leading training materials and certification programs. Participate in team-building events and utilize the integration budget . Celebrate work anniversaries, birthdays, and milestones. Access medical and sports packages , eye care, and well-being support services, including psychotherapy and coaching. Get full work equipment for optimal productivity, including a laptop and other necessary devices. With our backing, you can boost your personal brand by speaking at conferences, writing for our blog, or participating in meetups. Experience a smooth onboarding with a dedicated buddy, and start your journey in our friendly, supportive, and autonomous culture. Originally posted on Himalayas

description: Please note that we are unable to consider applications from candidates based in France, Italy, or Germany for this role. description: Who You Are We're looking for a Senior Backend Engineer who thrives in high-ownership environments and knows what it takes to build, ship, and operate distributed systems at scale, not just design them. You’ll help build and scale a product that relies on reliable, high-throughput backend services and strong operational maturity. This is a hands-on senior role: you will design, code, ship, operate, and continuously improve distributed systems in production. You're someone who has seen production fail, learned from it, and built better systems because of it. You care about observability, reliability, and code quality not as checkboxes but as craft. You're comfortable with ambiguity, collaborative by nature, and you raise the bar for the engineers around you. What you’ll do Design and implement distributed backend systems : services that are resilient, observable, and scalable (latency, throughput, reliability). Build event-driven and asynchronous architectures using queues, pub/sub, background workers, and idempotent processing. Own production reliability : performance tuning, incident response, on-call participation (if applicable), and systematic improvements (SLOs, error budgets, runbooks). Raise the engineering bar : lead by example in code quality, API design, testing strategy, and operational best practices. Deeply instrument services with logs, metrics, and traces; help standardize observability patterns across the platform. Partner with Product and other engineers to define success metrics, measure impact, and iterate quickly based on real usage. Mentor and guide : review designs and PRs, support other engineers, and shape long-term technical direction. Specifically, we’re looking for Senior experience (typically 8+ years) building and operating backend systems in production. Strong coding skills in Go (production-grade, not scripting). Distributed systems fundamentals : concurrency, backpressure, retries, idempotency, consistency tradeoffs, schema evolution, failure modes. Cloud and infrastructure maturity (AWS preferred): designing services with managed cloud components, scaling patterns, cost awareness. Kubernetes and Docker experience: containerized services, deployments, operational workflows. Observability expertise : traces, metrics, logs, dashboards, alerting, incident analysis (Datadog and/or OpenTelemetry experience is a plus). Databases : strong PostgreSQL skills (schema design, indexing, query tuning) plus comfort working with OpenSearch and modern data stores. Engineering rigor : testing strategies (unit, integration, contract), CI/CD hygiene, safe rollout patterns (feature flags, canaries, gradual releases). Bonus Experience with queueing and streaming systems (SQS, SNS, Kafka, Kinesis, RabbitMQ, Pub/Sub). Vector databases and retrieval patterns (pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus, Qdrant, OpenSearch vector). Redis, MongoDB (only if truly used and not just “resume keywords”). Terraform (or equivalent IaC), GitHub Actions (or similar CI/CD). Security basics for backend systems (authn/authz, secrets management, least privilege, threat-aware design). What success looks like Services that are easier to operate: clear SLOs, better alerts, faster incident resolution. Higher throughput and lower latency as usage grows. Stronger platform foundations: repeatable patterns for async processing, observability, and safe deployments. A team that levels up through your mentorship and technical leadership. Ideally, you are someone that Has previously worked in startups - comfortable navigating some uncertainty and high energy environments Enjoys the collaborative process with different roles to design, implement and iterate on possible ideas and solutions Is not a perfectionist but has a mindset of continuous, incremental improvements towards top-quality work Is great at communicating with engineers, product managers, and other team members Bonus: Worked in the SalesTech space Our Process We want to be mindful of your time while finding the right candidate for our team. No homework to do, only human interactions ! Our typical recruitment timelines looks like this: Screening call with Talent Acquisition (30 minutes) - to know more about you and go deeper about the role Technical fit call with CTO (30 minutes) - to get to know each other, know about your technical depth. Virtual Onsite Session : Coding Session (1 hour) : In this hands-on session, you'll pair with our engineers to solve a real-world problem, focusing on clean logic, maintainability, and how you think through edge cases in real-time. System Design Interview (1 hour) : We’ll dive into a whiteboard session to explore how you architect scalable systems, specifically looking at your ability to navigate technical trade-offs and balance performance with simplicity. Culture and Values Interview (30 minutes) : We’ll wrap up by exploring our core values and your working style to ensure our environment is one where you’ll feel energized, supported, and empowered to do your best work. Manager Interview (30 minutes) : This is a two-way conversation with your potential lead to discuss your career trajectory, how you navigate project ownership, and how we can support your growth within the team. If all goes well, we’ll then make you an offer ! What we offer Up to 100K€ package, depending on equity, profile and contract type Challenging and interesting work A place in our diverse team A healthy work environment (few meetings and “low touch” management) Fully-remote work within EU timezones (GMT +/- 3h) Stipend to set up your home office Yearly team events in Paris and offsite Health insurance and other benefits applicable to your place of residence, if contract of employment in France or elsewhere via Deel Employer of record Possibility to work as a freelancer Originally posted on Himalayas

description: About Journal Lab Journal Lab is a Netherlands-based startup dedicated to revolutionizing the way people and organizations capture and share their stories. 🌟 Our flagship product: Travel Diaries Travel Diaries enables users to create beautiful digital diaries that can be: 📝 Shared online as blogs 📄 Downloaded as PDFs 📚 Ordered as exquisitely printed books Our impact so far: 🌍 Over 200,000 users worldwide. 📦 More than 15,000 books delivered globally. ✍️ 3000 premium members. 💼 Our B2B solutions But we don't stop at individual travelers! Enabling businesses: Providing innovative solutions that help our partners enhance customer engagement and deepen client relationships. Offering tools for content marketing, user-generated content integration, and branding opportunities to elevate their marketing efforts. Help travel agencies turn their clients into ambassadors. By uniting our commitment to personal storytelling with empowering organizations to connect meaningfully with their customers, we strive to create lasting emotional connections that resonate globally. ✨ 🙆 Join our team We’re a small (<15), young, dynamic and innovative remote-first company dedicated to driving growth and creating impactful solutions. 🎉 Passionate and diverse team: Committed to excellence and continuous improvement. 💻 Tech-savvy and data-driven: We leverage cutting-edge technology and use data analytics to drive innovation and make informed decisions. 🌐 Fully remote company: All of our positions are fully remote. Segment validation and entry Qualified lead generation Number of new clients acquired B2B revenue growth from travel agencies Sales process development Client satisfaction 🧐 Responsibilities in detail Market research and validation Identify opportunities within the travel agency sector in Dutch and international markets. Test hypotheses and validate market needs. Develop hypotheses about new market opportunities and design experiments to test them. Adapt and shape our B2B products to meet the needs of new clients, potentially developing new solutions. Identify opportunities to diversify our B2B strategy and implement scalable, repeatable sales processes. Lead generation and sales Generate and qualify leads through outreach and networking. Build relationships with key stakeholders. Present proposals and close deals with travel agencies. Maintain a pipeline of high-quality leads and opportunities. Meet and exceed revenue targets by driving sales growth in new segment. Process optimization Design scalable sales processes tailored to travel agencies. Collaborate with teams to align efforts. Maintain accurate records of business development activities, opportunities, and pipeline status in our CRM system. Generate regular reports on performance, including key metrics and progress towards goals. Analyze data to identify trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement. 🧰 What you bring Experience and skills: Minimum of 3-5 years of experience in business development, sales, or a similar role within the travel industry or related sectors. Personal attributes: You're proactive, innovative, and not afraid to take calculated risks to achieve goals. You make decisions based on data and are skilled at analyzing market trends and performance metrics. You’re passionate about understanding and meeting client needs. Ability to engage with diverse cultures and adapt communication styles accordingly. 🌍 Our Company Culture We believe in a flexible, results-oriented work culture where productivity is rewarded, and team members have the freedom to shape their work and personal lives. Our ethos is centered around fostering happy, engaged, and motivated team members who feel a strong connection to the company. We prioritize location-independent work, leveraging digital meetings and daily communication through Slack to maintain a content and efficient team. 📜 Journal Lab Tenets 👑 Ownership Mindset: We act as stakeholders, taking responsibility for the company's direction and goals. We don’t say “that’s not my job” – we roll up our sleeves and contribute solutions, not just problems. description: The Agency Fund is a nonprofit innovation lab working to expand human agency — the capability for individuals to navigate toward the future that they want. Strategic Execution: Proven ability to not just think strategically about an operating model, but to personally build the systems, write the documentation, and do the detailed execution work required for full, organization-wide implementation. Accountability Driver: Expert-level proficiency in developing, implementing, and managing performance metrics (OKRs/KPIs) and driving organizational accountability to those targets. Communication & Influence: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate complex systems and policies and influence adoption across a flat, non-hierarchical team. description: About the company At Nuitée , we are building the API backbone for the global travel industry. Founded in 2017, Nuitée is on a mission to transform a fragmented travel ecosystem with simple, scalable, and API-first infrastructure—think “Stripe for Travel.” By enabling seamless connectivity between hotels, OTAs, fintechs, super-apps, and businesses, some of which are entering the travel market for the first time, Nuitée empowers companies to deliver reliable travel products effortlessly. Our robust platform simplifies complex supplier networks, offering direct access to hotel inventory with better pricing, coverage, and technology. With teams across the globe, including hubs in London, New York, San Francisco, Palma de Mallorca and Casablanca, Nuitée has grown into a global infrastructure provider trusted by industry leaders like Hopper, Priceline, Google, and Uber. Now backed by leading VCs and world-class investors including leaders from , Stripe, and Shopify, Nuitée is positioned to redefine the B2B travel market, streamline operations for hotels, and enable new applications through cutting-edge APIs. Nuitée is at the forefront of a revolution—delivering AI-powered, smarter, and more personalized travel experiences for a new era. About the job Remote in EU, or hybrid in Barcelona, Palma, Dublin, or Casablanca. This is a product role where a good idea in the morning can be in the product by the evening. You'll own Mapping & Content: the layer that decides whether a room one supplier calls "Deluxe Double" and another calls "Habitación Deluxe" are recognized as the same physical room, at a precision and coverage the rest of the industry hasn't matched. You’ll run it as a full business and product domain. You’re accountable for the outcomes, economics, priorities, and product decisions. You’ll help define what success looks like, then decide with your team what to prioritise, what to test, what to build, and where to make trade-offs. The problem underneath is unusually complex. A single physical hotel room can be described in 500 to 1,000 different ways across suppliers, languages, and content formats. How do you resolve that ambiguity at scale, and keep improving coverage without degrading accuracy? What makes it interesting for you You can move extremely fast. There's very little red tape, teams make their own product decisions, and the culture is much closer to ask for forgiveness than wait for permission. If something makes sense, you can test it quickly instead of spending weeks getting alignment. You own the path to the outcome. You'll agree what success looks like, then decide with your team how to get there. You get a genuinely hard, industry-wide problem. Room and hotel mapping has resisted easy solutions across travel, and you're inheriting one of the strongest systems in the market: roughly 99.5% accuracy at 85% coverage, validated by customers like EasyJet who chose Nuitée over the alternatives. You'll help build Nuitee's product organisation. We got to roughly €1B in booking value without a proper product org. Now we're building one, and you'll help shape it as we push toward €10B. Nuitée has grown 10x since 2022, was profitable before raising a $48M Series A led by Accel, and works with companies such as Revolut, Grab, Hopper, Priceline, and Sabre. This role comes with meaningful equity, so when we hit our next growth milestones, you get real upside in the company you’re helping build. The kind of problems you’ll work on How do you map the same physical room across hundreds of differently worded supplier descriptions, in different languages, with extremely high confidence? When should the system prioritize coverage versus precision, and how do you increase coverage without degrading accuracy? How do you identify the highest-value mapping failures and focus the team where better mapping creates the biggest customer or commercial impact? This role fits if you Have owned a product or business area end to end for several years and can show the outcomes you drove. Understand entity resolution and can go deep into data or ML product problems: search, matching, catalogues, identity, recommendations, knowledge graphs, or content quality. Can go deep into data and technical mechanics and turn that into product decisions, without needing to be the person building the algorithm. Are comfortable working closely with engineering and data science on technically complex products. Have worked in a high-pressure environment where you were expected to drive the outcome yourself. Are willing to go deep into ambiguous, probabilistic problems rather than staying at surface-level product management. Data and platform depth matters more to us than travel experience. Nuitée moves quickly, has little process, and gives people a lot of room to make decisions. You’ll do well here if ambiguity does not slow you down, you like going deep into difficult problems, and you want to be accountable for what your product actually delivers. If this sounds like your kind of product role, we’d love to hear from you. You can apply with your LinkedIn profile or CV. The process is straightforward and typically takes 2–3 weeks. Why Nuitee? At Nuitée , we’re not just reimagining travel—we’re building the infrastructure to power it. Massive Market Opportunity: We are tackling the $9.9tn travel industry, starting with the $75 billion B2B hotel market, a fragmented space filled with outdated systems, gatekeepers, and inefficiencies. Nuitée ’s API-first platform is solving this, enabling businesses to access hotel inventory seamlessly and at scale. World-Class Backing: Backed by Accel and visionary leaders across tech and travel—including Booking.com, Stripe, and Shopify—we’re equipped to scale our ambition globally. Bootstrapped Resilience, Startup Agility: Having grown profitably for years without external funding, we combine operational discipline with the speed and innovation of a scaling startup. Global Impact: Our infrastructure supports partners like Google, Grab, worldwide fintechs, superapps, travel companies and others AI-Driven Innovation: Nuitée is uniquely positioned to power the future of travel in the AI era—enabling seamless, intelligent, and hyper-personalized travel interactions. By joining Nuitée , you’ll be part of a team that’s building a category-defining platform. You’ll work on a global scale, innovate alongside industry leaders, and help drive the next phase of travel technology. If you’re excited to push boundaries, redefine a multi-trillion-dollar industry, and grow with us— Nuitée is the place for you. By submitting your application, you consent to Nuitée processing your personal data for the purposes of assessing your suitability for employment. Your information will be stored securely and will only be retained for as long as necessary for the recruitment process, or up to 6 months afterward, in accordance with our data protection policy and applicable laws. You have the right to request access, correction, or deletion of your personal data at any time by contacting us at . For more details, please see our Privacy Policy: Nuitée Privacy Notice 2026. description: Kargo creates powerful moments of connection between brands and consumers to build businesses. Every day, our dynamic teams work to radically raise the bar on what agentic AI, CTV, eCommerce, social, and mobile can do to deliver unique ad experiences across the world’s most premium platforms. Taking a Creative Science approach to all we do, we continuously innovate solutions that outperform industry benchmarks and client expectations. Kargo is growing rapidly and currently has offices in NYC, Chicago, LA, Dallas, Sydney, Auckland, London and Waterford, Ireland. Who We Hire Techies who want to build the future. Creatives who want to design it better. Communicators to win business. Collaborators to build it. Data pros who turn numbers into insights. Product builders who turn ideas into innovations. Anyone eager to be on a team that doesn’t stop to ask what’s next, because they’re already building it. The Opportunity Kargo is building toward a unified platform where advertisers run campaigns across CTV, web, mobile apps, and social entirely self-serve. This is the first time that capability goes directly into clients' hands. Clients will pull their own reports, debug their own setups, and ask why a campaign isn't pacing, so the data behind them must be quick to extend, stable enough to trust, and structured for automated triage. Our pipelines already run at that scale, but each demand is met one team at a time: reporting is bespoke, stability rests on each team's own practice and monitors, and triage depends on whoever knows the pipeline. We're standing up a Data Platform team to solve these problems once for the whole company, and you'll be its founding engineer. Working directly with the Sr. Director of Data Engineering, you'll shape the standards and build the software that enables and enforces them, open the platform up to contributors across Kargo , and grow the team as its scope expands. You'll own it as a long-term product: modular tools and paved roads that let any team publish data and have it arrive discoverable, reliable, and observable enough to triage without tribal knowledge. The Daily To-Do Build the data control plane. One place to see and govern what data products exist: schemas, lineage, ownership, freshness commitments, quality, access. Built for people browsing and agents querying. Build the paved road for standing up a data product. Libraries, SDKs, templates, and data-specific CI/CD on Kargo 's engineering platform, plus a supported near-real-time pattern. Following the standard should be easier than bypassing it. Build the enforcement layer for the data standards. Schema registry, the contract validator and the CI step that runs it, automated certification. Make every data product observable by default. Freshness, volume, schema conformance, and quality instrumented by the paved road rather than hand-built per team, emitting into Kargo 's existing monitoring with the ownership and lineage metadata that makes AI-assisted triage possible. Set the platform's technical direction. Architecture, roadmap, and build-versus-buy calls, informed by what the teams who produce and consume data actually need. Run the design reviews where they weigh in, and keep the platform modular enough that they contribute capabilities back. Qualifications: You’ve built loosely coupled production services, APIs and SDKs in Python that multiple teams depend on. You've built metadata-driven platforms that integrate with catalogs and check lineage, contracts and quality automatically. You've built observability other teams depend on, and can tell a signal from noise. You get tools adopted by teams that don't report to you through architecture reviews, mentorship, and clear communication. Strong AWS, Terraform and Kubernetes experience. Strongly Preferred Experience moving from batch to streaming; understanding of cost tradeoffs. Spark and Iceberg at significant scale, and Snowflake in production. Ad tech, or another domain with high-volume event data and multiple consumers. Experience building tooling and data structures that AI agents operate against. Nice to have: Experience standing up a platform team's first generation of capabilities. Data catalog, semantic layer, or governance tooling. description: About AMMP AMMP builds software for the renewable energy sector: AMMP OS, the operating system for renewable energy portfolios. Developers, EPCs, asset owners, O&M providers and finance teams use it to monitor, operate and report on their sites. It connects 30+ inverter, battery and meter brands and covers 10,000+ sites in 35+ countries, many of them multi-vendor fleets. We build the product with our customers, and their day-to-day problems set the roadmap (a missed outage, a savings report that takes a week to compile). In 2026 we launched Ray, an AI coworker that sits in Teams or Slack and answers questions about a customer's fleet in plain language. We're a small team, working remotely. What you'll do Onboarding (roughly 40% of your time) Run kickoff calls and collect what we need from each customer: site lists, vendor API credentials, PV orientation, target yield from PVsyst or Helioscope. Set up new organisations and assets in AMMP OS; connect vendor APIs, and data source selection. Configure and manage AMMP OS platform tailored to the customer's operation Test end to end before handover, then invite users and set their permissions. Work closely with other teams including but not limited to Software and Product Team. Adoption and account health Track feature adoption and a health score for each account; we have a framework drafted and need someone to run it. Run quarterly check-ins with key accounts. Train users when adoption drops below target. Spot expansion: more MWp, an added module, Ray, the Data API. Support Be the first point of contact. Triage data gaps, missing telemetry and billing questions; use our AI agents for first-line investigation and escalate the rest. Renewals and feedback Feed recurring customer requests into the product backlog, with a clear write-up of who asked and why. Help us make onboarding faster. Today a 6-vendor customer takes about 10 hours of asset setup plus 20 hours of dashboard work; we want that number to fall. What you'll bring Must-haves 3+ years in customer success, technical account management or solutions engineering at a B2B SaaS company. Comfort with data. You can read an API response, write a basic SQL query, and spot when a number looks wrong. Clear written English; you'll write to customers in 35+ countries. You finish things. Onboarding has a lot of small steps, and missing one breaks the customer's first impression. Nice-to-haves Experience with battery storage, gensets or hybrid systems. Working knowledge of solar PV: you know what an inverter, PR and yield are, and why a site underperforms. Grafana, Looker Studio or a similar BI tool. Python or Jupyter notebooks for small data jobs. Familiarity with inverter portals. Experience in emerging markets, especially sub-Saharan Africa or Latin America. French, Portuguese or Spanish. What we offer A real say in how customer success works here; you'd be building the playbook, not following one. Work that cuts emissions: every site we monitor is solar or storage replacing diesel or grid power. A team that already uses AI agents in daily work, so you spend less time on copy-paste setup. Remote work and flexible hours. Salary: EUR 15,000-25,000/year Originally posted on Himalayas

Technical curiosity, and interest in software technology and its challenges. description: Location & work modality: Remote Start: Asap Type of Contract: Freelance or Permanent About Radian Arc . Radian Arc delivers AI infrastructure and GPU-as-a-Service (GPUaaS) solutions that enable enterprises, telecommunications operators, governments, and AI organizations to deploy, operate, and scale high-performance GPU infrastructure. With teams across the USA, Australia, Europe, Malaysia, Singapore, and Japan, we work with customers and strategic partners to deliver platforms for enterprise AI, sovereign AI, inference, training, and next-generation GPU cloud services. What impact you will have We are looking for a Senior Project Manager to own complex, multi-stakeholder GPUaaS and AI infrastructure deployments from planning through production handover. You will set the plan, critical path, and delivery governance for each deployment. You will coordinate Solutions Architecture, Engineering, Product, Procurement, Data Center Operations, Service Delivery, Sales, customers, vendors, and strategic partners, and keep delivery aligned with customer expectations and commercial commitments. You will also play a key role in building Radian Arc 's Project Management Office (PMO). That means designing and standardizing how we deploy, and applying automation and AI-assisted development tools to turn those processes into repeatable workflows and live dashboards, with less manual coordination as deployment volume grows. This is a highly autonomous role for someone who enjoys creating structure in a fast-growing company. You will work with teams across the USA, Europe, Asia, and Australia, so you will regularly need to collaborate outside standard business hours. What you’ll do: Deployment Delivery Own end-to-end delivery of GPUaaS, AI infrastructure, hardware, and new data center / PoP deployments, from initial planning through production handover. Build and maintain the integrated deployment plan and critical path across all workstreams: scope, timelines, milestones, dependencies, owners, risks, decisions, and completion criteria. Coordinate hardware procurement, site readiness, installation, networking, storage, compute, platform deployment, and customer onboarding across internal teams and external partners. Keep solution and engineering requirements, hardware delivery, site and operational readiness, customer commitments, and target production dates aligned. Lead deployment acceptance, go-live readiness, stabilization, and formal handover into Service Delivery and Operations. Manage multiple deployments in parallel, balancing shared resources, dependencies, and competing priorities. Deployment Process Design and Governance Define Radian Arc 's standard deployment lifecycle, including stages, owners, required inputs, approval gates, and entry/exit criteria for each phase. Establish delivery governance, including project kickoffs, readiness reviews, change control, decision logs, and escalation paths. Create practical templates, checklists, and runbooks so new deployments start quickly and run consistently. Help build Radian Arc 's PMO by setting project-management standards and delivery disciplines that scale across customers, regions, and data center environments. Run post-deployment reviews and feed lessons learned back into the standard process. Automation, Dashboards, and Reporting Use AI-assisted development and automation tools, such as Claude Code, to build, document, and continuously improve deployment workflows and project-management processes. Work with Engineering to connect deployment workflows to Radian Arc systems, tools, and data sources, and automate routine coordination, tracking, reporting, and data updates wherever practical. Build a standardized, shareable dashboard for each deployment, generated directly from workflow data so status is never maintained twice. Provide executive and working-level views of scope, procurement status, milestones, dependencies, blockers, decisions, owners, and next actions, as a single source of truth throughout the project lifecycle. Risk, Issues, and Stakeholder Communication Identify risks, blockers, resource constraints, and dependency conflicts early, and drive mitigation, escalation, and cross-team resolution. Provide clear, consistent status reporting to internal leadership, customers, vendors, and partners, and run regular project reviews, readiness reviews, and executive updates. Translate complex technical, operational, procurement, and delivery issues into concise updates, clear decisions, and actionable next steps. Build trusted relationships with customer, partner, and vendor stakeholders at both working and executive levels. What success looks like: In your first 90 days, you will: Own active deployments, with an integrated plan, critical path, and risk register in place for each. Document version 1 of Radian Arc 's standard deployment lifecycle, including stages, owners, gates, and completion criteria. Stand up a live dashboard for each active deployment that updates from workflow data rather than by hand. Within six months, you will: Have the standard deployment process in use across all new deployments. Have measurably reduced the manual effort spent on coordination, tracking, and status reporting What you'll need 7+ years in project management, program management, technical delivery, or infrastructure deployment roles, including 5+ years managing complex infrastructure deployments involving multiple internal teams, vendors, partners, and customers. 3+ years working with AI infrastructure, GPU platforms, cloud infrastructure, data centers, hardware deployments, telecommunications operators, or managed infrastructure services. A track record of owning deployments end to end, with direct responsibility for timelines, dependencies, and delivery outcomes, from hardware procurement and site readiness through go-live and handover to operations. Experience building or improving PMO processes, project governance, reporting frameworks, dashboards, and standardized delivery processes. Demonstrated ability to design and improve integrated project workflows, with a practical understanding of how automation, APIs, workflow tools, and AI-assisted development tools can reduce manual coordination and reporting. Technical fluency across compute, networking, storage, data center, platform, and operational workstreams: enough to challenge a plan, spot a missing dependency, and earn engineers' trust. Excellent written and verbal communication, including with customers and executives. Experience working with distributed teams across multiple countries and time zones. Nice to have: Hands-on experience building workflow automation, integrations, or AI-assisted tooling using scripting, APIs, workflow platforms, Claude Code, or similar tools. Direct experience deploying GPU clusters or other high-performance compute environments. Experience with telecommunications operators, or with government or sovereign AI programs. Experience at a fast-growing company where you built delivery processes from scratch. PMP, PRINCE2, or Agile/Scrum certification What we offer • Attractive compensation package reflecting your expertise and experience. • A great work environment characterised by friendliness, international diversity, flexibility, and a hybrid-friendly approach. • You'll be part of a fast-growing scale-up with a mission to make a positive impact, offering an exciting career evolution. Our job titles may span more than one job level. The actual base pay is dependent on a number of factors, such as transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. Our inclusive responsibility Radian Arc is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status, or any other protected category under applicable law. description: Founded in 2017, refurbed is Europe’s fastest-growing marketplace for refurbished products, active in 23 European countries and having surpassed €2Bn in GMV — all while being profitable. With beautiful headquarters in Vienna, we operate as a remote-first company and have been recognised as a Top DACH Employer by Kununu for four consecutive years. Our mission is to make sustainable consumption the easy choice by enabling customers to buy products up to 40% cheaper while significantly reducing CO₂ emissions. If you thrive in an environment that values momentum, ownership, and impact, you’ll feel at home here. We’re a fast-paced, high-performance team that works hard and challenges itself everyday. To enable this high-performance every team member enjoys full autonomy over their location (we’re remote-first). For our Listing department, we are looking for a Taxonomy/Catalogue Expert who will own the structure, quality, and scalability of refurbed 's product catalogue — the category tree, attributes, and data models that search, filters, listings, pricing (SRP), and compliance are all built on. WHO YOU ARE Experienced with product taxonomy/classification in e-commerce or marketplace environments A strong data modeler and structured thinker, comfortable defining schemas rather than just filling them in Proficient in SQL and spreadsheet/BI tools (Looker or equivalent) for auditing Catalogue quality at scale Familiar with SEO and search/filter mechanics as they relate to attributes and category structure Experienced with (or has an aptitude for) automation/scripting to run taxonomy audits and bulk changes A strong cross-functional communicator who can drive alignment without direct authority over sellers or other teams; WHAT YOU'LL DO Own the global category tree structure: product/instance relationships, subcategories, and category dependencies across markets — and run periodic taxonomy audits Design the attribute schema for each category: (allowed values, mandatory vs. optional, units) and own attribute governance and naming conventions Lead deduplication and normalization initiatives across: the catalog, and define/monitor data-quality KPIs for the taxonomy Lead taxonomy design for new category and market expansion: benchmarking against industry standards, and strong vertical players Detail-oriented but able to zoom out to system-level: ("does this scale") thinking Own and maintain: the Category Tree SOP, Filter SOP, and Attribute Governance documentation Act as the taxonomy point of contact for: Category Management, Selection Squad, Catalyst Squad, Compliance, Marketing, and Customer Service WHY YOU WILL ENJOY WORKING WITH US: Our Culture and Values: Decisions should be made based on facts and not by hierarchy levels? We sure think so! We embrace giving and receiving feedback, testing and welcoming new ideas, as well as sharing our knowledge across the company. You fail sometimes? Well, so do we! We’re all just human, let’s learn from our mistakes to improve in the future! No matter who you love, where you’re from, who you pray to, whether you pee sitting down or standing up – we are a bunch of talented people who enjoy spending our time making a difference! Personal & Professional Development: You'll have access to a dedicated learning budget within your department to support your growth, whether it's courses, conferences, or other learning opportunities that matter to you. We partner with Likeminded, offering you private sessions with experts for your personal growth and mental health. We frequently host internal workshops, allowing our teams to further develop their skills in different areas and enhancing collaboration across departments. Flexibility: We care about a healthy work/life balance. We not only function and support a fully remote setting but also offer the possibility to work from our beautiful office in the vibrant heart of Vienna – we love dogs, so feel free to bring your furry little buddy too 😊 We trust you to do the best job, so we don't care so much when you do it – you are able to self-organize. You will also be invited to take part in our office weeks, happening three times a year, where you will have the chance to work side by side with your colleagues and enjoy the team-building events and on-site workshops …and much more! description: Be the voice of Canonical across channels Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing. We are looking for an outstanding colleague to join our communications team as a senior social media specialist. Our brand is part of a global open source ecosystem. We encourage adoption through community engagement. We build credibility and trust through advocacy and thought leadership. The ideal person for this role is driven to develop and implement social media strategies focused on long-term brand equity and differentiation. You will have the opportunity to advance your career with a brand that touches every aspect of the modern technology stack. Our communication strategy provides a window between the people who make our products and those who use them. With audiences in the millions, our online communities have the opportunity to talk to us, engage with us, provide feedback and be involved in the world of open source. The ideal candidate is passionate about technology, technology marketing and the use of technology in marketing. They would love to gain experience translating strategy into impact, and collaborating with multiple stakeholders. They enjoy learning and improving themselves, the team and the organization. They problem solve, get hands-on, experiment, measure and use automation and AI to make daily life easier. To succeed in this role, the candidate must be driven, organized and attentive to detail. This is a senior role reporting to the director of communications. Location: This role will be based remotely in the EMEA region. What your day will look like Develop and own the communications strategy across multiple channels, with a focus on excellent planning, messaging quality and timely delivery Deliver regular analysis and reporting on various communications channels, content performance and campaigns results Support the growth and nurturing of Canonical ’s enterprise audience, while increasing product adoption Develop flair with copywriting and asset creation to create messaging that aligns with the brand and its personality, and drives audiences towards action Be audience centric and use modern tools to understand market sentiment Create awareness on integrated campaigns, product launches, webinar series, industry announcements and core content. Package all of Canonical ’s product offerings and educational material creatively, while overseeing distribution strategy and alignment across channels What we are looking for in you Understanding of best practices for communications in tech Deep experience with all major social media platforms with strong creative judgement Hands-on knowledge of social media management and analytics tools Interest in mentorship and team development An analytical eye and the ability to develop measuring frameworks to inform senior decision making Exceptional interpersonal skills and aptitude for forging trusting relationships across diverse, cross-functional teams to ensure alignment with campaign objectives, paid media strategies and PR/AR initiatives Excellent verbal and written communication skills, strong content marketer Proven ability to prioritize and differentiate what matters from the noise, meeting deadlines without sacrificing quality Process owner for organic social media, establishing standards and leading planning and distribution across channels Interest in video and production, with some projects or strong thoughts on the use of video in social media Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal or external events What we offer you Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. Our compensation philosophy is to ensure equity right across our global workforce. In addition to a competitive base pay, we provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. Our working environment offers flexibility, autonomy, and the opportunity to contribute to meaningful projects with global impact. The role is fully remote and offers real ownership over how we plan, test, and measure our marketing — working closely with international colleagues. You will work hands-on across content, email, SEO/search visibility and distribution, while collaborating with colleagues in Marketing, Sales, Programme, Social & Video. Perform exploratory data analysis and communicate findings through dashboards, visualizations, and concise analytical reports. Work with product and engineering teams to turn analytical insights into product improvements. Help establish data quality checks, experiment tracking, and reproducible analytical workflows. Explore new applications of machine learning and generative AI in recruiting and talent intelligence. LLM Evaluation Framework: Build benchmarks and metrics to measure the consistency and quality of AI-generated candidate assessments. Interview Quality Analytics: Analyze interview questions and candidate responses to determine which signals are most useful for candidate assessment. Recruiting Funnel Analytics: Identify bottlenecks and conversion patterns across application, screening, interview, and hiring stages. AI Experimentation: Run controlled experiments comparing prompts, models, evaluation rubrics, or interview strategies. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Experience with Python and common data analysis libraries such as Pandas and NumPy. Working knowledge of SQL and relational data analysis. Understanding of statistics, probability, experimental design, and data visualization. Familiarity with machine learning concepts and common ML workflows. Ability to communicate analytical findings clearly to both technical and non-technical teammates. Comfortable working in a fast-moving startup environment and independently exploring ambiguous problems. Familiarity with LLM evaluation techniques, benchmarking, or human/AI evaluation workflows. Experience analyzing text or other unstructured data using NLP techniques. Experience with visualization or BI tools. Familiarity with A/B testing, causal inference, ranking systems, recommendation systems, or information retrieval. Experience working with production datasets, data pipelines, or cloud platforms. description: Role Title: Product Manager / Product Owner Role Type: Contractor Location: Remote We are engaging Product Managers and Product Owners as expert contributors to an advanced customer project focused on AI system development. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters. This is strictly an evaluation and analysis opportunity. It does not involve roadmap ownership, delivery management, sprint facilitation, stakeholder leadership, or programme governance. Contributors with backgrounds in project management, programme management, delivery, or scrum leadership should not apply — this engagement requires deep product management and product ownership skills in content and specification evaluation. Required Skills Product Management Product Ownership Specification Writing Content Evaluation Written Communication Attention to Detail Critical Analysis Stakeholder Communication Independent Work Virtual Collaboration Scope of Work Assess and compare AI-generated responses to a variety of writing prompts, including specifications, release notes, user-facing copy, and stakeholder updates. Score each response based on clarity, tone, adherence to instructions, and usefulness for the intended audience. Write detailed rationales explaining the reasoning behind each score, focusing on whether the content meets prompt requirements and audience needs. Identify and document cases where fluent writing fails to answer the question, or complete responses are unsuitable for users. Spot factual inaccuracies, inconsistencies, and instances where content exceeds or misses prompt constraints. Collaborate virtually and asynchronously with project managers and reviewers to ensure consistency and quality in assessments. Preferred Qualifications Professional experience as a Product Manager or certified Product Owner, with a strong record in cross-functional product development. Native-level English fluency and exceptional written communication skills. Extensive experience authoring and evaluating specifications, PRDs, acceptance criteria, release notes, or decision documents. Demonstrated ability to judge whether content is appropriately tailored for executives, technical stakeholders, or end users. Proven skill in providing actionable, written feedback on technical or user-facing documentation. Attention to detail, critical analysis skills, and the ability to work independently while meeting remote project deadlines. Familiarity with model evaluation, RLHF, or annotation is a plus, but not required. Originally posted on Himalayas

description: ABOUT THE ROLE RootstockLabs is seeking a visionary Fund Manager to architect, launch, and scale an institutional-grade, BTC-denominated investment fund from the ground up. This fund will enable institutional and private Bitcoin holders to unlock yield and manage credit risk through a mixed portfolio of strategies. By bridging traditional institutional demand and Bitcoin-native yield generation, the fund serves as a trusted, regulated vehicle for deploying sophisticated capital. As a founding leader, you will own the fund's strategy, portfolio construction, risk management framework, investor relations, and regulatory governance. This is a high-impact, greenfield opportunity to define a flagship financial product in the Bitcoin ecosystem. The mandate Objective: Deliver risk-adjusted returns measured in BTC, with principal preservation in BTC terms as the first priority. Vehicle: Cayman Islands SPC, CIMA-registered, with independent directors and a third-party administrator, auditor and custodian. Investors: L1 foundations and treasuries, ecosystem funds and selected institutional allocators seeking BTC exposure with yield. Strategies: BTC-collateralised lending, market-neutral and basis strategies, liquidity provision, and yield on Rootstock and other Bitcoin-aligned venues, within board-approved limits. Directional exposure and unhedged leverage are out of scope unless the board expressly approves them. Target size: $500 million committed capital within 12 months of launch. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Investment and portfolio management Set the fund's investment strategy, allocation policy and limits, and take them through board approval. Source, diligence and execute positions across BTC lending, basis and on-chain yield strategies. Run counterparty and protocol due diligence, including smart-contract, bridge, custody and liquidation risk. Report performance in BTC terms, with clear attribution by strategy. Risk management Build the risk framework: exposure limits, concentration, liquidity buckets, collateral haircuts and drawdown triggers. Monitor positions daily and stress-test against BTC price shocks, venue failure and depeg events. Maintain a liquidity profile that matches investor redemption terms. Investor relations and capital raising Raise capital from L1 foundations, ecosystem funds and institutional allocators, within applicable marketing and solicitation rules. Structure share classes, side letters and terms suited to foundation treasuries. Produce monthly investor reporting and quarterly letters; lead investor calls and annual meetings. Governance, compliance and operations Work with the board, independent directors, AML officers (AMLCO/MLRO), administrator, auditor and legal counsel. Own the offering documents, valuation policy and NAV process alongside the administrator. Ensure ongoing regulatory compliance, including CIMA filings, AML/KYC on investors and annual audit. Select and manage service providers: custodians, prime brokers, OTC desks and on-chain infrastructure. Team and ecosystem Hire and lead a small team (analyst, risk, operations) as the fund scales. Act as the fund's senior voice with L1 ecosystems, and feed investor demand back into Rootstock's product roadmap. WHAT YOU BRING 10+ years in asset management, credit, or trading, with at least 5 years as a portfolio manager or CIO with P&L responsibility. A track record managing a regulated fund or institutional mandate, ideally $100M+ AUM. Deep, hands-on knowledge of Bitcoin markets, BTC-collateralised lending, derivatives and basis trades. Working knowledge of DeFi mechanics: lending protocols, liquidity pools, bridges and their failure modes. Strong fund governance experience: offering documents, NAV and valuation, audit, and working with independent boards. Existing relationships with crypto foundations, treasuries or institutional allocators, and a record of raising capital. Able to meet director and key-person fitness and propriety standards in the fund's jurisdiction, with a clean regulatory history. NICE TO HAVE Experience with Cayman fund and BVI Investment Management structure. Background in structured credit (tranching, waterfalls) or treasury management. Relevant qualifications such as CFA, CAIA, FRM, PRM, or an equivalent regulatory licence. Familiarity with Rootstock, Bitcoin L2s or merged-mining ecosystems. ROOTIES BENEFITS At RootstockLabs , we don’t just offer a job, we offer a community. Here’s what you can expect when you join us: Competitive compensation package and unique benefits designed to support your growth and well-being. 100% Remote Work from Europe & Latin America, with access to global CoWorking spaces. Work-Life Balance: Paid vacation and sick leave days Continuous Learning: Access to training programs, language courses, and learning sponsorship annually. Unique Projects: Work with cutting-edge blockchain technology in a global, diverse team. ABOUT ROOTSTOCKLABS RootstockLabs is a key contributor to Rootstock, Bitcoin's Financial Infrastructure for lending, yield, and onchain capital markets. We build and commercialize the institutional infrastructure that turns Bitcoin into productive capital. What we do: Develop and commercialize Bitcoin-backed lending, tokenized real-world assets, and onchain financial strategies Who we work with: Leading custodians, asset managers, and financial institutions Why it matters: Rootstock is secured by 80%+ of Bitcoin's hash power and has run with 100% uptime since 2018 (bringing Ethereum-style programmability to the world's hardest money). Proof it works: 200+ dApps live on Rootstock, from BTCFi protocols like Sushiswap and Oku to institutional names like Mercado Bitcoin, Animoca Brands, and Paystand Originally posted on Himalayas

title: DevOps Engineer Internship
description: Overview: Infrastructure Automation and CI/CD The DevOps Engineer is responsible for automating, streamlining, and maintaining the infrastructure and deployment pipelines for our entire integrated platform. You'll ensure rapid, reliable, and consistent delivery of our e-commerce storefront, internal supply chain tools (MES, WMS, OMS), and cutting-edge AI agent services, primarily utilizing Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) and robust CI/CD practices. Internship Details Duration: 3 months Start Date: Immediate Location: Remote Stipend: None initially. Based on your first-quarter performance, you may be offered a paid full-time opportunity, or even be absorbed directly by the client as an FTE. Key Responsibilities & Core Projects You will build and maintain the fully automated platform that underpins our entire tech stack. Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC): Design, implement, and manage infrastructure provisioning across all environments using Terraform for our Oracle Cloud Free VMs (or equivalent cloud resources). Ensure infrastructure is auditable, repeatable, and secure. CI/CD Pipeline Management: Set up and maintain the Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) pipelines, primarily driven by Makefile and automated testing, for the Node.js/NestJS modular monolith and Next.js frontend applications. Containerization & Orchestration: Manage application containerization using Docker. Define deployment strategies, service discovery, and traffic routing using Traefik for our containerized services. Observability Implementation: Implement, manage, and optimize the comprehensive logging, monitoring, and alerting system using our selected stack: Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Tempo, and OpenTelemetry. Ensure end-to-end tracing is functional across the complex business flow (MES → WMS → OMS). Resilience & Backups: Collaborate with the SRE team to implement high-availability features and maintain automated backup solutions, including pgBackRest for our PostgreSQL 15 database. Workflow: Maintain the Monorepo structure for streamlined code management and deployment separation across applications (web / admin / API) and domain packages. Required Technologies & Tools Candidates must possess mandatory expertise in our core infrastructure and automation stack: Infrastructure-as-Code: Expert proficiency in Terraform. Containerization: Expert proficiency in Docker and deployment strategies (e.g., Traefik, orchestration concepts). CI/CD: Hands-on experience building and maintaining complex pipelines (Makefile, Jenkins/GitHub Actions/GitLab CI concepts). Observability: Strong implementation experience with Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, and OpenTelemetry. Cloud & Linux: Experience with Linux administration and managing cloud resources (Oracle Cloud or equivalent). AI Agent Focus You will ensure the scalable and monitored deployment of the AI layer. Deployment Automation: Automate the packaging and deployment pipelines for resource-intensive AI agent services and LLM fine-tuning environments. Resource Monitoring: Set up specific monitoring and alerts to track the performance, resource consumption, and cost of the AI agent compute demands. Success Metrics & Career Path Performance will be measured by: Deployment Frequency: Reduction in lead time and increased frequency of stable deployments. Infrastructure Stability: Reliability of provisioned infrastructure (minimal unplanned downtime). Observability Coverage: Completeness and reliability of monitoring, logging, and tracing across all production services. Mentorship Structure: Reports to the Solution Architect or Head of Technology, working closely with the SRE, DevSecOps, and Backend engineering teams to build a robust platform.
