description: About the Job The Opportunity As a Senior Software Engineer at Emetlab , you will design and build the systems that power elite AI training data infrastructure serving frontier laboratories, Fortune 500 enterprises, and sovereign AI programmes worldwide. Emetlab is an AI data infrastructure company delivering expert-produced, rigorously validated datasets and end-to-end AI solutions that transform good models into exceptional ones. In this role, you will take ownership of critical platform systems, from data pipeline architecture and contributor tooling to quality assurance automation and client delivery infrastructure. You will lead technical initiatives, mentor junior engineers, and make architectural decisions that scale with the demands of a global operation spanning 5,000+ domain experts, 100+ languages, and 12 specialised dataset domains. This is an opportunity to do meaningful engineering work at the foundation of AI's most critical bottleneck, where the systems you architect and the code you write will directly determine the quality of training data behind the world's most advanced models. What You'll Do Design, build, and maintain scalable services, APIs, and data pipelines that power Emetlab 's global data production and delivery infrastructure. Develop and optimise systems that support multi-stage quality assurance, expert contributor workflows, and high-throughput data processing across diverse domains. Own features and systems end-to-end, from technical design and implementation through to testing, deployment, and monitoring. Lead architectural decisions that ensure platform reliability, security, and scalability as our contributor network and client base grow. Mentor and elevate junior and mid-level engineers through code reviews, pairing, and architectural guidance. Collaborate cross-functionally with data operations, AI/ML, and product teams to deliver infrastructure that meets the precision demands of frontier AI development. Contribute to infrastructure and DevOps practices including CI/CD pipelines, containerisation, and cloud deployment at scale. What You'll Need to Succeed 4+ years of professional software engineering experience, with strong proficiency in one or more languages such as Python, C#, Java, TypeScript, or Go. Proven experience designing and building production-grade APIs, services, and distributed systems that operate at scale. Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure), containerisation (Docker, Kubernetes), and modern deployment practices. Experience working with databases (relational and/or NoSQL), caching layers, messaging systems, and data pipeline tooling. A strong engineering mindset, comfortable navigating ambiguity, making pragmatic trade-offs, and delivering with quality under pace. Experience mentoring engineers and contributing to engineering culture through technical leadership and collaboration. A collaborative disposition, comfortable working cross-functionally with data operations, AI/ML, product, and engineering teams in a fast-paced environment. Genuine interest in AI, data systems, or machine learning infrastructure is highly valued. Role Details Employment Type: Full-Time and Part-Time positions available Location: Fully Remote Stage: Growth stage, operational About Emetlab Emetlab is an AI data infrastructure company built on a single conviction: the quality ceiling of any AI system is determined by its training data, not its architecture or compute. We produce expert-crafted, rigorously validated training datasets across 12 specialised domains, delivered by a global network of over 5,000 vetted domain specialists spanning 100+ languages and 50+ specialisations. Beyond datasets, we offer end-to-end AI solutions including Fine-Tuning, RLHF & Alignment, Red Teaming, Model Evaluation, Data Annotation, Synthetic Data Generation, and Pre-Training Data Pipelines. We are not a crowd-sourcing platform. We are the data partner that matches the ambition of the teams building the next generation of AI, delivering measurable results: 42% accuracy improvements, 3x faster time-to-production, and 99.4% regulatory precision. Equal Opportunity Emetlab is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome dedicated individuals regardless of gender, race, ethnicity, national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We believe that extraordinary products are built by extraordinary teams, and extraordinary teams are built on inclusion, respect, and the understanding that brilliance has no single origin. description: Welcome to Perena : Your Risk Layer on Solana Perena is a decentralized financial protocol on Solana that offers USD STAR (USD*), a yield-bearing asset. all Perena surfaces, including public-facing apps, internal operations tools, and documentation Integrate directly with on-chain data and wallet infrastructure, building seamless interactions with to translate sophisticated financial concepts (yield strategies, collateral flows, risk metrics) into clear, trustworthy interfaces that inspire user confidence Own frontend performance, reliability, and regions Drive data-driven iteration by instrumenting user flows, analyzing engagement and conversion metrics, and shipping improvements that make Perena 's products easier and more compelling to title: AI Software Engineer
description: About us IOMETE is the sovereign data platform for the AI era. Enterprises run our data lakehouse, built on Apache Spark and Apache Iceberg, in their own trusted environment: on-premises, in their own cloud, or hybrid. It is built for regulated industries such as financial services, healthcare and government. Customer data never leaves the customer's trust perimeter, and the AI we build on it stays inside that perimeter too. Position overview We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated AI Software Engineer to join our team. We tackle a variety of exciting challenges, from connecting AI tools and models to the lakehouse to diagnosing Spark applications and troubleshooting failures. You'll build agents that run inside the customer's environment, on LLMs the customer provides or, later, on custom models we train for Spark tuning and troubleshooting. You'll also build the framework that defines those agents and the harness that runs, limits, traces and evaluates them. The AI team We are building the AI platform for the lakehouse — Lakehouse Intelligence. The team's roadmap includes, but is not limited to, the MCP Server for AI Agents, which lets AI tools query the lakehouse; the Model Gateway, through which IOMETE 's AI features call models; agents for Spark application diagnosis, troubleshooting and onboarding; and SQL AI Functions, which run language models from inside a query. Down the road, you'll also get to fine-tune and build custom models for our platform's specific needs, small enough to run inside a customer's deployment. What you'll do Contribute to and maintain IOMETE 's AI services, including the MCP Server for AI Agents, the Model Gateway, SQL AI Functions, and lakehouse-specific agents (such as Spark Application Diagnosis) and their harness. Build AI enablers: extend the IOMETE lakehouse and platform to support more AI-powered features, for example by making Spark job logs, query history and table metadata available to them. Be hands-on with Kubernetes, including the Helm charts that ship our AI services into each customer's deployment. Collaborate closely with external customer engineering teams to support integrations, troubleshoot complex issues and provide guidance for successful adoption of our platform. Participate in design discussions about agents, model access, evaluation, and overall systems architecture. Write the tests, docs and release notes for what you build. A feature is done when it has shipped with all of them. Review your teammates' work and provide feedback. What we're looking for 5+ years of professional experience in software engineering (we’re open to exceptional candidates with less experience who demonstrate deep systems knowledge and impact). Deep understanding of LLM-based systems in production – tool calling, structured output, retrieval, evaluation, and how they fail. Our AI features are written mostly in Python and Go. The data platform is built on the JVM, in Kotlin and Java, and new platform features are being built in Go. Production experience with any of these languages is a big plus, but we know strong engineers learn a new language fast. Familiarity with distributed systems and their challenges (e.g., data consistency, fault tolerance, scheduling). Fluency in English, both written and verbal — this role involves working with international customers and partners. Based in a time zone that overlaps Amsterdam working hours (CET/CEST). Preferred qualifications Hands-on experience across the AI stack: agents and their evaluation, tool protocols such as MCP, model routing and serving, and fine-tuning. Prior exposure to data platforms like Snowflake, Databricks, etc. Experience with Apache Spark (especially tuning Spark jobs), Apache Iceberg, or contributing to open-source compute engines. Hands-on experience with Kubernetes and Helm. What we offer Exciting projects and challenges. Opportunity to work with cutting-edge technology. Ability to play a key role in shaping the direction, culture, and architecture of a young & growing engineering organization. Competitive compensation and stock options. Hiring process Introduction call — 30 mins max Technical conversation (with a challenge) — 90 mins Team interview — 60 mins Offer Originally posted on Himalayas

description: Who are we? Tripledot Studios is one of the largest independent mobile games companies in the world. We are a multi-award-winning organisation, with a global 2,500+ strong team across 12 studios. Our expanded portfolio includes some of the biggest titles in mobile gaming, collectively reaching top chart positions around the world and engaging over 25 million daily active users. Tripledot’s guiding principle is that when people love what they do, what they do will be loved by others. We’re building a company we’re proud of. One filled with driven, incredibly smart and detail-orientated people, who LOVE making games. Our ambition is to be the most successful games company in the world, and we’re just getting started. The role is working within our studio: PuzzlePlay Puzzleplay is Tripledot’s new player rewards platform, designed to make playing our games even more fun and engaging. By playing our casual, free to play mobile games, users can earn points, complete challenges, and win real prizes. It’s our way of giving back to players and rewarding them for doing what they already love. Puzzleplay is a key part of our growth strategy, combining smart engagement mechanics with high-quality game content. Role Overview Puzzleplay at Tripledot Studios is looking for a data analyst to own the fraud side of its user segmentation work. The team is building a system that combines fraud and activity signals to understand users and inform revenue-share decisions. You'll work with the analyst responsible for gameplay signals, alongside product and data colleagues, to keep that system useful as fraud patterns change. Fraud patterns keep changing, so you'll regularly revisit the signals behind the segments and help the product team decide which verification methods make sense in each market. This role is open to candidates based in Europe; Warsaw is preferred, where several of the people you'll work with are based. Key Responsibilities Review fraud signals regularly, adding, removing and refining them to distinguish suspicious activity from legitimate users. Signals under consideration include IP spoofing, VPN use and unusual play patterns. Own the fraud-related segments of the user segmentation system, from deciding how signals should be interpreted to monitoring how well the categories work over time. Work with the product team on fraud verification tools for different markets. The team currently uses FaceTec for facial verification and may need other methods, such as ID scanning or phone verification, in other countries. Investigate users flagged for manual review, including ambiguous cases in the Tremendous queue, and look for ways to improve the review process. Identify gaps in the available signals and recommend third-party tools for the product roadmap where they would help. Required Skills, Knowledge and Expertise Hands-on experience using data to investigate fraud and shape detection or prevention decisions, not just working alongside a fraud team. Experience designing or improving fraud signals, user segments or review processes, with an interest in how those decisions change as tactics evolve. The ability to work with product and other teams to turn analysis into operational fraud controls. Originally posted on Himalayas

title: Phonetic Linguist - Singing Voice Data Annotation for AI
description: We are seeking a highly qualified Phonetic Linguist to join our team working on cutting-edge AI voice synthesis technology. This role involves precise annotation of professional singing recordings to create training data for advanced voice synthesis models. The position requires segmenting singing audio into individual phonemes with millisecond-level accuracy using spectrogram analysis. You will work with recordings across multiple languages, identifying and labeling vocal techniques including breathing patterns, glottal stops, vocal fry, and silence markers. This is a remote contract position offering the opportunity to work with proprietary annotation technology while contributing to breakthrough developments in AI-powered vocal synthesis. The role involves collaboration with an international team and handling confidential voice synthesis research. Key responsibilities include: Segmenting singing recordings into 5-30 second phrases with precise timing Correcting automated phoneme predictions using visual and auditory analysis Labeling special vocal elements (breathing, silences, glottal stops) Handling cross-linguistic pronunciation variations in musical contexts Maintaining consistent quality standards across large datasets Working with proprietary web-based annotation platforms Technical requirements: Reliable high-speed internet connection Professional audio equipment for precise listening Quiet workspace suitable for detailed audio analysis Availability for 20-30 hours per week Comfortable with NDA and confidentiality requirements Requirements Essential qualifications: Master's or PhD in Linguistics, Phonetics, or related field Expert knowledge of International Phonetic Alphabet (IPA) Proven experience with acoustic analysis software (Praat, ELAN) Strong background in phonetic transcription and spectrogram interpretation Experience with time-aligned annotation workflows Native or near-native English proficiency Additional language skills (Japanese, Mandarin, Korean, Spanish preferred) Preferred qualifications: Experience with speech synthesis or voice technology projects Understanding of vocal techniques and singing styles Background in computational linguistics or audio signal processing Previous work with AI training data annotation Research experience in acoustic phonetics or speech science Highlights Work on breakthrough AI voice synthesis technology, annotating singing recordings with millisecond precision for next-generation vocal AI models. title: Group Product Manager
description: Digible is a privately owned and operated digital marketing company founded in 2017 with a mission to bring cutting-edge solutions to the multifamily industry. We offer a full suite of digital services, alongside Fiona, our predictive analytics platform—the first of its kind. At Digible , we take pride in our collaborative, transparent, and authentic culture. Since 2021, we've been recognized as a Top Workplace in Colorado and secured the #8 spot in the Best Places to Work Multifamily rankings. From our hiring process to our All Hands meetings and Town Halls, our values are at the core of everything we do. We believe diversity fuels innovation, and we strive to create an inclusive environment where everyone can bring their authentic selves to work. If you're ready to do the best work of your career, we'd love to have you on the team! Core Values Authenticity — The commitment to be steadfast and genuine with our actions and communication toward everyone we touch. Curiosity — The belief that a deep and fundamental curiosity (the "why") in our work is vital to company innovation and evolution. Focus — The collective will to remain completely devoted and ultimately accountable to our deliverables. Humility — The recognition and daily practice that "we" is always greater than "I". Happiness — The decision to prioritize passion and love for what we do above everything else. The Role Digible is hiring a Group Product Manager who is both a hands-on product manager and an experienced people leader. Your primary responsibility is being the product manager for your own pod, and showing business results for that pod's area of responsibility is your top priority. In addition, you directly manage and coach two experienced Product Managers who each run their own pod. You and your two PMs work as a unit to identify overlaps and opportunities across pods, and you resolve them strategically and proactively in your respective product strategies and roadmaps rather than letting them surface as conflicts in delivery. In your own pod, you'll work on integrations, customer data architecture, core platform, and workflow productization, and you should be excited by exactly that kind of work. You'll also work on some customer-facing experiences and run customer discovery and research, build real relationships with customers and stakeholders, and set and communicate strategy clearly enough to bring the company with you. As a senior member of the team, you'll help lead AI transformation across product, design, and engineering, and you'll help shape how product management is practiced at Digible (AI-native, problem-first, customer-obsessed) through your own example and your coaching. You'll report to the VP of Product. We're a small product org inside a profitable, bootstrapped company — nine years successful before the recent AI wave, and now in the middle of an AI transformation, reinventing how an established company operates and thrives in the AI era. Profitability and bootstrapping mean you'll work on real customer and business problems, not a search for product/market fit, with a direct line to an accessible leadership team. You'll use AI throughout your workflow to move faster and more effectively than a team our size normally could. You'll Love This Job If You Love: Products with… 🧵 Connective Tissue: unifying fragmented tools, data, and services into one coherent experience for our agency teams and our customers 🏢 Two Sets of Customers: internal agency teams and external customers — you'll build for both 🧩 Portfolio Coherence: strategy that makes a group of pods add up to one story, not a collection of roadmaps ✨ AI: deciding what gets solved by people, product, or automation, and raising the AI-native bar for every pod in your group, not just your own Roles with… ⚖️ IC + Manager Hybrid: owning your own pod's results while managing and coaching two experienced PMs who own theirs 🌱 Multiplier Impact: a great week includes your PMs' wins, not just your own 🔭 New Bets: exploring new technology product opportunities and shaping what we build next Organizations with… 🚀 Small Teams: working with small teams that trade scale for agility & autonomy 🏗️ Early Foundations: crafting the systems, rituals, and mindsets of a relatively new product org Cultures with… 📅 4-day Workweek: we work Mon–Thu, so every weekend is a long weekend ⚖️ Modeled Balance: we know work is a part of life — boundaries are modeled by leadership Businesses with… 📈 Fast Growth: this isn't a turnaround — 371% three-year growth per the 2025 Inc. 5000 (No. 1,165) 🥾 Bootstrapped Profitability: we control our own destiny, with no investor or burn pressure What You'll Do: 🛠️ Own Your Pod: run your own pod end-to-end as its product manager: discovery, strategy, roadmap, delivery, and business results, problem-first every time. This is the biggest part of the job 💡 Customer Discovery & Research: run real discovery with customers, agency teams, and the market, and keep customer conversations on your calendar no matter the load 🧱 Foundational Platform Work: lead discovery and delivery of integrations, customer data architecture, core platform, and workflow productization, plus the customer-facing experiences they power 👥 Manage & Grow Two PMs: own the performance and career growth of two experienced Product Managers through 1:1s, goals, coaching, and craft feedback that makes their work visibly better 🧭 Cross-Pod Strategy: with your PMs, spot the overlaps and opportunities across pods early and resolve them in your respective strategies and roadmaps, so the group adds up to one story with no seams 🤝 Stakeholder Partnership: align pod teams, leadership, agency partners, and customers around the group's strategy; stakeholders are customers and partners, not requesters 🏁 End-to-End Delivery: ship the full experience, customer-facing and internal, including enablement and change management 📏 Measure Impact: define success metrics at both pod and group level, and get creative or technical when the data is hard to come by 🤖 AI Transformation: help lead AI transformation across product, design, and engineering, and set the AI-native bar for how your PMs work 🧠 Product Taste: set the bar for what deserves to ship across the group, balancing creative instinct with data and business goals 📡 Industry Trends: stay ahead of AI and product trends and bring what matters into the group's work How Success Will Be Measured: Business Metrics $ Pod Business Impact: measurable operational efficiency and revenue outcomes from your own pod. This comes first $ Group Business Impact: measurable revenue and efficiency outcomes across your group's pods, with overlaps resolved rather than duplicated Product Metrics Adoption & CSAT: internal teams and customers actually run on, trust, and prefer what your pods ship Delivery Predictability: the group ships what it commits to, quarter after quarter People Metrics PM Performance & Growth: your Product Managers' performance, development, engagement, and career trajectory What You Should Have: Must Have 7+ years of product management experience, including senior-level ownership of a pod or domain with measurable business impact 2+ years of AI product experience 2+ years of formal people-management experience managing experienced product managers, with accountability for their performance, growth, and career development Still excellent, and happy, doing hands-on PM work as the biggest part of your job; you want an IC and manager hybrid role by choice Technical depth to work on integrations, customer data architecture, core platform, and workflow productization, and genuine excitement for that type of work Customer discovery and research fluency: you talk to customers directly, and your product decisions trace back to what you learned Strategic and communication range: you can set a strategy, make the case for it, and keep executives, agency leaders, engineers, and your own PMs moving in the same direction Track record of aligning multiple teams or product areas around one product story, and of spotting and resolving overlap across them Preferred Small start-up (<150 people) experience Experience productizing internal operations or building workflow/integration products Tech-enabled services or hybrid product-service business experience Bonus Digital marketing domain knowledge (strategy, metrics, and technology) Real estate domain knowledge (ex: rentals, multifamily, single family, etc.) Pay, Perks and More! title: Front End RTL Designer / SoC integration
description: About Us : AI compute is hitting a hard physical wall, and memory bottlenecks are throttling the entire industry. Founded in October 2024 and backed by €57M in funding, Vertical Compute is solving this with proprietary Vertical Integrated Memory (VIM™) chiplets, making AI hardware faster, greener, and vastly more scalable. We are an interdisciplinary team transforming breakthrough semiconductor physics into commercial reality. Why Now : After 18 months of intensive R&D, Vertical Compute has reached a critical inflection point. Our underlying technology is validated, and we have successfully met our core technical milestones. Armed with a proven technical data package and ongoing system studies, we are now shifting from pure R&D to active engagement with global enterprise customers. As we prepare for our next phase of scale and growth starting in 2027, joining us today means taking direct ownership of the hardware foundation that will power the next era of AI compute. About the role: We are looking for a Front-End RTL Designer to contribute to building our Vertical Compute 's 3D-integrated chiplets. In this role, you will focus on top-level integration and integrating all IPs to build the AI accelerator that will demonstrate the full potential of our Vertical Integrated Memory (VIM™) technology. You will handle full SoC integration, working in close collaboration with verification and physical design teams to ensure the targeted Power, Performance, and Area (PPA) of the product. Key Responsibilities: Lead top-level SoC and chiplet integration, incorporating all internal and third-party IPs to build high-performance AI accelerators. Integrate proprietary Vertical Integrated Memory (VIM™) technology with compute engines to maximize throughput and bandwidth efficiency. Partner closely with functional verification teams to build verification environments, debug RTL issues, and ensure robust design coverage. Collaborate with physical design teams to optimize Power, Performance, and Area (PPA), supporting synthesis, timing closure, and floorplanning. About the team: This role is part of the Hardware (HW) team, reporting directly to the HW Manager. You will join a collaborative and innovative team dedicated to delivering cutting-edge AI accelerator solutions and pushing the boundaries of memory and compute integration. Requirements About who you are: Solid background and experience in front-end RTL design and top-level SoC/chiplet integration. Degree (B.S., M.S., or Ph.D.) in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Microelectronics, or a related field. Strong hard skills in RTL languages (SystemVerilog/Verilog), IP integration, and working closely with verification and physical design teams to optimize PPA (Power, Performance, Area). Strong communication and collaborative problem-solving skills in a fast-paced environment. Fluency in English with effective written and verbal communication skills. Highlights Leading and mentoring engineering teams, managing projects from concept to silicon qualification, and collaborating with key industry partners to deliver innovative memory solutions. title: SEO/AEO Lead
description: About Discovered Labs Discovered Labs is an SEO/AEO agency built by a Stanford rocket scientist turned AI researcher (Ben Moore) and demand gen marketer with experience scaling B2B SaaS companies to 8-figures in ARR (Liam Dunne). We're a team of ML engineers, data scientists and senior marketers trusted by fast-growing B2B SaaS companies including Instantly, Granola and Composio to help generate leads and customers through Google and AI assistants like ChatGPT. We do this through a mixture of content marketing, technical optimisations and off-site brand amplification (PR, backlinks, Reddit marketing). View recent case studies at High-level overview of our approach: AI-powered operations: Our ML team builds internal tools that remove repetitive work and give marketers more time for judgement and execution. Senior judgement: Experienced marketers set the strategy and quality bar; automation supports the work rather than replacing it. Full-stack execution: We work across content, technical SEO/AEO and off-site amplification to give clients better outcomes. Note: If you want to stand out, please include a Loom video showing a tool, system or deliverable you've produced and are proud of. We'd love to see it! This role We’re hiring for a SEO/AEO Lead. You’ll manage our team of analysts and strategists, constantly raise the bar across client work and collaborate closely with product and engineering to turn client and market insights into better tools and workflows for the team. You’ll be accountable for client health, making sure the department’s quarterly net revenue retention (NRR) goal is hit and coaching the team to become best-in-class marketers who are progressing in their careers. This is not a typical management role where your value is measured by team meetings. It will be operationally intense: high context, high communication and the application of unreasonably high standards across everything we do for clients. It is fully remote, ideally within +/-4 hours of GMT, though we can be flexible for the right person. What you'll do Improve the delivery methodology. Identify better ways for us to find, diagnose and act on SEO/AEO performance opportunities that help clients win. Turn successful changes into playbooks and workflows that don’t rely on heroics. Set and maintain delivery standards. Improve how we structure deliverables, run QA, communicate with clients and collaborate as a team so clients receive a world-class experience and we maintain a culture of excellence. Coach and train the team weekly. Use structured work, call and communication reviews to give feedback, practise improvements and check that subsequent client work meets the standard. Manage performance and development. Run structured fortnightly 1:1s, quarterly reviews, and maintain individual development plans so team members are progressing in their careers and feel incentivised. Own NRR and client health. Report on retention, expansion and account health; spot risks early and work with strategists on save plans for red accounts. Build the talent bench and hire well. Build a pipeline of capable analysts and strategists for future capacity needs. Run structured assessments and interviews to evaluate ability and help close candidates. Build effective onboarding. Build and improve an onboarding curriculum so analysts and strategists reach our delivery standards faster. Sponsor product and workflow improvements. Work with product and engineering to build new tools and workflows that make your team more effective and gives clients unfair advantages. The ideal person for this role You’ve led teams before . You know how to run performance reviews, handle hard conversations and get the most out of those who work with you. You can challenge a search strategy . You can judge whether a content plan targets the right clusters, a technical recommendation deserves priority or an AEO experiment will deliver the right commercial outcomes. You operate with radical candour . You proactively provide feedback and are comfortable having difficult conversations without being an asshole. People know where they stand with you. You are detail-oriented . You spot details that others miss and you unapologetically hold yourself and everyone around you to a high standard. You can diagnose the real problem. If a strategy is underperforming, you are able to quickly identify the issues and resolve it using data. You develop judgement in others. You can explain why a plan or deliverable falls short, give useful feedback and help the person produce better work next time. You think in systems . Disconnected work drives you crazy. You connect work into clear frameworks, shared definitions and standards. Requirements Experience formally managing SEOs with evidence of improved performance, candid feedback and difficult people decisions. Strong practical SEO judgement across content, technical and off-page work. Evidence that your SEO decisions improved client business outcomes. Evidence of prioritising across client accounts or equivalent stakeholder portfolios when performance, retention risk and delivery capacity compete. Ability to define requirements and acceptance criteria for delivery improvements, and validate solutions with product or engineering. Excellent written and verbal English and availability for a working day that overlaps meaningfully with GMT. This role is not for you if… You’re not exceptional at SEO. We believe great leaders must first be great operators. You’d rather operate in the shadows. This is a high-visibility role interacting with clients every day and collaborating with the team. You aren’t comfortable with data. We’re a deeply technical team who prefers data over opinions. You’d rather sit at 50,000 feet in diagrams and planning docs. You’ll be expected to also be in the weeds pushing work forward. Culture fit You'll thrive here if: You like small teams, direct feedback and a high degree of autonomy. You’re comfortable challenging others’ thinking and also having yourself challenged. You are comfortable making a recommendation and explaining the data and rationale behind it. You won't thrive here if: You need heavy management or wait for perfect instructions. You rely on “that’s how it’s always been done” to defend an approach. You leave concerns unspoken because the conversation might be uncomfortable. You intend to view Discovered Labs as another client amongst other projects and clients. What's in it for you Compensation: $50K to $85K USD, DOE Fully remote: work from where you do your best work, with meaningful overlap with GMT. Progression : A clear path towards head of client delivery or associate director. Flexibility : You can have flexible working hours with the expectation of 40 hours of meaningful work per week. Real autonomy: you will have a voice, be trusted to do your work and make improvements to our systems. A small, senior team: work directly with experienced operators, with direct feedback and quick decisions. Annual company off-site : We get together once a year at a nice destination to relax, reset and plan. Interview Process: Async assessment (15 minutes) 30 minute call with founder 90 minute deep-dive into career history and work 3 hour paid assessment Reference checks with former peers and managers. To apply: Please complete the short form on the platform where you see this job ad. Be specific as possible when answering questions - we love detail. Please do not use sloppy AI to auto-apply for this role. It’s obvious and will result in us not progressing with your application for this role and future roles. Originally posted on Himalayas

With BlinkRx, never again will a patient show up at the pharmacy only to discover that they can’t afford their medication, their doctor needs to fill out a form for them, or the pharmacy doesn’t have the medication in stock. Comfort with an outbound call motion. Ability to thrive in a dynamic and fast-paced environment Ability to prioritize duties and manage multiple projects from start to finish with minimal supervision. Strong time-management and organizational skills Must be able to exercise strict confidentiality and have impeccable judgment Ability to coordinate several tasks simultaneously Experience in working with a CRM (eg Salesforce) and softphone system is preferred Why Join Us:It is rare to have a company that both deeply impacts its customers and is able to provide its services across a massive population. We are also the fastest growing healthcare company in the country and are driving that impact across millions of new patients every year. Our business model not only helps people, but drives economics that allow us to build a generational company. We are a relentlessly learning, constantly curious, and aggressively collaborative cross-functional team dedicated to inventing new ways to improve the lives of our customers. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity of all kinds. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. description: Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder led, profitable and growing. We are hiring a Usability Engineer for our Design Team. User Science is an evolving design discipline at Canonical . While we have long incorporated diverse research on user needs into our products, the mission of the newly formed User Science team is to expand beyond traditional models of UX research, integrating user needs end-to-end in development processes and quality standards across the company. This mission requires skillful advocacy as well as organizational learning and change. As process pioneers, we draw insights from others, foster collaborative user research cultures, and constantly innovate with frameworks and standards. Location: This role will be based remotely in the EMEA region. The role entails Collecting and synthesizing user data: Developing user insights in diverse formats, scientifically analyzing data from A/B tests, usability studies, and other methodologies to create compelling findings. Prototyping for impact: Building lightweight prototypes, data visualization dashboards, or automation scripts to enhance broader consumption of research. Responding to audience needs: Calibrating research presentations with sensitivity and precision in a highly technical environment, understanding what level of depth is right for each stakeholder. Promoting a data-informed culture: Working closely with process, product, and engineering teams to integrate user research into existing decision-making flows. Building research scalability and interoperability: Strengthening research ops infrastructure, making key methodologies more accessible, actionable, and repeatable. Fostering a learning culture: Contribute to the evolving definition of User Science through user-centered training, resource development, and outreach. What we are looking for in you Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a related field such as Design, Engineering, Data Science or similar, or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path. User research expertise: Proficiency in both qualitative and quantitative user research methodologies, including user interviews, usability testing, A/B testing, surveys, and data analysis. Tinkerer mindset: A passion for hacking, exploring, and building creative solutions, whether through technical prototyping, scripting, or research tooling. A degree of technical fluency: Ability to quickly pick up technical concepts, engage deeply with engineering and process optimization teams, and contribute to cross-functional discussions. A talent for optimization: A strong alignment towards building research ops, systematizing best practices, and creating frameworks for broader knowledge-sharing. Finely tuned communication skills: Impeccable verbal and written communication abilities, characterized by warmth, precision, and a commitment to maintaining high-quality standards. Portfolio: A robust portfolio showcasing a range of user research, design, or engineering projects that show a talent for exploration, optimization, and transforming insights into action. Some experience with or interest in data analysis frameworks in Python (e.g. pandas, seaborn), R, MATLAB or similar. A proven track record of contributing to Open Source projects or communities. A passion for aesthetics, visualization, or design. What we offer you Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. title: AI/ML Engineer Internship
description: Overview: Building Autonomous AI Agents The AI/ML Engineer with an AI Agent Focus is a specialized role dedicated to designing, building, and deploying autonomous AI agents that handle complex business processes independently. You will be at the forefront of integrating cutting-edge Large Language Models (LLMs) and reasoning frameworks into our e-commerce and supply chain ecosystem, driving efficiency and innovation through intelligent automation. Internship Details Duration: 3 months Start Date: Immediate Location: Remote Stipend: None initially. Based on your first-quarter performance, you may be offered a paid full-time opportunity, or even be absorbed directly by the client as an FTE. Key Responsibilities & Core Projects You will be responsible for the full lifecycle of agent development, from initial design to production optimization and monitoring. Agent Architecture & Development: Design and build autonomous AI agent architectures utilizing LLMs, advanced reasoning frameworks, and decision-making systems to achieve specific business goals (e.g., customer support automation, sales assistance, workflow optimization). Business Process Automation: Create agents that integrate directly into the platform to automate critical supply chain and administrative tasks, such including: Customer Support Agents integrated into the e-commerce storefront. Internal Workflow Automation agents (e.g., Slack integration, Jira automation). Multi-Agent Systems: Implement and orchestrate multi-agent systems where specialized agents collaborate to solve complex, multi-step problems across different modules (MES, WMS, OMS). Advanced Agent Capabilities: Develop and implement memory systems, sophisticated context management, and tool integration strategies (allowing agents to use internal APIs, search, or code execution) to enhance agent efficacy. Model Optimization: Implement techniques for agent improvement, including fine-tuning of LLM models and applying concepts from Reinforcement Learning for optimal decision-making. Safety & Monitoring: Implement safety guardrails, define ethical usage guidelines, and build robust monitoring systems (collaborating with MLOps) to track and analyze agent behavior and performance in production. Required Technologies & Tools Candidates must possess deep experience in machine learning, LLM technology, and production deployment: LLM/Agent Frameworks: Mandatory hands-on expertise with agent construction frameworks like LangChain, LlamaIndex, and AutoGen. Programming & ML: Expert proficiency in Python and standard ML/Deep Learning libraries (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow). Data & APIs: Experience preparing data for model fine-tuning and integrating agents via API endpoints into production services (Node.js/NestJS). Deployment: Familiarity with MLOps concepts (versioning, deployment) and containerization (Docker) for agent deployment. Databases: Understanding of vector databases and retrieval augmented generation (RAG) techniques. Supply Chain Integration (Domain Focus) You will integrate intelligent agents directly into our core supply chain and data systems. Data Analysis Agents: Build agents capable of complex data analysis and insight generation using aggregated data from MES, WMS, and OMS. E-commerce Integration: Deploy agents that assist users directly within the e-commerce platform by accessing real-time catalog and inventory data. Success Metrics & Career Path Performance will be measured by: Agent Autonomy: Measurable increase in the percentage of business tasks handled end-to-end by autonomous agents. Business Impact: Quantifiable improvements in metrics driven by the agents (e.g., reduced customer support response time, increased sales conversion). Model Performance: Accuracy and efficiency of fine-tuned models and the reliability of multi-agent systems. Mentorship Structure: Reports to the Head of Technology/CTO, working closely with the Data Architect and MLOps Engineer to productionize and scale agent capabilities. Originally posted on Himalayas

Framework Integration: Define best practices for production AI agents utilizing frameworks like LangChain, LlamaIndex, or AutoGen. title: Infrastructure / Systems Operations Engineer
description: At ZIGChain , we're designing the next generation of blockchain infrastructure, leveraging decentralized technologies for enhanced security, scalability and interoperability. Our mission is to empower people everywhere through transparent, decentralized systems that drive financial freedom. ZIGChain is a Layer 1 blockchain focused on unlocking financial opportunities for everyone, regardless of their income, location or level of knowledge. We're looking for a junior-to-mid systems and infrastructure engineer to take on the day-to-day operation of our Linux, AWS, and blockchain-node infrastructure. You'll start by owning routine administration and monitoring, and grow into more of our infrastructure-as-code and node-operations work over time. This is a hands-on operations role with a clear path to broader responsibility, and a great fit for someone with solid fundamentals who wants to deepen their cloud and infrastructure skills in a real production environment. Requirements What You'll Do Operate and maintain our Linux, AWS, and blockchain-node infrastructure on a day-to-day basis. Own routine administration, monitoring, and troubleshooting of services and networking. Contribute to our infrastructure-as-code work with Terraform, growing your ownership over time. Support blockchain node operations across our ecosystem. Automate recurring tasks and diagnostics through scripting. Help keep our systems secure, patched, and running smoothly. Requirements Must-Haves: Linux administration: CLI fluency, systemd, package management, log analysis, and troubleshooting of services and networking. Shell scripting (Bash) for automation and diagnostics. Working knowledge of core AWS services: EC2, VPC, IAM, S3, CloudWatch, and load balancers (ELB/ALB). You should be able to operate and debug them, not necessarily architect them. Terraform at a working level: you have authored and applied configurations and understand state and the plan/apply cycle. Prior Terraform experience on any cloud is fine, it doesn't need to be AWS. Networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, DNS, SSH, firewalls and security groups. Git: comfortable with the everyday branch/commit/PR workflow. Sound credential and access hygiene: proper SSH key handling, least-privilege IAM, keeping secrets out of code and repositories, and keeping systems patched. Cool-to-Haves: Terraform beyond the basics: modules, remote state, multi-environment setups. Blockchain node experience, whether with Cosmos specifically or another chain. Docker; Kubernetes exposure is a plus. Monitoring and observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana). Python for tooling beyond Bash. CI/CD exposure. Soft Skills Accountability: you own your work and communicate openly when something goes wrong, focusing on fixing it rather than explaining it away. Honesty and candor: you speak up for what's good for the team, even when it's not the easiest thing to say. A self-taught instinct: you're comfortable figuring things out on your own and genuinely enjoy learning, since much of this role is grown into rather than known on day one. Collaborative team player, self-directed and comfortable working autonomously in remote environments. What We Offer Competitive annual salary ranging from $40,000.00 to $50,000.00 (USD) depending on seniority. 15% extra to the salary in ZIGs tokens as part of the compensation package. Fully remote work environment. Opportunity to work in a cutting-edge industry. Collaborative and inclusive work culture. Professional growth and development opportunities. Why Join ZIGChain ? Impact, help operate and strengthen the core infrastructure that powers a decentralised, interoperable financial future, Innovation, work with a cutting-edge tech stack in a space that rewards experimentation and creativity, Ownership, take real responsibility for systems that matter from your first weeks, with a clear path to more, Growth, join a team that values learning, autonomy and technical excellence at every level. Our Core Values At ZIGChain we don't just build blockchain technology, we build a culture rooted in five values that shape how we work every day. Extreme Ownership: we close the loop. Work ends shipped, killed, or explicitly handed off, and we escalate when blocked instead of going silent, Heroes Don't Scale: we step up when the moment demands it, then build the processes, workflows and agents that prevent the next crisis, Excellence: excellence is what ships. Quality and time are fixed, scope flexes, and we aim to deliver work that becomes the reference others measure against, Strategic Intelligence: we think in second and third orders, naming downstream consequences before committing and choosing speed or depth as the moment requires, The Org Is AI: AI executes work and holds the system while we give it direction. Building and orchestrating agents is basic literacy here. These values drive how we work, grow and make an impact, and we're inviting you to be part of it. Apply now! Highlights Own the day-to-day of ZIGChain 's Linux, AWS and node infrastructure, and grow into IaC and node operations. Fully remote, real production environment, real responsibility. description: About Imagine Worldwide All children have immense potential, but hundreds of millions don’t have access to the learning they need. Imagine Worldwide believes that every child should be empowered with the basic right to literacy and numeracy. We provide an innovative education technology solution and implementation model to the global literacy/numeracy learning crisis using the onebillion application and various toolkits and systems to support implementation. Our model is massively scalable, evidence-based, and can deliver foundational learning to millions of the most marginalized children. Imagine Worldwide partners with governments, organizations, and communities to provide child-directed, tablet-based learning that is accessible, effective, and affordable. We are incorporated in California (United States) as a nonprofit organization, but operate in Sub-Saharan Africa through locally-registered entities in Malawi, Sierra Leone, and Tanzania. Learn more on our website. Role Overview The Director of Supply Chain Operations will play a critical role in carrying out Imagine’s mission to scale tablet-based learning solutions that enable children to become literate and numerate. They will join a highly committed and collaborative team that is working together to empower every child everywhere to achieve their full potential. They will lead the design and optimisation of our in-country supply chain architecture in the low-resource contexts in which Imagine works, ensuring that devices don’t just arrive in-country — they reach learners, stay operational, and last as long as possible. This role requires deep collaboration and partnership with country logistics teams to architect and operationalise contextually relevant in-country supply chains to reliably conduct forward and reverse logistics for devices and materials in real-world field conditions. This role provides thought leadership and tools for inventory and stock management, route planning and last‑mile distribution, forward logistics (deployment to schools), reverse logistics (returns, redeployment, end‑of‑life), repairs and refurbishment strategy, and local logistics partner management. Key Responsibilities Regional Supply Chain Architecture In collaboration with country teams, develop in-country supply chain architectures across portfolio countries with the goal of ensuring that learning is not disrupted by downtime or asset loss. Lead geospatial mapping and analysis to build digital maps of the terrain,road networks, road infrastructure, and key points of interest to inform route planning and placement of warehouses and service centers. Based on geospatial data analysis, develop the strategy for the strategic placement of warehouses and service repair centres. Based on geospatial data analysis, determine routes and vehicles for distribution and replacement of assets. Drive research and cost-benefit analyses to develop robust strategies for last-mile distribution in each country (e.g, in-house, outsource, CSR partnerships, etc). Distribution, repairs, and maintenance logistics Develop cost-efficient strategies for forward and reverse logistics to support the deployment, returns, and end-of-life processes. Develop multiple strategies for repairs, maintenance, and replacement operations that evolve with the scale of the program, are sustainable in the long-term including after full handover to government, extend device lifespan, and minimize turnaround time. Determine the strategy and tools to enable data-driven route planning for ongoing maintenance / service visits. Ensure this is based on geospatial data, has context-specific understanding of road conditions, and can be continuously updated as weather patterns and local conditions change. Advise country teams on strategies to manage spare parts flows and turnaround times. Inventory tracking, safety, and risk management Research health and safety regulations, in local markets as well as global standards, to establish minimum safety and security standards for asset storage and distribution. Develop and implement strategies to mitigate risk of theft or loss of assets during storage, transit, and repairs services. Research and recommend suitable asset tracking solutions (e.g. NFC tags, tracking applications, GPS, RFID, etc.). Collaborate with relevant colleagues to implement improvements to the inventory management process, reports, and system that enhance safety and tracking of assets. Source and manage experts to assess and mitigate risks for fire, electrical shocks and any potential dangers to learners, educators, partners and staff. Local capacity for repairs and e-waste management Research, document, and disseminate global standards for sustainable use, repair, recycling, and disposal of electronic products. Adapt global standards to local infrastructure, regulatory, and operational contexts. In collaboration with government and country teams, develop strategies to cultivate technical repair skills and e-waste management companies in each country. Support each country to identify, select, and manage potential partners from both public and private sectors to activate repairs and e-waste management resources. Develop global standards and frameworks to guide partnership agreements (e.g.,mandatory terms for SLAs). In collaboration with government, partners, and country teams, develop a certification processes to Accredit technicians to repair equipment used in our programs while maintaining specific standards of quality and output. Accredit companies or organizations to dispose of electronic products in compliance with global and country-specific regulations. Data-driven leadership and capacity building Use data to improve visibility, accountability, and performance of supply chain operations. Enable county teams to implement the global strategies and processes by providing documentation, SOPs, templates, and training. Build a strong data culture and develop data fluency across the country supply chain value chain. Drive the uptake and utilisation of dashboards and data resources by upskilling teams, and embedding the use of data in standardised ways of working, and raising delivery excellence. Champion a culture of collaboration, continuous learning and optimisation. Requirements The successful candidate will possess the following competencies, experiences, and qualities: Honours Degree or Post Graduate Diploma in supply chain management, supply chain architecture, logistics, field operations, or related fields. Master's Degree qualification preferred. A minimum of 10 years’ experience in logistics, supply chain operations, or asset-heavy field operations, of which 5 years must have been at a senior level with demonstrated experience in supply chain architecture. Proven experience managing inventory, distribution, and reverse logistics with bias toward practical, durable solutions that work on the ground. Strong understanding of asset lifecycle management and repairs. Experience operating in low-resource, high-complexity environments. Experience with building a data-driven culture in an organization to support better decision-making. Experience working with remote or hybrid teams across multiple countries. Experience working in the non-profit or social sector is an advantage. Compensation & Benefits Salary is competitive and commensurate with experience. Location The Director of Supply Chain Operations must be based in Africa.The Director will frequently collaborate and coordinate with operations teams across Africa, the US, and the UK. This is a full-time remote position; the role can be based anywhere in Africa with reliable internet access and alignment with core working hours across time zones. The role is primarily home-based, with at least quarterly international travel for in-person team meetings, field support, or training. Must be comfortable working independently in a virtual environment and managing communication across global teams. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis * * * Imagine Worldwide is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status. description: Ready to own it, build it, and grow it? The Mission Publitas turns static, dead PDFs into interactive, shoppable digital content discovery experiences. Our Reach proposition — our consumer portals, including and in the Benelux and Promozilla portals across ~40 countries — connects millions of shoppers with localized retail deals, flyers, and promotions. It is a core traffic and engagement engine for the company. Your mission as Growth Marketing Manager is to own consumer traffic growth across our portals end to end. You will protect and grow our largest market (Benelux), where the bulk of today's traffic sits, while building a repeatable acquisition playbook to scale our newer Promozilla portals from a standing start. You own every lever that moves consumers to our portals — organic/SEO, social, affiliates and partnerships, paid, and lifecycle/retention. We work ~80% asynchronously and judge you on traffic growth, audience retention, and channel efficiency — not hours on Zoom. What Success Looks Like (Your First 90 Days) We measure outcomes, not tenure. In your first three months: Day 30: You've achieved full campaign continuity with zero disruption to active Benelux flows, and audited traffic sources across the portal network — establishing a clear baseline of what drives volume in each live market and a working relationship with product and development. Day 60: You've identified the highest-yield channel per market and the friction points capping growth (technical, behavioral, or distributional), and shipped your first round of experiments — across organic, paid, social, partnerships, or lifecycle — with early measurable lift. Day 90: Your highest-leverage channels are running predictably in Benelux, and you've drafted and aligned a scalable acquisition playbook to roll out to the nascent Promozilla markets — mapped to the development team's product and UX/UI ETAs for Q3/Q4. Requirements The DNA of a Growth Marketer at Publitas Founder-Level Ownership : You treat the portal network like your own business. You don't wait for a roadmap to be handed to you — you read the data, uncover the insight, chase down the tracking gap, and make high-impact calls autonomously. A Continuous Growth Mindset : Consumer behavior and search/distribution algorithms shift fast. You treat traffic as a system to be engineered — constantly testing unconventional loops, optimizing channel mix, and treating every performance drop as a data point to dissect and iterate on. High Autonomy, Low Ego : In a remote-first, async environment, the work speaks for itself. You're motivated by solving hard distribution problems, not by synchronous cheerleading, and you're comfortable being judged on the real health of portal traffic and retention. The Non-Negotiables Multi-Channel Traffic Mastery : A proven track record driving consumer traffic at scale across the full mix — organic/SEO (including programmatic/technical SEO), paid social and search, affiliates and partnerships, and lifecycle/retention. You understand B2C shopper psychology and how audiences hunt for promotions. High-Volume B2C / Platform Background : Experience in app-first consumer marketplaces, coupon/deal platforms, news/media publishers, or large-scale e-commerce/affiliate networks. Programmatic & Multi-Market Scaling : You've scaled traffic across many markets or properties and understand how to standardize a playbook and localize it efficiently — rather than rebuilding from scratch per market. AI-First Execution : We do not scale headcount to solve manual problems. A demonstrable track record of using generative AI and automation to scale campaign copy and localization, build programmatic reporting loops, and trigger automated workflows. We are not looking for "AI-curious" — we look for people already using AI to do better work, with tangible impact to show. Flawless Professional English : You collaborate with the global Publitas team in English; your written communication must be exceptional for an async-first team. Dutch — strong plus . What We Offer You to Win Transparent Compensation: A competitive entry-level base salary of €40 000 - €60 000 (geo-bracketed to your location in the EU) with a clear, performance-based path for career progression. True Remote Autonomy: We work 80% asynchronously using Notion and Slack. We don't monitor your screen or count your hours—we trust you to own your delivery targets and manage your day. Global Team Retreats: Working remotely shouldn't mean working isolated. We gather the entire company in inspiring cities across the globe once a year to connect, strategize, and celebrate in person. Premium Workspace & Gear: A top-tier MacBook, high-end remote work accessories, and co-working allowance if you prefer an office environment. Personal Growth Budget: A monthly wellness allowance, an education/course budget to sharpen your SaaS skills, and free access to Kindle and Audible books. Time Off: 25 days of paid vacation plus your local national holidays. At Publitas, we see AI as a core lever for performance, efficiency, and innovation. We expect all team members to actively use AI in their daily work to improve quality, speed, and output. Depending on the role, this ranges from effectively using AI tools in day-to-day workflows to designing and scaling AI-driven systems. We are not looking for candidates who are “AI-curious”; we look for people who already use AI to do better work and can demonstrate tangible impact. Originally posted on Himalayas

This job sits at the intersection of SoC architecture (specifically the physical design) , package design, and 3D manufacturing processes. Key Responsibilities: Integration Architecture & Process Definition : Develop and define architectures for 2.5D/3D stacking of VIM chiplets with compute chiplets. Collaborate with design and technology teams to develop interconnect solutions that ensure high bandwidth and low latency. Define clearly the impact of the chiplet physical design chiplets (through-silicon vias, micro-bumps, hybrid bonds, redistribution layers, and chiplet interfaces, …) define fabrication flows and design rules with foundries, packaging partners, and internal physical design teams Performance Analysis & Simulation: Conduct early multi-physics simulations (thermal, electrical, mechanical) to analyze and optimize the performance and reliability of integrated systems. drive external partners for final package design Collaboration & Communication:Partner closely with design, process engineering, metrology, and system architecture teams. Participate in conferences, standardization bodies and industry events to promote or lead discussions about the future of chiplet integration. Technical Leadership:Provide technical leadership and project management guidance to multidisciplinary teams. About the team: This role is part of the Product & system team, partnering closely with our cross-functional engineering teams in Product & system and Memory Design. We foster a highly collaborative, inclusive environment where strong alignment, high transparency and seamless team coordination are central to our shared success. Requirements About who you are: You’ve spent 5–10 years exploring the frontiers of 2.5D/3D packaging and heterogeneous integration, turning complex ideas into manufacturable systems. You have a deep understanding on the SoC physical design, TSVs, Redistribution Layers, hybrid bonding and how they are used at system level to implement chip IOs (Functional and power IOs) You are mastering Integrity 3D-IC Platform to define the chiplets interface, to define 3D stacking system, to generate the 3Dblox views, and to run all the 3D system level analysis (Power Delivery Network, Thermal, STA, LVS, SI/PI, …) You thrive where architecture meets technology — translating ambitious concepts into elegant, high-performance designs. You’re naturally collaborative — just as comfortable in technical deep dives as you are building bridges between design, process, and system teams. You’re the kind of engineer who balances vision with execution: leading projects, mentoring peers, and pushing boundaries with a calm hand. Above all, you’re curious — drawn to the challenge of building something new and meaningful at the intersection of memory, compute, and packaging innovation. Fluency in English with strong written and verbal communication abilities. Why Join Us: You will get the opportunity to work at the forefront of memory technology innovation. Making sure you and your team are going to enjoy the journey and become passionate about what we do is a key goal of our founders. You can be part of a talented and dedicated team in a fast-paced startup environment. In this role, you contribute to projects that will have a significant impact on the future of computing and electronics. You can count on a motivating total rewards package. Flexible ways of working. Join us in shaping the future of compute & memory technology — and celebrating success! Originally posted on Himalayas

description: Please note that we are unable to consider applications from candidates based in France, Italy, or Germany for this role. Money is moving onto the internet, and the shift has a name: Open Money. This is money that is open, portable, agentic, and owned by you. MetaMask spent the last ten years building it; with 100M+ downloads, users in ~190 countries, and trillions in cumulative transaction volume, it's the most trusted self-custodial financial platform on the internet. Now we're building the operating system for your money: one place to hold, move, grow, and use anything you own. Join a remote-first, global team rebuilding how money works: a problem that touches everyone, every day. About the role MetaMask is a self-custody wallet that does not hold users’ private keys. Blockchain transactions are generally irreversible, meaning a vulnerability in the product or its software delivery chain can lead directly to financial losses for users. As a result, MetaMask attracts sustained attention from financially motivated attackers and sophisticated supply chain actors. We are looking for a Senior Manager, Application Security to lead application security across the MetaMask extension, mobile app, Snaps, backend services, DeFi primitives, stablecoins, and supporting smart contracts. The role covers architecture, code, dependencies, build and release controls, security testing, and vulnerability disclosure. This is a hands-on leadership role. You will set the strategy and operating model, lead a small senior team, and remain directly involved in code review and threat modelling. You will report to the Head of Security and work closely with MetaMask Engineering leadership to ensure security risks are understood, owned, and addressed. Responsibilities Leadership and planning Lead and develop the Application Security team, including hiring, performance management and career development, while remaining directly involved in technical work. Set the Application Security strategy, annual goals and quarterly OKRs in line with company objectives and the approved Target Operating Model. Define and track KPIs to measure performance and progress. Report AppSec progress, coverage, remediation performance and material gaps to Security leadership and contribute to Risk Committee reporting. Secure design and delivery Define security review requirements across development and release, assess whether they are met and escalate unresolved risks. Lead threat modelling and security design reviews across clients, APIs and backend services, including authentication, key management, signing and delegated actions. Assess trust boundaries across the full system and participate in architecture and RFC reviews. Define software supply chain security requirements and work with engineering teams to implement and validate controls for dependencies, builds, artefacts and publishing. Lead security code reviews across MetaMask applications and smart contracts, working with engineers and relevant specialists to address findings. Define and evolve the secure development lifecycle to incorporate AI agents, including their access, actions and human review requirements. Set security standards for AI development tools, generated code and AI components in products. Integrate security testing into development and delivery workflows, including static and dynamic analysis, dependency scanning, secrets detection and AI scanning. Evaluate tools and validate their findings. Help engineers prevent recurring vulnerabilities through secure coding guidance, reusable libraries, training and the security champions programme. Vulnerability management and external testing Own application vulnerability assessment, triage, prioritisation and remediation tracking within the organisation’s vulnerability management framework. Correlate findings across clients, services and supporting infrastructure with the relevant owners to assess combined impact. Ensure findings have clear owners and deadlines, verify fixes and escalate overdue risks. Set the scope and proposed investment for bug bounty, penetration testing and AI security scanning based on risk and results. Manage external providers, researcher relationships, rewards and payouts, and coordinate vulnerability disclosure. Assurance and incident support Provide evidence of application security controls for audits and assurance reviews, and support customer and partner due diligence. Provide application security expertise during incidents, including vulnerability analysis and remediation support. Qualifications Required : At least eight years in application security or software engineering with a security focus, including two years leading people. Strong practical code review skills in TypeScript/JavaScript, Go or Solidity across browser extensions, mobile applications and backend services, with the ability to identify vulnerabilities and work with engineers to fix them. Proven experience securing applications across clients and backend services, including distributed authentication, authorisation and key management. Experience building or substantially improving an AppSec programme, including security reviews, automated testing, AI scanning, vulnerability management and developer support, with sound judgement on where AI adds value and how to validate its findings. Practical experience securing software supply chains, including dependency policies, software composition analysis, npm, artefact integrity and CI/CD. Experience running bug bounty and penetration testing programmes, including selecting and managing external providers. Working knowledge of EVM smart contract security, including common vulnerabilities, review methods, upgrade and admin controls, and assessing external audits. A record of delivering security improvements through engineering teams outside your reporting line. Clear written communication, from actionable threat models to concise summaries of risk for executives. Preferred : Offensive security qualifications such as OSCP, OSWE or OSWA, or a proven record in bug bounty programmes or CTF competitions. Experience securing browser extensions or mobile applications. Experience securing development workflows that use AI, or AI components in production applications. Experience in crypto, Web3 or another sector facing sustained attacks, such as fintech, payments or infrastructure. Knowledge of or a strong interest in applied cryptography. Familiarity with attacks by state actors against software companies, particularly DPRK supply chain and social engineering campaigns. Experience providing evidence of secure development controls for SOC 2 or ISO 27001 assessments. Don't meet all the requirements? Don't sweat it. We’re passionate about building a diverse team of humans and as such, if you think you've got what it takes for our chaotic-but-fun, remote-friendly, start-up environment—apply anyway, detailing your relevant transferable skills in your cover letter. While we have a pretty good idea of what we need, we're ready for you to challenge our thinking on who needs to be in this role. In the rapidly evolving Web3 space, we believe that everyone is a builder. This expansive paradigm requires a range of backgrounds, talents, skills, and experiences to influence and shape the future. At MetaMask, this diversity fuels our ability to shift control and redefine the realm of possibility. We are committed to ensuring that our technology empowers people and communities through decentralized technologies. We welcome the range of perspectives and differences and celebrate them. We're excited to see how your unique skills as a builder can contribute to our vision, drive innovation, and help us shape a more inclusive Web3. MetaMask is an equal opportunity employer. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, genetic information, religion, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital status, family status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. MetaMask may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of our recruitment process, such as reviewing applications, screening resumes, or conducting initial candidate assessments. These tools are designed to assist our recruiting team and improve efficiency — they do not replace human judgment. A human recruiter or hiring manager reviews every candidate, and all final hiring decisions are made by people, not AI. description: About the company At Nuitée , we are building the API backbone for the global travel industry. Founded in 2017, Nuitée is on a mission to transform a fragmented travel ecosystem with simple, scalable, and API-first infrastructure—think “Stripe for Travel.” By enabling seamless connectivity between hotels, OTAs, fintechs, super-apps, and businesses, some of which are entering the travel market for the first time, Nuitée empowers companies to deliver reliable travel products effortlessly. Now backed by leading VCs and world-class investors including leaders from , Stripe, and Shopify, Nuitée is positioned to redefine the B2B travel market, streamline operations for hotels, and enable new applications through cutting-edge APIs. Nuitée is at the forefront of a revolution—delivering AI-powered, smarter, and more personalized travel experiences for a new era. About the role Remote in EMEA, or hybrid in Barcelona. You'll decide how a category-defining travel company tells its story. Nuitée powers hotel booking for some of the biggest names in travel and fintech. The product and our partnerships have driven that growth, and the next step is telling the story at the scale the business has reached. You'll own Nuitée 's external voice end to end: brand, PR, events, and social. It starts with one story that works for both sides of our marketplace: the travel and fintech companies that distribute hotels, and the hotels themselves. Then you get that story in front of the right people, consistently. Marketing at Nuitée is a growth engine. Every story, announcement, and event should help open doors and drive revenue. You'll set the direction and get hands-on with the work, seeing your ideas through from first draft to launch. What you'll own: Brand & Creative Direction Own Nuitée 's positioning, narrative, and visual identity, and make sure the brand feels consistent and distinctive at every touchpoint. Build one story that resonates with travel platforms, fintechs, and hotels alike, and strengthen Nuitée 's reputation with hotels and supply partners. Set the creative direction for launches, campaigns, events, and presentations, and shape design work directly. PR & Communications Own PR end to end, from partner announcements and press releases to executive talking points and thought leadership. Build relationships with travel, tech, and business media, and plan the outlets and partnerships that matter each quarter. Events & Experiences Build the events calendar with Sales: where Nuitée shows up across travel, tech, fintech, and AI, and how. Lead the concept, branding, and execution of events, from sponsorships to our own dinners and activations. Turn events into relationships and pipeline, and measure what each one delivers.
