Turn product launches, partnerships, and company milestones into stories, and help leaders and teams share them. Make complex infrastructure, APIs, and AI innovation simple and memorable. Digital Brand Own the brand experience across the website and key digital surfaces, working with Product and Growth. Build pages, assets, and content yourself, using AI tools to move fast. Building the Function Set up brand guidelines, templates, and processes so everyone at Nuitée tells the same story. Work with freelancers and partners where needed, and grow the function as it proves its impact Nuitée has grown 10x since 2022, was profitable before raising a $48M Series A led by Accel, and works with companies such as Revolut, Grab, Hopper, and Priceline. Telling that story well, to the right audiences, is now a priority for the business. This role fits if you: Have 6–8+ years across marketing, PR, communications, or events, building the brand of a fast-growing tech, SaaS, fintech, or travel-tech company. Can turn complex technical products into simple, compelling stories, and take them all the way to high-quality execution. Have led PR and media relations, including sensitive partner announcements, and are comfortable representing a company externally alongside senior leaders. Have created and delivered industry events, launches, or brand activations. Have a strong eye for design. You can direct creative work and build assets, pages, and content yourself, using AI tools to move faster. Are equally comfortable setting strategy and executing hands-on in a fast-moving environment. Bonus if you have travel industry experience, especially with hotels, hotel tech, or distribution, or an existing network across travel media and industry events. Nuitée moves quickly, keeps things simple, and gives people a lot of ownership. You’ll do well here if you’re comfortable making decisions, prefer shipping and learning over long planning cycles, and enjoy seeing your ideas go live within days. If this sounds like your kind of role, we'd love to hear from you. You can apply with your LinkedIn profile or CV. The process is straightforward and typically takes 2–3 weeks. Why Nuitee? At Nuitée , we’re not just reimagining travel—we’re building the infrastructure to power it. Massive Market Opportunity: We are tackling the $9.9tn travel industry, starting with the $75 billion B2B hotel market, a fragmented space filled with outdated systems, gatekeepers, and inefficiencies. Nuitée ’s API-first platform is solving this, enabling businesses to access hotel inventory seamlessly and at scale. World-Class Backing: Backed by Accel and visionary leaders across tech and travel—including Booking.com, Stripe, and Shopify—we’re equipped to scale our ambition globally. Bootstrapped Resilience, Startup Agility: Having grown profitably for years without external funding, we combine operational discipline with the speed and innovation of a scaling startup. Global Impact: Our infrastructure supports partners like Google, Grab, worldwide fintechs, superapps, travel companies and others AI-Driven Innovation: Nuitée is uniquely positioned to power the future of travel in the AI era—enabling seamless, intelligent, and hyper-personalized travel interactions. By joining Nuitée , you’ll be part of a team that’s building a category-defining platform. You’ll work on a global scale, innovate alongside industry leaders, and help drive the next phase of travel technology. If you’re excited to push boundaries, redefine a multi-trillion-dollar industry, and grow with us— Nuitée is the place for you. It combines the day-to-day program delivery ownership of the Program Lead with the candidate-facing and supplier-facing rigor of the Senior Talent Consultant, wrapped in a strategic Business Partner lens toward the client’s Customer Success organization. You will be empowered to build senior stakeholder relationships, proactively identify new business opportunities within the account, lead a confident commercial talk track, and deliver flawless operations in conjunction with the Client Sponsor, Service Delivery team, and Shared Back-Office Services team. We are looking for an experienced MSP professional with incredibly high integrity, an inquisitive mind, strong commercial instincts, and a passion for operational and customer service excellence. Commitment to our culture, values, and behaviors: Achievement of the position objectives and key responsibilities is attained by: Fostering collaboration and building strong connections that drive Impellam’s strategy and initiatives forward. Championing respect and inclusion, ensuring every interaction reflects our commitment to equal opportunity and a positive workplace culture. Acting responsibly and with integrity, prioritizing the safety and well-being of yourself, others, the environment and our company. Key responsibilities: Commercial Ownership, Customer Success & Business Partnership – your top priority is building relationships and driving measurable commercial impact across the client account: Commercial Ownership – protect, grow, and defend the account by identifying opportunities to increase spend, monetization, program adoption, and overall account value. Business Development – proactively hunt for new opportunities within the account, including new departments, hiring managers, labor categories, service lines, and areas of unmanaged or under-penetrated spend. Senior Relationship Management – build and maintain trusted relationships with senior and executive client leaders, carrying a confident commercial talk track that connects program performance to business outcomes. Customer Success Business Partnering – act as a proactive Business Partner to the client’s Customer Success, HR, Procurement, and Hiring Manager stakeholders, translating program data into practical insight, recommendations, and growth opportunities. Client Relationship & Satisfaction Management – develop and maintain business relationships with key client stakeholders and hiring managers, ensuring the program is positioned as a strategic solution rather than a transactional delivery function. Commercial Thought Leadership – be viewed as a subject matter expert to the client; provide ongoing training, education, and market insight for HR, Procurement, Customer Success, and Hiring Manager stakeholders. Communication – support delivery of relevant corporate, client, and team communications, ensuring messaging reinforces account growth, program value, and stakeholder alignment. Issue Resolution – ongoing management and resolution of program, team, and people issues that may impact client satisfaction, account health, or commercial momentum. Commercial Rhythm, Pipeline & Business Reviews: Pipeline Management – maintain visibility to active and future account opportunities, tracking progress, barriers, next steps, and stakeholder engagement required to convert growth opportunities. Forecasting & Target Management – support account forecasting against growth, spend, utilization, and program expansion targets, using data to identify risks and opportunities early. QBRs & Business Reviews – own or support the regular client business review cadence, preparing clear insights on program performance, value delivered, pipeline, market trends, and recommended actions. Program Management: Day-to-Day Operations – work closely with the Service Delivery and back-office teams to ensure that day-to-day client requirements are being met; ensure SLA/KPI compliance is met at all levels. Supplier/Vendor Operations – actively manage the reporting and KPIs to ensure supplier performance for appropriate job category coverage, response timing and candidate quality, ongoing supplier rationalization and optimization. Escalation Management – proactively identify and successfully manage through day-to-day issues that impact program performance and client satisfaction levels, escalating to the Program Leader as needed. VMS Management – build a strong relationship with the VMS Supplier to ensure system performance meets customer expectations. Experienced with Business Intelligence Tools – Power BI preferred. Billing, Reporting & Analytics: Ensure accurate and timely billing, reporting, and ongoing analysis, including scheduled and ad hoc requests; prepare weekly and monthly status reports on program activity, account health, pipeline, and issues. Project Management – support the management and implementation of program/project modifications and enhancements. Continuous Improvement – use experience, data, and analytics to drive improvements in program process, utilization, satisfaction, and commercial performance. Workplace Health, Safety, and Environmental Compliance: At Impellam, it is our moral obligation to safeguard each other, our customers, our temporary workforce and the environment by operating an injury-free, healthy workplace that minimizes our environmental impact. Impellam is committed to providing a safe and secure working environment for all employees and promoting best practices. You will meet our HSE obligations by committing to: Seek to prevent injury to any employee, customer, worker, or contractor. Actively participating and completing compliance training as required. Consider the safety implications of decisions. Work experience and attributes: Essential: Knowledge of: Staffing Industry, Managed Service Provider (MSP), Vendor Management Systems (VMS), Procurement, Statement of Work (SOW), Human Resources (HR). Experience leading teams to meet service level agreements and key performance indicators relevant for MSP business performance; strong experience, and detailed orientation, in report development, management, and QA. Experience in identifying and leading initiatives for process improvement. Project Management experience. Effective communication, presentation, time management, organization, and planning techniques. MS Excel and MS PowerPoint. Experienced with Business Intelligence tools and driving decisions using analytics. Commercial account management disciplines, including pipeline management, forecasting, QBR/business-review preparation, stakeholder mapping, and growth planning. Modern sales technology and CRM platforms, including Salesforce or Microsoft Dynamics, and tools such as ZoomInfo, Outreach, Gong, Highspot, or similar enablement and intelligence platforms. Ability to: Demonstrate a track record of growing and maturing client relationships. Demonstrate fiscal responsibility for account management. Manage by influence. Demonstrate excellent communication. Problem solves and present conceptual information to all levels of internal and external management. Initiate, recommend, or provide solutions through designated channels. Build and execute project plans. Manage data collection and reports for regular and ad hoc reporting needs. Core Competencies: Passion for excellence. Stress tolerance and ability to thrive in a dynamic environment. High level of attention to detail. Proactive approach to supporting a team and client partnership. Urgency and speed of response. High level of dedication and accountability. Minimum of 3 years of experience as part of a Managed Service Program or Staffing management environment. General Understanding of: MSP / Human Capital / Staffing. Human Resources. Procurement. title: Freelance Creative / Content Lead – DTC e-commerce launch
description: Voor de launch van een nieuw direct-to-consumer consumer brand zoeken we een ervaren freelance Creative / Content Lead die tijdelijk de overkoepelende regie pakt over de content en productpresentatie. De belangrijkste uitvoerende disciplines worden afzonderlijk geselecteerd: fotografie; video; 3D / CGI / motion; copy; Shopify design/development. We zoeken daarom nadrukkelijk geen full-service bureau en ook niet iemand die alles zelf moet produceren . De opdracht is juist om ervoor te zorgen dat al deze disciplines vanuit één duidelijke commerciële en visuele lijn samenwerken. Er ligt inmiddels al veel: positionering en productpropositie; uitgebreide benchmark van directe DTC-concurrenten; PDP/content-blueprint; eerste commerciële copy; uitgewerkte richting voor fotografie, video en 3D/CGI. De opdracht begint dus niet bij een blanco vel. Wat we zoeken Iemand die: de bestaande PDP/contentstrategie kritisch kan challengen en aanscherpen; begrijpt welke boodschap waar op een e-commerce productpagina moet landen; fotografie, video, CGI, copy en Shopify inhoudelijk bij elkaar brengt; behandelingen, shotlists, CGI-briefings en copy kan beoordelen; bewaakt dat verschillende partijen geen dubbel of overbodig werk produceren; mee kan kijken bij assetselectie en postproductie; en vóór livegang de uiteindelijke Shopify-PDP kritisch beoordeelt op verhaal, content, UX en conversie. Profiel We zoeken iemand met aantoonbare ervaring in: DTC / e-commerce; Shopify of vergelijkbare e-commerceomgevingen; PDP / CRO; contentproductie; creative direction / art direction / content strategy. Ervaring met consumer products, lifestyle, interieur, bedding of vergelijkbare categorieën is een pre. Belangrijker dan functietitel is dat je zowel commercieel, creatief als productioneel kunt denken. Opzet Het gaat om een compacte freelance opdracht van enkele senior dagen verspreid over het traject richting launch eind dit jaar. We zoeken iemand die zelfstandig werkt, snel door bestaande documentatie heen kan en comfortabel is in het aansturen/challengen van andere senior specialisten. Reageren Stuur graag: korte introductie; beschikbaarheid; indicatief dagtarief; en vooral 2–3 relevante DTC/e-commerce/PDP-cases waar jouw rol duidelijk uit blijkt. Originally posted on Himalayas

title: Global Travel Retail Director (H/F)
description: Depuis plus de 40 ans, Gérard Bertrand fait rayonner les grands vins du Sud de la France à travers le monde. Votre mission Directement rattaché(e) à la Direction EXPORT, vous définissez et déployez la stratégie mondiale Travel Retail. Vous êtes responsable de la croissance, de la rentabilité et du rayonnement international de cette activité. Vous construisez une vision à long terme, développez les partenariats stratégiques et faites émerger de nouvelles opportunités sur les principaux hubs internationaux. Vos responsabilités Définir la stratégie mondiale Élaborer et piloter la stratégie internationale Travel Retail Définir les objectifs de croissance et les priorités de développement Construire le plan de développement à moyen et long terme Identifier les marchés, hubs et segments les plus prometteurs Assurer le pilotage budgétaire et le suivi de la performance Créer et renforcer des relations privilégiées avec les principaux acteurs mondiaux du secteur : les principaux opérateurs de croisières les compagnies aériennes internationales les distributeurs spécialisés Travel Retail Construire des partenariats stratégiques Négocier les accords commerciaux internationaux Développer des plans de croissance communs avec les partenaires Optimiser la distribution, les assortiments et la visibilité des marques Identifier les opportunités d'innovation commerciale Développer des éditions exclusives et des concepts dédiés au Travel Retail Porter l'image de Gérard Bertrand En collaboration avec les équipes Marketing et Export, vous imaginez des expériences de marque différenciantes : lancements internationaux activations premium éditions exclusives animations commerciales dispositifs de visibilité dans les principaux aéroports internationaux Piloter la performance Développer durablement le chiffre d'affaires et la rentabilité Suivre les indicateurs de performance Construire les prévisions de ventes Identifier les leviers de croissance Présenter les résultats et recommandations auprès de la Direction Générale Requirements Vous êtes aujourd'hui reconnu(e) comme un expert du Travel Retail international. Vous connaissez les décideurs du marché. Vous comprenez les attentes des grands opérateurs mondiaux. Vous savez ouvrir des portes, construire des partenariats durables et développer des marques premium à l'échelle internationale. Vous justifiez notamment de : plus de 5 années d'expérience dans le développement international ; une expérience significative dans le Travel Retail mondial ; une excellente connaissance des secteurs des vins & spiritueux, du luxe ou des produits premium ; un réseau établi auprès des principaux opérateurs internationaux ; une expérience confirmée dans la négociation d'accords internationaux ; une forte culture du résultat et du développement commercial ; une vision stratégique alliée à une grande capacité d'exécution. Une certification WSET ou une excellente connaissance des vins constitue un véritable atout. Originally posted on Himalayas

title: Initiativbewerbung
description: Überraschend überzeugend! Mit einer klaren Vorstellung oder einer besonderen Qualifikation musst du nicht auf eine passende Stellenausschreibung warten. Ergreife selbst die Initiative und schick uns deine Bewerbung auf deine Wunschposition – selbst wenn die Stellenbeschreibung nicht zu 100 % passt. Auch Berufsanfänger*innen sind bei uns herzlich Willkommen. Bei deiner Bewerbung solltest du uns bestenfalls ein genaues Bild davon geben, welche Fähigkeiten und Qualifikationen du hast und in welchem Arbeitsbereich oder welcher Fachabteilung du das Paragon-Team bereichern möchtest. Requirements Wir haben aktuell nicht die passende Stelle für dich online? Dann bewirb dich doch gerne initiativ bei uns! Dazu sind zunächst nur dein Lebenslauf und Anschreiben notwendig. Dabei gibst du bestenfalls auch gleich deine Wünsche und Vorstellungen im Hinblick auf Stundenumfang, Arbeitsort und Arbeitsfeld an. Das hilft uns dabei, deine Initiativbewerbung besser zuordnen und für passende Stellen prüfen zu können. Haben wir aktuell keine passende Stelle für dich, heißt das noch lange nicht, dass der Prozess damit beendet sein muss. Gerne nehmen wir dich in unseren internen Bewerberpool auf und kontaktieren dich, sobald wir eine neue Stelle haben, die für dich passen könnte. Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung mit deinem Lebenslauf, den Rahmenbedingungen (gewünschtes Arbeitszeitmodell, Gehaltsvorstellung sowie frühestmögliche Verfügbarkeit) und Angaben zu deiner gewünschten Tätigkeit! description: At R2 , we believe that small and medium businesses are the productive engine of society. Small and medium businesses (SMBs) make up over 90% of companies in Latin America, yet they face a trillion-dollar credit gap. Our mission is to unlock SMBs' potential by providing financial solutions that are tailored to their needs. We are reimagining the financial infrastructure of Latin America, where SMBs' financial needs are satisfied without ever having to go to a bank. R2 enables platforms to embed financial services that SMBs can then leverage, starting with revenue-based financing. We are a tight-knit team coming from organizations such as Google, Amazon, Nubank, Uber, Capital One, Mercado Libre, Globant and J.P. Morgan. We are entering a new phase of growth following a strategic investment from Ant International, focused on rapidly expanding our partner footprint, strengthening our credit and underwriting capabilities, and scaling operations across multiple markets. As part of this growth journey, eligible team members have the opportunity to participate in R2 ’s Phantom Share Program, a performance-based incentive designed to align our team with the company’s long-term success and value creation. We believe in building a culture of ownership, where those who help create value share meaningfully in it. As Data Engineering Tech Lead, you will be the senior technical authority for R2 's data platform and the day-to-day leader of the Data Engineering team. You will report to the Director of Data Management. You will own the architecture, technical roadmap, tooling and vendor decisions, reliability and cost of the platform behind ingestion, data processing, underwriting and our enterprise data warehouse. The role evolves in three stages: Lead by influence. A hands-on lead engineer who sets technical direction and standards. Run the team. Own planning, prioritization and delivery for the Data Engineering team day to day. Manage people. Take on direct management of some of our Senior Data Engineers. As we expand from Latin America into Europe, including a fully isolated EU data platform, you will shape how our data architecture scales across countries, legal entities and regulatory regimes. What you will do Architecture and technical direction Own the target architecture of the data platform, including ingestion, cleaning, processing, the warehouse, Airflow orchestration and the data flows behind underwriting. Lead architecture decisions together with the Director of Data, and set the principles the team designs against. Define and own the Data Engineering technical roadmap, balancing business priorities, platform health and tech debt. Lead tool and vendor evaluation, selection and contract input. Design a multi-country, multi-entity platform, including a fully isolated EU data platform and the data residency rules around it. Stay hands-on in the most critical and complex parts of the stack: Snowflake, Airflow DAGs, dbt and Python. Reliability, operations and cost Own the reliability, observability and SLAs of production pipelines. Design the on-call rotation, incident response process and post-mortem practice. Own Snowflake spend, including warehouse sizing, usage monitoring, budgets and cost-optimization practices. Define and enforce engineering standards for modeling, testing, CI/CD, documentation and code review. Introduce AI-enabled tooling and agents where they measurably improve productivity or data operations. Team leadership and delivery Run the Data Engineering team day to day: planning, prioritization, delivery cadence and unblocking. Project-manage data initiatives end to end: scope, estimates, plans, tracking, and clear communication of risks and trade-offs to stakeholders. Mentor and grow Senior Data Engineers through design reviews, code reviews and regular feedback. Take part in hiring, onboarding and shaping the team's structure as it grows. Progressively take on people management for part of the team, including 1:1s, performance and career development. Partner with Analytics, Product, Risk and Credit, ML, Engineering and Compliance to turn business needs into platform work. Data governance, security and compliance Co-own data governance with the Director of Data, covering data quality, lineage, cataloging and access control. Design how PII is handled across the platform, including classification, masking, encryption, Snowflake role-based access, retention and deletion. Make sure the platform meets regulatory and audit requirements, including GDPR in Europe, LGPD in Brazil, central bank and local regulatory reporting, and investor and partner requirements such as Ant International's. Translate regulatory requirements into technical controls, evidence and documentation that hold up in an audit. Who you are 8–12+ years in Data Engineering or closely related roles. Prior experience as a Principal or Staff Data Engineer, or as Tech Lead of a team of 4 or more engineers. Proven team leadership and project management. You have run a team's delivery, led multi-quarter initiatives and managed stakeholders end to end. Deep, hands-on production experience with Snowflake, including architecture, performance tuning, cost management and role-based security. This is required. Advanced experience with Airflow and dbt in production. Strong software engineering background with deep Python expertise, plus advanced SQL and dimensional / analytical data modeling. Hands-on experience with ELT patterns and tools such as Airbyte or Fivetran. Experience running data platforms on AWS. Experience building or operating data platforms across multiple countries, legal entities or regulatory regimes. This is required. Practical experience applying privacy and data protection regulations such as GDPR or LGPD, and building governance controls for PII. Comfortable owning systems in production, including monitoring, alerting and incident response. Able to explain technical trade-offs clearly to leadership and to Risk, Product and Compliance partners. Professional English, plus Spanish or Portuguese. Snowflake is a hard requirement. Profiles centered on Databricks or BigQuery without significant production Snowflake experience will not be a fit. Bonus Experience in fintech, lending, credit risk or underwriting data. Experience standing up a data platform in the EU, or an isolated regional platform with strict data residency. Experience with data catalog, lineage or data contract tooling. Experience integrating AI/ML tooling or agents into data workflows, or building feature pipelines for ML models. Experience designing self-serve analytics platforms. Experience with cloud data cost management (FinOps) at scale. What We Offer The chance to join a high-impact, mission-driven fintech. Ownership and impact in a fast-paced, growth-oriented startup. Cross-functional collaboration with exceptional teams. Exposure to complex regulatory challenges and innovation in embedded finance. Locations: Buenos Aires, São Paulo, Bogotá, Santiago, Bogotá Originally posted on Himalayas

description: Verian is an independent research, evidence, evaluation, and communications agency that helps governments solve public policy challenges by working with citizens and the public realm. The surveys you help build will directly inform public policy decisions across the continent. The core of the role is the craft itself: building and testing surveys that work reliably, in a fast-paced delivery environment where accuracy and quality matter every day. At the same time, Verian is investing heavily in automation and AI-assisted approaches to survey scripting, and you will be part of that journey from the start - working alongside the engineers building these solutions, and learning skills in automation and AI-assisted workflows that very few scripting roles anywhere can offer. description: Cabot Corporation (NYSE: CBT) is a leading global specialty chemicals and performance materials company headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts, USA. Our businesses deliver a broad range of products and solutions to customers in every corner of the globe, serving the transportation, infrastructure, environment and consumer industry sectors. We bring the power of innovative chemistry to solve customers' challenges today while preparing them to meet tomorrow’s needs. Our commitment to innovation is driven by a passion to advance our customers' businesses through our deep understanding of their applications and the global trends that impact their operations. If you do not meet every requirement, or your experience is slightly different that what we have listed, we still encourage you to apply! Your Role at Cabot Provides commercial leadership for large, complex accounts of Cabot’s inkjet colorants business in EMEA. Plans and implements sales to major global accounts, developing and maintaining relationships, identifying opportunities, and managing overall account activities. This includes aligning customer needs with the company’s inkjet technology offerings and capabilities, ensuring long-term value creation. The Account Manager will work closely with the Sales Administration and Technical Service Manager in their region while reporting directly to the global Director of Business Development and Key Accounts. This is a remote position, and we are open to candidates based at one of Cabot's European locations. How You Will Make an Impact Develop and implement regional account strategies using a broad understanding of Cabot’s services and technologies for the inkjet printing industry. Negotiates and administers customer contracts to maximize profitability. Provides commercial leadership for global accounts and strategic customers and coordinates specific marketing, manufacturing, capital investments and quality actions related to these accounts to meet customer’s needs. Expand Cabot's market presence by proactively pursuing new business opportunities and converting prospects into long-term customer partnerships. Identify emerging market trends and customer needs, translating them into actionable business opportunities for Cabot's inkjet colorant portfolio Drive both current and future value for Cabot by building a shared understanding of the individual customer and overall portfolio profitability and focus on where Cabot can differentiate itself at the interface with the customer. Develops broad contacts throughout the customer’s organization. Maintains customer profiles for competitive analysis. Represents accounts internally and externally to the highest professional standards. Understands and responds to customer needs for existing and new products (i.e. pricing, product availability and quality). Communicates customer goals and objectives with other businesses and plants. Facilitates, coordinates and manages Cabot communications with the customer. Collaborate with technical, marketing, and product development teams to create compelling value propositions that win new business and strengthen customer loyalty Monitors competitive activity in each account and ensures that appropriate response strategies are formulated Monitors accounts receivable to meet corporate initiatives and handles occasional account escalations. Assists in developing the business case for key customer programs such as continuous improvement, quality, new product service initiatives and capital investments. Provides business perspective to management of accounts via weekly reports, volume reports and price index. Consistent use of Salesforce.com for maintaining up to date “living documents” and contain the ComStrat, Balance of Power and ENS negotiations preparation documents. What You Will Bring to Cabot Technical Excellence. Knowledgeable about Cabot’s technical capabilities in the inkjet market, the applications in which they perform and how they complement performance in the customers’ applications. Strong knowledge of the inkjet value chain, including printhead technologies, ink manufacturers and OEMs. Commercial Skills . Knowledgeable of the inkjet markets and applications in which our products add value, and able to effectively capture the value. Proven ability to identify and convert new business opportunities while expanding existing customer relationships. Communications & Presentation Skills . Ability to effectively engage in verbal and written communications and presentation that are timely, direct, concise, clear and relevant and delivered with appropriate style and tone and influencing skills at executive, commercial, and technical levels. Customer Relationship Management. Establishes and maintains appropriate relationships with customers to enable execution of Cabot’s strategic goals; sees the management of the overall customer relationship as a key component of the role. Results Driven . Takes ownership and responsibility for achieving a desired result. Planning, organizing, prioritizing and monitoring to ensure the attainment of business objectives. Business Savvy . Knowledgeable about all functional elements that are important for business profitability. Strong financial and business acumen, including forecasting, implementing pricing strategy, and contract management. New Opportunity Advancement . Ability to utilize knowledge of Cabot’s capabilities to develop, recognize and advance opportunities where Cabot can provide solutions to customer needs and obtain new business. Experience supporting strategic customers through qualification, commercialization, and scale-up of new inkjet products and platforms. Creative Problem Solving. Apply analytical thinking to identify potential solutions to problems; is able to be innovative in identifying new solutions. Travel. Willingness to travel internationally as required (50%+). Education/Experience Bachelor/University degree in a Technical field or Business. Strong understanding of all aspects of the inkjet printing industry with a solid track record of successfully selling consumables into this industry or similar Technical and commercial experience with water-based inkjet colorant dispersions and ink formulation is preferred Minimum seven years experience in complex customer account management. At Cabot, we bring the power of innovative chemistry and a spirit of partnership with our customers to advance solutions that will enable a sustainable future. Our strength in research and development is a major reason why we have been an industry leader for more than 135 years in products such as reinforcing and specialty carbons, battery materials, aerogel, fumed metal oxides, inkjet colorants, masterbatches and conductive compounds. Our employees around the world are united by our shared purpose: Creating materials that improve daily life and enable a more sustainable future. Through our corporate strategy, “Creating for Tomorrow,” we are focused on our core strengths to lead in performance and sustainability – today and into the future. Originally posted on Himalayas

description: Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing. This is an exciting opportunity for a software engineer passionate about open source software, Linux, and web services at scale. Come build a rewarding, meaningful career working with the best and brightest people in technology at Canonical , a growing pre-IPO international software company. Canonical ’s engineering team is at the forefront of the IoT revolution and aims to strengthen this position by developing cutting-edge telemetry and connectivity solutions. By integrating reliable, secure, and robust data streaming capabilities into the Snappy ecosystem, we are setting new standards in the industry for ease of development, implementation, management and security. We are seeking talented individuals to help us enhance our global SaaS services, providing customers with the essential data services needed to build the next generation of IoT devices effortlessly. Our commitment to data governance, ownership, and confidentiality is unparalleled, ensuring our customers can innovate with confidence on top of the globally trusted Ubuntu platform. Location: This role will be based remotely in the EMEA region. What your day will look like Work remotely with a globally distributed team, driving technical excellence and fostering innovation across diverse engineering environments. Design, architect, and build high-performance APIs to power streaming data services, ensuring seamless integration across teams and products using Python and Go. Develop robust governance, auditing, and management systems within our advanced telemetry platform, ensuring security, compliance, and operational integrity. Partner with our infrastructure team to build scalable cloud-based SaaS solutions while also delivering containerized on-prem deployments for enterprise customers. Lead the design, implementation, and optimization of new features, taking projects from specification to production, ensuring operational excellence at scale. Provide technical oversight, review code and designs, and set best practices to maintain engineering excellence. Engage in high-level technical discussions, collaborating on optimal solutions with engineers, product teams, and stakeholders. Work remotely with occasional global travel (2-4 weeks per year) for internal and external events, fostering deeper collaboration and knowledge-sharing. What we are looking for in you You design and architect scalable backend services, messaging/data pipelines, and REST APIs using Go or Python, guiding best practices, technical direction, and system scalability. You possess deep expertise in cybersecurity principles and proactively address the complex challenges of IoT environments: secure connectivity, data streaming, governance, and compliance. You bring proven expertise in designing and optimizing systems using: IAM models, encryption, access control, and compliance frameworks (GDPR, HIPAA) to ensure secure and compliant data handling Ability to design decentralized data ownership models, ensuring interoperability and governance across domains Designing high-throughput, low-latency systems for IoT data processing Data streaming technologies (MQTT, Kafka, RabbitMQ) Observability tools (OpenTelemetry) Industrial/engineering data exchange protocols (OPC-UA, ModBus) You thrive in cross-functional environments, partnering with product teams, engineers, and stakeholders to drive high-impact technical solutions that align with business objectives. You mentor junior engineers, foster technical excellence, and contribute to a culture of innovation, continuous improvement, and knowledge sharing. You embrace challenges with an open mind, continuously seeking opportunities to learn, improve, and innovate in a rapidly evolving IoT landscape. You are familiar with Ubuntu as a development and deployment platform. You hold a Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM, or a related field. You are willing to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events. What we offer colleagues We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally. Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year Annual compensation review Recognition rewards Annual holiday leave Maternity and paternity leave Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events About Canonical Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical is an equal opportunity employer We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration. description: Who we are Properstar connects real estate buyers, renters, and agents, here and everywhere. Buyers and renters find their next home with us, locally or across borders. Agents reach them in countries they couldn't otherwise sell into, in languages they don't speak. Our Product & Marketing department grows the brand and our footprint. Small team, no fluff. We acquire new users, nurture them, qualify them, and turn them into customers. We believe in a new way of working, where AI is fundamental: you direct, you don't execute. About the job You own B2B growth end to end. Our database holds some 140,000 real estate agency offices and 640,000 agents. You turn more of them into active, engaged and paying users. AI does the heavy lifting, you steer it. Three targets: B2B revenue, monthly active users, and mobile adoption. That means real segmentation, not the same email sent to everyone. A solo agent in Lisbon and a 40-office network in Madrid don't need the same message. You get agents onto the app, push self-serve purchases through the dashboard, design offers that convert, and use content and every relevant channel to move them along. 2027 is the year we build and test the engine. 2028 is the year we scale it. You set the strategy and you run it. You own the budget, get hands-on when needed, and lead the people who help you execute. You report to the CPO. What you'll do Set the B2B growth strategy. Segments, markets, channels, offers, budget. Defend every euro with numbers. Segment the base for real. Office size, market, plan, activity, behavior. Each segment gets its own path. Own the agency lifecycle. Onboarding, activation, engagement, upgrade, retention, win-back. Find where agents drop and fix it. Drive self-serve revenue. Push purchases through the dashboard. Upgrade flows, trials, pricing pages, checkout. Less sales touch, more conversion. Design offers that convert. Plans, bundles, promotions, timing. Test them. Kill the losers. Make the app the agent's daily tool. Installs, adoption, weekly use. Move agents from desktop to mobile and keep them there. Grow monthly active users. Give agents reasons to come back. Leads, insights, alerts, content. Use every relevant channel. Email, push, in-app, content, webinars, paid, partnerships. Pick by segment, not by habit. Run experiments. Onboarding, messaging, offers, pricing. Fast cycles, clear reads. Work with sales and customer success. Self-serve for the long tail, humans for the big accounts. Hand them the right accounts at the right time. Work with product. Push for what moves activation and conversion. Bring evidence, not opinions. Lead the people who execute. Set their goals, review the work, raise the bar. Build the playbooks as Claude skills, so the team and the agents can run them. Talk to agents. Read the data yourself. What we're looking for B2B growth track record. You've grown a B2B or SMB product with thousands of customers, largely self-serve. Real numbers, real graph. Show us. SaaS for small businesses, marketplace, or portal experience is a strong plus. Real estate is a bonus, not a requirement. Lifecycle and segmentation. You think in cohorts, segments, and lifecycles, not campaigns. The cheapest customer is the one already in your database. Self-serve monetization. You've moved users from free to paid through the product. You know your activation, conversion, expansion, and churn by segment. Multichannel range. You've owned several channels and have strong opinions on the rest. Single-channel specialists won't fit. Mobile adoption. You've driven app adoption with a professional audience. You know what makes a busy agent open an app twice. Product sense. You know how product changes move conversion. You bring PMs and designers evidence, not opinions. Strategist and operator. You build the plan and you run it. You've owned a budget and answered for the return. You set up the flow and pull the numbers yourself. No agency in between. Deep AI fluency. Claude is your daily driver, in Cowork and Code. You've built skills and orchestrated agents. Tell us what you automated this month. "Open to AI" doesn't pass the bar. Data and judgment. You measure what works and kill what doesn't. You also decide without waiting for the perfect test. Ownership. Brief to result. No handoffs. Leadership. You make people better and faster without micromanaging them. Clarity. You explain things simply. You don't hide weak results behind charts. Languages. Fluent English. French or Spanish is a plus. What we don't care about Where your degree is from. Bachelor preferred, not required. Track record beats papers. How polished your LinkedIn is. We read what you've shipped. Whether you've worked at a brand we recognize. The best operators we've met came from companies you haven't heard of. Logistics Remote. Anywhere within +/- 3h of CET. Type: Full-time, permanent contractor. Start: January 2027 at the latest. What we offer B2B growth to own end to end. No committees, no hand-holding. 140,000 agency offices and 640,000 agents to activate. A dashboard and an app to grow. Budget to test now, and a bigger one to scale in 2028. The AI stack you'd struggle to build elsewhere. Claude (Cowork and Code), Mixpanel, HubSpot. All paid for. A title with weight. You report to the CPO in a flat hierarchy. Competitive comp aligned with your market. Originally posted on Himalayas

title: Senior Business Analyst (Discovery&Delivery)
description: About the role You will own the entire requirements process on our client projects, and you will be the bridge between the client, the product and the engineering team. This is not a BA role whose main job is documentation. We expect you to run the client communication yourself, lead discovery, shape and challenge requirements, and help design the solution together with the technical team — especially on our AI and fintech projects. You need to be technical enough to speak the same language as developers and architects, and to turn the client’s business need into something the team can actually build. We enter projects two different ways. Often from scratch: no written product definition exists yet, and we author it with the client. Just as often by joining something already in flight: an existing backlog, someone else’s conventions, a deadline already running. Both ask the same thing of you — build the structure where there is none, and take the requirements to the point where a developer can build without guessing. Requirements What you will do: Drive the client communication — you don’t just take part in the meetings, you drive the discussion. Lead discovery and refinement sessions with clients in English — you run them, you don’t take notes at them. Shape and challenge requirements, and help design the solution together with the technical team. Join running projects, map what already exists, and bring the documentation to a consistent, testable state. Write specifications developers can build from: concise, testable acceptance criteria, no duplication, no invented facts. Turn unknowns into open questions with named owners, and chase them down the cheapest route that can answer them. Support scope and ROM estimation with explicit assumptions, dependencies and confidence levels. Use AI as a full working instrument in your analysis, and take part in building AI-enabled solutions — verifying everything it produces before it reaches a client or a developer. What we are looking for: Strong client-facing experience — you have been the person the client talks to, not the person briefed afterwards. Strong fintech / banking expertise — a deep understanding of financial products and processes, integrations and data flows: enough to ask the right questions, spot the risks and challenge what the client asks for. An AI background — experience on projects where AI is part of the product, plus daily use of AI tools in your own analysis work, including a concrete example of catching a wrong AI output. Technical enough to speak the same language as developers and architects. 5+ years as a Business Analyst / Systems Analyst in custom software development, including at least 2 years as the only analyst on a project. Experience of both entries : starting a product from scratch, where the requirements had to be created rather than collected, and joining a project already in flight with documentation you did not write. English B2+ (C1 preferred) — enough to facilitate a workshop with a client, not only to attend one. Discipline in written specifications : testable acceptance criteria, and the judgement to cut what does not belong. Confident daily use of Jira and Confluence ; able to read designs in Figma. The habit of asking the uncomfortable question a second time when the first one was brushed off. Nice to have: Pre-sale experience: scope shaping, assumptions, ROM estimates, proposal input. Domains beyond fintech: healthcare, logistics, renewable energy. BPMN / UML / ERD used as a means of agreement, not as a deliverable for its own sake. Experience mentoring analysts or reviewing other people’s specifications. How we work: One department standard and one quality rubric — your work is measured against the same instrument as everyone else’s, and so is everyone else’s. Decisions have named gates: AI drafts, a human decides, and it is written down who decided. We fight documentation overload as a matter of policy. Shorter and testable beats longer and thorough. What we offer: Long team focus: we create an environment of transparent communication, and minimal bureaucracy, which leads to long-term relationships. Development of niche expertise: we are working in several niches, such as FinTech, healthcare, and logistics. Therefore, our employees can develop their own expertise in these domains. Continuous learning: we create employee development plans / personal roadmaps /quick promotion processes. Internal career development: 80% of our current executives were promoted to those positions within S-PRO . We encourage initiative. If a person wants to set new challenges and grow, we will definitely support them. Benefits and perks: Flexible schedule. Remote work model. Paid vacations. Paid Sick-leaves. Paid State holidays. description: Maybe you call yourself a Senior Data Engineer, a pipeline architect, a "why-is-this-TOS-data-a-mess" specialist… or maybe you just call yourself Sam. Whatever you call yourself, you'll join Terminal.exe, All Your BI 's AI-native data platform for container terminal operators, and build the core of it: the pipelines and data model that turn fragmented, hard-to-trust terminal data into something operators run their day on. What you get A salary between €85,000-€99,000 per year inclusive of holiday allowance, based on your experience. €5,000 a year for your own growth, with a real say in how you spend it. 25 vacation days + the option to buy up to 10 more + local public holidays + the option of a sabbatical up to 4 months. Statutory benefits (pension, health, social security, leave, sick pay, notice) follow the hire's country via their local contract or EOR. About us All Your BI is a remote-first data agency based in Rotterdam. Since 2019 we've grown from a boutique consultancy into an international data team of more than 60 data heroes spread across Europe. We deliver managed BI services for logistics and industrial companies, helping reduce data waste and move businesses forward. We live for the WOW moment, that sparkle in users' eyes when they gain new insights and discover opportunities. We work according to Holacracy: little hierarchy, lots of ownership. Serious work. Serious fun. About Terminal.exe Terminal.exe is All Your BI 's SaaS platform for container terminals. It unifies fragmented data, TOS, maintenance, gate, sensors, into one governed model, so every site works from the same numbers instead of rebuilding its own reporting from scratch. The platform is growing fast. You'll help shape the engineering foundations that need to scale next: multi-tenant data architecture, near-real-time pipelines from 24/7 operations, and a standardized data model that works across terminals worldwide. What the job looks like You will design and build the pipelines that move data from terminal operating systems (such as Navis N4) into our platform, and the transformation layer that turns raw operational data into curated, documented datasets. Concretely, you will work on: ELT pipelines from on-premises terminal databases into our Azure-based platform, with near-real-time refresh (3-minute microbatch) for operational reporting and daily batch for analytics. Extraction uses watermark-based incremental queries over Kafka (Azure Event Hubs) to PostgreSQL staging. A multi-tenant data architecture on Azure PostgreSQL with database-per-tenant isolation and a standardized STG → ODS → DataMart layer structure driven by our internal declarative transformation framework (dewi) Our internal connector tooling written in Go, which you will help develop and extend Data quality monitoring: gap detection, freshness alerting, and reconciliation The standardized terminal data model: mapping source data from different TOS versions and configurations onto shared definitions of moves, calls, and equipment events You will work directly with terminal operations staff, without intermediate layers. Requirements What you bring Attitude and experience: curiosity and a genuine appetite for architectural ownership, and 5+ years of data engineering experience, including end-to-end ownership of production data platforms. This is a product under active development, we need you comfortable deciding, not just executing. Core stack: strong SQL and Python; Go experience is a significant plus (our connectors and consumers are written in Go). Solid experience with SQL Server as a source system and PostgreSQL as a target store. Pipelines and streaming: experience building and operating ELT pipelines against operational source systems, including watermark/incremental or CDC/replica-based extraction, and with event-driven or streaming architectures, we use Azure Event Hubs with a Kafka-compatible endpoint. Cloud and observability: cloud data platform experience on Azure, familiarity with AKS, Azure DevOps CI/CD, and GitOps (Argo CD) is a plus, alongside a strong focus on data correctness and instrumentation, we use OpenTelemetry. Nice to have: knowledge of the container terminal or port logistics industry, direct experience with Navis N4 or another TOS, multi-tenant SaaS data architecture experience, and familiarity with declarative, YAML-driven transformation frameworks. Industry knowledge is a strong plus, not a hard requirement, we'll teach you the terminal domain. We're a growing team across Europe, and we hire to widen that mix, not narrow it. What matters is what you can do and the perspective you bring, not your age, gender, ethnicity, orientation, disability, background, or where you studied. If the role excites you and you bring most of it, apply: the people who add the most rarely tick every box. Highlights Build the pipelines and data model powering a live SaaS platform for container terminals worldwide. Originally posted on Himalayas

description: We’re Fly .io, and we’re building a new public cloud. We transmogrify containers into lightweight VMs and run them on our hardware around the world – hundreds of thousands of applications rely on us, running on every continent except Antarctica. If you haven’t already,take us for spin. Your app will be up and running in just minutes. Unlike all the rest of our roles, these roles are geographically specific; devrel here is in large part about engaging local communities. We’re currently hiring devrel people who can deliver work full time in North America and Europe. Of course, our whole thing is that we deploy everywhere else in the world, too, so we’ll be expanding from there soon. There are a lot DevRel jobs where you have to make your own fun, because the product is about eliminating some gnarly business slog like inventory management or expense tracking or underwriting. We’re not knocking those jobs! There’s nobility in eliminating slogs! But this isn’t one of those jobs. We’re doing something big, something that’s about software development itself. We’re one of a number of upstart companies rethinking the public cloud, breaking down infrastructure problems that used to take months of work and dedicated headcount into a platform that our users can gain fluency with in a matter of minutes. If you’re our kind of developer, the fun in this job is built-in. Folks working in DevRel at Fly .io interact with three different groups of people: Group A: our product teams, like in every other devrel job: the people building the platform and its features. Group B: our “framework” teams, which are a fun quirk of Fly .io: these are small teams of people organized around individual application frameworks like Rails, Django, Phoenix, and whatever people are doing in Javascript these days. Group H: the “developer community”, a term the industry uses because it is apparently squicked out by the word “customer”. You’ll accomplish this by deploying all of your “skills of an artist”, hopefully including things like: Quickly building proof-of-concept applications that show off cool things about Fly .io, like how quickly you can start up a new VM, or the timeless elegance of our IPv6 addressing. Building and delivering presentations for events, presentations that have the net effect of customers (err, the developer community) liking us more. Also, having the good taste to do this in ways that are interesting even to people who might never deploy an app on Fly .io. Talking to people working on all kinds of applications, from side projects to large teams building microservice ensembles, and talking them through making the best use of Fly .io, the Fly Machines API, our integrations with products like Supabase, that sort of stuff. Maintaining a public presence in online communities where developers congregate, and somehow doing all of this while maintaining your own authenticity and credibility. We’ll help! 25% monthly travel (with seasonal variability) to meet with developer communities in person to engage in small and large settings to build authentic developer interest in various regions and communities. This Role Is A Good Fit For You If: You enjoy building applications and are particularly psyched about the prototyping phase of building things, because there’s going to be a lot of that here. The idea of a little bit of chaos appeals to you, because it’s a sign to you that there’s an opportunity to help define a new practice and make some big moves. You’re opinionated enough to be interesting, but exceptionally good at listening, empathizing, and rolling with the opinions of our users. That’s a hard tradeoff and not a lot of us here can do it! Your career goals involve increasing your public profile. We punch above our weight in getting attention from developers, and your job here would be part of building and expanding on that. Going to a bunch of different developer events sounds like a good time to you. There’s some travel involved in this job. You’ll Know You’re Succeeding If: The numbers are going up and to the right (or you’ve built a time machine and can make the numbers go left). You’re involved in helping systematize our content development past blog posts and documentation and into a library of different kinds of content to connect with people at different phases of their use of the product, and you’re seeing results. You’re comfortable with how Fly .io intersects with all the major app frameworks and can effectively talk people through solving problems, and when you do that, the result is that people are excited to use us. More Details This is a fully-remote, full-time position. In order to optimize for pay equity, Fly .io doesn’t negotiate salaries. We have standardized salaries for each employee level. The salary for this role is, depending on level, $134k or $190k USD. We offer competitive equity grants with a long exercise window. US employees get health care, everyone gets flexible vacation time (with a minimum), hardware/phone allowances, the standard stuff. Our hiring process may be a little different from what you’re used to. We respect career experience but we aren’t hypnotized by it, and we’re thrilled at the prospect of discovering new talent. So instead of resumes and interviews, we’re going to show you the kind of work we’re doing and then see if you enjoy actually doing it, with “work-sample challenges”. title: Claims - Care Manager, RN, Claims
description: Who We Are Wellcove has been recognized as the nation’s leading full-service senior market solutions provider for over 25 years. Our solutions span the insurance senior market sector, focusing on long-term care and Medicare Supplement plans. However, we don’t stop there. Wellcove also addresses challenges faced in accident & health, disability, and supplemental health insurance programs. Our team provides individuals and their families with peace of mind knowing their insurance needs will be met in a thoughtful, efficient manner. We are able to do this because of our dedicated associates, innovative solutions, and state-of-the-art technology. We are seeking an experienced Registered Nurse (RN) to serve as a Care Manager supporting Long Term Care (LTC) insurance claims. This individual contributor role is responsible for conducting comprehensive clinical eligibility reviews to determine whether policyholders meet the benefit eligibility requirements outlined in their LTC policy. The Care Manager, RN will complete and document Chronically Ill Certifications (CICs) and develop Plans of Care (POCs) for initial claims and ongoing recertifications, ensuring determinations are clinically sound, and policy aligned. Key Responsibilities Perform detailed clinical reviews of LTC claim files to determine eligibility in accordance with policy provisions and regulatory requirements. Assess Activities of Daily Living (ADLs), cognitive impairment, diagnoses, comorbidities, and level of care needs. Review medical records, Minimum Data Set (MDS) assessments, facility documentation, home health records, daily visit notes, and supporting claim forms. Determine whether the insured meets the policy definition of Chronically Ill. Prepare and document Chronically Ill Certifications (CICs) and individualized Plans of Care (POCs) for initial approvals and recertifications. Clearly document clinical rationale to support benefit determinations. Collaborate with Claims, Eligibility, and Customer Service teams to obtain additional documentation when necessary. Maintain knowledge of LTC policy language, benefit triggers, and regulatory requirements. Qualifications Active, unrestricted Registered Nurse (RN) license required. Clinical experience in long-term care, home health, geriatrics, case management, or utilization review preferred. Experience reviewing medical records and assessing functional and cognitive impairment. Knowledge of LTC insurance benefit triggers, ADL requirements, and chronically ill certification standards preferred. Strong clinical judgment, critical thinking, and documentation skills. Ability to manage multiple cases and meet turnaround expectations. At Wellcove, we strive to create an inclusive culture for all. We understand the importance of listening and incorporating various perspectives at every level of service. Our company does not discriminate based on gender identity, race, sexual orientation, age, religion, or disability. Originally posted on Himalayas

title: Compensation & Benefits Manager
description: In the MGID team , we're currently seeking a driven individual who thrives on challenges and is eager to dive into the world of analyzing performance and understanding people's behaviors through data. Our ideal candidate is someone who embraces uncertainty and is determined to forge mutually beneficial relationships. At our company, we're all about evolution and innovation. We're constantly refining our processes and exploring new ideas. As part of our team, you'll have the opportunity to experiment with various strategies and see your ideas come to life. You'll be joining a dynamic team that's committed to growth and success. While we can't promise it'll be a walk in the park, we can guarantee an exciting journey filled with interesting goals, demanding challenges, learning and growth. As we continue to expand rapidly, you'll be part of a team that operates in its own time zone, constantly pushing boundaries and embracing diversity. So, we are looking for a highly skilled and experienced professional to join our HR department as a Compensation & Benefit Manager. This role will focus on overseeing and managing our company's compensation and benefits programs on a global scale. If you're ready to take on new challenges and be part of a vibrant, forward-thinking team, then we want to hear from you! Apply now and let's embark on this journey together Who We are: MGID is a global advertising platform helping brands reach unique local audiences at scale. In MGID we empower brands and publishers to work together transparently through our privacy-first targeting technology to enable advertisers to drive performance and awareness, and publishers to retain and monetize their audiences. Today, we’re creating unique technologies and with your help, we are looking to aim even higher. What You'll Do: Improving and managing global compensation and benefits policies to align with organizational objectives and comply with local regulations. Analyzing market trends and conducting benchmarking to ensure competitive and attractive compensation and benefits packages for potential and existing employees. Utilizing financial analysis skills to assess the impact of compensation and benefits programs on the company’s financial performance. Monitoring the effectiveness of KPIs and balancing them with the business (revenue, expenses, margin). Providing guidance and support to HR teams globally on compensation-related matters, including salary structures, bonus programs, and incentive schemes. Progressing and refining compensation and benefits programs to provide a competitive level of pay, motivation, and reward to employees, as well as protection. Enhancing fair and attractive incentives and/or bonus programs for specific employee categories. Collaborating with HR and finance teams to develop and monitor budgets for reward programmes. Creating dashboard reports to track the reward dynamics of different groups of employees. Calculate variable pay, commissions, and bonuses for different departments accurately and on time (e.g., applying specific metrics and rules for Sales, PubDev, and other teams). Prepare and update regular reports, as well as generate ad-hoc (on-demand) reports for HR or management when needed. Requirements Who You Are: 7+ years of relevant experience in Compensation & Benefits, financial controlling, FP&A, workforce analytics, or a similar analytical role, with substantial hands-on exposure to compensation management. Experience supporting or designing compensation governance , including approval processes, budget controls, salary exceptions, promotions, new hires, and replacement hiring. Strong analytical capability, including experience interpreting large datasets, identifying anomalies and trends, conducting audits, and providing management with clear data-driven recommendations . Experience conducting market compensation benchmarking and translating market data into actionable recommendations on pay positioning and compensation adjustments. Practical experience in designing, reviewing, or managing compensation structures , including salary ranges/bands, job levels, annual salary review processes, variable compensation, and benefits. Experience working in a multi-country/international organization and understanding the challenges of compensation across different markets. A degree in HR Management and/or Statistics/ Finance is preferred. Professional certifications (GRP, WorldAtWork, etc.). B2 level or above proficiency in English. Technical Skills: Advanced Excel/Google Sheets skills , including complex formulas, lookups, Pivot Tables, financial models, and analysis of large datasets. Experience with Power BI, Tableau, or similar BI tools is preferred. Analytical Mindset: Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with a focus on working accurately with numbers and financial metrics. Attention to Detail: High level of accuracy and responsibility, especially when calculating bonuses and working with sensitive payroll information. Ethics & Confidentiality: Strict understanding of corporate ethics and the ability to maintain absolute confidentiality regarding employee compensation data. Communication: Strong written and spoken communication skills to collaborate effectively with the HR team and answer basic employee questions. MGID is an awesome place to work for those who share results-driven culture, passion for AdTech, innovation, and human focus . We set ambitious goals, approach challenges with enthusiasm, and value honesty, transparency, and empathy. We celebrate the diversity and the unique contributions of each individual. By embracing these values, we create a culture of excellence, creativity, and empathy. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Join us and unleash your full potential in a fun and rewarding environment! Let's create better together. Originally posted on Himalayas

title: Streaming Technology Expert
description: Mayflower is a technology company building highload products used by millions of people worldwide. Operating at the scale of one of the world's top-50 websites, we solve complex engineering challenges and create solutions that power real-time entertainment for a global audience. We are looking for a Principal Streaming Technology Expert will serve as the company's senior technical authority on streaming technologies, supporting complex technical assessments , technology risk analysis, deep technical research, and strategic decision-making. Job Responsibilities Complex Technical Analysis: Investigate complex technical questions related to products, architecture, protocols, and implementations. Develop evidence-based technical positions on complex matters. Work with internal stakeholders and external experts on complex technical assessments. Prepare technical reports, diagrams, comparisons, and supporting materials. Explain complex streaming technologies to both technical and non-technical audiences. Technology Landscape & Risk Research: Research technologies, standards, publications, implementations, and industry practices. Compare company solutions with existing industry approaches and implementations. Conduct technical risk analysis related to technologies, standards, and third-party solutions. 👈 Support technical due diligence and risk assessments for products and architectural decisions. Track important technology trends and developments across the streaming ecosystem. Maintain awareness of emerging technical risks affecting the company's technology strategy. Technology Research & Documentation: Perform deep technical research relevant to the company's streaming platform and products. Maintain documentation of architecture, protocols, data flows, algorithms, DRM, CDNs, and media pipelines. Create technical diagrams, implementation analyses, and historical technical records. Investigate third-party technologies, standards, open-source components, and commercial solutions. Maintain understanding of how company technology differs from existing technical approaches. Preserve institutional knowledge around key architectural and engineering decisions. Internal Technical Authority: Act as a streaming technology expert across engineering, product, executive, and cross-functional teams. Review major architectural decisions requiring additional technical assessment or risk analysis. Collaborate with senior engineers and architects on complex technical reviews. Independently analyze source code, specifications, standards, protocols, and production architectures. Provide independent technical judgment on complex or sensitive technology questions. Requirements You’ll thrive here if you have Deep hands-on knowledge of video/audio streaming architectures, protocols, codecs, CDNs, and related technologies. Ability to independently analyze complex technical systems, standards, implementations, and architecture. Strong communication skills and ability to explain complex technical topics to non-technical audiences. Native or near-native English proficiency. Also would be nice: Experience working with complex technical reviews involving US-based stakeholders. Experience preparing technical materials for external review or formal assessment. Conditions We know that great talent deserves great conditions, so here's what you can expect when joining us: Full remote work. Competitive compensation with a service contract. Transparent performance reviews twice a year, with bonus opportunities and salary adjustments. An annual allowance that you can use for home office improvements, sports activities, equipment upgrades, and more—tailor it to what benefits you most. Investment in your development: paid language courses, access to various learning platforms, and a mindfulness benefit, including psychological support with 50% coverage. Career growth in a fast-scaling project with opportunities to influence technical decisions. A culture of recognition: our peer reward program celebrates contributions from across the team. description: Who are we? Tripledot Studios is one of the largest independent mobile games companies in the world. We are a multi-award-winning organisation, with a global 2,500+ strong team across 12 studios. Our expanded portfolio includes some of the biggest titles in mobile gaming, collectively reaching top chart positions around the world and engaging over 25 million daily active users. Tripledot’s guiding principle is that when people love what they do, what they do will be loved by others. We’re building a company we’re proud of. One filled with driven, incredibly smart and detail-orientated people, who LOVE making games. Our ambition is to be the most successful games company in the world, and we’re just getting started. The role is working within our studio: PuzzlePlay Puzzleplay is Tripledot’s new player rewards platform, designed to make playing our games even more fun and engaging. By playing our casual, free to play mobile games, users can earn points, complete challenges, and win real prizes. It’s our way of giving back to players and rewarding them for doing what they already love. Puzzleplay is a key part of our growth strategy, combining smart engagement mechanics with high-quality game content. Role Overview Puzzleplay at Tripledot Studios is looking for a data analyst to own the fraud side of its user segmentation work. The team is building a system that combines fraud and activity signals to understand users and inform revenue-share decisions. You'll work with the analyst responsible for gameplay signals, alongside product and data colleagues, to keep that system useful as fraud patterns change. Fraud patterns keep changing, so you'll regularly revisit the signals behind the segments and help the product team decide which verification methods make sense in each market. This role is open to candidates based in Europe; Warsaw is preferred, where several of the people you'll work with are based. Key Responsibilities Review fraud signals regularly, adding, removing and refining them to distinguish suspicious activity from legitimate users. Signals under consideration include IP spoofing, VPN use and unusual play patterns. Own the fraud-related segments of the user segmentation system, from deciding how signals should be interpreted to monitoring how well the categories work over time. Work with the product team on fraud verification tools for different markets. The team currently uses FaceTec for facial verification and may need other methods, such as ID scanning or phone verification, in other countries. Investigate users flagged for manual review, including ambiguous cases in the Tremendous queue, and look for ways to improve the review process. Identify gaps in the available signals and recommend third-party tools for the product roadmap where they would help. Required Skills, Knowledge and Expertise Hands-on experience using data to investigate fraud and shape detection or prevention decisions, not just working alongside a fraud team. Experience designing or improving fraud signals, user segments or review processes, with an interest in how those decisions change as tactics evolve. The ability to work with product and other teams to turn analysis into operational fraud controls. Originally posted on Himalayas

description: Founded in 2010 in the Netherlands, AnywhereNow is a global leader in Enterprise Dialogue Management, with a vision to ensure every employee and customer feels heard, understood, and valued. Deepdesk – AI-powered Agent Assist technology that helps service teams work faster and smarter. Tendfor – a customer engagement and contact centre solution designed for Microsoft Teams environments. This is a hands-on engineering role focused on designing, building, and scaling intelligent agents across the Microsoft ecosystem. You'll transform defined business use cases into production-ready agentic solutions, leveraging modern AI technologies, Azure services, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) architecture.
