You'll work closely with Product, Engineering, QA, and AI leadership to ensure every solution delivers real business value while meeting enterprise standards for security, performance, and governance. Beyond technical delivery, you'll bring product thinking and commercial awareness, helping to identify meaningful customer challenges, emerging AI opportunities, and relevant market trends. Your insights will contribute to shaping and refining the Agent Factory roadmap and backlog. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys building practical AI applications and can take solutions from concept through to production deployment. What You'll Be Doing Build and Deliver Intelligent Agents Design, build and deploy AI agents that solve real customer and business problems. Create agents that deliver value independently while contributing insights to a broader intelligence ecosystem. Translate product requirements and use cases into scalable, production-ready solutions. Develop MCP-Based Integrations Build and operate Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers that provide agents with secure access to tools, systems and enterprise data. Define and implement tool interfaces, authentication mechanisms and resource access patterns. Ensure agents can interact with enterprise services in a structured, secure and reliable way. Integrate Enterprise Systems Connect agents with business-critical platforms including: Microsoft Dynamics 365 Microsoft Graph Dataverse ServiceNow Contact Centre and Customer Experience platforms Internal and third-party APIs Design Context, Memory & Intelligence Define how agents manage memory, context and decision-making patterns. Implement retrieval, reasoning and tool-use strategies that promote consistent and predictable behaviour. Design guardrails that enable agents to operate safely and effectively within enterprise environments. Contribute to the Agent Ecosystem Develop supporting services including adapters, event processing capabilities and integration layers. Enable agents to share insights and consume intelligence from a wider ecosystem of interconnected solutions. Help shape future product direction by contributing technical expertise, customer insights and market observations. What You'll Bring Microsoft Technology Expertise Strong software engineering experience using C# and .NET . Hands-on experience with Azure services, including: Azure Functions Azure App Service Azure OpenAI Service Azure AI Foundry / AI Studio Experience integrating with Microsoft business platforms such as: Dynamics 365 Dataverse Microsoft Graph Power Platform Knowledge of Azure security and identity services, including: Microsoft Entra ID Managed Identities Azure Key Vault Agentic AI & MCP Experience Practical experience building or consuming MCP servers. Knowledge of agent frameworks and orchestration technologies such as: Semantic Kernel AutoGen Microsoft AI SDKs Experience with: Function and tool calling Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) Vector databases Context and memory management Ability to design clear, reliable and secure agent interactions.# Broader Engineering Skills Strong API integration experience, including REST APIs, webhooks and event-driven architectures. Experience with cloud-native deployment, CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure-as-code approaches. Understanding of performance, latency, reliability and cost considerations when working with Large Language Models in production. Commitment to software quality, testing and continuous improvement. Ability to work closely with QA teams on agent evaluation, testing and quality assurance. Who You Are You'll be successful in this role if you are: A pragmatic builder who can take ideas from concept to production. Passionate about applying AI to solve real-world business challenges. Comfortable working independently while collaborating with cross-functional teams. A systems thinker who understands how individual components contribute to larger platforms and architectures. Security-conscious and focused on building reliable enterprise-grade solutions. Excited by emerging AI technologies and eager to learn as the landscape evolves. Nice to Have While not essential, we'd be particularly interested in candidates with experience in: Multi-agent architectures and agent-to-agent communication. Delivering AI solutions within enterprise or regulated environments. LLM observability, monitoring, tracing, and evaluation frameworks. Contact Centre, Customer Experience, or enterprise workflow automation platforms. Why Join Us? This is an opportunity to help shape the future of AI within a rapidly evolving product organisation. You'll work with cutting-edge Microsoft AI technologies, contribute directly to innovative agentic solutions, and play a key role in building scalable AI capabilities that deliver measurable value to customers. If you're passionate about building intelligent systems and want to be at the forefront of enterprise AI innovation, we'd love to hear from you. All employees are expected to actively support and maintain the organisation's information security standards and contribute to protecting the confidentiality, integrity and availability of company and customer information. This includes: Adhering to all applicable information security policies, procedures and guidelines at all times. title: Product Formulator
description: Zelh is a fast-growing, passionate outsourcing company. Our mission is to be the most reliable company by offering and maintaining consistently high-quality services. We achieve this mission by fostering long-term relationships with customers, employees, and vendors. Personal attention, timely communication, and respect for all people are the foundation of our business philosophy! At this point, Zelh is looking for a Product Formulator to join our team. The Product Formulator & Quoter will be responsible for developing preliminary product formulas, preparing accurate Bills of Materials (BOMs), and creating quote packages for customer projects in the dietary supplement and nutraceutical industry. This role requires a strong understanding of ingredient science, potency levels, biological activity, and overage calculations to ensure that proposed formulas meet customer requirements and applicable labeling standards. The successful candidate will work closely with Product Development, Sourcing, Procurement, and Sales teams to ensure formula accuracy, cost transparency, and a smooth transition from initial quoting to final product specifications. As the role develops, the individual will also review and approve Finished Product Specifications (FPS) to ensure consistency between the original quote and the finalized product. Duties and Responsibilities Product Formulation & Technical Analysis: Interpret customer briefs, target formulas, and label claims to develop technically accurate ingredient lists and preliminary formulas. Determine appropriate ingredient forms, potency levels, biological activity values, and extract standardization requirements. Ingredient Calculations & Stability: Calculate ingredient overages to account for manufacturing losses, moisture, and shelf-life stability. Identify incompatible ingredients, potential formulation risks, and gaps in claim substantiation. BOM Development & Costing: Build detailed preliminary Bills of Materials (BOMs) for powders, capsules, and other finished product formats, including raw material specifications, part numbers, quantities, yields, unit costs, and estimated packaging components. Supplement & Nutrition Facts Panels: Prepare preliminary Supplement Facts Panels (SFP) and Nutrition Facts Panels (NFP), ensuring accurate ingredient declarations, serving sizes, percentage Daily Values, and required non-ingredient statements. Quote & Data Management: Enter and maintain accurate quote information in ERP and project management systems, including Deacom and Odoo. Ensure data accuracy for costs, suppliers, minimum order quantities (MOQs), and raw material sourcing notes. Sourcing & Procurement Coordination: Collaborate with Sourcing and Procurement teams on ingredient requests for quotations (RFQs), providing project details, estimated volumes, and sample requirements. Finished Product Specification Review: Compare finalized Finished Product Specifications against the original quote to verify formula integrity, ingredient levels, overage calculations, BOM accuracy, and label compliance. Quality Control & Discrepancy Resolution: Document discrepancies between original quotes and finalized specifications, escalating unresolved issues to the Product Development Manager before approval. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Product Development, Sales, Sourcing, and Procurement teams to communicate technical assumptions, ingredient availability, cost drivers, and project requirements. Process Improvement & Documentation: Update legacy quote sheets, identify data gaps, maintain accurate formulation records, and support continuous improvements throughout the quote-to-order process. Education & Experience Bachelor's degree in Food Science, Nutrition, Chemistry, Biology, Biotechnology, Biochemistry, or a related scientific field. 3–6 years of experience in nutraceuticals, dietary supplements, food and beverage product development, or technical sales support. Strong knowledge of supplement ingredient science, including potency and activity declarations, overage calculations, extract standardization, and bioavailability considerations. Hands-on experience preparing detailed Bills of Materials (BOMs), including raw material specifications, quantities, yields, and cost calculations. Experience with ERP systems and project management tools; knowledge of Deacom and Odoo is an advantage. Experience working with or alongside a Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) is preferred. Skills & Competencies Strong analytical skills and excellent numerical accuracy in formulation and cost calculations. Exceptional attention to detail and the ability to identify inconsistencies in formulas, ingredient declarations, and product specifications. Good understanding of supplement labeling requirements and Supplement/Nutrition Facts panel preparation. Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously. Excellent written English communication skills and the ability to explain technical information clearly. Proactive problem-solving skills and the ability to identify potential formulation, sourcing, and costing risks. Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams in a remote, international environment. Ability to work independently while maintaining close communication with the Product Development team Working Conditions Work format: Fully remote. Working hours: 8 hours per day, with core working hours overlapping with the team from 9:00 AM to 3:00 PM Eastern Time (ET). Possible schedules: 7:00 AM – 3:00 PM ET 8:00 AM – 4:00 PM ET 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM ET Compensation: Competitive salary in USD. 10+ business days of paid time off Equipment: Provided by the company. Recommend and implement appropriate risk mitigation actions, including leverage restrictions, margin adjustments and trading condition changes . Strong practical knowledge of market risk, client risk, exposure management, leverage, margin and stop-out mechanisms . Hands-on experience with MT4/MT5 and trading/risk monitoring. Strong understanding of trading behaviour and abuse patterns , including toxic flow, latency arbitrage, bonus abuse and scalping. Strong analytical skills with advanced Excel ; experience with BI tools, SQL, Python or other risk/analytics tools is an advantage. Nice-to-Have Experience implementing risk rules/alerts via BI, SQL, Python, or internal tooling. Familiarity with liquidity/prime brokerage setups (A-Book/B-Book hybrid models). Previous work in regulated environments (CySEC, MFSA, SCA, etc.). Experience designing bonus/promotion risk controls and eligibility frameworks. description: MailerLite is one of the fastest-growing email marketing services. We help more than 1 million businesses around the world stay in touch with their customers. Experiência avançada em soluções de IA generativa, criação de Agents e Skills com versionamento e evaluation. Vivência no uso e integração de agentes, RAG, BMAD, APM, Devin, Claude, Copilot, skills e ferramentas internas como Hybrid Flow e Hive. Capacidade para documentar processos com clareza e compartilhar conhecimento tecnicamente estruturado. Conhecimento aprofundado em práticas de IA com foco em eficiência e boas práticas. O que seria muito legal se você soubesse Experiência em liderança técnica ou participação ativa em conferências e fóruns sobre Inteligência Artificial. Publicação de artigos técnicos ou apresentações sobre inovações em IA. Vivência em projetos que envolvam integração entre múltiplos fornecedores ou soluções customizadas para grandes organizações. Proposta ou implantação de iniciativas que resultaram em ganhos mensuráveis na eficiência das soluções AI implementadas. O que acontece após minha aplicação na vaga interna? title: Support Engineer Internship
description: Overview: Technical Support and Customer Advocacy The Support Engineer / Customer Success role is the primary technical interface for our users. You'll provide timely, expert technical support to both our e-commerce customers and internal users of our sophisticated supply chain tools (WMS, OMS). This role is critical for ensuring high client satisfaction, rapid issue resolution, and capturing valuable user feedback to drive product improvement across the platform. Internship Details Duration: 3 months Start Date: Immediate Location: Remote Stipend: None initially. Based on your first-quarter performance, you may be offered a paid full-time opportunity, or even be absorbed directly by the client as an FTE. Key Responsibilities & Core Projects You will manage the full lifecycle of support issues, from initial report to final resolution, focusing on user enablement. Technical Troubleshooting: Provide Tier 1 and Tier 2 technical support, rapidly diagnosing and resolving platform issues for e-commerce transactions, B2B portal access, and internal application functions (e.g., inventory display issues, order processing errors). Client Onboarding & Training: Conduct technical onboarding sessions for new B2B clients and internal teams, ensuring they effectively utilize the platform's features, especially complex domain modules like the OMS and WMS. Ticket Management: Manage the support queue in our internal ServiceNow-like system, ensuring all support tickets adhere to defined SLAs and maintain comprehensive documentation of troubleshooting steps and resolutions. Escalation and Feedback: Act as the liaison between users and the engineering teams. Accurately document and escalate complex bugs/feature requests (e.g., performance issues, compliance gaps) and verify fixes before closing tickets. Customer Feedback Loop: Proactively gather customer feedback and usage insights to inform product roadmaps, documentation improvements, and service training materials. Required Technologies & Tools Candidates should be technically adept with experience in troubleshooting web applications and using support platforms: Application Troubleshooting: Proficiency in debugging web application issues (using browser developer tools) and understanding API communication flows. Support Systems: Experience managing complex ticketing systems (ServiceNow, Jira Service Desk, etc.). Platform Familiarity: Basic ability to interpret logs from the observability stack (Grafana/Loki) to aid in initial diagnosis. Domain Focus: Strong ability to quickly learn and articulate complex supply chain concepts (MES $\rightarrow$ WMS $\rightarrow$ OMS). AI Agent Focus You will interact with and help support the AI tools used for customer service. Agent QA: Provide feedback and troubleshooting for the AI customer support agents, identifying instances where the LLM-powered tools fail or provide inaccurate information. Knowledge Base Curation: Contribute to maintaining and structuring the knowledge base that feeds the AI agents, improving their accuracy and effectiveness. Success Metrics & Career Path Performance will be measured by: Resolution Time (MTTR): Achievement of defined SLAs for initial response and Mean Time To Resolution (MTTR). Customer Satisfaction (CSAT): High customer satisfaction scores based on ticket resolution quality. Escalation Quality: Quality and completeness of documentation for bugs and feature requests escalated to engineering. Mentorship Structure: Reports to the Customer Success Manager or Engineering Lead, working closely with the development teams to understand and communicate technical resolutions. description: Who we are Properstar connects real estate buyers, renters, and agents, here and everywhere. Buyers and renters find their next home with us, locally or across borders. Agents reach them in countries they couldn't otherwise sell into, in languages they don't speak. Our Product & Marketing department grows the brand and our footprint. Small team, no fluff. We acquire new users, nurture them, qualify them, and turn them into customers. We believe in a new way of working, where AI is fundamental: you direct, you don't execute. About the job You own B2C growth end to end. You bring buyers and renters to Properstar . You keep them coming back. AI does the heavy lifting, you steer it. That means multichannel acquisition and a lifecycle that runs from first visit to repeat visit. Search, paid social, email, push, app. The app comes first. One gap matters most. People start with research: what a flat costs in Lisbon, how to rent in Spain as a foreigner. Later, they search for a home. Today we don't connect the two. You build that bridge. 2027 is the year we build and test the engine. 2028 is the year we scale it, with a large paid push in France, Spain, and Switzerland. You own the budget and direct our paid media specialists. You report to the CPO. What you'll do Set the growth strategy. Channels, markets, segments, budget. Defend every euro with numbers. Build multichannel acquisition. Test new channels, scale what works. Know your CPL, CAC, and payback by channel and market. Connect research to search. Turn people reading guides and asking questions into people searching listings and contacting agents. Make the app our first channel. Installs, adoption, retention. Move users from web to app and keep them there. Own the lifecycle. Activation, conversion, retention, reactivation, LTV. Find where users drop and fix it. Work the database. Segment, nurture, reactivate. Email, push, in-app. Run experiments. Landing pages, onboarding, messaging, offers. Fast cycles, clear reads. Direct the specialists. Set their goals, review the work, raise the bar. Work with product and nurturing. Push for what moves conversion. Track lead qualification with our nurturing lead. Prepare the 2028 ramp-up. Markets, channels, creative, tracking. Ready before we spend. Build the playbooks as Claude skills, so the team and the agents can run them. Talk to users. Read the data yourself. What we're looking for Growth track record. You've grown a B2C product with a large user base, across channels and markets. Real numbers, real graph. Show us. Marketplace, portal, or app experience is a strong plus. Multichannel range. You've owned several channels and have strong opinions on the rest. Single-channel ads specialists won't fit. App growth. description: As the publisher of Ubuntu we serve millions of developers, building for the cloud, IoT and data science. We aim to make open source easier and more reliable for innovators and enterprises. We have created a new Developer Relations team to engage directly with open source communities and developer-centric organisations. We hope both to communicate our vision and products for better open source development experiences, and also to have a better feedback loop from those audiences to shape our offerings and priorities. A Developer Relations Engineer is a technical expert, strategist and communicator with deep empathy for developers. This discipline combines practical engineering skills with firm diplomacy across organisational boundaries, in both directions. Like our audience, a Developer Relations Engineer is never satisfied with the status quo, and is driven by an insatiable curiosity to find better ways to get things done. They are problem-solvers and inventors, who understand people's needs and love the way that tools can be adapted to meet them. They stay current with tech trends and provide insights and guidance while fostering innovation. To improve your chances of success in this application, read our advice on how to get a job at Canonical . Location : we are building our initial DevRel team in Europe, Middle East, African and American time zones What your day will look like In a typical day, a developer relations engineer might: take part in team product meetings, at levels from strategy to day-by-day development progress, contributing insight and expertise maintain conversations with developer community members wherever they may be found - IRC, social media, product forums, meet-ups and more work with colleagues in other teams in the company, as part of efforts to help establish commonality and consistent approaches help solve specific technical problems that users or colleagues have identified contribute to technical documentation to ensure that developer users' needs are met there work on technical articles, presentations or workshops identify new opportunities and directions for improvement in the developer experience we provide present at conferences, meetups or technical events What we are looking for in you A strong candidate is a programmer or developer with a demonstrable passion for and engagement in open-source software has worked with real-world challenges developing and deploying software using Linux has practical hands-on experience of Linux software packaging (including Snaps, debs, charms, rocks, PIP, containers) understands current software packing issues and trends in the Linux ecosystem has been a contributor to open-source communities, software and documentation is an engaging, vivacious speaker and presenter can work effectively, tactfully, empathetically and confidently in contexts where different parties have different perspectives, needs and understanding builds trust, relationships and confidence is willing to travel globally twice a year for company events, as well as to upstream and partner events Additional skills that you might also bring previous experience in a developer advocacy or community role in-depth familiarity with Ubuntu and the Canonical ecosystem of products What we offer you We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally. description: Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction. Innovate with Tether Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services. But that’s just the beginning: Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities. Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing. Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity. Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways. Why Join Us? Keet is a fully peer-to-peer messaging and video calling app built on Holepunch's P2P stack. There are no servers, no middlemen, and no data harvesting. People talk directly to each other, with end-to-end encryption by design. We're taking Keet to a billion users, competing head-on with WhatsApp and Telegram. Product sets the direction. We're looking for a Product Engineering Lead to turn that direction into features people love, built to a standard that holds up at global scale. You lead the teams that build Keet's features: the API team, which adds feature-focused APIs to Keet's core, and the frontend team, which builds the React app on top, each with its own lead. You report directly to the CTO and take direction from product. Product owns the what and the why. You own the how and the engineering bar. The split is roughly 70% engineering leadership and 30% product. You're a combination of three things. You're an engineering leader who has helped teams ship consumer products at speed. You have real product sense and can partner with PMs as an equal, shaping what gets built, not just executing it. And you have an intuition for distributed, local-first systems, so you can work fluently on top of a P2P engine without needing to build it yourself. Responsabilities Engineering Run the API and frontend teams day to day: unblocking, reviewing, and keeping them shipping. Set and hold a high engineering bar for performance, reliability, and clean APIs. Own the technical design of features and the API surface between Keet's core and the app. Make sure the API team works closely with our deep tech teams on code reviews, design, and anything that touches the engine. Product Partnership Work alongside Keet's product managers to turn vision and roadmap into scoped, buildable work. Push back when scope and reality don't match, and propose better paths when they exist. Bring an engineering perspective to product decisions, especially where P2P opens doors that centralized apps can't. Help the team move fast, using AI tools and quick prototypes to validate ideas before committing to them. Leadership Create clarity around team goals and make sure everyone knows what success looks like. Mentor team leads to build strong team operating systems, improve how their teams work with others, and grow as leaders. Lead by example: roll up your sleeves when the team needs it, and step back when they're ready to own it. Requirements Experience managing engineers or engineering leads who ship consumer product, ideally in chat, calling, or social apps. Strong product sense: you can tell a good feature from a busy one. Intuition for distributed and local-first systems. Offline-first and eventual consistency should feel natural. You don't need P2P protocol expertise, because our core abstracts it away. Deep JavaScript and React. Initiative, curiosity, resilience, and the ability to give and receive direct critique. Bonus: experience with local-first apps, CRDTs or sync engines, offline-capable mobile or desktop apps, or open source. Highlights Originally posted on Himalayas

description: About the company At Nuitée , we are building the API backbone for the global travel industry. Founded in 2017, Nuitée is on a mission to transform a fragmented travel ecosystem with simple, scalable, and API-first infrastructure—think “Stripe for Travel.” By enabling seamless connectivity between hotels, OTAs, fintechs, super-apps, and businesses, some of which are entering the travel market for the first time, Nuitée empowers companies to deliver reliable travel products effortlessly. Our robust platform simplifies complex supplier networks, offering direct access to hotel inventory with better pricing, coverage, and technology. With teams across the globe, including hubs in London, New York, San Francisco, Palma de Mallorca and Casablanca, Nuitée has grown into a global infrastructure provider trusted by industry leaders like Hopper, Priceline, Google, and Uber. Now backed by leading VCs and world-class investors including leaders from , Stripe, and Shopify, Nuitée is positioned to redefine the B2B travel market, streamline operations for hotels, and enable new applications through cutting-edge APIs. Nuitée is at the forefront of a revolution—delivering AI-powered, smarter, and more personalized travel experiences for a new era. About the role Remote in Europe, or hybrid in Barcelona, Dublin, London, or Palma. Imagine making a technical decision today and seeing its impact on revenue in days. You'll lead engineering for Pricing & Revenue, a core part of Nuitée 's hotel booking infrastructure. This is where supplier connectivity, distribution, pricing, and monetisation come together, with engineering decisions directly affecting performance, competitiveness, and margin. You'll own the technical direction, architecture, reliability, and delivery of the domain. You'll lead and grow a small engineering team, work closely with Product and Trading, and have the autonomy to decide how to solve problems without approval layers. The technical challenge is central. A single hotel search can trigger synchronous queries across around 200 suppliers. We're now building more sophisticated trading capabilities, including a proper pricing engine and automated rebooking, to make better decisions about supply, pricing, and distribution at scale. What makes it interesting for you Build something important from scratch. We're developing a proper pricing engine and new trading capabilities on top of an established, revenue-generating platform. Real technical ownership. You'll make architectural decisions, shape how the domain evolves, and see the commercial impact of your engineering choices. You stay close to engineering. You'll lead, mentor, and hire engineers while remaining deeply involved in the systems, code, and technical decisions. You can move fast. Small teams, little red tape, and the freedom to make decisions. You can identify a problem, make a change, and see its impact quickly. Nuitée has grown 10x since 2022, was profitable before raising a $48M Series A led by Accel, and works with companies such as Revolut, Grab, Hopper, Priceline, and Sabre. This role comes with meaningful equity, so when we hit our next growth milestones, you get real upside in the company you’re helping build. The kind of problems you'll work on How do we build a pricing engine that balances supply, demand, competitiveness, and margin across a complex hotel marketplace? How do we return competitive rates quickly when each hotel search can involve around 200 supplier connections, with different response times and reliability? How do we improve hotel search availability, currently around 42%, while ensuring customers can actually fulfil their bookings? How do we automate rebooking, first for our internal operations and eventually as a product our customers can use? This role fits if you Have led, mentored, and grown engineering teams while staying hands-on with architecture, code, and production problems. Have built or improved marketplace, trading, or optimisation systems, with experience across both supply and demand. Understand how pricing, inventory, distribution, and fulfilment interact in a marketplace. Have strong Go experience and deep backend engineering expertise, including distributed systems, high-volume APIs, latency, concurrency, and reliability. Can translate complex commercial problems into engineering decisions and build systems that deliver measurable outcomes. Thrive in fast-moving environments where you're expected to take ownership and figure things out. Experience with marketplaces involving real-world inventory, such as mobility, delivery, ecommerce, or travel, is particularly valuable. Nuitée moves quickly, has little process, and gives people a lot of room to make decisions. You’ll do well here if ambiguity does not slow you down, you like going deep into difficult problems, and you want to be accountable for what your work actually delivers. If this sounds like your kind of role, we’d love to hear from you. You can apply with your LinkedIn profile or CV. Why Nuitee? At Nuitée , we’re not just reimagining travel—we’re building the infrastructure to power it. Massive Market Opportunity: We are tackling the $9.9tn travel industry, starting with the $75 billion B2B hotel market, a fragmented space filled with outdated systems, gatekeepers, and inefficiencies. Nuitée ’s API-first platform is solving this, enabling businesses to access hotel inventory seamlessly and at scale. World-Class Backing: Backed by Accel and visionary leaders across tech and travel—including Booking.com, Stripe, and Shopify—we’re equipped to scale our ambition globally. Bootstrapped Resilience, Startup Agility: Having grown profitably for years without external funding, we combine operational discipline with the speed and innovation of a scaling startup. Global Impact: Our infrastructure supports partners like Google, Grab, worldwide fintechs, superapps, travel companies and others AI-Driven Innovation: Nuitée is uniquely positioned to power the future of travel in the AI era—enabling seamless, intelligent, and hyper-personalized travel interactions. By joining Nuitée , you’ll be part of a team that’s building a category-defining platform. You’ll work on a global scale, innovate alongside industry leaders, and help drive the next phase of travel technology. If you’re excited to push boundaries, redefine a multi-trillion-dollar industry, and grow with us— Nuitée is the place for you. By submitting your application, you consent to Nuitée processing your personal data for the purposes of assessing your suitability for employment. Your information will be stored securely and will only be retained for as long as necessary for the recruitment process, or up to 6 months afterward, in accordance with our data protection policy and applicable laws. You have the right to request access, correction, or deletion of your personal data at any time by contacting us at . For more details, please see our Privacy Policy: Nuitée Privacy Notice 2026. title: Senior Protocol & Product Engineer
description: Welcome to Perena : Your Risk Layer on Solana Perena is a decentralized financial protocol on Solana that offers USD STAR (USD*), a yield-bearing asset. USD* is fully collateralized and earns yield from diversified, real sources such as delta-neutral strategies and secured borrow-lend market positions. Its value grows automatically, making it a simple, secure way to save on-chain. USD* is fully collateralized by a diversified portfolio of yield-generating assets and positions, including: Delta-neutral hedged positions on centralized and decentralized exchanges (e.g., BTC, ETH, SOL) Secured borrow-lend market positions involving on-chain stablecoins Real-world assets , such as the reinsurance fund by OnRe Perena actively manages asset allocation and diversifies across multiple strategies to reduce single points of failure and optimize for sustainable, consistent yield performance. Built on Solana’s high-performance blockchain, Perena is creating a liquid, yield-bearing digital dollar that anyone can access with a sustainable, risk-managed approach. Looking ahead, Perena is building a full suite of on-chain stablebanking products to expand access to real yield across crypto and traditional finance. The goal is a sustainable financial experience for anyone to transact, save, and invest on-chain. Perena is founded by a team of builders from the Solana ecosystem with backgrounds in TradFi and DeFi. We believe deeply in pushing financial architecture forward — and in doing it with transparency, resilience, and speed. We’re backed by some of the best in the world, including: Solana co-founders Anatoly Yakovenko and Raj Gokal Investors from Citadel, Jane Street, IMC, and Susquehanna Borderless Capital, Binance Labs, Primitive Ventures, Maelstrom, Anagram, Breed, and others Perena was a sponsor of the Colosseum Hackathon Stablecoin Track , helping fund the next generation of stablecoin projects on Solana. Our growing community spans over 20,000 developers, users, and builders aligned around one goal: reinventing how money works. What You’ll do Turn ambiguous product ideas into well-designed, production-ready systems. This person should be able to challenge requirements, make sound architectural decisions, write the technical plan, and deliver quickly with limited supervision. Design flow-of-funds orchestration across venues and chains — bridging, routing, rebalancing between custodial and non-custodial systems — with reliable settlement, reconciliation, and failure handling as first-class concerns Develop custody and key management patterns that meet institutional-grade security requirements across custodial and non-custodial environments Build on-chain settlement and payment flows, including integrations with DEXs, lending markets, custodians, and bridge infrastructure — starting on Solana (Rust) and extending across EVM and other chains as we scale Build and maintain the systems that move Perena 's money: minting/redeeming USD*, allocating collateral, and routing capital between on-chain protocols, centralized custodians/exchanges, and partner bank rails What We’re Looking ForDefining characteristics 3+ years building financial systems where correctness and settlement guarantees are non-negotiable — payment rails, custody/settlement infrastructure, or trading systems Built and shipped a DeFi, fintech, trading, or infrastructure product in a small team. Has owned meaningful systems from design through production. Strong smart-contract and backend/infrastructure fundamentals. Experience with EVM; Solana experience is valuable. Understands vaults, asset management, yield products, or onchain financial primitives. Familiar with institutional concerns such as custody, permissions, compliance integrations, accounting, and operational controls. Ideally a former founder or early engineer—even if the company or protocol ultimately failed. Comfortable working directly with founders and translating commercial opportunities into scoped products. Defining characteristics Product-minded: Begins with the user, business objective, and operating constraints (not just the requested implementation) High agency: Identifies gaps, proposes solutions, and keeps moving without waiting for granular direction. Bias for action: can take a half-formed spec and run with it, iterating quickly rather than waiting for full direction. Architecturally credible: Someone whose judgment on system design can be trusted with minimal oversight. Constructively challenging: Pushes back when requirements are unclear, risky, or cannot meet a proposed timeframe. Clear communicator: Produces concise technical specifications before significant implementation Earlier in your career? Apply anyway if you can show real campaign ownership, sharp writing, and a clear point of view on the market. Why Perena ? Stablecoins are transforming how the world stores, moves, and grows value — and we’re still early. This is a once-in-a-generation shift: from legacy money to programmable, accessible, internet-native finance. Building here isn’t just technically interesting — it’s globally meaningful. We own our future — we trust each other to take initiative. Voices are heard and outcomes matter. We treat our work as craft — thoughtful, opinionated, and precise.Many of us come from design, art, or cultural backgrounds. We think from first principles — Perena is a reimagining of financial infrastructure. That starts with reimagining how we build. We work in public — we value clarity, writing, and sharing progress openly within the team and with our community. Originally posted on Himalayas

description: Job Description: About the Role The Groove is building out a formal finance and accounting function to match its growth — moving from a founder-run, FreshBooks-era setup to a clean, accrual-basis close on Workday. We're hiring a Staff Accountant to be the hands-on, day-to-day executor of that build-out: reconciliations, journal entries, AP/AR support, and the general ledger discipline that lets the rest of the finance team focus on policy and higher-level review rather than data entry. This is a ground-floor opportunity to help stand up a finance function from the inside, working directly with the CFO and an experienced controller consultant. What You'll Do Perform monthly and quarterly bank reconciliations in Workday, including clearing out a backlog of unapplied deposits and cash. Reconcile balance sheet accounts on an accrual basis each quarter, researching and correcting unnatural or stale balances. Support the transition to accrual-basis accounting: prepaid amortization, depreciation, accrual entries for payroll/PTO/bonus/commission, and other standard month-end adjustments, under the Controller Consultant's direction. Assist with accounts payable: invoice coding, cost-center/worktag completion, and 1099 vendor tracking alongside the AP/payroll lead. Assist with accounts receivable: cash application, unapplied payment research, and supporting a weekly reconciliation process for time-and-billing data. Support payroll-related reconciliations, including matching payroll journal entries to ADP settlement detail and reviewing benefits deductions for accuracy. Help build and maintain a documented monthly close checklist as the function matures. Take on increasing responsibility for recurring, process-driven accounting work as Workday automation (bank-rec, AP workflow, revenue-recognition) comes online, freeing up senior team members for review and exception-handling rather than data entry. What We're Looking For Bachelor's degree in Accounting required. 3–5 years of general ledger / staff accounting experience: journal entries, account reconciliations, AP/AR, and month-end close support. Solid working knowledge of GAAP and double-entry accounting fundamentals. Comfort with Excel for reconciliation and analysis work (lookups, pivot tables). Workday Financials experience is a strong plus — this role will work inside Workday daily, including during an active configuration and clean-up project. High attention to detail and comfort working through unresolved or messy data to find the right answer, rather than needing a fully built-out process to follow. Self-starter who's comfortable in a lean, fast-moving environment — this is our first dedicated staff accounting hire, so some ambiguity comes with the territory. Nice to Have Experience in a professional services or consulting business (time-and-billing, project-based revenue). Prior exposure to a system conversion or ERP implementation. Build an understanding of where the best candidates are, what motivates them, and how the market is evolving. Turn that knowledge into better searches and smarter hiring decisions. Help build our employer brand. Contribute to national and international recruitment campaigns and initiatives that make the right people curious about Azumuta . Use data to get better. Track recruitment activity and pipeline performance, identify what is and isn’t working, and turn those insights into concrete improvements. 💜 What’s In It for You We’re a small team doing big things in a market that’s ready for change. Join us and you’ll have a real seat at the table, meaningful ownership, and the opportunity to shape the team behind Azumuta . That means: Impact from day one. The people you bring in will directly influence our growth, and your ideas will help shape how we recruit as we scale. Room to build. This isn’t a role where every process has already been defined. You’ll have the freedom to experiment, improve our sourcing approach, and help build a recruitment function that can grow with the company. A scale up environment with solid roots. Work in a fast paced international company where autonomy, ownership, and new ideas are genuinely encouraged. A fun, ambitious team. Join colleagues who are building Azumuta ’s next chapter together, with plenty of milestones and questionable dad jokes along the way. A visible role in our employer brand. Experience recruiting niche, specialist, or hard to find profiles , beyond standard SaaS or tech roles. When there’s no obvious talent pool, you know how to map the market and build a search strategy from scratch. A genuine hunter mindset . You enjoy research, outreach, experimentation, and the challenge of finding someone who isn’t sitting in every recruiter’s LinkedIn search. Strong judgment and curiosity. You ask the questions needed to really understand a role rather than simply working from a job description. A direct and transparent communication style . You give candidates and hiring managers the real picture, including when it isn’t necessarily what they want to hear. A strong sense of ownership . You manage your searches proactively, keep things moving, and don’t wait to be told what comes next. The ability to work autonomously and stay organized in a fast moving scale up environment where priorities can evolve quickly. Ready to find the people who will build what’s next? We’d love to hear from you. Send us a short note about why this role fits where you are in your career. No generic cover letter needed. We’d much rather hear from you. description: We are hiring a General Counsel , reporting to the Chief Operating Officer (COO). This role leads Canonical ’s global Legal and Compliance function. This is a unique opportunity for an exceptional and commercially-minded senior lawyer to lead the legal and compliance function of a profitable, fast-growing technology company that is privately held with the intention to list on a public exchange. We’re looking for someone with genuine fluency in the software industry and in open source dynamics, who can translate that insight into clear positions on licensing, commercial contracts and risk, and hands-on execution. Reporting directly to the Chief Operating Officer, you will own Canonical 's legal, regulatory and governance posture and lead a distributed team across EMEA and the Americas. Your primary challenge will be to continue building both the team and the architecture: a management layer across two regions, and the governance, contracting and controls a public company needs, in an environment that regularly does things the industry has not done before. You will work closely with our product and engineering teams on licensing and IP questions, with the security function on customer assurance, and you will advise the Board and its committees directly. In our selection process, we prioritize intellect and judgement alongside depth of practice. We are looking for someone with a strong academic background, an active licence to practice, and demonstrable exposure to a multilayered global operational environment. Location: This role will be based remotely in EMEA time zones. The role entails Leading the global Legal and Compliance function: setting it's structure, standards and priorities across EMEA and the Americas. Building and managing a management capability: hire and develop managers, set objectives, review performance against a clear bar, and address under-performance directly. Setting the operating cadence of the function: intake and prioritization of legal work, service expectations with internal clients, and reporting on workload and risk to the leadership team. Owning public-market readiness on the legal side: corporate governance, group and entity structure, delegated authority, policies, disclosure controls and records, in partnership with Finance. Advising the CEO, COO, CFO and the Board, and supporting in Board and committee meetings. Owning the commercial contracting framework: standard templates, negotiating positions, and a deviation and escalation process that makes commitments visible before they are signed. Leading intellectual property and open source licensing strategy, including copyleft, trademark and the terms on which Ubuntu and our products are distributed. Owning the global compliance programme: data protection and privacy, export controls and trade compliance, anti-bribery and corruption, competition and AI regulation. Managing litigation, disputes and regulatory engagement, together with the external counsel panel, its budget and its quality. Advising on M&A, partnerships, strategic alliances and financing as the company grows. What we are looking for in you An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university. A degree in law, or equivalent, and an active licence to practice in an EMEA or Americas jurisdiction. Substantial senior in-house experience in a global technology or software business. Proven experience leading a distributed legal team, including managing managers across regions and time zones. A track record of setting and holding a high performance bar: hiring well, developing people, and dealing with under performance directly rather than waiting it out. Experience building or restructuring an in-house legal function, including deciding what is retained, delegated and sent to external counsel. Technology related experience of: negotiating and owning commercial technology contracts, including enterprise software and subscriptions, channel and reseller agreements, hardware manufacturer agreements, cloud and services advising on open source licensing, including permissive and copyleft licences, and familiarity with how open source communities operate. Experience of, or demonstrable readiness for, public company governance: listing preparation, board and committee support, disclosure and controls. Depth in at least two of: data protection and privacy, IP and trademark, export controls and trade, competition, or disputes. Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, hold colleagues accountable, and share ideas without hesitation. Professional written and spoken English with excellent drafting and presentation skills. Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability. International travel two to four times a year for company events up to two weeks long. Nice-to-have skills Experience taking a company through an IPO, or practicing as counsel inside a listed company. A technical or engineering background, or fluency in how software is built and shipped. Experience of a subscription or recurring-revenue business model. Experience building or restructuring an in-house legal function. A qualification in more than one jurisdiction. What we offer colleagues We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally. Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person. Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year. Bi-annual compensation review. Company recognition rewards. 40 days annual leave per annum, including public holidays and our All Company holiday periods. Maternity and paternity leave. Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform. Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues, with Priority Pass for lounge access. About Canonical Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. We are founder-led, profitable, and growing. Powered by worldwide distributed collaboration since our inception in 2004, we believe tech and business leadership can emerge anywhere. We have no central headquarters. Most of us work from home, but we are exceptionally disciplined about this. We have very high expectations of all colleagues, and are champions of excellence. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical is an equal opportunity employer We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration. description: Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing. We are hiring a C++/Rust Graphics and Windowing System Software Engineer. We build Mir – a high-performance, high-efficiency technology stack for window managers, display subsystems and solutions built on top of it, like Ubuntu Frame. Leading with vision, we shape the technology stack that empowers communities to realize a world where apps work seamlessly in every graphical environment. Our goal is to enable the whole spectrum of graphics from single-purpose screens through edge devices to full desktop environments. We also set the pace for graphics enablement across the Ubuntu certified hardware ecosystem. Our daily drill includes design, development and testing of features as well as working with the community and responding to issues and user inquiries. Most of the software is written in C++, with support tooling in scripting languages. We will use Rust as an evolutionary step forward. Thus candidates are required to have strong skills in both Rust and C++. We're growing the team and looking for new colleagues who share our passion for precision, performance and user experience. We are hiring on various career levels with a minimum of 2 years industry experience. We are looking for people who ideally have experience in building window compositing systems or graphics device experience. We're committed to creating an outstanding developer experience, secure foundations, and easy access to today's most used graphics toolkits and libraries. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who wants to have a meaningful impact on modern display technologies that will impact millions of developers and users. Canonical offers a fast-paced team environment and a career full of learning and development opportunities across the open source spectrum. Location: This role will be based remotely in the EMEA or APAC region. The role entails Design and implementation of features across the Mir stack Assisting in debugging, tracking down and fixing issues Participating in our engineering process through code and architectural review Creating and improving tests and performance benchmarks to catch issues early Creating and maintaining documentation to enhance the developer experience Engaging with the open source community and commercial partners Collaborating proactively with a distributed team What we are looking for in you Excellent Bachelor’s or equivalent degree in Computer Science, STEM or similar and 2+ years of working experience Excellent modern C++ and excellent Rust programming skills Familiarity with Linux as a development and deployment platform Ability to collaborate remotely with a diverse set of team members and remain highly motivated, productive, and organized Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long Nice-to-have skills You have experience with the Wayland protocol ecosystem and compositors You are familiar with OpenGL, Vulkan, Flutter and other graphics, toolkits and animation frameworks You have a solid understanding of asynchronous programming and concurrency patterns You have proven ability to consistently deliver robust code to production You have strong written and verbal communication skills to document and present software developed What we offer colleagues We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. description: At Novakid, we are on a mission to build the world’s best online education platform for children. With over 100,000 students and 4,000 teachers, Novakid is already one of the most popular language learning platforms for children aged 4–12 across Europe and Asia. About the role We are building a new interactive entertainment project for families (parents + children) — with YouTube as the main platform and content home. Short-form content (TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts) will serve as the acquisition engine: hooks, teasers, cliffhangers, and emotional moments designed to drive viewers to the main YouTube episodes. You will own the creative direction for both long-form and short-form — ensuring every piece of content works together as a system, not separately. Before we invest in full production, we will first test concepts using short-form content to measure audience demand, engagement, and intent to watch longer episodes. Cultural & Audience Insight Ensure concepts resonate with parents culturally and emotionally, with a focus on the TR market Anticipate cross-cultural interpretation, humor, and sensitivity Keep Novakid relevant to real parent conversations, not marketing narratives What you have done before (real experience we need) You have concepted and led production of long-form YouTube content (8–20+ min) — episodic, story-driven, with clear hooks and payoff. You have successfully repurposed long-form content into short-form trailers/teasers that drove measurable traffic back to YouTube. You have tested content concepts using only short-form (TikTok, Reels, Shorts) before investing in full episodes — and can show examples of how you made that decision. You understand YouTube organic metrics (CTR, retention, AVD) and short-form metrics (completion rate, shares, comments) — and how they relate. You have worked on projects with participatory or community elements (even simple ones like comments shaping next steps). Key responsibilities YouTube first: Everything starts with the long-form episode. Short-form serves it, not the other way around. Test fast: Use short-form to validate concepts before building full episodes. Own the creative vision from title/thumbnail to final frame of each episode. Collaborate with production teams but stay responsible for viral instincts and audience psychology. Analyze performance across both formats and iterate quickly. Requirements Must-have qualifications Portfolio with long-form YouTube content you concepted (show retention, CTR, or growth if possible). Proven ability to drive traffic from short-form to long-form (examples required). Deep understanding of TikTok, Reels, and YouTube Shorts as acquisition tools, not standalone entertainment. Obsessed with hooks, pacing, cliffhangers, and payoff. Strong interest in parenting, family dynamics, or human stories involving children Requirements: Experience leading video projects from concept to final delivery. Experience with family, parenting, or kids content. Basic editing or thumbnail design sense. Experience building a YouTube channel (other Social Media channels) from zero. C1 level English We offer: Opportunity to work in an innovative, fast-growing edtech company. A creative and collaborative work environment. Comprehensive professional development and leadership growth opportunities. The chance to have a meaningful impact on the lives of young learners around the world. 100% Remote work Unlimited holidays Bonuses and stock options Highlights Originally posted on Himalayas

description: At Sword, we’re building AI to heal billions and unlock humanity’s full potential. In doing so, we’re pioneering AI Care, a fundamentally new approach to healthcare built for medical reasoning, safety, and real-time treatment, not generic technology applied after the fact. As both a clinical-centric frontier AI lab and an applied AI platform, Sword is reimagining how care is delivered at scale, removing traditional barriers like appointments, waiting rooms, and stigma so more people can access the care they need—and ultimately get back to lives lived in full. Since 2020, Sword has expanded across physical therapy, women’s health, cardiometabolic, and mental health, and is now moving beyond the session to a fully AI-native, 24/7 care program that brings physical activity, therapeutic exercise, psychotherapy, nutrition, and behavior change into one connected experience. More than 700,000 members across three continents have completed over 10 million AI sessions, helping 1,000+ enterprise clients avoid more than $1 billion in unnecessary healthcare costs. Backed by 42 clinical studies, 44+ patents, and more than $500 million raised from leading investors including Khosla Ventures, General Catalyst, and Founders Fund, Sword is defining a new standard for healthcare. AI Proficiency at Sword AI fluency is a core expectation at Sword. Every candidate is assessed against our three-level framework — be ready to share real examples of how AI is already part of how you work. Explorer (Level 1) — Uses AI daily to boost personal productivity Builder (Level 2) — Creates workflows and tools that elevate the whole team Integrator (Level 3) — Embeds AI into products and processes at scale Every hire must demonstrate at least Level 1. The expected level will vary depending on the seniority of the role. As a Senior Backend Engineer in Consumer Growth at Sword, you’ll build the services that help people discover our products, become paying members, experience value, and stay engaged over time. Working closely with Product, Design, Data, Marketing, and mobile engineers, you’ll turn growth opportunities into reliable, measurable product experiences. Your work will span acquisition integrations, onboarding, subscriptions, and retention, combining rapid experimentation with the engineering foundations needed to scale successful ideas. What you’ll be doing: Design, build, and operate backend services and APIs supporting the consumer journey across web, Android, and iOS; Build subscription and payment capabilities, including checkout integrations, purchase-to-account linking, entitlements, renewals, and subscription lifecycle events; Enable targeted experiences and controlled experiments through feature flags, cohort targeting, and reliable experiment assignment; Implement trustworthy event instrumentation and integrations that help teams understand acquisition sources, funnel performance, and customer behavior; Partner with Product and Data to clarify hypotheses, define measurement requirements, and assess results after launch; Improve performance and reliability across critical journeys, with particular attention to payment correctness, data consistency, and failure recovery; Own changes through design, implementation, testing, deployment, monitoring, and iteration; Use AI tools to accelerate development and troubleshooting while taking responsibility for correctness, security, and maintainability. What you need to have: Experience building and operating backend services in production, with strong experience in TypeScript; Strong foundations in API design, relational databases, data modeling, and automated testing; Understanding of asynchronous processing and distributed systems, including retries, idempotency, and consistency; Ability to translate product goals into pragmatic technical solutions and make clear trade-offs between speed and long-term maintainability; Familiarity with product analytics and experimentation, including how instrumentation affects the reliability of results; Experience diagnosing production issues using logs, metrics, and tracing; Clear communication, a collaborative approach, and the ability to take ownership in an evolving environment; Practical experience using AI in your engineering workflow and critically reviewing its output; Fluent English, written and spoken. Nice To Have: Experience with consumer subscriptions, payment providers, or entitlement systems; Experience with experimentation platforms, attribution, or lifecycle messaging; Familiarity with Go, cloud infrastructure, and event-driven architectures. *The range below reflects base, variable, and equity for this role. Day to day, you will balance setting direction with staying close to the work: prioritizing risk with Engineering and IT, guiding audit and certification cycles, coaching a small and talented team, and joining customer conversations where security is part of the buying decision. Carrot has already earned SOC 2 Type II, HIPAA, HITRUST, and PCI DSS compliance, so this role is about taking a strong foundation to the next level of maturity, not starting from scratch. What makes this role different is the combination of stakes and influence. Few security leaders get to protect data this personal, at global scale, while working directly with executive leadership and shaping how a health platform is built, sold, and trusted. What You’ll Own 💼 In this role, you will: Lead Carrot's security strategy and roadmap, using a recognized maturity model (such as C2M2 or NIST CSF) to prioritize investments and report progress to executive leadership Own the full security program across corporate security (GRC, incident management, security awareness, third-party risk) and product security (application security, cloud and infrastructure security, secure SDLC) Partner with Engineering, especially the Internal Platform team, to build security into how Carrot designs, ships, and operates its systems, going beyond compliance Lead internal risk assessments across application, cloud, and corporate environments and turn the results into prioritized technical safeguards Own the compliance portfolio, including SOC 2 Type II, HITRUST, PCI DSS, and HIPAA, and prepare Carrot for additional frameworks such as ISO 27001 as the business requires Direct incident response readiness, including playbooks, tabletop exercises, executive communication, and post-incident learning Represent Carrot's security posture to employers, health plans, and health systems through security reviews, questionnaires, and strategic sales conversations Work with Legal and Privacy to meet global data protection requirements (HIPAA, GDPR, CCPA/CPRA) for member health data Build, coach, and grow the security team, balancing hands-on execution with delegation as the team scales Manage the security budget, tooling, and vendor relationships, and tailor security guidance for a remote-first workforce and physical offices What Success Looks Like 📈 In your first 12–18 months, you will have: A documented, executive-endorsed security strategy and multi-year roadmap with clear priorities, owners, and measures of progress Clean outcomes on recurring audits and certifications (SOC 2 Type II, HITRUST, PCI DSS), with remediation items closed on schedule A tested incident response program, with regular tabletop exercises completed and lessons learned built back into the program A measurable reduction in high-risk vulnerabilities and open security findings, with remediation timelines agreed on with Engineering A living risk register and vendor security review process that leaders rely on to make decisions A security team with defined roles, clear growth paths, and the right capacity for Carrot's growth, including key hires made Faster, more consistent security reviews for Sales and Customer Success, with fewer escalations from enterprise customers A clear plan, and visible progress, on any additional frameworks the business prioritizes, such as ISO 27001 About You ✨ You likely have: A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent experience) 10+ years of experience in technology, including 5+ years in information security and at least 3 years leading security teams A security certification such as CISSP or CISM Experience leading the security function at a late-stage startup, scale-up, or public company Working depth in healthcare data protection and privacy frameworks, including HIPAA, GDPR, and CCPA/CPRA Experience overseeing enterprise frameworks and audits such as SOC 2 Type II, HITRUST, PCI DSS, and ISO 27001 Strong knowledge of application, network, and cloud security (AWS and Azure) and frameworks such as NIST CSF and OWASP Experience running core security programs, including incident response, risk management, vulnerability management, penetration testing, and security awareness Executive-level communication skills and confidence engaging customers and sales teams on security requirements Experience managing budget and allocating resources across people, tools, and vendors Nice to Have ⭐ While not required, we would be especially excited if you bring: Experience leading security through a major company event such as an IPO, acquisition, or large-scale audit cycle A background in healthcare, digital health, or another highly regulated, high-trust environment Experience leading security in a remote-first, globally distributed company Familiarity with compliance automation platforms such as Drata Experience building a security engineering practice alongside platform and infrastructure teams Why This Role Matters 🧡 Members trust Carrot with some of the most personal information a person can share, often during some of the most meaningful moments of their lives. Protecting that trust is not a back-office function. It is what allows employers, health plans, and health systems to bring Carrot to millions of people worldwide. As Carrot grows, security leadership shapes how we build, how we sell, and how we show up for customers. In this role, you will make security a strength that members and customers can see and rely on, and build a team that keeps raising the bar as the business scales. This individual will also have consulting experience specific to the SPD and will oversee the successful implementation of surgical instrument management solutions across Integrated Delivery Networks (IDNs) and hospitals, directly managing a team of SPD Solutions Specialists and Technicians. This role requires regular travel to customer sites and a willingness to be hands-on in the field with teams and hospital partners. In This Position, You Will Have the Opportunity To Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team of SPD Solutions Specialists and Technicians, drawing on your own experience running SPD departments to provide credible, real-world direction, performance feedback, and development. Bring order and consistency to how Aspen implements IDN and hospital-level contracts — leaning up existing processes, eliminating inefficiencies, and building standardized, scalable playbooks that can be applied across multiple simultaneous projects. Lead regular team and stakeholder meetings to monitor project progress, resolve issues, and share insights. Ensure all direct reports meet hospital credentialing requirements and maintain professionalism in customer-facing, clinical environments. Demonstrated experience leading and developing people — you've built, managed, and grown teams, not just projects. Deep, working knowledge of SPD and/or OR workflows, instrumentation handling, and the operational pressures of a hospital sterile processing environment. A track record of taking inconsistent or informal processes and making them lean, standardized, and repeatable across multiple sites or projects at once. Bachelor's degree in Business, Healthcare Administration, or related field preferred; significant relevant SPD/OR leadership experience will be given equal weight in lieu of a degree. Prior experience with consulting engagements, IDN conversions and contract implementations strongly preferred. Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Salesforce, and relevant ERP/data systems. Strong leadership, organizational, and project/process management skills. Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the credibility to engage SPD and OR leadership as a peer.
