description: We are currently recruiting a Desk Director to join our Programs team. This is a remote position open to candidates based within the UTC+1 to UTC+4 time zones and requires up to 30% international travel. The role reports to the Director of Program Implementation and is a senior member of Relief International 's Programs team. At Relief International , we are committed to building a representative, inclusive and authentic workplace. We strongly encourage applications from candidates from minoritized backgrounds and those who bring lived experience of the contexts in which we work. We are proud to be a global recruiter, hiring people from around the world. We offer competitive salaries and benefit packages for all staff that are applied fairly and transparently. This means we are unable to advertise the salary as it is dependent on the local job market of the staff member. Shortlisted candidates will be informed of the salary range during the selection process. This role is classified as requiring enhanced pre-employment checks. About Relief International Relief International is an international non-profit organization that partners with communities impacted by conflict, climate change and disaster to save lives, build greater resilience and promote long-term health and wellbeing. Our teams work across Africa, Asia, and the Middle East, delivering Health and Nutrition, WASH, Protection, Education and Livelihoods programming that creates the foundation for resilient communities. Operating under a one-team model, Relief International brings together global expertise and local knowledge to deliver effective humanitarian and development programming in some of the world's most challenging environments. About the Opportunity As Desk Director, you will provide strategic oversight and leadership for a portfolio of up to seven country programmes with a combined annual portfolio value of approximately $60 million. You will directly manage Country Directors and lead a Desk Team responsible for supporting country operations, programme quality, donor engagement, risk management and organizational sustainability. The role sits at the intersection of strategy, operations and humanitarian leadership. You will work closely with Country Directors, the Resource Development team, Security, Finance, HR, Awards Management and senior organizational leadership to ensure that programmes are delivered safely, effectively and in compliance with donor and organizational requirements. You will be expected to navigate complex humanitarian crises, political volatility, donor expectations and operational risks while ensuring Relief International remains responsive, accountable and focused on delivering impact for the communities we serve. This is an exceptional opportunity for an experienced humanitarian leader who combines strategic vision with operational excellence and is passionate about strengthening country programmes, empowering leaders and driving organizational growth. Your Responsibilities This role includes the following responsibilities: Provide strategic leadership and oversight for a multi-country portfolio, ensuring alignment with Relief International 's global strategy, country priorities and donor expectations. Directly line manage Country Directors and the Desk Manager, providing leadership, coaching, accountability and support to drive high performance across the portfolio. Oversee programme quality, operational performance, financial management, compliance and security across all countries within the Desk portfolio. Ensure country programmes are delivering high-quality, timely and compliant services while effectively managing risk and maintaining strong donor confidence. Lead cross-functional coordination with Finance, HR, Security, Supply Chain & Operations, Awards Management and Technical teams to resolve challenges and improve programme performance. Support and guide donor engagement efforts, strategic positioning and business development initiatives to strengthen programme sustainability and portfolio growth. Provide oversight of proposal development processes, ensuring donor submissions are strategic, competitive, compliant and aligned with organizational priorities. Drive risk management across the portfolio, ensuring proactive identification and mitigation of operational, programmatic, security and reputational risks. Foster collaboration, innovation and knowledge sharing across countries and departments to strengthen learning and programme impact. Contribute as a senior leader within the Program Implementation Department, helping shape organizational strategy, priorities and continuous improvement initiatives. About You You will bring the following experience, skills and leadership qualities: Master's degree in International Development, Political Science, Social Sciences or a related field. Significant senior leadership experience within humanitarian and development organizations, including multi-country, regional or global management responsibilities. Demonstrated success managing large and complex donor-funded portfolios across fragile, conflict-affected and rapidly changing environments. Strong experience working with major institutional donors including BHA, PRM, ECHO, UN agencies and other international funding bodies. Excellent understanding of programme cycle management, programme quality standards, compliance frameworks and risk management systems. Exceptional leadership and people management skills, with experience coaching senior leaders and building high-performing teams across multiple locations. Proven ability to influence, negotiate and collaborate effectively with donors, partners, boards, senior executives and cross-functional teams. Strong strategic thinking and decision-making skills, with the ability to balance operational realities, humanitarian imperatives and organizational objectives. Excellent written and spoken English. French and/or Arabic language skills are highly desirable. Experience in localization, partnership strengthening, climate resilience or nexus programming would be an advantage. How To Apply To apply for this post, click on the Apply button in the job advert page. You will be asked to upload a CV and Cover Letter. The cover letter should be one page and explain why you are interested in this post with Relief International and how your skills and experience make you a strong fit for the role. Closing Date Monday 14 September As a humanitarian organization, Relief International is committed to safeguarding all those we come into contact with through our work. We are committed to the core humanitarian principles regarding the prevention of sexual exploitation, abuse and harassment. Relief International expects all staff and volunteers to share this commitment and uphold the values and behaviours outlined in our Code of Conduct. Recruitment to all roles at Relief International includes references, a criminal records self-declaration and other pre-employment checks, which may include police and qualification checks. Due to the nature of this role, applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis and the position may be filled before the closing date. Early applications are strongly encouraged. title: Senior / Principal Consultant – Quality (m/w/d)
description: ihre aufgaben Sie kennen die Qualitätswelt der Pharmaindustrie aus erster Hand und möchten mit Ihrer Arbeit wirklich etwas bewegen? Bei MAIN5 unterstützen Sie führende Pharma- und Life-Sciences-Unternehmen dabei, ihr Qualitätsmanagement fit für die Zukunft zu machen – von der Transformation von Qualitätsmanagementsystemen über eQMS-Implementierungen bis hin zur Digitalisierung von Prozessen und allem, was dazugehört. Je nach Ihrer Erfahrung steigen Sie bei uns als Senior Consultant oder Principal Consultant ein. Gemeinsam finden wir im Bewerbungsprozess heraus, welche Rolle am besten zu Ihnen passt. Ihre Aufgaben Leiten Sie Projekte, die wirklich etwas bewegen: Sie beraten unsere Kunden bei der Konzeption, Optimierung und Digitalisierung von Qualitätsmanagementsystemen und qualitätsrelevanten Geschäftsprozessen – von der QMS-Strategie über die eQMS-Implementierung bis hin zum Go-live auf Veeva Vault Quality und anderen führenden Plattformen. Übernehmen Sie Verantwortung für Ihre Ergebnisse: Als Senior Consultant steuern Sie eigenständig Arbeitspakete, Teilprojekte sowie kleinere bis mittelgroße Kundenprojekte. Als Principal Consultant verantworten Sie komplexe Projekte und Programmteile über den gesamten Projektlebenszyklus hinweg – von der Analyse und Konzeption bis zur Implementierung und dem Go-live. Sorgen Sie dafür, dass Veränderungen nachhaltig wirken: Sie analysieren bestehende Strukturen und Prozesse, erkennen Optimierungspotenziale und entwickeln gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden nachhaltige Lösungen. Außerdem stellen Sie sicher, dass neue Prozesse, Methoden und digitale Tools dauerhaft in der Organisation verankert werden. Seien Sie die Person, der unsere Kunden vertrauen: Sie sind auf Projektebene die zentrale Ansprechperson und arbeiten an der Schnittstelle zwischen Fachbereichen, IT und Management. Sie leiten Workshops, führen Interviews und übersetzen die Anforderungen interdisziplinärer Teams in praxistaugliche Konzepte. Gestalten Sie Compliance praxisnah: Sie beraten zu regulatorischen Anforderungen und Best Practices im Life-Sciences-Umfeld und entwickeln pragmatische Lösungen, die regulatorischen Anforderungen gerecht werden. Gestalten Sie unser Wachstum mit: Sie bringen Ihre Erfahrung in Presales-Aktivitäten, Angebotserstellungen und die Weiterentwicklung unseres Beratungsportfolios ein. Als Principal Consultant übernehmen Sie mit unserer Unterstützung Schritt für Schritt mehr Verantwortung für Kundenbeziehungen und die Geschäftsentwicklung. Teilen Sie Ihr Wissen: Sie unterstützen die fachliche Weiterentwicklung unserer Consultants, engagieren sich in unseren Communities of Practice und gestalten unser Beratungsangebot im Bereich Quality aktiv mit. Zeigen Sie Präsenz in der Branche: Sie repräsentieren MAIN5 auf Konferenzen, Kundenveranstaltungen und Branchenevents. ihr profil Ihr Profil Sie haben ein abgeschlossenes Studium der Life Sciences, Pharmazie, Informatik oder eines vergleichbaren Fachgebiets oder verfügen über eine vergleichbare Qualifikation mit einschlägiger Berufserfahrung. Fundierte Erfahrung im Qualitätsmanagement: Sie verfügen über mehrere Jahre Erfahrung in der Pharma- oder Life-Sciences-Branche oder in der Beratung mit klarem Schwerpunkt auf Qualitätsprozessen, Qualitätssystemen und GxP-Anforderungen. Wie umfangreich Ihre Erfahrung ist, entscheidet darüber, ob Sie als Senior oder Principal Consultant einsteigen. Praktische Erfahrung mit eQMS – insbesondere Veeva Vault Quality: Sie haben mit eQMS-Plattformen in Implementierungs-, Migrations- oder Optimierungsprojekten gearbeitet, idealerweise mit Veeva Vault Quality (z. B. QMS oder QualityDocs). Außerdem sind Sie in der GxP-Welt zu Hause – von GMP und behördlichen Anforderungen bis hin zu Qualitätsstandards und Best Practices der Branche. Ein echtes Beratungs-Toolkit: Strukturiertes Problemlösen, Prozessanalyse, Projektmanagement, Workshop-Moderation und Stakeholder-Management gehören für Sie zum Arbeitsalltag und sind weit mehr als Schlagworte im Lebenslauf. Sicheres Auftreten beim Kunden: Sie vermitteln komplexe Themen verständlich, gehen souverän mit anspruchsvollen Stakeholdern um und behalten auch dann den Überblick, wenn sich Prioritäten ändern. Für die Position als Principal Consultant: Sie haben Freude an der geschäftlichen Seite der Beratung. Kundenbeziehungen weiterzuentwickeln und neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten zu erschließen, ist für Sie der natürliche nächste Schritt. Sie verfügen über fließende Englischkenntnisse; Deutschkenntnisse sind von Vorteil, aber keine Voraussetzung. Sie arbeiten gerne remote und wissen, wie Sie auch in einem verteilten Team gut vernetzt bleiben und erfolgreich zusammenarbeiten. warum wir? Warum MAIN5? Projekte & Umfeld Sie arbeiten an Projekten mit echtem Mehrwert für führende Pharmaunternehmen in einem internationalen Umfeld, in dem Qualitätsexpertise auf Technologie trifft. Unser Team vereint Menschen aus vielen unterschiedlichen Kulturen, die gemeinsam Lösungen entwickeln, welche die Branche nachhaltig prägen. Team & Kultur Es erwartet Sie ein motiviertes Team, das Sie vom ersten Tag an unterstützt. Wir kommunizieren offen und auf Augenhöhe und arbeiten – und feiern – gerne gemeinsam. Wir arbeiten überwiegend remote, aber persönlicher Austausch ist uns wichtig: Mindestens zweimal im Jahr kommt das gesamte Team zu Workshops, Events und gemeinsamen Feiern zusammen, die unsere Unternehmenskultur lebendig machen. Entwicklung & Perspektiven Wir investieren in Ihre Zukunft: mit einem strukturierten Onboarding, vielfältigen Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und unseren Dine & Learn-Sessions – einer entspannten Gelegenheit, Wissen zu teilen und aktuelle Themen gemeinsam zu vertiefen. Durch unsere internationale Ausrichtung arbeiten Sie länderübergreifend und erweitern Ihren Horizont kontinuierlich. Benefits, die wirklich zählen Remote-first und zwar konsequent: Arbeiten Sie dort, wo Sie am produktivsten sind. Familienfreundlich von Anfang an: Flexible Arbeitszeiten, die sich Ihrem Leben anpassen – nicht umgekehrt. Ob Schulabholung, Arzttermin oder konzentrierter Vormittag: Sie gestalten Ihren Arbeitstag selbst. Eine Arbeitskultur auf Augenhöhe: Wir stellen erfahrene Menschen ein und schenken ihnen Vertrauen. Eigenverantwortung ist für uns wichtiger als Mikromanagement. Der Mensch steht im Mittelpunkt: Offene Kommunikation, ein Team, das zusammenhält, und Führungskräfte, die zuhören. Ein attraktives Gesamtpaket: Freuen Sie sich auf eine attraktive Vergütung mit Bonusmöglichkeiten sowie moderne Arbeitsausstattung – ganz gleich, wo Sie arbeiten. Klingt das nach Ihnen? Dann freuen wir uns darauf, Sie kennenzulernen! Originally posted on Himalayas

description: About AllShore Talent AllShore Talent partners with growing organizations to build high-performing technology and consulting teams. We connect skilled professionals with meaningful, long-term engagements across web technologies, digital experience platforms, and enterprise software delivery — offering competitive compensation, flexible engagement models, and a collaborative, remote-friendly culture. About the Role Adobe Workflows, API Integration and Digital Media AllShore Tallent is seeking a mid-to-senior QA Engineer specializing in creative automation to validate end-to-end creative automation and digital media production workflows. The role spans Airtable intake and status control, AWS orchestration, Adobe Photoshop APIs, and review and approval. The current use case focuses on static banners and Photoshop outputs, with motion graphics and video workflows in the pipeline, including one moving into implementation. The ideal candidate brings a methodical approach to tracing distributed workflows, finding edge cases, maintaining state integrity, and verifying data isolation, with a background in digital media workflow engineering, ad-tech production pipelines, creative automation, or cloud-native integration QA. Key responsibilities · Validate asynchronous, event-driven pipelines in which intake actions trigger background state machines and webhooks. Trace the complete flow from Airtable through AWS and Photoshop APIs to Frame.io. · Verify idempotency, de-duplication, race-condition handling, and queue throttling, including duplicate Frame.io Approved webhooks. · Test recovery from network interruptions, expired tokens, corrupt or oversized source media, missing manifest keys, and simulated API service limits. Verify circuit breaker thresholds, queue pausing, slot release, and manual or administrator recovery. · Design deterministic cache lifecycle tests that distinguish reusable asset-level caches (Creative/DMC) from isolated template-level manifests. Confirm that template timestamp changes and asset re-uploads invalidate caches correctly and prevent stale file delivery. · Reconcile assets, folders, and version stacks. Test URL-encoded filenames, duplicate same-name folder structures, version stack collisions, and protection of active in-progress uploads from deletion. · Validate AI cropping and graphical transformations across human and non-human subjects in landscape and portrait source files. Assess bounding-box and focal-point detection, identify unnecessary Firefly Generative Expand versus appropriate native cropping, and verify masks preserve native boundaries. · Inspect typography, font substitutions, leading, multi-line wrapping, bold ranges, safe-zone margins, CTA button bounds, disclaimer visibility, and ratings bug placement across aspect ratios. · Document reproducible, step-level defects in Jira Cloud with complete asset and log context, and evaluate results against acceptance criteria associated with Epics, Stories, and Bugs. Requirements Required qualifications and technical skills QA experience: Mid-to-senior QA engineering experience aligned with digital media workflow engineering, ad-tech production pipelines, creative automation, or cloud-native integration QA. Strong end-to-end troubleshooting, edge-case testing, state integrity, and data isolation skills. Airtable: Practical understanding of field types, formulas, automations, and trigger actions. Ability to validate Action = Execute and Automation Status transitions from Pending to Queued to In Progress to Review, Approved, or Finalizing. Experience checking field hygiene, null and fallback values such as NA, Automation Version Stack ID tracking, and Invalidate Asset Cache and Creative Allocation overrides : Strong practical knowledge of as an automated review and approval surface, including version stacking, Approved asset status hooks, share-link generation, and structural validation. Experience with API authentication nuances, including server-to-server (S2S) authentication and workarounds, custom headers, and rate-limiting behavior. Adobe Photoshop and imaging APIs: Solid conceptual understanding of artboards, smart objects, layer hierarchies and masks, text layers, typography leading and sizing, and bounds calculation. Familiarity with Adobe Photoshop APIs and smart-object replacement mechanics. Ability to inspect and validate PSD/PSB, JPG, PNG, and GIF outputs, including raster and animated renditions as applicable. AWS orchestration and observability: Comfort navigating SQS queues, DynamoDB locking and slot tracking, Step Functions / state machines, Lambda, and S3 asset storage and overwrite behavior. Ability to trace execution logs, correlation IDs, and failure payloads to distinguish upstream intake errors, service timeouts, and circuit breaker trip states. Workflow reliability: Experience testing asynchronous and event-driven systems, webhook de-duplication, idempotency, concurrency, throttling, resilience, circuit breakers, layered caching and invalidation, and asset and folder synchronization edge cases. Visual quality assurance: Understanding of bounding-box and focal-point detection, native cropping, Firefly Generative Expand, and mask boundaries. A keen eye for digital display production and design standards across multiple output formats and aspect ratios. Jira Cloud: Deep comfort working with Epics, Stories, Bugs, acceptance criteria, and detailed, reproducible defect reports supported by assets and logs. Preferred skills Familiarity with Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, Motion Graphics templates (MoGRTs), Adobe Media Encoder with particular emphasis on presets, and video codecs, output formats, and resolutions to support upcoming motion graphics and video use cases. title: VFX Compositor (Talent Pool)
description: Please note, this listing is not for an immediate open position but for our Talent Pool for VFX Compositors. Grip is looking for a VFX Compositor to support the on-set and VFX production for our clients! An exciting opportunity as you’ll be working with some of our biggest clients, travelling around the world to be present during shooting and filming. You are hands-on and have experience in editing, effects, and compositing software. You are operationally involved in VFX production and are able to combine all elements (Live action, 2D, and 3D) that make one shot as if they naturally belong in one space and balance between the creative and technical side of each component. What is Grip? With the help of Grip, companies such as L'Oréal, Coca-Cola and Beiersdorf are automating content production for their entire business. Grip moves classic creation and production efforts into the cloud, where a software solution takes care of generating high-quality visuals, at scale, on-demand and based on data. Brand styles, as well as product look and feel are codified, which ensures an entirely consistent, always on-brand output, no matter who (or what) requests it. In the few years since we launch, more than 50% of the biggest FMCG / CPG companies started working with Grip. We grow fast as we build a product that changes the whole industry - and the next one after What will you be doing? Composite 3D products into live-action footage, matching lighting, reflections, shadows, colour, focus, motion blur, and grain. Adapt product packaging, labels, pack sizes, and liquid colours for different markets, using approved artwork and product references. Replace products while keeping hands, people, and the original footage looking natural. Work on tracking, rotoscoping, keying, paint work, and cleanup, rebuilding backgrounds where needed. Use render passes and Cryptomattes to refine product materials, reflections, transparency, and lighting. Keep product shapes, label placement, colours, and materials accurate across all shots and market versions. Build organised compositing setups that can be reused and updated across multiple adaptations. Work within GRIP’s pipeline, following file naming, versioning, colour management, and delivery requirements. Check every shot for visual and technical issues, including single-frame errors, missing masks, flickering, and render inconsistencies. Work closely with 3D artists, editors, project managers, and VFX supervisors to deliver shots that match the brief and approved master. Apply feedback consistently across versions, flag issues early, and deliver on schedule. Find practical and creative solutions that respect the client’s vision and project deadlines. Support shoots by making sure the required plates, HDRIs, camera information, and references are captured. Requirements Would be amazing if you have: A background in VFX compositing, knowledge of 3D, and an understanding of photography and cameras. At least 5–7 years of hands-on experience with Nuke, with strong technical skills in node-based compositing and building organised, efficient, reusable node setups. Ideally, 3–5 years of experience with After Effects. Experience with product replacement, advertising, and adapting content for different markets. Strong skills in tracking, rotoscoping, keying, cleanup, and integrating CG into live-action footage. An understanding of 3D rendering workflows, render passes, Cryptomattes, and 2D and 3D tracking. Experience managing multiple shots and versions while keeping quality consistent. Confidence working with clients and creative teams. Fast, reliable internet, a powerful computer that can handle 4K footage, and enough storage for large project files. Experience planning VFX before a shoot, including tracking markers, green screens, stand-in objects, and cleanup requirements. Experience supporting shoots and guiding the capture of clean plates, hand plates, 360° HDRIs, and reference images. Flexibility to travel when needed. Why Join Grip? The Platform Position. Grip is infrastructure for enterprise creative production—powering content generation across global brands with strict quality requirements. The Market Timing. AI is increasing content volume exponentially. The bottleneck is no longer creation—it’s maintaining quality at scale. The Technical Moat. A multi-tenant platform combining AI workflow orchestration, ComfyUI integrations, and production-grade pipelines across TypeScript, Python, Elixir, and C#. The Work. You define what “quality” means in a system generating thousands of assets—and ensure it holds under scale. The procedure If you’re ready to bring your powers to a role where you can make a difference, we want to hear from you. Send your resume and portfolio in English via the link provided. If you have questions, contact our Recruitment Department at . After reviewing your application, if there’s a potential fit, a member of our recruitment team will be in touch with you. title: Quality Engineering Lead (m/w/d)
description: Shopware ist ein führendes E-Commerce-System, das Unternehmen weltweit dabei unterstützt, im digitalen Handel schnell und effizient zu wachsen. Als zukunftsweisende Open-Source-Lösung wird Shopware bereits von einigen der größten europäischen Marken, Händlern und Herstellern im B2C- und B2B-Bereich eingesetzt. Als Quality Engineering Lead führst und entwickelst du ein Team von Quality Engineers und trägst dazu bei, die Zuverlässigkeit der Commerce-Plattform von Shopware zu verbessern. Du verbindest Mitarbeiterführung mit praktischer Arbeit in den Bereichen Testing und Automatisierung. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Engineering- und Produktteams zusammen, um Risiken frühzeitig zu erkennen und die Entwicklung sowie Veröffentlichung unserer Software kontinuierlich zu verbessern. Du übersetzt Unternehmensziele und Produktprioritäten in eine Quality-Engineering-Roadmap mit klaren und messbaren Verbesserungszielen. Du setzt Prioritäten, delegierst Aufgaben und stellst dich direkt komplexen Herausforderungen im Testing. Requirements Führe, unterstütze und entwickle das Team durch regelmäßiges Feedback, Mitarbeitergespräche und individuelle Karriereentwicklung. Unterstütze außerdem bei der Einstellung und beim Onboarding. Definiere gemeinsam mit den Engineering-Kolleg:innen die Teststrategie und Qualitätsstandards für die Produktteams. Priorisiere und verteile Quality-Engineering-Aufgaben entsprechend den Produktrisiken, Roadmap-Zielen und Teamkapazitäten. Arbeite aktiv an Testdesign, Testautomatisierung und explorativem Testing mit. Unterstütze bei der Analyse komplexer Fehler und validiere Änderungen, die mehrere Produktbereiche betreffen. Unterstütze Quality Engineers, Entwickler:innen und Product Manager teamübergreifend bei der Umsetzung der Teststrategie und dabei, Qualität frühzeitig in Planung und Entwicklung zu berücksichtigen. Verbessere Testwerkzeuge und -praktiken, einschließlich des verantwortungsvollen Einsatzes KI-gestützter Tests. Nutze Kundenprobleme, Fehler und die Zuverlässigkeit von Tests, um Verbesserungspotenziale zu identifizieren. Unterstütze Produkt-Releases, indem du Testergebnisse, verbleibende Risiken und eine klare Qualitätsempfehlung an die für den Release koordinierenden Kolleg:innen kommunizierst. Das bringst du mit: Erfahrung in der Führung eines technischen Teams, einschließlich Coaching, Performance-Gesprächen und individueller Weiterentwicklung. Praktische Erfahrung im Softwaretesting, in der Entwicklung von Teststrategien und in der Testautomatisierung, einschließlich Ansätzen wie End-to-End-, API-, Integrations- oder Komponententests. Erfahrung in der Definition und Präsentation von Qualitätsmetriken sowie darin, diese gemeinsam mit Testergebnissen und Risikobewertungen zu nutzen, um Lücken zu erkennen und Entscheidungen zu unterstützen. Die Fähigkeit, Prioritäten zu setzen, Aufgaben zu delegieren und effektiv mit Kolleg:innen aus den Bereichen Engineering und Produkt zusammenzuarbeiten. Sehr gute schriftliche und mündliche Englischkenntnisse sowie die Fähigkeit, technische Sachverhalte und Abwägungen verständlich zu erklären. Deutschkenntnisse sind nicht erforderlich. Hilfreich, aber nicht zwingend erforderlich Erfahrung im E-Commerce, mit Open-Source-Software, Cloud-Anwendungen, Upgrades und Migrationen sowie mit KI-gestützter Entwicklung und Testautomatisierung ist von Vorteil. Vorkenntnisse in Shopware sind nicht erforderlich. Wir begrüßen vielfältige Karrierewege und Perspektiven. Du musst nicht in allen genannten Bereichen Erfahrung haben, um dich zu bewerben. Erzähle uns, wie dich dein bisheriger Werdegang darauf vorbereitet hat, ein Team zu führen und die Softwarequalität zu verbessern. Das bieten wir dir: Unternehmenskultur: Offene Kultur, flache Hierarchien, Eigeninitiative wird gefördert. Arbeitsverträge: Unbefristete Anstellungen bieten langfristige Sicherheit. Flexibilität: Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Optionen für mobiles Arbeiten und Full-Remote-Verträge. Ausstattung: Freie Wahl der Arbeits-Hardware. Onboarding: Gut strukturiertes Onboarding mit Unterstützung durch einen persönlichen "Buddy". Arbeitsumfeld: Inspirierendes Umfeld mit engagierten Kollegen und einer dynamischen Gemeinschaft. Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten: Vielfältige Chancen für persönliches Wachstum und Entwicklung. Zusatzleistungen: Attraktive Benefits wie betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Gesundheitsprogramme und regelmäßige Teamevents. ... und vieles mehr! Einen detaillierten Einblick bekommst du auf unserer Karriereseite. Deine Ansprechperson für diese Stelle ist Yanina Schröer und steht dir bei Fragen gerne zur Verfügung! description: This role is part of our Central Platform Engineering Team at saas.group . What is saas.group ? Profile Overview Our Platform Engineering team runs central infrastructure services and partners with brands to modernize their stacks. The mission: provide a “paved road” of opinionated best practices (observability, backups, CI/CD, infra as code) that brands can adopt quickly, and support hands-on migrations when needed. You’ll own outcomes for a set of brands: assess where they are, recommend what “good” looks like, and implement the plan. The role blends architecture, enablement, and practical engineering. It’s senior and autonomous: you’ll advise and sometimes convince stakeholders, then deliver. Your immediate impact in the first 3-6 months will be: Complete central onboarding by pairing with a team member for ~2 weeks to learn our patterns and tooling, then start managing the brands assigned to you. Lead the onboarding of at least one brand to our “paved road” standards (GitHub org, CI/CD, monitoring/observability, IaC), with positive feedback from brand leadership and our team. Deliver one or more migrations/refactors (e.g., CI/CD, infra modernization, cost/availability improvements) and document decisions so others can build on them. Your responsibilities Lead infrastructure projects for assigned brands: migrations, performance & reliability improvements, incident response practices, containerization, and cloud cost optimizations. Establish/upgrade CI/CD, infra as code, monitoring, alerting, and SLO-aligned dashboards; baseline and improve reliability with data. Advise brand CTOs/engineering leads on trade-offs and architecture; justify decisions with clear reasoning and measurable outcomes. Contribute to and consume central services (e.g., observability, backups) so brands don’t reinvent the wheel. Collaborate with developers as part of the product team during engagements; troubleshoot across app and infra boundaries. Bring AI into the paved road itself: use tools like Claude Code or Codex daily to speed up IaC, scripting, and incident diagnosis, and help brand teams pick up the same habits in their own workflows. Participate in an on-call rotation (lightweight today; scaling toward a fair, shared model). What You bring to the table 5+ years of experience in Platform or Cloud Engineering, DevOps, or Site Reliability Engineering roles, operating at a senior level with strong ownership and autonomy. Deep expertise in at least one major cloud provider (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and practical experience with Infrastructure as Code (ideally Terraform). Solid understanding of CI/CD concepts and best practices; able to assess, design, and modernize pipelines across diverse brand environments. Experience with monitoring and observability tools (Datadog, New Relic, ELK, Prometheus, or similar) and sound judgment on what “good” looks like. Hands-on, daily use of AI coding tools (Claude Code, Codex, or similar) in real infra work, not just curiosity about them; comfortable coaching brand teams on how to use them well. A background in software development or the ability to read and debug application code. Excellent communication and consulting skills; confident in advising and influencing technical stakeholders while adapting to different teams and tech stacks. What’s in it for You Ultimate flexibility: We’re 100% remote. You can work from wherever you like, whenever you like. Freedom and autonomy: We’re a high-trust team, and you’ll be given lots of flexibility to solve problems in your own way — with plenty of help from the team when you need it. Minimum bureaucracy: We don’t like to get bogged down with meetings and red tape. We like to be efficient and keep momentum steady & sustainable. Small & friendly team: We help each other out, have fun, and joke around. Our network: We are a community of entrepreneurial SaaS professionals that regularly exchange ideas, knowledge, learning and expertise with each other internally. Flexible time off: We want you to recharge your batteries when needed. We don’t just simply offer you to “take a job with us” but rather to “join us on this journey” to build the world's largest platform of independent SaaS companies. Sounds like something you’re up for? Feel free to apply even if you don’t check all these boxes. We believe in the power of diversity and fresh perspectives to spice up our team. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you're passionate about working with a team that values innovation, excellence, and fairness, we encourage you to apply. We believe in fair and transparent pay. Salary ranges at saas.group are location-adjusted, targeting local market medians for a remote-first environment, and will be shared with our potential future employees in writing before your first interview - so you have everything you need to evaluate the opportunity. title: M&A Manager (m/f/d)
description: deine aufgaben Die Onepage GmbH ist ein AI-first-SaaS-Unternehmen mit 19.000 zahlenden Kunden und über 250.000 Usern und zählt damit zu den größten Plattformen im Bereich Web-Präsenz im deutschsprachigen Raum. Onepage ist gründergeführt, eigenfinanziert und profitabel, und wir starten gerade das nächste Kapitel: Aus Onepage wird eine Gruppe. Der Website-Builder bleibt unser Motor. Drumherum bauen wir ein Portfolio aus Software-Brands auf, die für unsere Zielgruppe – kleine und mittlere Unternehmen sowie Agenturen – relevant sind. Dafür bauen wir eine neue Funktion im Unternehmen auf – und suchen die Person, die sie gemeinsam mit uns aufbaut. Du arbeitest direkt mit dem CEO und dem Finance-Team, baust die Pipeline auf, bewertest Deals und pflegst den Kontakt zu Eigentümern potenzieller Targets. Du willst nicht nur Deals begleiten, sondern mitdenken, mitverhandeln und mitentscheiden? Komm als M&A Manager (m/w/d) an Bord! Deine Aufgaben Marktscreening & Target Identifikation: Du identifizierst potenzielle Übernahmekandidaten (Targets) und wertest diese gemeinsam mit unserem CEO und Finance-Team nach strategischen Kriterien aus. Deal-Flow & Pipeline: Du baust unseren Deal-Flow systematisch auf – über Direktansprache, Broker, Netzwerke und unser Ökosystem aus Kunden und Agenturpartnern – und hältst die Pipeline strukturiert nach. Austausch mit Targets: Du stehst im direkten Austausch mit Eigentümern und Management potenzieller Zielunternehmen und baust eine erste Gesprächsbasis auf. Deal-Analyse & Bewertung: Du erstellst gemeinsam mit dem Finance-Team Unternehmensbewertungen (u. a. DCF, Multiplikatorverfahren) und Business Cases für mögliche Transaktionen. Due Diligence: Du unterstützt bei der kaufmännischen, rechtlichen und steuerlichen Prüfung von Zielunternehmen – in Abstimmung mit CEO, Finance-Team und externen Beratern (Anwälte, Steuerberater, Wirtschaftsprüfer). Verhandlung & Strukturierung: Du bereitest Verhandlungen von Term Sheets, LOIs und Kaufverträgen mit vor und begleitest diese gemeinsam mit dem CEO. Transaktionsbegleitung: Du begleitest Transaktionen von der Anbahnung bis zum Signing/Closing in enger Abstimmung mit CEO und Finance. Post-Merger-Integration: Du unterstützt bei der Integrationsplanung nach erfolgtem Zukauf und entwickelst mit uns ein Integrations-Playbook, das wir Deal für Deal wiederverwenden. dein profil Berufserfahrung : Du hast mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in M&A, Investment Banking, Transaction Services, Corporate Finance oder Strategieberatung. Ausbildung : Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium in Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Finance oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich. Know-how : Du hast fundierte Kenntnisse in Unternehmensbewertung und Finanzmodellierung. SaaS-Verständnis : Du verstehst, wie Software-Unternehmen ticken – ARR, Net Revenue Retention, Churn, CAC – und kannst daraus eine Bewertungslogik ableiten. Erfahrung mit Buy-&-Build-Modellen oder Software-Deals ist ein großes Plus. Due Diligence : Du hast Erfahrung in der Durchführung oder Begleitung von Due-Diligence-Prozessen. Kommunikation : Du überzeugst durch verhandlungssicheres Auftreten und Kommunikationsstärke im Umgang mit Geschäftsführern und Eigentümern. Arbeitsweise : Du arbeitest selbstständig, strukturiert und mit hoher Eigeninitiative bei der aktiven Ansprache von Targets. Netzwerk : Idealerweise bringst du Kontakte in die Software-, Hosting- oder Agenturszene mit – oder die Fähigkeit, sie schnell aufzubauen. Sprachen : Du sprichst sehr gutes Deutsch und Englisch. worauf du dich freuen kannst: Aufbau-Rolle : Du bist die erste Person, die bei Onepage ausschließlich M&A macht. Prozesse, Tools und Playbook entstehen mit dir – nicht vor dir. Direkter Draht : Du arbeitest direkt mit dem CEO und dem Finance-Team, Entscheidungen fallen schnell. Sichtbarkeit : Deine Arbeit prägt, wie die Onepage -Gruppe in drei Jahren aussieht. Remote-First: Arbeite zu 100% remote und genieße maximale Flexibilität in deinem Arbeitsalltag. Gesundheit: Deine Gesundheit liegt uns am Herzen – wir unterstützen dich mit einer Zusatzkrankenversicherung sowie einem Zuschuss zu dem Gesundheitsprogramm von Wellhub. Nachhaltige Benefits: Erhalte attraktive Mitarbeiterrabatte in vielen Kategorien über FutureBens. Mitgestaltung & Entwicklung: Bringe deine Ideen aktiv ein, gestalte Prozesse mit und erweitere deine Fähigkeiten durch kontinuierliche Weiterbildung. Originally posted on Himalayas

title: Associate Product Manager- Real Time Payments
description: Bold Nuestra compañía fue fundada en Mayo de 2019 por un equipo de personas increíbles y con una experiencia única, el grupo de fundadores está conformado por los creadores de PayU Latam y otras empresas expertas en tecnología financiera. Estamos creando soluciones de pago y de banca para MiPymes, independientes y emprendedores en Colombia. Actualmente contamos con más de 450.000 clientes registrados en nuestra plataforma y hemos recibido más de USD $120 millones de fondos de inversión nacionales y extranjeros, somos una de las startups de más rápido crecimiento en LatAm en el sector fintech. Bold es una fintech que provee una solución de pagos a los microempresarios para recibir pagos con tarjetas débito, crédito y billeteras a través de datáfonos y links de pago. Sin embargo, la visión de Bold es más ambiciosa que ser una empresa de pagos y estamos trabajando para volvernos una plataforma de servicios financieros y tecnológicos para las pequeñas empresas en el país complementando las soluciones de pagos y banca con otros productos de software conexos a toda nuestra propuesta de valor. Nuestra misión en Bold es liberar el potencial de los emprendedores. En Bold creemos firmemente que podemos ayudar a los pequeños emprendedores a desarrollar sus negocios ofreciendo servicios financieros y tecnológicos hechos a su medida, que sean amigables y cercanos. En Bold definimos los siguientes valores como los pilares de nuestra cultura organizacional: Maestría, Pensamiento crítico, Trabajo en equipo, Sentido de urgencia, Somos abiertos y el cliente el centro de lo que hacemos. Para más información acerca de Bold visita nuestro sitio web: El Rol: Como Associate Product Manager- Real Time Payments Harás parte de un equipo que lidera la estrategia y el escalamiento de los pagos inmediatos de Bold en Colombia e impulsa su expansión hacia otros países de la región. Tu objetivo principal será facilitar el incremento de la velocidad de adopción de los pagos inmediatos mediante la innovación y el fortalecimiento de los productos existentes, garantizando que se conviertan en una alternativa cada vez más relevante dentro del ecosistema de pagos. Trabajarás de la mano con equipos transversales —ingeniería, diseño, datos y demás stakeholders relacionados— para colaborar en el diseño de productos innovadores que permitan seguir escalando los pagos inmediatos, así como para conectar los distintos sistemas de pagos inmediatos de la región y llevar esta propuesta de valor a nuevos países. Análisis de datos que puede incluir feedback de usuarios y objetivos de negocio. Entender el ecosistema de pagos y su relación con el mundo bancario para identificar nuevas oportunidades de producto. title: SAP Basis Performance Consultant
description: We are looking for an experienced SAP Basis consultant to act as a performance advisor for complex SAP landscapes. This is an advisory role rather than hands-on system administration: the focus is on analysing environments and providing expert recommendations that optimise system performance and ensure compatibility with specialised transformation tools. You will work closely with a multidisciplinary team delivering large-scale SAP initiatives, including data migrations, carve-outs, data deletions, upgrades and transformations. Your recommendations will directly shape how efficiently and safely these projects run. Requirements Key responsibilities Analyse SAP system landscapes and identify performance bottlenecks. Provide expert recommendations to customers on system configuration and optimisation. Advise on the changes required to ensure optimal performance of external tools and processes. Review architecture across SAP versions and database platforms. • Guide best practices for: – System performance tuning Data volume management (excluding archiving strategies) Support planning activities for data migrations, system carve-outs, and upgrades and transformations. Collaborate with technical and functional teams to align recommendations with project goals. Provide input on database-level considerations across Oracle, Microsoft SQL Server and SAP HANA. Assist in analysing ABAP-related performance issues (traces, dumps and inefficient programs). Required skills & experience Strong background in SAP Basis architecture and performance optimisation. Experience across multiple SAP versions (ECC, S/4HANA, etc.). Deep understanding of database platforms: Oracle, Microsoft SQL Server and SAP HANA. Working knowledge of ABAP performance analysis. Proven experience in SAP projects involving data migrations, carve-outs and system upgrades. Ability to assess complex landscapes and provide clear, actionable recommendations. Strong understanding of key SAP tables and data structures – particularly the large-volume tables that dominate performance and data-intensive operations: Preferred qualifications Experience in S/4HANA conversions or transformation programmes. Exposure to SAP functional processes (FI, MM, SD, etc.). Experience advising clients in high-impact or large-scale environments. Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills. Highlights Work environment You will collaborate with a highly experienced team specialising in: • Data migrations • Carve-outs • Data deletions • System upgrades and transformations Originally posted on Himalayas

title: Healthcare Integration Architect
description: The Integration Architect is responsible for designing, developing and governing integrations between Affidea’s clinical and business applications, with a primary focus on healthcare interoperability and the Group’s central integration platform. A key responsibility of the role is the technical ownership, development and continuous improvement of Affidea’s Central Mirth integration platform, which provides standardized integration capabilities between country-level and Group-level clinical systems. The Integration Architect combines solution architecture with hands-on integration development. The role is expected not only to define integration designs and standards, but also to develop, configure, test, troubleshoot and optimize interfaces and integration components. The role works closely with Group and Country IT teams, application owners, clinical IT teams, project teams and external vendors to ensure reliable, secure and scalable exchange of healthcare information between systems such as HIS, RIS, PACS, LIS and other clinical and operational platforms. The Integration Architect also drives the standardization of healthcare integrations across Affidea, reducing unnecessary point-to-point integrations and establishing reusable integration services and patterns. Healthcare Integration Architecture Design end-to-end integrations between healthcare applications including HIS, RIS, PACS, LIS and other clinical systems. Define integration architecture and data flows between local country systems and central Group platforms. Design and maintain integration solutions using healthcare interoperability standards including HL7 v2, FHIR and DICOM. Define standardized integration patterns for patient, appointment, order, result and other clinical information exchange. Analyze existing healthcare workflows and interfaces and propose improved or standardized integration solutions. Support the transition from country-specific and point-to-point interfaces towards reusable Group integration services. Produce and maintain integration architecture diagrams, interface specifications, message flows and technical documentation. Ensure appropriate consideration of patient safety, data integrity, availability and traceability when designing healthcare integrations. Central Mirth Platform Take technical ownership of Affidea’s Central Mirth integration platform and its integration architecture. Design and develop Mirth channels supporting communication between Group and country-level systems. Configure and maintain Mirth source and destination connectors, transformers, filters and routing logic. Develop message transformations and routing rules for healthcare and application integrations. Implement and maintain HL7 and other message-processing workflows within Mirth. Develop custom scripts and components where required to support complex integration requirements. Design reliable message processing including acknowledgement handling, retries, queues, error handling and message recovery. Monitor and optimize integration performance and message processing. Troubleshoot complex integration problems including connectivity, message format, transformation, routing and application-level issues. Analyze failed, delayed or duplicate messages and perform root-cause analysis. Define monitoring, alerting and logging requirements for the central integration platform. Support high availability, scalability and business continuity requirements of the Central Mirth environment. Establish development, testing and deployment standards for Mirth channels and integration components. Maintain appropriate version control and release management for integration developments. Integration Development Perform hands-on development of integration solutions as a core part of the role. Develop and maintain interfaces, APIs, integration services, scripts and message transformations. Develop integration logic using technologies such as JavaScript, Java, C#, SQL or other relevant technologies. Build and consume REST APIs and web services. Develop data transformation and mapping logic between different source and target data structures. Work with XML, JSON, HL7 and other structured message formats. Develop database integration components and queries where required. Implement appropriate validation, error handling, logging and reconciliation mechanisms. Create reusable integration components and libraries to accelerate future integration development. Perform unit and integration testing of developed interfaces. Support UAT and production deployments. Investigate and resolve production integration incidents where development-level expertise is required. Healthcare Interoperability Define and maintain Affidea standards for healthcare interoperability. Work extensively with HL7 v2 messages, including common ADT, ORM, ORU and SIU workflows. Design and support FHIR-based integrations where appropriate. Understand and support DICOM-related workflows and integration with medical imaging environments. Work with clinical and technical stakeholders to understand healthcare workflows and translate them into integration requirements. Ensure correct patient identification and appropriate handling of patient and clinical data across integrated systems. Support integration between scheduling, patient administration, clinical reporting and medical imaging systems. Work with vendors to understand and validate their healthcare integration capabilities and interface specifications. API and Application Integration Design and develop integrations using REST APIs, web services, messaging and other integration technologies. Define standards for API-based communication and reusable integration services. Design synchronous and asynchronous integration patterns according to business and technical requirements. Support integration with cloud-based and on-premise applications. Define common approaches for authentication, authorization, error handling, retry mechanisms and API versioning. Work with external vendors to design and implement interfaces between vendor solutions and the Affidea environment. Integration Monitoring & Operations Ensure integrations can be effectively monitored and supported in production. Define end-to-end monitoring and alerting for critical healthcare interfaces. Implement appropriate logging and technical traceability. Establish processes for identifying failed, delayed or duplicate messages. Support root-cause analysis of integration incidents. Work with support teams to establish appropriate operational procedures and escalation paths. Identify recurring incidents and implement permanent technical improvements rather than relying on manual operational workarounds. Continuously improve integration reliability, performance and maintainability. Architecture & Technical Governance Act as the technical authority for healthcare integration solutions. Define and maintain Affidea integration architecture standards and development guidelines. Review integration designs proposed by internal teams and external vendors. Ensure new integrations follow agreed architecture and interoperability standards. Promote reusable integration components and standardized interfaces across Affidea countries. Reduce unnecessary direct system-to-system integrations where centralized or reusable integration services provide a more sustainable solution. Evaluate new integration technologies and healthcare interoperability approaches where relevant. Maintain technical documentation and integration inventories. Projects & Stakeholder Management Work closely with Group IT, Country IT, Clinical IT, Digital Solutions and project teams. Participate in requirements gathering and translate business and clinical requirements into technical integration designs. Lead technical integration workshops with internal stakeholders and external vendors. Identify technical dependencies and integration risks early in projects. Provide technical estimates and support integration planning. Coordinate technical implementation activities between multiple systems and vendors. Support country rollouts of centrally managed integration solutions. Communicate complex integration topics clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Provide technical guidance and mentoring to developers and other technical team members. Requirements Qualifications Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology or a related technical discipline. Healthcare interoperability, integration or architecture certifications are an advantage. Experience Minimum 8 years of professional IT experience with significant experience in application and system integration. Minimum 3–5 years of experience in an Integration Architect, Integration Developer, Solution Architect or comparable senior technical role. Strong hands-on integration development experience. Strong experience with enterprise integration engines; Mirth Connect experience is strongly preferred. Experience designing and developing integrations between healthcare applications is highly desirable. Strong knowledge of HL7 v2, v3 and healthcare messaging concepts. Experience with common healthcare integration workflows and message types such as ADT, ORM, ORU and SIU. Knowledge of FHIR and modern healthcare interoperability concepts. Understanding of DICOM and medical imaging workflows is an advantage. Experience with HIS, RIS, PACS, LIS or comparable clinical applications. Strong knowledge of REST APIs, web services and application integration. Experience working with XML and JSON and performing complex message/data transformations. Strong scripting or software development skills, preferably including JavaScript and/or Java, C#/.NET. Good SQL and relational database knowledge. Understanding of synchronous and asynchronous integration patterns, messaging and queues. Experience implementing error handling, retries, message acknowledgement, monitoring and logging. Experience troubleshooting complex production integrations and performing root-cause analysis. Understanding of source control, software development lifecycle and CI/CD practices. Experience with cloud and hybrid integration environments. Microsoft Azure integration technologies are an advantage but are not the primary focus of the role. Healthcare & Integration Knowledge Strong understanding of healthcare system interoperability and clinical data exchange. Understanding of patient, appointment, order and clinical result workflows. Experience working with healthcare vendors and their interface specifications. Understanding of patient identification and data consistency challenges across multiple healthcare applications. Awareness of healthcare data protection, security and regulatory requirements. Experience working in a multi-country or multi-organization healthcare environment is a strong advantage. · Personal & Professional Skills Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Strong technical troubleshooting capabilities. Ability to work at both architecture and hands-on development level. Ability to understand complex system landscapes and end-to-end data flows. Ability to translate business and clinical requirements into technical integration solutions. Strong ownership and accountability for technical solutions. Ability to work independently and take responsibility for complex technical problems. Strong stakeholder and vendor management skills. Excellent technical documentation skills. description: About Holepunch At Holepunch , we’re building a peer-to-peer development platform that lets you build apps that don’t require infrastructure. No servers whatsoever. Since servers are removed from the equation, users retain full control over the data they create, keeping things maximally private. We’ve started demonstrating what this future will look like with Keet, our P2P communications app. Holepunch is built on a battle-hardened, Node.js-based technology stack we’ve built called Hypercore, which provides the basic machinery for establishing peer-to-peer connections and replicating data in a fashion similar to BitTorrent. Currently looking for: P2P Node.js Engineer (Remote) We're big fans of Node.js — Holepunch is built on it. During this next growth phase, we could use your help to expand and strengthen our core P2P networking and storage primitives. Our P2P technology covers a wide surface area, so if the parts of this following tech profile fits you, we’d love to talk to you. Requirements Requirements Extensive knowledge of P2P protocols (Kademlia, BitTorrent, libp2p, hypercore) Demonstrable experience optimizing network protocols for performance Advanced JavaScript skills for implementing high-performance networking code Deep understanding of UDP and TCP/IP networking, including NAT traversal techniques Experience implementing custom binary protocols and serialization formats Familiarity with cryptographic primitives for secure P2P communication Experience with performance profiling and optimization of networked systems Preferred Qualifications 5+ years experience building production P2P systems or distributed systems Experience optimizing JavaScript for low-latency networking applications Knowledge of V8 internals and JavaScript performance characteristics Experience with libuv and asynchronous I/O in C Contributions to open-source P2P projects or networking libraries Experience building reliable systems on unreliable networks Experience with native addons and bridging between JS and C Originally posted on Himalayas

title: Director of Supply Chain
description: We're so happy you're here! Thank you for checking our job out and we hope to have the chance to meet you in our interview process! About the role Our supply chain team has built something solid. We're looking for a Director of Supply Chain to take it over and take it further: leveling up how we negotiate with suppliers, building out demand planning and a real S&OP cadence, taking ownership of our logistics network end to end, and growing a small team as the work scales. You'll inherit something that runs, and you'll have the room to make it even better. This role reports directly into our VP of Operations. This role is part of our remote HQ! We have a fully remote, high-trust work environment - and also come together on a biannual basis for amazing off-sites where we can connect IRL. In this role, you will: Own the monthly supply plan across our network of contract manufacturers and pack-out partners, working from demand down to purchase orders Take over supplier relationships directly and build a negotiation program on top of them: pricing tiers, capacity commitments, and quarterly business reviews backed by scorecards on delivery, yield, quality, and cost Publish and own our fully burdened cost per unit, partner with Finance to track it, and find the levers to bring it down through smarter allocation and procurement Build and run demand planning and a monthly S&OP cycle that gets Finance, Marketing, and Retail committed to one number Design and de-risk our logistics and 3PL network, including routing and freight decisions that affect landed cost Manage and develop your team, staying hands-on in the model while building the leadership the function needs as scope grows Move our planning process off spreadsheets and onto a system built for it We're looking for someone who: Has 8-12 years in CPG supply chain, with at least 3 years owning a function or a major end to end scope Has run an asset-light contract manufacturing network: allocating volume across multiple co-manufacturers or co-packers, working within MOQs and capacity ceilings, and managing long lead times Has a strong track record negotiating supplier agreements directly Has owned a cost-per-unit or COGS number and can tell us the baseline, what they did, and the result Has built a supply plan themselves in a model: net requirements, safety stock, on-hand, and open POs Has run or stood up an S&OP process and gotten cross-functional teams to commit to a number, including an unpopular one Approach to the role: You see a working system as a foundation, not a finish line, and you're excited to build on top of it rather than around it You stay in the model yourself and bring recommendations, not just data You're decisive with incomplete information. You make the call, name the assumption you're carrying, and say what would change your mind You're commercially aggressive and relationally durable: you push hard on price and still get the call answered when you need a favor six months later You communicate with brevity. Whether it's Finance, the CEO, or a cross-functional partner, they get what they need and nothing extra. You move with urgency and low ego, and you don't need a lot of infrastructure to get going Compensation & Benefits: At Grüns , we're committed to providing a competitive total compensation package — grounded in market data that considers our size, stage, industry, and location. For this role, the base salary range is $180,000-$200,000 plus incentive compensationdepending on experience, paired with a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the well-being and growth of our team. A bit about us... At Grüns , we believe that foundational nutrition should be simple and convenient for everyone. We're dedicated to bringing comprehensive and real nutrition to you through our gummies, formulated from 60 nutrient-dense and whole-food ingredients. Simply enjoy a grab-and-go snack pack of gummies daily whenever fits best in your schedule and wherever life takes you. Like you, we were disappointed. There’s an infinite number of “nutrition” companies, all focused on what’s best for them — not what’s best for you. Hundreds of products to sell you on, low-quality ingredients, and small nutrient doses. We’ve seen it all. So we decided it was time to fix it. No more choking on and popping pills like a pharmacy. No more clean-up and disgust from gross powders. And no more cobbling together handfuls to dozens of supplements. Grüns is comprehensive nutrition, made convenient and delicious. What we care about... Be the Best: We hold ourselves, our teams, and our partners to an incredibly high standard - and we raise the bar constantly. "We've never done this before" isn't an excuse here. It's an invitation. Own It: We act like our name is on the door. That means taking complete ownership of outcomes, collaborating deeply, working through roadblocks - not around them - and never waiting for someone else to solve the problem. Great owners are great partners. Drive Impact, Urgently: We measure impact, not effort. We work smart and hard, move fast, and use every tool at our disposal - including AI - to focus our energy where it matters most. Compensation & Perks: For every role, we aim to have highly competitive compensation and opportunity for impact and career growth. Everyone at Grüns works hard, but we believe in wellness and balance too. We have super strong benefits coverage -- for you and your family, generous PTO, free Grüns , and a few more perks centered around health and well-being that we can't wait to tell you about! description: About Halborn Inc Our mission is to provide value-add security services and products to the world’s most cutting edge technology firms and that starts with blockchain tech. Founded in 2019, Halborn is an elite cyber security company focused on solving complex adversarial problems unique to the cryptocurrency and fintech industries. From breaches and social engineering to stolen private keys and economic hacks, Halborn solves it. Our clientele are the exclusive blockchain companies as well as new startups with high growth trajectories. Our Culture Halborn is a globally distributed team of 100+, looking to grow our elite team of white hat hackers, sales professionals, security engineers and DevSecOps specialists who value independence, want to make their own hours, work for themselves and have a passion for the ever evolving cryptocurrency industry. Our Commitment to Diversity Halborn Inc is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are looking for a full stack developer who is comfortable owning a feature from the database schema to the last pixel and who already builds with AI as a core part of how they work, not as a novelty. You will build the platforms our security researchers use to run engagements, the products our clients use to consume findings, and the AI-assisted workflows that let a small team operate at a scale that should not be possible. The work is real product engineering against real adversarial conditions, and the security bar is high because our customers are the reason it has to be. Responsibilities Design, build, and ship features end to end across a React and TypeScript front end and Python or Node.js services, taking ownership from technical design through production support. Model data and design APIs that hold up as requirements change — clear contracts, sane migrations, and schemas that will not need to be rescued in six months. Build AI-native product capabilities: LLM orchestration, agentic and multi-step workflows, retrieval over engagement data, and structured output that downstream systems can rely on. Use AI coding tooling aggressively in your own development loop while maintaining the review discipline that keeps generated code from becoming a liability. Automate internal engineering and security workflows, turning processes our researchers currently run by hand into durable product surface. Write secure code by default — input validation, authentication and authorization, secrets handling, dependency hygiene — and treat security review as part of shipping, not a gate at the end. Participate in code review as both author and reviewer, raising the standard of the codebase rather than just approving diffs. Deploy and operate what you build: containerized services, cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, monitoring, and the on-call ownership that comes with running production systems. Collaborate directly with security researchers, auditors, and product stakeholders to translate deep domain expertise into software that non-experts can use. Contribute to technical direction — framework choices, architecture, and the tradeoffs behind them — and document decisions so the team can move without you in the room. Qualifications 4 or more years building and shipping production web applications, with genuine ownership on both the front end and the back end. Strong React and TypeScript, including modern state management, component architecture, and CSS competent enough to build an interface without a designer hovering. Strong server-side skills in Python, Node.js, or both, with production experience designing REST or GraphQL APIs. Solid relational database experience — PostgreSQL preferred — including schema design, query performance, and migrations. Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure), Docker, and CI/CD pipelines you configured yourself. Demonstrated AI-forward development practice: you integrate LLM APIs into real products, you use AI coding assistants as part of your daily loop, and you can articulate where they accelerate you and where they need a human. Security-minded engineering instincts and a working understanding of common web vulnerability classes and how to prevent them. Excellent asynchronous written communication and the self-direction to own outcomes across time zones without being managed day to day. Comfort operating in ambiguity in a constantly changing and evolving work environment where growth is non-stop. Willingness to learn the technical aspects of blockchain and cybersecurity. Bonus Points Web3 development experience — ethers.js or viem, wallet integrations, RPC providers, or Solidity and Rust smart contract familiarity. Experience building agentic systems, working with the Model Context Protocol, vector databases, or evaluation frameworks for LLM features. DevSecOps experience: infrastructure as code, secrets management, supply chain security, or automated security scanning in CI. Prior work at a cybersecurity, fintech, or crypto company, or on products handling sensitive customer data. Experience taking a product from zero to one on a small team. Open source contributions. Knowledgeable of the latest trends in Blockchain and DeFi. Originally posted on Himalayas

title: Medical Monitor
description: Job Description Summary The Medical Monitor, Clinical Development is responsible for providing day‑to‑day medical oversight for one or more clinical trials to ensure patient safety, data integrity, and protocol compliance throughout trial execution. This role serves as the primary medical point of contact for study teams and clinical sites, supporting safe and compliant study conduct in alignment with Good Clinical Practice (GCP) and regulatory requirements. Operating within defined protocols and development strategies, the Medical Monitor provides medical judgment during trial execution, including safety signal evaluation, eligibility assessments, dose modifications, and risk mitigation. The role works closely with Clinical Operations, Pharmacovigilance, Data Management, Biostatistics, and Regulatory Affairs to support operational excellence, timely issue resolution, and high‑quality clinical data. GE HealthCare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator. Our purpose is to create a world where healthcare has no limits. Unlock your ambition, turn ideas into world-changing realities, and join an organization where every voice makes a difference, and every difference builds a healthier world. Le Médecin Moniteur (Medical Monitor), Développement Clinique est responsable de la supervision médicale quotidienne d’un ou de plusieurs essais cliniques afin de garantir la sécurité des patients, l’intégrité des données et la conformité au protocole tout au long de l’exécution de l’étude. Ce poste constitue le principal point de contact médical pour les équipes de l’étude et les sites cliniques, en veillant à ce que les études soient menées de manière sûre et conforme aux Bonnes Pratiques Cliniques (BPC/GCP) ainsi qu’aux exigences réglementaires. Dans le cadre de protocoles définis et de stratégies de développement établies, le Médecin Moniteur apporte son jugement médical durant l’exécution des essais, notamment pour l’évaluation des signaux de sécurité, l’examen de l’éligibilité des participants, les ajustements de doses et les mesures d’atténuation des risques. Le titulaire du poste travaille en étroite collaboration avec les équipes des Opérations Cliniques, de Pharmacovigilance, de Gestion des Données, de Biostatistiques et des Affaires Réglementaires afin de soutenir l’excellence opérationnelle, la résolution rapide des problèmes et la production de données cliniques de haute qualité. GE HealthCare est un leader mondial des technologies médicales et des solutions numériques innovantes. Notre mission est de créer un monde où les soins de santé n’ont aucune limite. Libérez votre ambition, transformez vos idées en réalités capables de changer le monde et rejoignez une organisation où chaque voix compte et où chaque contribution participe à bâtir un monde en meilleure santé. Job Description Key Responsibilities Clinical Trial Medical Oversight Provide medical oversight for one or more assigned clinical trials within a program or portfolio. Ensure patient safety and protocol‑compliant execution throughout trial conduct. Apply medical judgment to eligibility questions, protocol deviations, dosing decisions, and participant risk mitigation. Safety Monitoring & Signal Detection Review and assess AEs and SAEs, including causality and severity evaluations. Participate in ongoing safety reviews, internal safety committees, and Data Safety Monitoring Boards (DSMBs) as required. Collaborate closely with Pharmacovigilance to support safety signal detection, escalation, and risk‑management actions. Support development and implementation of protocol amendments or safety measures when indicated. Site & Investigator Support Serve as a key medical contact for investigators, responding to protocol‑specific medical questions and eligibility clarifications. Support investigator meetings and site engagement activities with study‑specific medical input. Provide medical oversight and guidance when studies are conducted with CRO medical monitors, ensuring consistency with GE HealthCare expectations. Cross‑Functional Study Team Collaboration Work closely with Clinical Trial Leads (CTLs), Clinical Project Managers (CPMs), CRAs, Data Management, and Biostatistics to support smooth trial execution. Participate in operational safety and study management meetings, contributing medical perspective to study‑level decisions. Support timely identification and resolution of safety or operational risks impacting study conduct. Regulatory & Documentation Support Contribute to clinical study reports (CSRs), safety narratives, and regulatory submission documents. Ensure accuracy and consistency of medical data in study documentation and regulatory deliverables. Support regulatory interactions by addressing detailed clinical execution and safety questions as required. Ensure appropriate SAE reconciliation and alignment between clinical, safety, and regulatory datasets. Required Qualifications: MD or equivalent medical degree. 3–7 years of experience in clinical trial execution, medical monitoring, or related roles. Strong knowledge of GCP, clinical trial conduct, and safety reporting requirements. Experience reviewing AEs/SAEs and participating in safety oversight activities. Ability to work within protocol and regulatory frameworks while applying sound medical judgment. Desired Characteristics Strong clinical judgment with attention to patient safety and data quality. Solid understanding of clinical trial methodology and operational execution. Ability to collaborate effectively within cross‑functional and matrixed teams. Clear and professional communication with investigators and study stakeholders. Detail‑oriented, with strong documentation and compliance mindset. Principales responsabilités Supervision médicale des essais cliniques Assurer la supervision médicale d’un ou de plusieurs essais cliniques attribués au sein d’un programme ou d’un portefeuille d’études. Garantir la sécurité des patients et une exécution conforme au protocole tout au long de la conduite des essais. Appliquer son jugement médical aux questions d’éligibilité, aux écarts de protocole, aux décisions de dosage et aux mesures de réduction des risques pour les participants. Surveillance de la sécurité et détection des signaux Examiner et évaluer les événements indésirables (AE) et les événements indésirables graves (SAE), y compris les analyses de causalité et de gravité. Participer aux revues de sécurité continues, aux comités internes de sécurité et aux Comités de Surveillance de la Sécurité des Données (Data Safety Monitoring Boards - DSMB), selon les besoins. Collaborer étroitement avec la Pharmacovigilance pour soutenir la détection des signaux de sécurité, leur escalade et les actions de gestion des risques. Soutenir l’élaboration et la mise en œuvre d’amendements au protocole ou de mesures de sécurité lorsque cela est nécessaire. Support aux sites et aux investigateurs Servir de contact médical principal pour les investigateurs, en répondant aux questions médicales spécifiques au protocole et en apportant des clarifications sur l’éligibilité des participants. Contribuer aux réunions d’investigateurs et aux activités d’engagement des sites en fournissant une expertise médicale liée à l’étude. Assurer une supervision et des conseils médicaux lorsque les études sont menées avec des médecins moniteurs de CRO, afin de garantir l’alignement avec les attentes de GE HealthCare . Collaboration avec les équipes d’étude multidisciplinaires Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les responsables d’essais cliniques (Clinical Trial Leads - CTL), les chefs de projet clinique (Clinical Project Managers - CPM), les Attachés de Recherche Clinique (CRA), les équipes de Gestion des Données et de Biostatistiques afin d’assurer une exécution fluide des essais. Participer aux réunions opérationnelles de sécurité et de gestion des études, en apportant une perspective médicale aux décisions prises au niveau de l’étude. Soutenir l’identification et la résolution rapides des risques de sécurité ou des risques opérationnels susceptibles d’affecter la conduite des études. ​ Support réflementaire et documentaire Contribuer à la rédaction des rapports d’étude clinique (Clinical Study Reports - CSR), des récits de sécurité et des documents destinés aux soumissions réglementaires. Garantir l’exactitude et la cohérence des données médicales figurant dans la documentation des études et les livrables réglementaires. Participer aux interactions avec les autorités réglementaires en répondant, si nécessaire, à des questions détaillées relatives à l’exécution clinique et à la sécurité. Veiller à une réconciliation appropriée des SAE et à l’alignement des données entre les bases cliniques, de sécurité et réglementaires. Qualifications requises: Doctorat en médecine (MD) ou diplôme médical équivalent. Entre 3 et 7 ans d’expérience dans l’exécution d’essais cliniques, la surveillance médicale ou des fonctions similaires. Solide connaissance des Bonnes Pratiques Cliniques (BPC/GCP), de la conduite des essais cliniques et des exigences en matière de déclaration de sécurité. Expérience dans l’examen des événements indésirables (AE/SAE) et la participation aux activités de supervision de la sécurité. Capacité à travailler dans le respect des protocoles et des cadres réglementaires tout en faisant preuve d’un jugement médical rigoureux. Profil Recherché Excellent jugement clinique avec une forte sensibilité à la sécurité des patients et à la qualité des données. Bonne compréhension des méthodologies des essais cliniques et de leur exécution opérationnelle. Capacité à collaborer efficacement au sein d’équipes multidisciplinaires et matricielles. Communication claire et professionnelle avec les investigateurs et les différentes parties prenantes des études. Grand souci du détail, associé à une forte culture de la documentation et de la conformité. Additional Information Relocation Assistance Provided: No Originally posted on Himalayas
