title: Renewals Manager
description: About Doppel Doppel is building the future of social engineering defense. Our AI-native platform uses agentic AI to protect executives, employees, customers, and brands from phishing, impersonation, fraud, and other AI-powered threats across digital channels. Backed by leading investors including Andreessen Horowitz and Bessemer Venture Partners, Doppel is a rapidly growing Series C company helping customers stay ahead of modern digital threats. The Role We are hiring our first dedicated Renewals Manager to build and run the renewals function at Doppel . This is a builder role and a hands-on commercial role. You will not inherit a finished renewals organization or simply administer contracts. You will design the operating model while personally owning renewal execution across our customer base. You will establish the systems, processes, forecasting discipline, commercial guardrails, segmentation, and cross-functional handoffs required to make renewals predictable and scalable. At the same time, you will be directly responsible for moving renewals from early planning through commercial negotiation, procurement, signature, and close. You will partner closely with Customer Success Managers, Account Executives, CS Operations / RevOps, Deal Desk, Finance, Legal, and channel partners. Customer Success will continue to own customer value, adoption, health, and risk-recovery plans. You will own the commercial renewal motion and renewable ARR. This is initially an individual-contributor role, with the opportunity to help define how the renewals organization should evolve as Doppel scales. What You Will Do Build the Renewals Function Design and implement Doppel 's scalable renewals operating model, including lifecycle stages, ownership, exit criteria, escalation paths, and rules of engagement. Establish renewal motions for strategic, core, scaled, direct, channel, and auto-renewal customers. Build a forward-looking renewal forecasting and inspection cadence that gives leadership reliable visibility into renewable ARR, expected renewals, churn, contraction, timing risk, and commercial blockers. Define clear renewal stages, forecast categories, risk definitions, and Salesforce data requirements so the renewal book can be inspected consistently. Develop playbooks, templates, customer and partner cadences, dashboards, reporting, and repeatable commercial workflows. Partner with Deal Desk, Finance, Legal, Sales, and CS leadership to define commercial guardrails for standard uplifts, multi-year agreements, co-terming, concessions, downsells, payment terms, and non-standard exceptions. Establish consistent churn and contraction reason codes and use renewal data to identify systemic retention risks and improvement opportunities. Identify opportunities to automate renewal opportunity creation, reminders, quoting, risk detection, reporting, and administrative work using Salesforce, customer-success tooling, and AI. Continuously refine the model as renewal volume and complexity grow, including recommending when additional renewal capacity or specialized coverage is required. Run the Renewal Business Personally own the end-to-end commercial renewal lifecycle across Doppel 's customer base, from early planning through quote, negotiation, procurement, signature, and close. Maintain a forward-looking view of the renewal book and ensure upcoming renewals are identified, validated, and actively managed well in advance of expiration. Lead customer-facing renewal conversations covering pricing, uplift, term, multi-year options, scope changes, downsell, procurement, and contract execution. Own standard renewal quotes and commercial execution, routing non-standard pricing or terms through DealHub and the appropriate approval process. Maintain an accurate renewal forecast and provide evidence-based visibility into expected outcomes, churn and contraction exposure, timing risk, and blockers. Partner with CSMs to translate account health, adoption, business outcomes, support history, stakeholder changes, and competitive signals into the renewal strategy. Identify renewal risk early and drive the commercial components of mitigation plans alongside the CSM, AE, leadership, and executive sponsor. Coordinate partner-led renewals and ensure Doppel , the partner, CSM, and AE are aligned on timing, pricing, scope, customer communication, and remaining steps to close. Partner with AEs on combined renewal-and-expansion motions. Renewals remains accountable for the existing renewable ARR and renewal execution; the AE owns incremental expansion ARR. Together, you will create one coordinated customer-facing commercial strategy. Manage complex renewal structures including multi-year terms, co-terming, product changes, pricing adjustments, and approved commercial exceptions. Keep Salesforce accurate and current as the single source of truth for renewal amount, forecast category, risks, next steps, owners, commercial status, and expected close timing. Ensure signed renewals become clean, billable transactions by coordinating PO requirements, billing contacts, subscription dates, payment terms, invoice schedules, and other required information with Finance. Analyze churn, contraction, uplift realization, multi-year adoption, late renewals, forecast variance, and other renewal patterns and turn those insights into improvements to the operating model. What We Are Looking For 5+ years of experience in SaaS renewals, account management, customer success, or another commercial post-sale role, with meaningful direct ownership of renewals. Demonstrated experience owning a renewal target or book of business and delivering strong retention outcomes with disciplined forecasting. Experience building or materially improving a renewals process, operating model, playbook, forecast methodology, or commercial cadence—not simply operating within an established one. Experience in cybersecurity or another complex B2B SaaS environment involving enterprise customers, channel partners, procurement, and legal stakeholders. Strong commercial judgment and negotiation skills across pricing, term, uplift, concessions, multi-year agreements, procurement, and contract execution. Ability to operate both strategically and tactically: you can design the process, build the dashboard, negotiate with a customer, inspect a forecast, and chase a signature when needed. Ability to distinguish customer-value risk from commercial or transaction risk and mobilize the right cross-functional team for each. Strong executive communication skills: concise, credible, comfortable with senior customer stakeholders, and effective in high-pressure commercial situations. Strong analytical skills and operational rigor, with the ability to manage a large number of concurrent renewal dates without losing the strategic context of the account. Strong Salesforce fluency; experience with CPQ / DealHub-style quoting, forecasting tools, customer-success platforms, and contract workflows is highly valuable. Comfort operating in a fast-growing environment where roles and processes are evolving and you are expected to create structure rather than wait for it. Why Join Doppel Competitive compensation and meaningful equity; $120,000 - $130,000 OTE Flexible work environment. Comprehensive health benefits, PTO, and parental leave. Opportunity to build a critical recurring-revenue function from the ground up and have a direct impact on how Doppel scales. Success Measures Strong Gross Revenue Retention and achievement of Doppel 's renewable ARR target. High percentage of renewals completed on or before the contractual renewal date. Reliable renewal forecast accuracy with risks identified early enough for the business to act. Consistent realization of approved renewal uplifts and increased adoption of multi-year agreements where appropriate. Reduced late-stage surprises, emergency extensions, and renewals entering the final 30 days without a clear path to close. Clear visibility into churn and contraction drivers with measurable improvements based on those insights. Consistent execution of direct, channel, and auto-renewal motions with clean ownership and handoffs. A scalable, documented renewals operating model that reduces administrative burden on CSMs and allows them to spend more time driving customer value. Clean handoffs from signed renewal to Finance, with accurate contracts, dates, PO information, billing contacts, and payment terms. A clear recommendation for how the Renewals function should scale as Doppel 's customer base and renewable ARR grow. Salary Range $120,000—$130,000 USD Originally posted on Himalayas

title: Responsable de programme (Côte d'Ivoire)
description: Solon Capital Partners (« Solon ») crée, s'associe et investit pour générer des rendements financiers et un impact significatif. Fort de plus de 13 années d'expérience, Solon s’appuie sur un modèle différencié basé sur la création d'entreprise, le partenariat et la patience pour maximiser l'ampleur de l'impact et les rendements financiers tout en atténuant les risques. Solon poursuit sa double mission envers le climat et les communautés à travers un portefeuille d'entreprises innovantes opérant désormais dans trois secteurs verticaux d'impact et neuf pays en Afrique et au-delà. Terra Nova Solutions (« TNS ») est une société du groupe Solon qui agit en tant que fournisseur de services pour Solon. TNS est une société de services professionnels qui renforce les capacités de ses clients au sein des marchés Africains, y compris ceux avec des défis importants. TNS fournit une gamme de services de finance, de conformité, de consultant et de conseil dans plusieurs secteurs et zones géographiques en Afrique subsaharienne. L'opportunité : Solon entreprend de bâtir un système de développement des joueurs de football à travers l'Afrique de l'Ouest - en éliminant les barrières structurelles pour permettre aux talents émergents du continent de s'épanouir. Lancé au Ghana en avril 2024, nous poursuivons la mise en en œuvre de la première phase de ce projet : un programme gratuit de formation de base au football pour les garçons et les filles à partir de l'âge de 6 ans, réparti dans les écoles primaires de chaque marché cible en Afrique de l'Ouest. La Côte d’Ivoire est notre prochain marché cible. Nous recherchons un responsable de programme expérimenté et proactif pour soutenir l'intention de Solon de mettre en œuvre cette phase initiale de notre programme de développement des joueurs de football en Côte d’Ivoire. Le rôle consistera à travailler avec une équipe soudée pour évaluer et développer les opportunités de mise en œuvre du programme. Vous rejoindrez une équipe collégiale, collaborative et curieuse. Responsabilités : Le candidat idéal adoptera une approche pratique pour gérer avec succès divers groupes de travail afin d'évaluer la Côte d’Ivoire en tant que nouveau marché pour la mise en place de notre programme de développement des joueurs de football. Il devra travailler en étroite collaboration avec les communautés, le gouvernement et d'autres partenaires pour résoudre les problèmes et faire avancer les différentes initiatives et étapes du projet. Il s'agira également d'être capable de répondre avec enthousiasme à un ensemble de demandes et de défis rapides et variés. Quelques exemples de responsabilités : Évaluation des opportunités. Identifier et évaluer les possibilités de partenariat avec les établissements scolaires en Côte d’Ivoire afin de mettre en place la première phase de notre programme de développement des joueurs de football - un programme de formation de base au football pour les garçons et les filles à partir de l'âge de 6 ans, réparti dans les écoles primaires existantes. Mise en œuvre du programme. En coordination avec l'équipe de Solon, mettre en œuvre et développer le programme de formation de base au football avec les propriétaires et réseaux d'écoles primaires identifiés en Côte d’Ivoire y compris l’éducation nationale ; assurer une supervision efficace pour veiller à ce que le programme réponde aux normes et aux objectifs de Solon. Engagement des parties prenantes. Établir et entretenir des relations avec les principales parties prenantes, notamment les prestataires de services, les représentants du gouvernement, les partenaires donateurs, les consultants et les membres des communautés. Collaborez avec les potentiels partenaires locaux, les experts du secteur et d’autres parties prenantes pour recueillir des informations et promouvoir les intérêts de Solon. Rapports et évaluation. Préparer des rapports détaillés et des présentations pour l’équipe d’encadrement de Solon afin de faciliter les processus de prise de décision. Gestion de projets. Gérer les délais, les ressources et les délivrables pour les projets désignés. Veiller à ce que toutes les activités du projet respectent les normes et les objectifs de Solon, en produisant des résultats dans les délais et le respect des budgets établis. Qualifications : Les qualifications de base pour cette mission sont les suivantes Diplôme bac +4 en administration des affaires ; Sciences économiques ; Relations internationales ; école de commerce ou domaines connexes. Expérience avérée en développement commercial ou dans un rôle similaire, de préférence en Côte d’Ivoire ou sur des marchés similaires. Solides compétences en communication écrite et orale, y compris la préparation de rapports de projet détaillés et la présentation à un public diversifié. Superbe attention aux détails et application au travail Capacité à travailler efficacement dans un environnement d'équipe multiculturelle et en rapide évolution. Solides compétences interpersonnelles et aptitudes à la résolution de problèmes. Connaissance approfondie de la culture, des coutumes et des pratiques commerciales de la Côte d’Ivoire. Maîtrise du français et de l'anglais (à l'oral et à l'écrit). Intégrité, bonne capacité de jugement et sens des affaires. Bonne présence et comportement professionnel. Capacité à résider et travailler légalement en Côte d’Ivoire. Passion ou intérêt pour le football Une expérience et/ou des connaissances dans les domaines du football, de l'éducation, ainsi que des initiatives de développement de projets dans ces domaines sont souhaitables. Nature de l'engagement : un engagement contractuel de 6 mois dont la durée peut être prolongée et évoluer plus tard vers un rôle à temps plein au sein de la société. Horaires de travail : Prendre en compte des possibilités de devoir assister en virtuel à des réunions à des heures de bureau standard de plusieurs fuseaux horaires, en particulier l’Amérique du Nord et le Pakistan. Lieu de travail : Ce rôle exige que le candidat réside en Côte d’Ivoire. Il s’agit d’un rôle à distance dans la mesure où la plupart des supérieurs hiérarchiques et collaborateurs seront basés hors de Côte d’Ivoire. Des déplacements dans toute l'Afrique de l'Ouest peuvent être nécessaires, ainsi que des déplacements occasionnels dans le monde entier. Rémunération : Solon est une organisation de choix qui propose des rémunérations compétitives ainsi que des bonus basés sur les performances et l’atteinte des objectifs. Why Join Us? Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry. If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you. Are you ready to be part of the future? About the job Keet is a fully peer-to-peer messaging and video calling app built on Holepunch's P2P stack. There are no servers, no middlemen, and no data harvesting. People talk directly to each other, with end-to-end encryption by design. We are looking for a Senior Technical Product Manager to own the vision for Keet and lead it to a billion users, competing head-on with WhatsApp and Telegram. This is not a maintenance role. You will define where Keet goes, convince the board and the team that it is the right direction, and then drive the execution that gets it there. You are a rare combination of three things. You are a product visionary who has shipped consumer chat or calling apps at scale. You are a technologist who can go deep on P2P architecture and the Pear / Holepunch stack (docs.pears.com). And you are a hands-on builder who uses AI tools to prototype and prove concepts in days, not months. You set the bar high, move at incredible speed, and lead from the front. You will also be the person who catches what others miss. The PM who thrives here reads every ticket, tracks every dependency, asks the uncomfortable question before it becomes a launch incident, and keeps five workstreams moving simultaneously without losing the thread on any of them. If you prefer a PM role where you set strategy and delegate execution, this is not the right fit. If you want to build something that ships to real users, moves markets, and carries your fingerprints from concept to production, we want to hear from you. Responsibilities Vision & Strategy Own and articulate the long-term product vision for Keet as the world's leading private, peer-to-peer communication app, with a clear path to 1 billion users. Analyze WhatsApp, Telegram, Signal, LINE, WeChat and emerging competitors to identify where P2P gives Keet an unfair advantage, and build the roadmap around it. Present product vision, strategy, metrics and progress to the board and executive leadership with clarity and conviction. Define a growth strategy across acquisition, activation, retention and virality, with measurable targets at every stage. Technical Product Leadership Develop a deep working understanding of the Holepunch P2P stack (Pear runtime, Bare, Hypercore, Hyperswarm, HyperDHT, Autobase, Hyperbee) and translate its capabilities and constraints into product decisions. Partner with core engineering on hard P2P problems at scale, including NAT traversal, offline sync, multi-device support, large groups, push notifications, and battery and data efficiency on mobile. Own the real-time calling experience (1:1 and group voice and video, plus screen sharing) to a quality bar that matches or beats Google Meet and Zoom. Define clear feature tiers with explicit labels for stable versus experimental functionality. Rapid Prototyping with AI Use AI coding and design tools to build working prototypes and demos that prove concepts before committing engineering resources. Turn ideas into something the team, users and the board can see and touch within days. Execution & Team Leadership Lead the product team and run the sprint cadence end to end, covering planning, prioritization, standups, reviews and retrospectives. Own deliverables from conception through release, testing and post-launch iteration, ensuring core functionality works reliably every time. Maintain issue trackers and roadmaps that accurately reflect priorities and sprint commitments. Coordinate across engineering, QA, design, marketing and business stakeholders, and manage cross-team dependencies across the Holepunch and Tether ecosystem. Provide transparent updates on status, risks and timeline changes, and hold direct conversations about accountability when needed. Mobile & Distribution Own the mobile release process across iOS and Android. This includes App Store and Google Play submissions, review guidelines, compliance, store listings, ratings and release management. Oversee desktop distribution and installers across macOS, Windows and Linux. Build crash reporting, debugging and analytics systems, privacy-preserving by design, that turn user reports into actionable engineering data. Requirements Mandatory: 8+ years of product management experience, including significant time in a senior or lead role owning a consumer product end to end. Strong product sense, with a proven track record of setting product vision and driving it to measurable outcomes at scale (tens of millions of users or more). Experience leading engineers who ship products, including running sprint cadences with predictable delivery across cross-functional teams. Deep JavaScript and React skills. You can read and write production code, review pull requests, and build working prototypes yourself. Intuition for distributed and local-first systems. You don't need P2P expertise, because our core abstracts it away, but you should be able to reason about sync, offline behavior and consistency trade-offs. Hands-on experience shipping and scaling mobile apps on iOS and Android, with deep familiarity with App Store and Google Play logistics, review processes and release management. Experience with real-time voice and video calling products (such as Google Meet, Zoom, FaceTime or WhatsApp calls) and the quality, latency and reliability trade-offs involved. Demonstrated ability to use AI tools to rapidly prototype and demonstrate product concepts. Exceptional communication skills, with experience presenting vision and strategy to boards, executives and investors. A strong understanding of urgency versus importance, and the judgment to make fast, high-quality decisions with incomplete information. You thrive in a high-intensity, fast-moving environment, set an exceptionally high bar, and are willing to go above and beyond, including extended hours, when the mission demands it. Excellent written and spoken English. Nice to have: Product leadership experience at a major messaging app such as WhatsApp, Telegram, LINE, WeChat, Signal, Viber or KakaoTalk. Experience with peer-to-peer technologies, distributed systems or decentralized protocols. Prior exposure to Holepunch, Pear or Hypercore is a strong plus. Experience growing a product in emerging markets or across multiple regions and languages. A background in privacy, encryption or security-focused products. Familiarity with Electron, React Native or similar cross-platform frameworks, as well as installer systems, boot performance and Linux packaging (Snap, AppImage, Flatpak). A solid understanding of testing approaches (unit, integration, end-to-end), test automation and performance testing. An engineering background or computer science degree. Experience with Git, issue trackers and modern collaboration tools. Why this role: The next billion-user communication app will not run on someone else's servers. If you want to be the person who defines it, presents it to the board, prototypes it yourself, and then leads the team that ships it, we want to hear from you. In your application, include a link to a product you have shipped or a prototype you have built, along with a few sentences on how you would take Keet to 1 billion users. Endless Access works to close the global digital divide by helping young people in underserved communities become creators of technology, not only consumers of it. Our learning programs teach a new generation to design and build their own games and digital projects using free, open-source tools, delivered through mentors, instructors, and partners around the world. This is a hands-on engineering role. You will ship features, fix issues, and help keep the game stable, performant, and fun to play. You will work closely with our senior game engineer as well as our creative director, producer, and contributor community. Most of your time will go to game development on the Threadbare roadmap. A smaller part of the role connects you with our learning programs, where you will guide learners who are building the game alongside us. This is a 5–6 month contract, and we are hiring with the clear intent of finding someone we would want on the team long term. If you enjoy working in an existing codebase, care about how changes feel to players, and like helping newer developers grow, this role is for you. Key Responsibilities Game Development (60%) Build and ship gameplay features, UI, and systems, from design spec to release. Fix bugs and improve performance, stability, and load times. Estimate your work, flag risks early, and keep the team informed through planning and regular updates. Contribute to the tools, pipelines, and documentation that make the team faster. Learning and Community (40%) Review code from learners in our game development programs and give clear, encouraging written feedback. Collaborate with our Learning Experience team on tooling that supports our game development curriculum, as the roadmap allows. Join occasional community events, such as game jams and livestreams. Skills and Experience Essential 4+ years of professional software engineering, including hands-on work on shipped or live games. Clear written and verbal communication, especially in a remote, asynchronous team. Familiarity with open-source communities and contribution practices. Able to work independently and to ask for help at the right time. Professional or fluent English. Desirable Experience with the Godot engine (GDScript) Accessibility or inclusive design experience in games. Experience with learning or educational games. Familiarity with analytics, live ops, or build and CI pipelines. Spanish ability. An interest in our mission to expand access to technology. Most of the team works remotely and asynchronously across many countries, and this role is no exception: it is fully remote and based in Latin America, collaborating daily with teammates and contributors across multiple time zones, much of it in writing, in code review, and over video. description: Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing. This is a technical management role to lead a team that develops Python and Golang micro-services that power our global software distribution engine. The world sees it as the Snap Store and marketplaces, behind the scenes it is a unified system that understands key concepts in software distribution - architectures, releases, betas, release candidates, stable releases, branches and more. We are on a journey to transform the experience that people all over the world have with their open source software by significantly expanding the range of software we can deliver through this system. If you have a passion for clean APIs, believe that great engineers ship software calmly and regularly against an agile plan, and know that tests are the key to higher velocity and reliability, you'll fit right in. This is a great opportunity to take part in engineering a highly scalable SaaS product (think about the load on our systems when one of our largest Ubuntu Desktop snaps is updated by the publisher, for instance). In addition, you will have the opportunity to learn from Canonical 's world-class security team as we work collectively to deliver this capability, safely, to our customers around the world. As an Engineering Manager at Canonical , you must be technically strong, but your main responsibility is to run an effective team and develop the colleagues you manage. You will develop and review code as a leader, but know that the best way to improve the product is to ensure that the whole team is focused, productive and unblocked. You are expected to help them grow as engineers, do meaningful work, do it outstandingly well, find professional and personal satisfaction, and work well with colleagues and the community. You will also be expected to be a positive influence on culture, facilitate technical delivery, and regularly reflect with your team on strategy and execution. You will collaborate closely with other Engineering Managers, product managers, and architects, producing an engineering roadmap with ambitious and achievable goals. We expect Engineering Managers to be fluent in the programming language, architecture, and components that their team uses. Code reviews and architectural leadership are part of the job. The commitment to healthy engineering practices, documentation, quality and performance optimisation is as important, as is the requirement for fair and clear management, and the obligation to ensure a high-performing team. This is a great opportunity to really learn how to do engineering of a highly-scalable SaaS product (think about the load on our systems when one of our largest Ubuntu Desktop snaps is updated by the publisher, for instance). In addition, you will have the opportunity to learn from Canonical 's world-class security team as we work collectively to deliver this capability, safely, to our customers around the world. Location : This role may be based remotely in the Americas, Europe, Middle East or Africa time zones. What your day will look like Lead a remote team of engineers in your time zone Develop talent through coaching, mentoring, feedback, and hands-on career development Set and manage expectations with other engineering teams, management, and external stakeholders Be an active part of the leadership team and collaborate with other leaders in the organisation With your team, build clean web service APIs to support both CLI and web frontend clients, using Python (and optionally Golang). Engage with many other teams at Canonical , as well as the open-source community and commercial partners What we are looking for in you Good experience in leading modern, agile software development practices Experience in forming a healthy, collaborative engineering culture in line with the company values Demonstrative experience of being a role model for sound engineering principles and directly contributing toward your team's goals Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events You love to mentor, develop and grow people, and have a track record of doing it You are knowledgeable and passionate about software development You are focused on success and the timely delivery of high-quality software You value and nurture great team culture and spirit You have experience and commitment to agile development methodologies Software development experience in Python (experience in Golang in addition to that would be a big plus) Effective written and verbal communication skills Practical experience with Linux system administration What we offer you Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. In addition to the benefits above, certain roles are also eligible for additional benefits and rewards including annual bonuses and sales incentives based on revenue or utilisation. Our compensation philosophy is to ensure equity right across our global workforce. In addition to a competitive base pay, we provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. Please note that additional benefits may apply depending on the work location and, for more information on these, you can ask in the later stages of the recruitment process. Fully remote working environment - we’ve been working remotely since 2004! Personal learning and development budget of 2,000USD per annum Annual compensation review Recognition rewards Annual holiday leave Parental leave Employee Assistance Programme Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues at ‘sprints’ Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events About Canonical Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. Serverless versus containerised, synchronous versus event-driven, build versus integrate. Then explain the reasoning so the pod can make the next call without you Take the highest-risk production implementations yourself, building across both the Vue 3 frontend and our TypeScript serverless and containerised services Set the engineering bar through your own code and your reviews: strict typing, real test coverage, structured logs, correlation IDs, graceful failure handling, and fault tolerance as a design goal rather than an aspiration Own the production health of Commercial services: meaningful Datadog dashboards, monitors and SLOs with thresholds that reflect reality, and alerts a person can act on at 3 am Lead incident response and root cause analysis for Commercial systems, and make sure the follow-up work actually ships Take part in the technical lead dev support rota, roughly once every five weeks. Mentor the engineers in the pod, growing their architectural judgement and not just their throughput, in partnership with the Engineering Manager Partner with the Product Manager to turn commercial priorities into a technical plan, and to be honest about cost, risk, and sequencing Run and encourage Knowledge Sharing Sessions, and keep the pod’s technical documentation trustworthy Interview candidates and act as a signal on the technical bar for the pod Embrace and demonstrate our values: humility, creativity, and independence What You'll Bring 7+ years building and running production systems, with at least 2 years as a tech lead, staff engineer, or equivalent technical anchor for a team Genuinely full-stack and credible on both sides. You have opinions about idempotency keys, dead-letter queues, and backoff that come from production scars rather than blog posts Expert-level TypeScript, plus solid Vue 3 or a demonstrated ability to get there fast from React or another modern framework You have led architecture for a team and had it adopted. description: At NOVACARD, we’re redefining how people use credit. You will work closely with developers, analysts, DevOps, and other QA engineers to ensure delivery speed and reliability of financial services. We expect an engineer who sees risks in a microservices architecture and prevents them with well-designed automated coverage. The role is fully remote, with occasional business trips if required. Key Responsibilities Develop, maintain, and evolve UI autotests for the Flutter mobile application (Android/iOS) using Python and Appium. Design the automation framework architecture: implement and maintain Page Object patterns, business step layers, fixtures, and environment configurations. Work with Flutter app locators: use Semantics labels and accessibility IDs, and align their implementation with mobile developers to improve test stability. Ensure autotest suite stability: diagnose and eliminate flaky tests, manage waits, and configure test isolation. Configure and maintain Allure reporting: steps, attachments such as screenshots, logs, and traffic, run history analysis, and linking autotests to test cases. Integrate autotests into CI/CD using GitLab CI: run pipelines, set up parallel runs on emulators and real devices, and maintain acceptable execution time. Analyze new functionality, participate in requirements review, and create test designs. Perform functional, integration, regression, and end-to-end testing. Test external and internal integrations, including SOAP/REST APIs, XML/JSON processing, authorization, contracts, and service interaction errors. Analyze asynchronous processes: message queues and event buses such as Kafka and RabbitMQ, consumers, retries, idempotency, and delayed effects. Identify cross-team dependencies during task definition and align them with related teams before development and testing begin. Estimate testing and automation effort, maintain and expand the regression test suite. Analyze run results, report risks, defects, and blockers in a timely manner, and prepare clear quality reporting. Automate test data preparation: use SQL scripts, internal service APIs, emulation of external system states, and mocks. Work confidently with databases: write medium-complexity SQL queries with joins and aggregations, validate data after user operations in MS SQL Server and/or PostgreSQL, and access databases from autotest code. Investigate logs and metrics in monitoring systems such as Kibana, OpenSearch, and Grafana, and trace requests across services using correlation or trace IDs. Diagnose autotest failures: identify root causes using device logs, traffic, and service logs, and file defects in the tracking system. Requirements Key Requirements 2+ years of experience in mobile UI test automation. 5+ years of experience testing microservice-based applications. 2+ years of experience testing external integrations. Strong Python skills: OOP, working with libraries, reading and refactoring code, writing utilities and helpers. Hands-on experience with pytest: fixtures, parametrization, markers, conftest, and plugins. Practical experience with Appium. Experience automating Flutter applications or readiness to quickly learn Flutter-specific automation. Knowledge of Git and experience integrating autotests into CI/CD. Experience in functional testing of Android and iOS mobile applications. Excellent knowledge of testing theory and test-design techniques. Strong understanding of SOAP/REST API testing, XML/JSON, HTTP response codes, contract schemas, session-based and token-based authentication; experience automating API calls in Python using requests or similar libraries. Confident SQL skills: ability to independently write medium-complexity queries, read database schemas, and validate data in MS SQL Server and/or PostgreSQL. Understanding of asynchronous service communication: Kafka, RabbitMQ, or similar brokers, consumers, idempotency, retry mechanisms, and delayed event processing. Experience with logging and monitoring systems such as Kibana, OpenSearch, Grafana, or similar tools. Ability to independently prepare test data using SQL scripts, internal or service APIs, and emulation of external system states. Fluent Russian and English at B1+ level, sufficient for technical documentation and an international team. Experience developing in Dart or reading Flutter app code to understand widget structure and add Semantics keys. Nice to Have Experience with device farms such as BrowserStack, Sauce Labs, or local device farms, Appium Grid, and parallel execution on device pools. Experience developing in Dart or reading Flutter app code to understand widget structure and add Semantics keys Experience with Charles, Fiddler, Swagger, Postman, and SOAP UI, including proxying and mocking responses on devices. Experience automating the API layer as a separate suite, as well as basic Postman automation and running collections via Newman. Experience with visual testing and screenshot-based tests. Experience in fintech or banking products: card processing, credit products, tariffs, fees, limits, card statuses, and card lifecycle management. Experience testing BPMS processes and workflow engines such as Camunda. Understanding of financial application security requirements: personal data handling, OTP flows, session management, and basic PCI DSS principles. Experience setting up test infrastructure: Docker, running emulators in CI, and build caching. Experience estimating testing tasks and working with QA quality metrics such as DDE, defect density, test coverage, autotest stability, and execution time. What We Offer Fully remote work format. Official employment in accordance with the Russian Labor Code for residents of Russia; contractor collaboration for candidates from other countries. Opportunity to work in an international team on an innovative digital credit product for the Mexican market. A product-focused, data-driven environment where quality directly influences the financial experience of thousands of users. The chance to work on complex mobile, backend, and integration scenarios in a rapidly growing fintech company. Originally posted on Himalayas

title: Furniture & Fabric Claims Representative
description: The Furniture and Fabric Claims Representative investigates, evaluates, and resolves product and installation claims for fabrics, trims, and wallcoverings. Serves as the primary liaison between clients, Purchasing, and installers to ensure accurate flaw assessments, fair vendor accountability, and swift, high-satisfaction resolutions. Key Responsibilities: Serve as the single point of contact for sellers and customers who report a claim with their delivered and applied/installed Fabric, Trim, or Wallcovering order. Manage daily communications via phone and email through Zendesk with customers, Sales Support associates, vendors, service technicians, freight partners, and internal departments. Assess photographic evidence, physical samples, and technical reports for material defects, shade variations, pattern misprints, and physical damage across all three product lines. Determine liability and authorize remedies—including returns, remakes, field repairs, or labor allowances—in accordance with company policies and vendor warranty guidelines. Collaborate with sales reps, Purchasing (mill vendors), and professional installers to de-escalate customer concerns and clarify installation specifications. Coordinate transportation and service provider scheduling to support timely claim resolution. Adhere to Furniture Customer Service processes and procedures. Participate in Furniture Customer Service department meetings and ongoing training. Perform any other duties as assigned by Manager/Supervisor/Lead. Decision-Making/Scope/Financial Responsibilities: Balance customer satisfaction with company policies and financial interests. Handle escalations, credits, RMAs, and accommodations decisions with sound judgment. Support financial operations through accurate order entry, billing, and application of discounts. Abilities/Key Competencies/Skills: Strong customer service orientation with clear, professional communication. Proficiency in furniture quoting, order management, fabric sales processes, and analyzing reporting from internal and external partners. Knowledge of cross-department workflows (Operations including Claims, Credit, Purchasing, Showrooms, etc.). Critical thinking and problem-solving with a focus on efficiency and seller outcomes. High attention to detail, organization, and follow-through. Ability to multi-task and adapt to changing priorities. Collaborative, team-oriented mindset with a positive, professional attitude. Solid organizational and time management skills. Comfort working in a fast-paced, contact center environment with measurable performance goals. Ability to troubleshoot for solutions before escalating. Ability to remain open minded and agile when new business decisions change a process or procedure. Requirements High School Diploma or equivalent A minimum of 3 years experience in Customer Service claims. Worked with luxury brands Originally posted on Himalayas

description: As the Business Partner, Customer Success (Program), you will be part of a dynamic Program Management Office team assigned to a specific Guidant Global MSP client, reporting into the Program Leader (Program Manager or Program Director). This role is commercially focused and accountable for protecting, growing, and defending the account by expanding spend, monetization, program adoption, and overall client value. It combines the day-to-day program delivery ownership of the Program Lead with the candidate-facing and supplier-facing rigor of the Senior Talent Consultant, wrapped in a strategic Business Partner lens toward the client’s Customer Success organization. You will be empowered to build senior stakeholder relationships, proactively identify new business opportunities within the account, lead a confident commercial talk track, and deliver flawless operations in conjunction with the Client Sponsor, Service Delivery team, and Shared Back-Office Services team. We are looking for an experienced MSP professional with incredibly high integrity, an inquisitive mind, strong commercial instincts, and a passion for operational and customer service excellence. Commitment to our culture, values, and behaviors: Achievement of the position objectives and key responsibilities is attained by: Fostering collaboration and building strong connections that drive Impellam’s strategy and initiatives forward. Championing respect and inclusion, ensuring every interaction reflects our commitment to equal opportunity and a positive workplace culture. Acting responsibly and with integrity, prioritizing the safety and well-being of yourself, others, the environment and our company. Key responsibilities: Commercial Ownership, Customer Success & Business Partnership – your top priority is building relationships and driving measurable commercial impact across the client account: Commercial Ownership – protect, grow, and defend the account by identifying opportunities to increase spend, monetization, program adoption, and overall account value. Business Development – proactively hunt for new opportunities within the account, including new departments, hiring managers, labor categories, service lines, and areas of unmanaged or under-penetrated spend. Senior Relationship Management – build and maintain trusted relationships with senior and executive client leaders, carrying a confident commercial talk track that connects program performance to business outcomes. Customer Success Business Partnering – act as a proactive Business Partner to the client’s Customer Success, HR, Procurement, and Hiring Manager stakeholders, translating program data into practical insight, recommendations, and growth opportunities. Client Relationship & Satisfaction Management – develop and maintain business relationships with key client stakeholders and hiring managers, ensuring the program is positioned as a strategic solution rather than a transactional delivery function. Commercial Thought Leadership – be viewed as a subject matter expert to the client; provide ongoing training, education, and market insight for HR, Procurement, Customer Success, and Hiring Manager stakeholders. Communication – support delivery of relevant corporate, client, and team communications, ensuring messaging reinforces account growth, program value, and stakeholder alignment. Issue Resolution – ongoing management and resolution of program, team, and people issues that may impact client satisfaction, account health, or commercial momentum. Commercial Rhythm, Pipeline & Business Reviews: Pipeline Management – maintain visibility to active and future account opportunities, tracking progress, barriers, next steps, and stakeholder engagement required to convert growth opportunities. Forecasting & Target Management – support account forecasting against growth, spend, utilization, and program expansion targets, using data to identify risks and opportunities early. QBRs & Business Reviews – own or support the regular client business review cadence, preparing clear insights on program performance, value delivered, pipeline, market trends, and recommended actions. Program Management: Day-to-Day Operations – work closely with the Service Delivery and back-office teams to ensure that day-to-day client requirements are being met; ensure SLA/KPI compliance is met at all levels. Supplier/Vendor Operations – actively manage the reporting and KPIs to ensure supplier performance for appropriate job category coverage, response timing and candidate quality, ongoing supplier rationalization and optimization. Escalation Management – proactively identify and successfully manage through day-to-day issues that impact program performance and client satisfaction levels, escalating to the Program Leader as needed. VMS Management – build a strong relationship with the VMS Supplier to ensure system performance meets customer expectations. Experienced with Business Intelligence Tools – Power BI preferred. Billing, Reporting & Analytics: Ensure accurate and timely billing, reporting, and ongoing analysis, including scheduled and ad hoc requests; prepare weekly and monthly status reports on program activity, account health, pipeline, and issues. Project Management – support the management and implementation of program/project modifications and enhancements. Continuous Improvement – use experience, data, and analytics to drive improvements in program process, utilization, satisfaction, and commercial performance. Workplace Health, Safety, and Environmental Compliance: At Impellam, it is our moral obligation to safeguard each other, our customers, our temporary workforce and the environment by operating an injury-free, healthy workplace that minimizes our environmental impact. Impellam is committed to providing a safe and secure working environment for all employees and promoting best practices. You will meet our HSE obligations by committing to: Seek to prevent injury to any employee, customer, worker, or contractor. Actively participating and completing compliance training as required. Consider the safety implications of decisions. Work experience and attributes: Essential: Knowledge of: Staffing Industry, Managed Service Provider (MSP), Vendor Management Systems (VMS), Procurement, Statement of Work (SOW), Human Resources (HR). Experience leading teams to meet service level agreements and key performance indicators relevant for MSP business performance; strong experience, and detailed orientation, in report development, management, and QA. Experience in identifying and leading initiatives for process improvement. Project Management experience. Effective communication, presentation, time management, organization, and planning techniques. MS Excel and MS PowerPoint. Experienced with Business Intelligence tools and driving decisions using analytics. Commercial account management disciplines, including pipeline management, forecasting, QBR/business-review preparation, stakeholder mapping, and growth planning. Modern sales technology and CRM platforms, including Salesforce or Microsoft Dynamics, and tools such as ZoomInfo, Outreach, Gong, Highspot, or similar enablement and intelligence platforms. Ability to: Demonstrate a track record of growing and maturing client relationships. Demonstrate fiscal responsibility for account management. Manage by influence. Demonstrate excellent communication. Problem solves and present conceptual information to all levels of internal and external management. Initiate, recommend, or provide solutions through designated channels. Build and execute project plans. Manage data collection and reports for regular and ad hoc reporting needs. Core Competencies: Passion for excellence. Stress tolerance and ability to thrive in a dynamic environment. High level of attention to detail. Proactive approach to supporting a team and client partnership. Urgency and speed of response. High level of dedication and accountability. Minimum of 3 years of experience as part of a Managed Service Program or Staffing management environment. General Understanding of: MSP / Human Capital / Staffing. Human Resources. Procurement. title: Computer Vision Engineer - Body Sensor Networks
description: Do you get excited about building cutting-edge perception systems that work reliably in the real world? Do you have a strong foundation in computer vision, robotics, or sensor fusion? Are you interested in shaping new technology capabilities within a growing and innovative high-tech company, where people and fun are part of our core values? We’d love to have you! Who is Xsens Xsens is a leading full-stack provider of sensors, software, and analytics that enable the digitization of movement. Xsens serves entertainment, humanoid robotics, health & sports and automation & mobility markets. By turning complex motion data into actionable insight, we help our partners accelerate development, improve control and learning, and bring physically intelligent systems to life. We collaborate with leading global innovators including Boston Dynamics, Toyota, Siemens, Electronic Arts, Epic Games, Netflix, and 20th Century Studios, alongside more than 1,000 research institutions, humanoid robotics companies and universities worldwide. Your role as a Computer Vision Engineer at Xsens As a Computer Vision Engineer, you will lead camera-based perception for Xsens motion capture. Your role is to establish Deep Learning and Computer Vision pipelines to turn camera images into human pose estimate. You will learn from the highly-skilled team of sensor fusion experts, biomechanists and mathematicians. You will be its computer vision specialist, and report to the Technology Manager. The position is open to hybrid / remote working. Key challenges: Select, adapt and fine-tune deep learning models for 2D and 3D human pose estimation from cameras, that perform robustly in challenging real-world conditions. Develop camera models and calibration routines for a range of camera and lens configurations. Evaluation of motion capture output and developing compensatory algorithms and techniques to handle camera /vision failure modes. Build training and evaluation pipelines from camera and optical motion capture recordings. Use synthetic data where real data is insufficient. Track the computer vision research landscape and assess whether new techniques are feasible for Xsens products. Requirements Xsens is looking for a hands-on Computer Vision Engineer who combines strong theoretical foundations with a proven ability to build and ship working systems. Required MSc/PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Robotics or a related field, with years of relevant industry or applied research experience. Hands-on experience training and fine-tuning deep learning models for human pose estimation, with results evaluated on public benchmarks. Solid understanding of camera and lens models, including wide field-of-view optics, intrinsic and extrinsic calibration, and multi-view geometry. Familiarity with the output representations of common pose models, such as keypoint sets and SMPL-family parameters. Experience with tools in markerless eco-system such as OpenCV, Sapiens, and SAM3D. Proficiency in Python. Working knowledge of C++ for integrating models into an existing C++ codebase. Preferred Experience with synthetic data generation and rendering pipelines. Experience optimizing models for real-time deployment, for example with ONNX, TensorRT or quantization. Experience building datasets and benchmarks for human motion. Working at Xsens We value ingenious ideas, no matter where they come from. We believe diverse thoughts, voices, and backgrounds make us stronger as a company. We know that it is through collaboration with people from all walks of life that we make the most positive impact as an organization. Join Xsens ’ innovative, ambitious, and international team, where your ideas and talents make an impact. Along with a competitive compensation package, we offer a range of benefits designed to support your well-being and help you thrive. 28 paid vacation days with an option to buy, sell, or carry over days, giving you flexibility to manage your time off as appropriate to your situation Tax perks for your sports memberships and bicycle purchase; so staying active is easier than ever. Flexible working hours and the option to work from home, helping you balance life and work Paid volunteer time: Through our partnership with Stichting Present, you have the opportunity to give back to the community during office hours Our partnership with Equip gives you on-demand access to a dedicated financial planner who provides clear guidance and a concrete plan for wealth building, pensions, and major life events. Enjoy company social events as well as fun, informal activities organized by our staff association. From movie nights and sports clinics to cooking classes and LAN parties, there’s always something happening to connect and have fun Originally posted on Himalayas

title: DevOps
description: At NOVACARD , we’re redefining how people use credit. We are the first interest-free and no-annual-fee credit card in Mexico , designed to simplify personal finances and give users complete control - all from a mobile app. With NOVACARD, users can access up to $200,000 MXN in credit , only pay when they use it, and manage everything digitally in under 5 minutes. Our mission is to empower people to make smarter financial decisions by offering flexibility, transparency, and the freedom they need to reach their goals. Simple finances, big goals. About the Role: We’re looking for a DevOps Engineer to design, deploy, and operate AWS infrastructure for a large-scale migration of a digital financial product. You’ll build and maintain a production-ready platform covering AWS networking, Kubernetes/EKS, CI/CD, observability, backup/restore, and secure access management. You’ll collaborate closely with development, system analysis, QA, and engineering teams to ensure fast delivery, stable services, and a controlled migration. Key Responsibilities: AWS Infrastructure Design & Operations Design, deploy, and maintain AWS infrastructure: VPC, Subnets, Route Tables, Security Groups, IAM, EC2, EBS, S3, ELB/ALB/NLB, Route53. Configure AWS networking: public/private subnets, NAT Gateway, Internet Gateway, VPC Peering / Transit Gateway, VPN, routing. Ensure HA, backup/restore, disaster recovery, and production infrastructure principles. Create and maintain AWS infrastructure as code using Terraform. Kubernetes & Containerization Build and operate Kubernetes on AWS (EKS). Work with core Kubernetes objects: Deployment, StatefulSet, DaemonSet, Service, Ingress, ConfigMap, Secret, Job/CronJob, PVC/PV, Namespace, ServiceAccount. Use Helm for application management. Configure Ingress Controller, Load Balancer, and TLS/certificates. Understand Kubernetes storage and ensure stateful applications run reliably. Work with Docker: image builds, registry, container troubleshooting. CI/CD & Automation Build CI/CD processes, preferably with GitLab CI. Automate deployment of applications and dependent services. Integrate infrastructure changes into pipelines and maintain reproducible environments. Observability, Reliability & Operations Set up monitoring with Prometheus + Grafana: metrics and alerts. Organize centralized log collection and analysis: Loki/ELK/OpenSearch. Diagnose network and system issues in Linux. Ensure production stability, respond to incidents, and eliminate root causes. Security & Access Management Manage secrets: AWS Secrets Manager / Vault/OpenBao / External Secrets. Configure RBAC/IAM and follow the principle of least privilege. Ensure secure service-to-service communication and infrastructure access. Data & Services Support PostgreSQL, Redis, RabbitMQ/Kafka at the infrastructure and application integration level. Ensure backup/restore and fault tolerance for stateful services. Help teams deploy and maintain dependent services in Kubernetes. Requirements Key Requirements: AWS & Networking Strong AWS experience: VPC, Subnets, Route Tables, Security Groups, IAM, EC2, EBS, S3, ELB/ALB/NLB, Route53. Good understanding of AWS networking: public/private subnets, NAT Gateway, Internet Gateway, VPC Peering / Transit Gateway, VPN, routing. Kubernetes & Containers Hands-on experience building and operating Kubernetes on AWS (EKS). Understanding of core Kubernetes objects: Deployment, StatefulSet, DaemonSet, Service, Ingress, ConfigMap, Secret, Job/CronJob, PVC/PV, Namespace, ServiceAccount. Experience with Helm. Experience configuring Ingress Controller, Load Balancer, and TLS/certificates. Experience with Docker: image builds, registry, container troubleshooting. Understanding of Kubernetes storage and stateful application operation. IaC & CI/CD Terraform — creating and maintaining AWS infrastructure as code. Experience building CI/CD, preferably GitLab CI. Data, Queues & Storage Experience with PostgreSQL, Redis, RabbitMQ/Kafka at the infrastructure and application integration level. Understanding of HA, backup/restore, disaster recovery, and production infrastructure principles. Monitoring, Logging & Secrets Monitoring: Prometheus + Grafana, configuring metrics and alerts. Centralized log collection and analysis: Loki/ELK/OpenSearch. Secrets management: AWS Secrets Manager / Vault/OpenBao / External Secrets. Linux & Security Linux administration and confident diagnosis of network and system issues. Experience configuring RBAC/IAM and following the principle of least privilege. Especially Important Practical Experience: The engineer must be able to design an AWS network from scratch → set up EKS → deploy an application and dependent services → configure ingress/DNS/TLS → CI/CD → monitoring/logging → backup → hand over a production-ready infrastructure for operation. Nice to Have: Experience migrating lending systems or fintech products. Experience building CI/CD with GitLab CI. Hands-on experience with Vault/OpenBao, External Secrets. description: WHY XOGENE? At Xogene, we’re revolutionizing the future of clinical trial transparency through AI-powered solutions. Join our team of experts who are transforming how leading pharmaceutical and life sciences companies navigate regulatory compliance. If you're driven by solving complex problems in a professional environment focused on meaningful and rewarding work, we want to hear from you. POSITION OVERVIEW Xogene combines regulatory expertise with advanced technology to automate complex processes in clinical trial transparency. Our software streamlines workflows through AI and agentic networking capabilities, improving data transformation and regulatory compliance for leading pharmaceutical and life sciences companies. We're committed to advancing technological solutions in clinical trial transparency. As we continue to expand, we are seeking an experienced QA Tech Lead to drive our test automation initiatives and strengthen our testing strategy. Reporting to the Director of Engineering, the QA Tech Lead will own test automation strategy and execution. This is a hands-on technical role: you will write and maintain automated tests while guiding the team's automation direction. KEY TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES Lead and mentor automation engineers, provide technical guidance to the wider testing team, and foster a culture of quality excellence and continuous improvement. Support skill development across the team, including cross-training manual testers in automation (e.g., Playwright Codegen, low-code contributions, and AI-assisted scripting with tools such as Claude) and ensuring automation engineers understand product domain and end-user workflows. Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Development, Customer Success, Product Management, Design and Product Support across multiple time zones. Define the overall risk-based test strategy, focusing testing effort where regulatory and customer risk is highest, with clear criteria for which tests are automated, which remain manual, and what doesn't need a test at all. Own automation test plans and standards across all Xogene product releases. Create and maintain quality metrics, KPIs, and dashboards on testing progress and potential blockers, and provide regular updates to the Director of Engineering. Define test scope, objectives, success criteria, and time and resource estimates with stakeholders, and ensure comprehensive coverage through effective test case design and review. Identify, assess, and mitigate quality risks throughout each sprint cycle, including during pre-release dry runs. Architect, build, and maintain scalable automation testing frameworks, including our custom-built Playwright framework, enforcing code standards, and maximizing test reusability through the Page Object Model (POM). Develop and execute automated test scenarios, scripts, and procedures for system, integration, regression, and API testing, growing automated test coverage across all Xogene software products. Act as the technical point of contact and subject matter expert on the code and system architecture, diagnosing complex technical problems and designing solutions that reflect lessons learned. Identify manual test cases suitable for automation and work with the Test Lead to prioritize and transition them. Move automated suites from manual triggers to a tiered CI/CD strategy in GitHub Actions (Smoke, Sanity, and Nightly Regression) that serves as quality gates for developers, and maintain suite health, including resolving flaky tests and tracking automation coverage. Oversee the integration between Playwright and Zephyr Scale, reporting test results directly into Zephyr Scale through automated JUnit XML reporting pipelines and maintaining a single source of truth for QA metrics. Oversee test environments and test data management, ensuring realistic, compliant test data is available for both manual and automated testing. Perform manual testing where automation is impractical, defect triage and resolution, and User Acceptance Testing (UAT), contributing automated regression coverage where practical. Contribute automation coverage and results to validation documentation, including the Test Plan, Test Summary Report, Traceability Matrix, and UAT Scripts. Page Object Model (POM), plus experience with other automation tools (e.g., Selenium, REST Assured) Strong hands-on programming skills (TypeScript, Python, JavaScript) and working knowledge of database technologies Proficiency in performance testing tools (JMeter, LoadRunner) and API testing frameworks Experience with CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, and test integration strategies communication skills, with the ability to explain technical topics to non-technical team members DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS Ability to balance long-term automation architecture with immediate release Translate engineering realities into clear, structured, and data-backed communication for technical and non-technical stakeholders. Support realistic planning by ensuring timelines, scope, and priorities are clearly understood and agreed. Support product and engineering prioritisation decisions by analysing delivery, technical, and business data, and translating inputs from Product and the wider business into clear, data-backed recommendations on sequencing and trade-offs. Establish, track, and evolve delivery and productivity metrics (e.g. throughput, predictability, flow, progress against plan) to provide meaningful insight. Analyse productivity and delivery data to identify trends, bottlenecks, and improvement opportunities. Prepare consolidated engineering status reports, delivery health views, and roadmap updates for leadership and stakeholders. Drive continuous improvement in engineering operations, planning practices, and ways of working across Sportsbook Engineering. Drive adoption of AI tooling across Sportsbook Engineering delivery and operations, from planning and reporting through to code review and alert triage, and measure its impact on throughput, predictability, and operational health. Success Criteria Delivery plans and progress are transparent, reliable, and easy to understand for leadership and stakeholders. Technical initiatives, architecture work, and technical debt are visible, prioritised, and accurately represented in Jira. The Sportsbook Engineering technical roadmap is current, coherent, and actively maintained, with priorities clearly agreed and reviewed regularly. Cross-team risks and dependencies are identified early and managed proactively. Engineering Managers and Principal Engineers experience reduced coordination overhead and improved alignment. Fewer late-stage delivery surprises, with clearer expectations around scope, timelines, and trade-offs. Productivity and delivery metrics provide meaningful insight, supporting better planning and decision-making. Strong coordination between Sportsbook Engineering and other Technology teams on shared initiatives. AI tooling is actively and responsibly adopted across Sportsbook Engineering, with measurable impact on delivery speed, quality, and operational insight. Requirements What are we looking for? Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical topics clearly and concisely to technical and non-technical audiences. Strong experience in technical delivery coordination, technical project/program management, or engineering operations. Proven experience working with internal technical and product stakeholders across multiple teams. Strong organisational, planning, and prioritisation skills, with attention to detail. Ability to work effectively through influence rather than authority. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to synthesise complex data and business information into actionable insights, supporting product and engineering prioritisation. Experience working in Agile delivery environments and with modern engineering teams. Ability to learn and understand new technical domains sufficiently to support planning, communication, and delivery alignment. Highly comfortable using AI and AI-powered tools, including those built internally at HRD, using them confidently to support analysis, planning, and day-to-day decision-making. You are energised by our AI-first direction and ready to champion responsible adoption across the teams you support. What’s in it for you? description: Mission – Why we exist, what we do, and why we need you SpotMe is a leading B2B event platform that helps enterprises increase the impact of their events by delivering CRM-connected, high-quality experiences across in-person, virtual, hybrid events, and webinars. With a strong focus on life sciences, SpotMe powers Onomi: an HCP engagement product that enables medical and commercial teams to run impactful congresses, symposia, advisory boards, and webinars. Together, SpotMe and Onomi turn events into a company’s most effective engagement channel. This role sets and runs the security configuration of the company across different tools we use. This position is the ideal role for someone who wants to raise the level of IT security in an environment where it carries real weight . Our customers are enterprises, and more than half a million healthcare professionals engage on Onomi every month. How our own accounts, laptops and tools are secured is part of that picture rather than a back-office concern. This is not about one access request or one control, it is about lifting the IT layer that everything else sits on. As a Security Operations Engineer, you will be reporting to the Chief Security and Trust Officer and you will spend roughly: 35% Identity, access and lifecycle. Joiners, movers and leavers, access requests and approvals, associate access, security hygiene across our SaaS tools, access reviews. Google Workspace is our identity layer. 20% Endpoint management and protection. Implementing both across our macOS fleet, then keeping the fleet in a known state and triaging what the tooling reports once it is live. 30% Security controls and access models inside our tools. Around a dozen SaaS applications, each with its own permission model, its own security controls, its own limits on what can actually be enforced, and its own logging capability. You will manage how each should be configured, design the role and permission structures inside them, work out what a given plan tier does and does not allow, and know where a tool is blind so we can compensate elsewhere. This also covers the alerts and logs from the tools we already have, including threat intelligence. 15% Building internal tooling. Access reporting, cross-tool investigation, and a small, deliberately tuned detection layer. Built primarily with Claude Code, jointly with the CSTO, against a written specification that already exists. This is an IT security role covering identity, device management and internal telemetry, with a real build component. It sits in security rather than IT because the work is judged on risk rather than on service. The role is both preventive and reactive. Most of it is preventive: closing gaps before anyone else finds them, and building the visibility that shows you where they are. But when a security event happens, you are part of the response, and security events do not keep office hours. This is not a shift pattern or a formal on-call rotation, and it is not frequent. Objectives - The problems you will solve In your first 1 month: You have a complete inventory of our tools and of how access to each one is granted and removed. You know which accounts exist across those tools and which of them map to a real person. You run onboarding, offboarding and access requests independently, without escalation. You have given us your first read on the environment: the three or four things you would fix first, why each one matters, and what it would take. After 3 months: You have a view of the security settings in each cloud/SaaS tool we use, what each is capable of enforcing, and what it currently enforces. You have recommended the changes worth making in priority order, and the first of them are already applied. You have produced the plan and the recommendation for the new endpoint management and protection: the options, the obstacles we will hit, and how you would get past them. After 6 months: New endpoint management and protection are running across the fleet and you can report coverage. There is one place that shows who has access to what across all tools, and access reviews run from it and produce the evidence export. The new Security Dashboard is built to the point where a real investigation can be done in it. What you need to be great at: Working across multiple areas of security rather than specialising in one, in combination with “standard IT activities”. Identity, endpoints, tool configuration and logging all sit in this role, and none of them get a dedicated person. Judging the balance between security that limits people and what the business actually needs to get done. Knowing which control is worth the friction and which one will simply be worked around. Because of our business, users often need immediate action. Some tickets can wait a week and some arrive as a Slack message because a customer event is happening now. Judging which is which, without treating everything as urgent or making people escalate to get attention, is a daily call. Google Workspace as an identity platform, including SSO and SAML app integration, groups and org units, admin roles and delegation, context-aware access, the security and admin audit logs and the alerts built on them Understanding the usage of APIs, minimally knowledge around REST and HTTP methods status codes, authentication via API keys, OAuth 2.0 What we are most curious about: How you decide between buying and building, what you base it on, and how the decision survives in real life. Where you think the effort really belongs when it comes to security settings and capabilities, and which attack vectors matter most for a company like ours. Your process for choosing security tools, what you rule out early, and what you insist on testing before anything gets signed. How you adapt your views and actions based on publicly known security incidents and breaches. How you handle the human pressure to override security requirements. A detection or an alert you switched off, and what convinced you. SpotMe recruits, compensates, and promotes regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, parental status, or veteran status. title: 🌍 Control System Engineer, Remote- Contract
description: Role Title: Control System Engineer Role Type: Contract Location: Remote Required Skills: PID controller design Plant modelling Real system deployment In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters. This opportunity is ideal for professionals passionate about shipping robust controllers, modeling complex plants, and applying both classical and modern control strategies in tangible environments. Scope of Work: Design and tune PID and advanced controllers (e.g., LQR, MPC, Kalman Filters) for deployment on physical systems such as robotics, drones, automotive, or industrial hardware. Develop plant models from first principles and validate them against empirical data using state-space and transfer function methodologies. Implement and verify control algorithms in Python using open source toolkits (e.g., python-control, SciPy, CasADi, do-mpc, Julia ControlSystems, OpenModelica). Document engineering decisions and control strategies with clear, high-quality written communication, and engage in effective verbal discussions as required. Analyze system performance, identify areas for improvement, and iterate on design for optimal real-world operation. Collaborate remotely with interdisciplinary contributors while maintaining autonomy and technical independence. Preferred Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree (or higher) in Control, Electrical, Mechanical, Mechatronics, or Aerospace Engineering. Over 5 years of hands-on controller design experience post-degree, with proven real system deployment (not simulation-only). Proficiency in building and validating physical plant models using first principles and data-driven methods. Demonstrated delivery of both classical (PID) and at least one modern control method (LQR, MPC, or Kalman) on real hardware. Fluency in Python for control code development, debugging, and validation using open source stacks. Exceptional written and verbal English communication skills, focused on clarity and precision. Additional strengths such as a Master’s or PhD, production MPC with tools like do-mpc or CasADi, Modelica/OpenModelica modeling, Julia proficiency, system identification, embedded C/C++, ROS, nonlinear/robust/adaptive control, or contributions to publications/open source are valued. description: Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution.
