If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry. If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you. Are you ready to be part of the future? About the job We are looking for a Head of Underwriting to drive underwriting activities across Digital Asset Financing. This is a senior, hands-on role requiring strong financial and credit analysis capabilities, sound commercial judgement and a deep understanding of counterparty risk. You will assess financing opportunities, evaluate institutional counterparties and structure transactions that balance commercial objectives with robust risk management. Working closely with internal stakeholders, you will play a key role in evaluating complex transactions and supporting informed, timely decisions in a dynamic market. Responsibilities Lead the credit assessment of borrowers (funds, miners, trading firms, corporates) from initial due diligence through transaction evaluation and approval recommendations. Analyse counterparty financial statements, liquidity, leverage, trading strategy, business models and overall creditworthiness. Evaluate digital asset collateral, collateral coverage, market volatility, liquidity and liquidation risks, where applicable. Assess operational and custodial setup of counterparties Structure terms, recommending appropriate LTV, tenor, covenants and margining. Identify and assess counterparty, market, concentration and operational risks associated with proposed transactions. Prepare clear, evidence-based underwriting assessments and present recommendations to relevant decision-makers. Monitor existing exposures, identify emerging risks and recommend appropriate mitigation measures. Collaborate with internal stakeholders to facilitate efficient transaction execution while maintaining disciplined underwriting standards. Continuously enhance underwriting methodologies in response to evolving digital asset markets, products and risk dynamics. Requirements Requirements 7+ years of relevant experience in underwriting, lending, credit risk, digital asset financing or a comparable field. Strong expertise in financial analysis, counterparty assessment, loan structuring (LTV, rates, thresholds) and credit risk evaluation. Understanding of collaterals including BTC/ETC, custody and transfers Margin mechanics awareness, including margin requirements, collateralisation, loan-to-value ratios, margin thresholds and liquidation processes. Counterparty due diligence experience, being able to effectively assess business models, ownership structures, operational capabilities and relevant risk factors. Skilled in ongoing risk monitoring, collateral coverage, margin calls, margin breaches and timely escalation of emerging risks. Understanding of digital assets, collateralised financing, cryptocurrency markets and associated liquidity and volatility risks. Experience evaluating complex transactions and making well-reasoned recommendations based on quantitative and qualitative analysis. Strong commercial acumen and the ability to balance business opportunities with prudent risk management. Excellent analytical, problem-solving and critical-thinking skills, with exceptional attention to detail. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to articulate complex risk considerations to senior decision-makers. High levels of integrity, accountability and independent judgement. Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, international environment, navigating ambiguity and making sound decisions under pressure. Important information for candidates Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles: Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website. Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms. Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ or @ We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately. When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website. Highlights Originally posted on Himalayas

Будуєш системний процес тестування. Працюєш у тісній зв’язці з UA. Використовуєш AI для пришвидшення продакшену та тестів. Вплив на CPA та revenue через нові креативні підходи. Прискорення speed-to-test через AI та automation. Спільна робота з UA для прийняття data-driven рішень. Ми очікуємо, що ти маєш: Глибоке розуміння метрик: CTR, Hook rate, Hold rate, CPA, CR, LTV. Досвід масштабування у Meta / TikTok. Системне мислення (будує процес, а не хаос). Hypothesis-first підхід. Практичне використання AI у продакшені. Ownership за бізнес-результат. Буде плюсом : Досвід роботи з subscription-моделлю. Досвід масштабування бюджетів. Побудова креативних пайплайнів із використанням automation. Досвід партнерства з UA / Growth командами. title: Mitigator III - DEFAULT MITIGATION MANAGEMENT
description: Summary The Mitigator III manages mortgage modification program cases from intake through final resolution. This role gathers and validates borrower and case information, prepares and reviews loss mitigation submissions, administers Portal activity and deadlines, facilitates communications and conferences, documents compliance, prepares required reports and court filings, and maintains complete and confidential case records. Schedule and conduct client interviews; gather and validate required bankruptcy, household, employment, income, expense, and mortgage information; and assist with applications, questionnaires, and forms. Prepare, assemble, and quality-control Initial MMP Packages and other loss mitigation submissions; upload documentation through the Portal; and coordinate required notices and court filings. Apply MMP rules, procedures, forms, deadlines, participant responsibilities, creditor documentation requirements, and available loss mitigation options when guiding participants and administering cases. Support access to and use of the Court-approved Portal and Document Preparation System, troubleshoot workflow questions, and create or update user guides and support materials. Monitor Portal communications, case activity, participant obligations, and case-specific deadlines, taking appropriate action to keep each matter progressing toward a decision. Prepare for, schedule, and conduct MMP conferences as needed; coordinate with parties and counsel; issue required advance notice; and document conference activity in the Portal. Identify and objectively document non-compliance, preserve supporting evidence, prepare required certificates and reports for Court review, and escalate delays, unresolved disputes, or failures to prosecute. 10. Monitor trial loan modifications through execution of a final modification or denial, maintaining appropriate Portal access and case oversight throughout the trial period. 11. Maintain complete and confidential case notes, ECF updates, status records, reports, correspondence, and other program documentation; coordinate with approved outside professionals when directed. 12. Train, coach, and supervise team members on assigned procedures, quality standards, and workflows, and maintain supporting process and training documentation. 13. Work independently, manage a high-volume caseload and competing deadlines, support required operating coverage, and complete assigned projects and operational reporting. Education and/or Work Experience Requirements College degree required. Professional experience working with attorneys, courts, creditors and servicers, trustees, customers, and other stakeholders. Mortgage loss mitigation knowledge is essential; prior experience as a Loss Mitigation Specialist is preferred. Bankruptcy, legal support, court-program, mediation-program, paralegal, or comparable regulated case-administration experience is strongly preferred. Demonstrated experience managing deadlines, case workflows, document exchanges, quality-control review, and electronic court filing or docket-review processes, including ECF/PACER-related workflows. Knowledge, Skills, and Competencies Advanced knowledge of mortgage loss mitigation, including loan modification, refinance, forbearance, short sale, surrender, mortgage financial instruments, income validation, documentation requirements, and program eligibility terms. Working knowledge of Chapter 13 bankruptcy and MMP procedures, with the ability to interpret and follow Court orders, local procedures, deadlines, and required forms. Ability to remain neutral, professional, and process-focused while communicating procedural requirements clearly to consumers, attorneys, creditors and servicers, trustees, and the Court. Exceptional case-management skills, including deadline tracking, documentation control, quality assurance, issue escalation, and management of a high-volume caseload. Strong judgment and attention to detail, including the ability to identify non-compliance, document facts objectively, and prepare accurate court-facing reports and compliance documentation. Ability to train, coach, and supervise others and to develop and maintain procedure guides, training materials, and user support documentation. Self-directed and accountable, with the ability to prioritize competing demands, meet deadlines, and work effectively across required operating hours. Why Join Stretto? You’ll have the opportunity to shape the direction of a rapidly expanding business unit while making a direct impact on the legal community. title: Senior Voice Routing Manager
description: The Challenge We connect over 500’000 callers in 190 countries: that represents 36,000 calling corridors and over 100 million calling minutes. We work with various global suppliers optimising for call quality. It’s complex. Each calling corridor has its own quality quirks and legal and regulatory rules to work within. We want someone to own call quality and routing holistically across all of it: routing daily to optimize what's happening right now, while watching the data for the long-term trends that tell us where to fix things next. A failed call is not a metric to us. It's someone not hearing their mother's voice or its an important business call that fails. We also have real ambitions to scale calling well beyond where we are today, so this complexity isn't going anywhere. It's only going to grow. Talk360 has been profitable since 2025, expanding beyond our core calling app into embedded, B2B2C calling for partners. We are lean, around 30 people globally, spread across the Netherlands, South Africa, Nigeria, Suriname, Turkey, Egypt, Kenya, Ukraine, and beyond. That means this role has real scope from day one: no layers between you and the decisions that matter, and no shortage of things worth tackling. What You'll Do Own call quality holistically : hold the full picture of call quality end to end, working with the team on both the daily grind and the long-term view, moving fluidly between quick fixes and structured experiments. Manage zones, codes, and origins : own and continuously refine our zone, dialing code, and call origin management, keeping the underlying structure clean and accurate across all 900 zones. Update routing continuously : change routing several times a day, from immediate fixes to longer-running tests of new suppliers. Work cross-functionally by design : partner daily with Ozcan, who owns supplier account management and deal creation, and Mahmoud, who runs hourly monitoring and support-team escalations to suppliers. Work with Ewan on automating the processes behind routing, and with Product and CRM to improve the experience for our end users. Move routing toward automation : work toward (semi) automated routing and pricing, reducing how much of this still runs on manual, single-person work. Requirements What You'll Bring Hands-on experience with international A-Z calling and telco routing: zones, codes, LCR, and SIP response codes, built at a telco, carrier, or comms platform with real cross-border calling experience. Use coding agent harnesses such as Cursor, Claude Code, and Codex as part of your workflow, and review generated code against tests, types, and contracts. Deep command of at least one high-performance language, such as Java/Kotlin, Go, Rust, C++, or C#, including its memory model, concurrency model, and runtime. Ability to work productively in Python, the language of the current services. Hands-on experience with observability in production: metrics, tracing, logging, SLOs, and tools such as OpenTelemetry, Datadog, Grafana, or Prometheus. Proven experience with performance work: profiling, query optimization, caching strategies, and load testing. Production depth in distributed systems: timeouts, retries, idempotency, partial failure, streaming (SSE, WebSockets), and decisions based on tail latency (p95, p99). Relevant experience delivering full stack to production with TypeScript and a modern web framework. Day-to-day fluency with coding agent harnesses such as Cursor, Claude Code, and Codex, including critical review of generated code. Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to discuss architecture and trade-offs in depth. Advanced communication in English; Spanish is a plus. Nice to have: Experience with serving layers for analytical data (OLAP, columnar stores, semantic layers) or with data platform integration. Experience integrating applications with LLM or agent services as a consumer. Experience with B2B, multi-country, or multi-tenant products. Set the operating model, priorities, and quality bar for the function Coach and develop team members as the function scales from strategy design into steady-state execution Build strong, trusted working relationships with Legal, Risk, and local Compliance teams across regions What We Look For In You Significant experience (at least 10+ years) in regulatory change, regulatory affairs, or a comparable senior compliance/ policy role, ideally within crypto, fintech, or another heavily regulated financial sector Demonstrated experience building or significantly reshaping a regulatory change function, not just operating within an existing one Global exposure to crypto-specific regulation, with working knowledge of multiple regulatory regimes Track record of influencing senior internal stakeholders (Legal, Risk, Compliance) without formal authority over them Experience building and leading a team, including hiring and developing junior talent Excellent written and verbal communication skills; comfortable operating at executive level internally and externally Pragmatic, execution-oriented mindset — able to move from strategic vision to operational detail Perks & Benefits Competitive total compensation package L&D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development Various team building programs and company events More that we love to tell you along the process! description: Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder led, profitable and growing. Canonical ’s product management team are technologists who have a passion for delivering products and solutions that help shape market demands while elevating open source software everywhere. This is a general application track for the product management positions at Canonical . You will set a clear vision, prioritize work effectively, and ensure the team delivers high-quality products that meet business and user needs. Apply here if you excel at leadership, communication, and technical vision, and believe you can drive product strategy for the business needs of tomorrow. During the interview process we will identify specific software products which would be a good fit for your interests. We believe that open source is transforming the way that enterprises solve their business needs. Although open source has been around for thirty years, it is only now fundamental to every corner of the software landscape. Going forward we believe open source will have an even bigger impact as it moves into specialised vertical markets. Our goal is to make open source easier, more reliable and more secure for deployment and development. We strive to be the provider of ‘most software to most companies’, starting with Ubuntu but expanding to cover every class of application on every class of compute. To deliver on that ambition, we select product managers for their intellect and strong drive to advance the open source community. Together, we aim to improve open source quality, outreach, and impact. Our product managers set the vision and the direction to ensure teams deliver the right products in the right markets at the right time. They push the boundaries of the technology landscape to identify and deliver products into new and existing market opportunities. Our product managers are technology professionals with a software engineering background who strive to become business executives and entrepreneurs. We discuss strategy, plan product development, drive engagement, and promote the open source way. We oversee the entire product lifecycle from conception to delivery, blending technical expertise, strategic thinking, analytics, project management skills and effective communication to ensure products meet both user needs and business objectives. We have open product manager roles across a wide range of product domains, including: Ubuntu Platform - Our Ubuntu experience on Desktop, Server, Windows (WSL), Multipass, Gaming, Enterprise, & Hardware Enablement Ubuntu Pro Services - Our key commercial offerings Ubuntu Pro, Compliance, Standards, Security Engineering, and Managed Services on cloud and on prem AI/ML & MLOps - Open source AI/ML solutions, AIOps automation, model lifecycle management, Kubeflow, MLFlow, KServe, and AI infrastructure on cloud and edge IoT - Ubuntu on embedded devices and/or edge servers, device management, and robotics Cloud - Ubuntu in public and private clouds, promoting automation frameworks, and including technologies such as Kubernetes, MAAS, and LXD Telco - Open source for Telco's including technologies and standards related to Core Network, RAN/vRAN, SoNIC, DENT, and SmartNICs Finance - Open source solutions for financial institutions including trading platforms, blockchain technologies, regulatory compliance, and AI-driven analytics Automotive - Open source solutions for autonomous driving, in-vehicle infotainment, connected vehicles, and compliance with automotive industry standards such as ISO 26262 and ISO 21434 Application Management - Open source solutions in the enterprise including Observability, IAM, App Stores and technologies such Grafana, GitOps, and Juju Charms If your domain of expertise isn’t listed above, yet you feel it’s relevant to Canonical , then feel free to apply anyway. We will route you to the most suitable team. Location: These roles are home based in the EMEA time zone. You will be expected to be located in this region. The role entails Lead the product development lifecycle, reviewing the priorities and goals for your product Collaborate with cross-functional teams such as engineering, design, marketing, and sales Address common challenges across projects, align on priorities, enable informed decisions, and keep business execution on track Conduct market research, analyse industry trends, and gather customer feedback to identify opportunities Communicate your product vision, status updates, and key decisions to ensure alignment and manage expectations Conduct usability testing, analyse user feedback, and iterate on the product to improve the user experience Collaborate with marketing, sales, and support teams to develop go-to-market strategies, create product documentation, and provide training Contribute to the success of our sales team in winning new opportunities, reviewing customer feedback and participating in customer meetings Oversee the work of a product line, ensuring consistency in strategy and execution across different teams Facilitate collaboration and resolve conflicts within different teams and across other departments What we are looking for in you Exceptional academic results at high school and university Understanding of Linux and the wider open source software community Understanding of computer architecture, application development, datacenters, cloud or devices Passion to write about technologies and the tech landscape A strong work ethic, and personal interests aligned with the open source movement Curiosity, and the habit of continuous learning A strong sense of ownership Problem solving and the ability to innovate Outstanding communications skills in English, both verbal and written For more senior positions, product management experience in the software industry Ability to manage multiple projects or product lines while maintaining focus on key priorities Demonstrated leadership in aligning diverse teams and driving consensus around product strategies Willingness to travel internationally up to 4 times a year for company events up to two weeks long Additional skills that we value Familiarity with a particular verticals (e.g. Telco, Finance, Industrial, Automotive) Familiarity with the technology ecosystem including Silicon, IHV, ISV, ODM/OEMs, cloud service providers and channel Familiarity with cloud native technologies such as Kubernetes, Docker containers & Snaps Familiarity with embedded and connected device technology and ecosystems Familiarity with networking technologies - ethernet, IPv4 and IPv6, routing, firewalling, overlays such as OVN/OVS, VPNs, SR-IOV, infiniband Familiarity with telco networking - RAN, Core, CPE Experience in leading distributed teams across different time zones Demonstrated ability to foster collaboration and innovation in team settings What we offer you We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally. Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year Annual compensation review Recognition rewards Annual holiday leave Maternity and paternity leave Employee Assistance Program Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events About Canonical Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical is an equal opportunity employer We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration. title: Associate Director, Merchandise Planning
description: Associate Director, Merchandise Planning Brilliant Earth is searching for an Associate Director, Merchandise Planning to lead our Inventory Planning function and the team behind it. Reporting to the Senior Director of Merchandising, you'll own forecasting, open-to-buy, and inventory strategy across every category and function, as well as the roadmap that takes our planning capabilities to the next level. This is a builder's role as much as a planner's: our planning infrastructure is actively evolving, and you'll set the direction, partner with Technology and Merchandising to implement new tools, and raise the analytical bar for the whole team. You'll build planning approaches that work for attribute-based, specification-driven assortments while holding the line on turn, in-stock, and margin. We have a social and environmental mission at the core of our company, and we're looking for someone excited to deliver exceptional business results while helping us advance it. What You'll Do: Inventory Strategy and Forecasting Own sales and inventory forecasts across all categories and functions, and hold the team accountable for the accuracy, timeliness, and achievement of inventory plans and KPIs. Set inventory strategy for fine jewelry assortments, including diamond, gemstone, and precious metal commodities, establishing the parameters (weeks of supply, safety stock, reorder points) that balance service levels against inventory productivity. Lead inventory planning for new showroom launches and growth initiatives, directing the scenario modeling and statistical analysis that pressure-test those plans. Open-to-Buy and Financial Planning Own and continue to evolve the OTB alignment and consensus process, translating financial plans into actionable buying strategies with Merchandising and Finance. Contribute to the annual bookings, ASP, and margin budget-setting process, bringing the inventory point of view to category and department targets and reporting consistently against inventory KPIs. Planning Systems and Process Create and drive the Inventory Planning roadmap. Work with leadership to initiate, prioritize, and approve projects, and manage long-term program schedules through to adoption. Partner with Technology on planning system implementation and maintenance, leading the broader team’s adoption of new demand planning and reporting tools. Adapt planning tools and models to integrate cleanly with our evolving enterprise systems and reporting, identifying gaps, developing workarounds, and replacing them with durable solutions. Leverage AI tools to automate recurring analysis and reporting, and drive identification and rollout of new AI-enabled planning workflows across the function. Team Leadership and Partnership Manage, coach, and develop a growing planning team through hiring, feedback, and clear team objectives. Raise planning fluency across the organization by mentoring cross-functional Merchandising partners on forecasting and inventory principles, and by representing Planning credibly to executive leadership. What You Bring: 10+ years in merchandise planning, inventory planning, forecasting, or quantitative analysis within retail, product, or e-commerce, including demonstrated success leading and developing a team. Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Business, Finance, Economics, or a related field; advanced degree or relevant certification a plus. Experience with attribute-based or commodity inventory planning (precious metals, gemstones, or other specification-driven categories) is a strong plus. Expert Excel skills: complex formulas, pivot tables, financial modeling, and efficient handling of large datasets. Retail math is second nature. Hands-on experience with demand planning software (Blue Yonder, Logility, Demantra, o9, MI9, or similar) and reporting/BI tools (Domo, Tableau, Power BI); NetSuite or comparable ERP experience a plus. A track record of leading system implementations and cross-functional programs end to end—from defining business requirements and guiding development through adoption—including new forecasting tools, report automation, and process redesign. Experience with AI-assisted tools (e.g., Claude, Excel Copilot, BI-native AI features, Snowflake Intelligence) to automate analysis and reduce manual effort; familiarity with prompt engineering and connecting AI tools to live data sources such as data warehouses or ERP is highly valued. Comfort operating in an evolving systems environment: you can spot the gap, build the workaround, then turn it into lasting process. Expert written and verbal communication, with clear, direct, concise presentations to broader teams and executive leadership. Entrepreneurial spirit and a self-starter mindset, with the ability to think critically and adapt quickly in a fast-paced environment. Commitment to respect and inclusion in the workplace. Interest in socially and environmentally responsible organizations and products. What We Offer: Career Growth. We want to see you sparkle! Through regular 1-1’s with your manager, a variety of training opportunities, and an annual 360 review process for all employees, our leaders are dedicated to creating clear pathways for growth. Ask the hiring team for more information on how Brilliant Earth creates a culture of collaboration and growth during your interview conversations! Diverse, mission-minded team. We were founded to cultivate a more transparent, sustainable, compassionate, & inclusive jewelry industry. Learn more about our impact and team diversity Here! Lifestyle Spending Account. At Brilliant Earth , we're committed to your well-being. Enjoy company reimbursements for eligible wellness expenses, such as gym memberships, massage, counseling, and more! Continued Education. Company-sponsored learning in leadership, professional skills, diversity & inclusion, and access to tuition reimbursement for role-specific trainings. Employee Discounts. As an employee at Brilliant Earth , you’ll receive a generous discount on our jewelry. Mental Wellness Perks. We offer access to mental health resources, such as self-care apps and seminars. Our Employee Assistance program offers 24/7 access to counseling! Giving Back and Volunteer Opportunities. In addition to our giving back programs, our teams support local initiatives and spend time together by volunteering. Medical, Dental, and Vision. We offer multiple plans to choose from, including a $0 monthly premium option for employee health insurance and employer HSA contributions. Insurance kicks in on the first day of your 2nd month! 401k match. We know that saving for the future is important. That's why we offer a generous 401k match. Paid Time Off. We know it’s important to recharge and relax Parental Leave. We aim to support our growing families. Employees can utilize our paid parental leave to bond and care for their new additions. Disability and Life insurance. 100% employer-paid. Pre-Tax Commuter Benefits More About Us At Brilliant Earth , our mission is to cultivate a more transparent, sustainable, compassionate, & inclusive jewelry industry. We believe in creating jewelry you can feel good about wearing, without ever compromising between quality and conscience. We are hard-working team players that welcome challenges and rise to any occasion. Our community of collaboration, respect and encouragement is fostered by frequent team events, cross-departmental meetings and celebrating our wins, big and small. As one of the fastest growing e-commerce jewelers in the world, we're searching for bright and passionate people who are excited to make an impact from day one and grow with the company to take on greater responsibility over time. Brilliant Earth recognizes the value of diversity and inclusion on our team, as we work together to reinvent fine jewelry in a thoughtful and modern way. At Brilliant Earth , we celebrate each other – our successes, the lessons along the way, and the unique perspectives each individual brings to our team. description: We're enabling high-performing, rock-solid MongoDB deployments on any cloud or platform our customers choose. description: About Phaidra Phaidra is building the future of industrial automation. The world today is filled with static, monolithic infrastructure. Factories, power plants, buildings, etc. operate the same they've operated for decades — because the controls programming is hard-coded. Thousands of lines of rules and heuristics that define how the machines interact with each other. The result of all this hard-coding is that facilities are frozen in time, unable to adapt to their environment while their performance slowly degrades. Phaidra creates AI-powered control systems for the industrial sector, enabling industrial facilities to automatically learn and improve over time. Specifically: We use reinforcement learning algorithms to provide this intelligence, converting raw sensor data into high-value actions and decisions. We focus on industrial applications, which tend to be well-sensorized with measurable KPIs — perfect for reinforcement learning. We enable domain experts (our users) to configure the AI control systems (i.e. agents) without writing code. They define what they want their AI agents to do, and we do it for them. Our team has a track record of applying AI to some of the toughest problems. From achieving superhuman performance with DeepMind's AlphaGo, to reducing the energy required to cool Google's Data Centers by 40%, we deeply understand AI and how to apply it in production for massive impact. Phaidra’s ability to achieve its mission is determined by our ability to work together — as defined by our core values: Agency, Velocity , Craft , and Truth . We seek individuals who embody these values, as they are instrumental in ensuring our team consistently delivers excellence and fosters an engaging and supportive culture Phaidra is based in the USA, but we are 100% remote with no physical office. Direct the pod: convert strategy into the next 30 days of work, keep your analyst's queue full and unblocked, and QA everything client-facing. Challenge the work from the data: kill or reshape anything that doesn't ladder to the client's number. Sign-off means interrogation, not a rubber stamp. Protect and grow the accounts: catch at-risk clients early and run the save; open the expansion conversation when the numbers are good. Improve the system as you go: templates, reporting and cadences get better because you touched them. The ideal person for this role You live with your clients. In the comms daily, fast to respond, and you always know where every account stands and where it needs to go next. You hold the room. Presentable, trusted on calls, and able to walk a VP through the numbers and land the story. You live with data. You run your own analysis, hold your own on stats, and present findings cleanly. Nice-to-haves (not required) A CRO, experimentation, performance marketing or SEO background Familiarity with B2B SaaS Code (SQL, Python, scripts): a plus, not the gate Culture fit You should ideally believe: Search has fundamentally changed. Google and backlinks still matter but are no longer the full picture - AI search is a new frontier and you're excited about that shift. AI is a force multiplier, not a crutch. You're actively using (or willing to use) AI tools daily: prompt engineering, context files, projects. You build workflows, not just type into ChatGPT. Speed and quality are both achievable. Everyone on our team operates at a fast pace, is reliable and takes extreme ownership of their work. There are no passengers at Discovered Labs. You'll thrive here if: You get energy from doing excellent work that makes clients successful. You see gaps in processes and fix them without being asked. You proactively communicate and move fast. You won't thrive here if: You need heavy management. You wait for perfect instructions before acting. You think SEO is still just about keywords and links. We don't bolt AI onto old processes, we build around it. We're building a tech-first agency. We build our own tools. We're constantly designing systems that scale quality without shipping AI slop. Engineering and ops thinking is part of the culture. Going against the norm. Most SEO agencies move slow, get bogged down in audits and wait for perfection. Every person tracks leading metrics so we catch problems early and stay aligned. Small team, big ownership. No layers of middle management. You'll have direct access to founders and real influence on how we operate. We share what we learn. title: Content Marketing Manager
description: As a Content Marketing Manager at JivPad, you will own the voice, story, and editorial presence of a brand built to transform how people communicate. JivPad is a modern communication platform powered by AI, enabling individuals with speech or hearing differences, and anyone who desires intelligent call assistance, to connect with confidence and authenticity. Our platform also delivers real-time translation for in-person conversations, removing language barriers entirely. In this role, you will develop and execute a content strategy that educates, inspires, and converts across every stage of the customer journey. You will shape how JivPad shows up in the world, from long-form editorial and thought leadership to product storytelling and social narratives. You will work closely with Product, Design, and Growth teams to ensure every piece of content reflects the precision and warmth of the brand. This is a rare opportunity to define the editorial identity of a company from day one, where your words will shape perception, build trust, and move markets. What You'll Do Develop and own JivPad's content strategy across blog, social, email, web, and emerging channels. Create compelling long-form and short-form content including articles, case studies, product narratives, thought leadership pieces, and campaign copy. Collaborate with Product and Engineering to distil complex AI and voice technology into stories that are clear, human, and emotionally engaging. Build and manage an editorial calendar that aligns with product launches, market moments, and brand milestones. Establish JivPad's tone of voice guidelines and ensure consistency across all touchpoints and teams. Partner with SEO, Growth, and Paid teams to ensure content drives measurable organic visibility, engagement, and conversion. Champion the stories of our users, particularly those in the accessibility community, bringing their experiences to the forefront of our brand narrative. What You'll Need to Succeed A degree in Marketing, Communications, Journalism, English, or a related discipline, with 2+ years of experience in content marketing, editorial strategy, or brand copywriting within a technology or SaaS organisation. A portfolio demonstrating exceptional writing across formats, from editorial and thought leadership to product and campaign copy. Experience thriving in fast-paced, early-stage environments where you take ownership of the full content lifecycle from ideation to distribution. A refined sense of tone, pacing, and storytelling, with the ability to write for diverse audiences while maintaining a premium brand voice. A deeply collaborative disposition, with the ability to work cross-functionally across Product, Design, Growth, and Marketing to deliver unified narratives. Genuine passion for accessibility, inclusive technology, or communication innovation is highly valued. Role Details Employment Type: Full-Time and Part-Time positions available Location: Fully Remote Stage: Founding team, pre-launch About JivPad JivPad is a modern communication platform built on the belief that everyone deserves to be heard, understood, and in control of their own voice. Our AI-powered calling technology enables users to make phone calls with full autonomy, whether they choose to speak through AI using their own cloned voice, direct the conversation in real time via text, or seamlessly take over the call themselves. Our live translation feature allows people speaking different languages to converse naturally, in person, without delays or interruptions. We are not building another AI calling tool. We are building the future of human connection, where technology amplifies who you are rather than replacing you. Equal Opportunity JivPad is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome dedicated individuals regardless of gender, race, ethnicity, national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We believe that extraordinary products are built by extraordinary teams, and extraordinary teams are built on inclusion, respect, and the understanding that brilliance has no single origin. Let's build the future of communication, together. Originally posted on Himalayas

description: Major League Hacking Streamers are community members who present technical topics at our digital events. They are passionate hackers and community members who love to teach and support peers of all skill levels. They are passionate about developer education and creative in their presentation style. Becoming a Streamer Why should I become a Streamer? As a Streamer, you'll be deeply involved in our dynamic digital events like Global Hack Week, preparing presentations that are both engaging and educational. If you are passionate about Developer Evangelism/DevRel, if you're an aspiring content creator, or if you were always tutoring your classmates on tricky topics, becoming a Streamer might be a great fit. You must be 18 or over for this position. Is this a paid position? Yes. We want to provide an opportunity for any student hacker to fully focus on giving back to the hackathon community without having to worry about how they can afford to do so. We view your work as a Streamer as an alternative to a campus job or becoming a T.A. We pay all Streamers in USD. Our rates are adjusted by purchasing power parity depending on what country you're based in. We use OECD data. What does the workload look like for a Streamer? Streamers are expected to produce a minimum of two technical streams (approximately 4 hours of content) per event in which you participate. You will be expected to participate in a minimum of 6 events a year. You will be responsible for the preparation of your streams (including any slides or visual aids) as well as your audio/visual setup. What experience are you looking for? You should be passionate about developer education. Strong public speaking and communication skills are required, as are exceptional time management skills. A teaching or content creation background helps, but isn’t a requisite. What does the application process look like? The application process starts by applying via the form here. We’ll send you a writing assignment to assess your ability to scope, prepare, and deliver a presentation on stream. Candidates who pass the writing assignment will be invited to an interview in which you'll be asked to present part of your presentation as if you were streaming to an MLH audience. Requirements Need To Have High quality A/V setup Solid organizational skills; able to set your own schedule and abide by it Passion for developer education Creative and somewhat improvisational; comfortable on stream Based in EMEA or APAC or willing to work those hours Nice to Have Experience with public speaking OR online content creation Teaching experience is a major plus A Successful Streamer Will: Stream regularly, producing a minimum of two technical streams for every GHW in which you participate. Participate in at least 50% of GHWs in 2025. Consistently provide stream availability in a timely fashion when requested (even when it’s zero) Stream from a reliable A/V setup (no outages on stream) Balance entertainment with education; cover interesting topics while making themselves approachable and relatable Avoid “dead air” during streams; fill time with valuable “MLHy” content Act as the “MLHer in Charge” when streaming; monitor attendee behavior and take action as necessary to protect the experience for everyone. title: 3D Graphics Engineer (Three.js / WebGL)
description: We are looking for a 3D Graphics Engineer to own and advance the real-time rendering engine at the heart of our web-based digital twin platform. You will work in our Three.js and React Three Fiber rendering library, building photoreal, high-performance 3D experiences (architectural walkthroughs, immersive sales experiences, and Gaussian-splat captures of real spaces) that run in the browser across kiosks, tablets, desktops, and large-format displays. This is a deep, specialist engineering role focused on real-time graphics, performance, and the 3D asset pipeline. You will partner with our full stack and web developers, who own the surrounding web app, CMS, and APIs, and with our content and 3D-capture teams. The rendering engine and its visual quality are yours to own and push forward. At Imerza, we are pioneers in architectural visualization software, specializing in digital twins and real-estate marketing. We turn architectural concepts into breathtaking, immersive experiences that run everywhere from a sales-center video wall to a tablet in a buyer's hands. Key Responsibilities Rendering and Graphics (primary focus) Build and maintain our real-time Three.js and React Three Fiber rendering engine. Implement and optimize rendering features: lighting (lightmaps, HDR and image-based lighting, ambient occlusion), anti-aliasing, materials, and post-processing. Integrate Gaussian splat captures alongside traditional mesh-based 3D content. Write and debug GLSL shaders and custom materials. Develop camera systems, navigation, waypoints, and scene interaction. Asset and Performance Pipeline Own the 3D asset pipeline: glTF and GLB optimization, Draco and mesh compression, KTX2 and Basis texture conversion, and lightmap baking. Profile and optimize for frame rate, memory, and load time across constrained devices (tablets, kiosks) and large displays. Use spatial structures (BVH) for fast raycasting, picking, and pathfinding. Build diagnostics and debug tooling that keep visual quality and performance measurable. Collaboration Partner with full stack and web developers to expose clean, well-documented renderer APIs to the web app. Work with 3D-capture, content, and design teams to bring real spaces and designs into the engine. Contribute to the Nx monorepo with strong testing, code review, and documentation. Help define the technical direction of immersive and photoreal experiences. Our Stack Core (what you will work in daily) A custom Three.js rendering engine (@imerza/threejs-renderer) built on React Three Fiber and drei, mounted inside a Next.js app. Gaussian splatting via Spark (@sparkjsdev/spark) for photoreal capture of real-world spaces, rendered alongside traditional mesh-based content. glTF and GLB asset pipelines with Draco compression, KTX2 and Basis textures, baked lightmaps, and HDR image-based lighting. WebGL and GLSL shaders, post-processing (temporal anti-aliasing, ambient occlusion), and spatial acceleration with three-mesh-bvh. WebXR immersive viewing via @react-three/xr, including a 360 viewer. TypeScript throughout, in an Nx monorepo with pnpm workspaces. Adjacent areas (owned by other engineers; good to understand) The React and Next.js plus Payload CMS web app that hosts and configures the renderer. Real-time digital-twin data streamed into scenes over MQTT. AWS (CDK) and Docker-based on-prem deployments. Skills, Knowledge and Expertise 3 to 7+ years of professional software engineering experience, with significant time spent on real-time 3D or graphics. Deep proficiency with Three.js (React Three Fiber experience is a strong plus). Solid WebGL and GLSL shader experience. Strong TypeScript or JavaScript skills. Experience with 3D asset formats and pipelines (glTF and GLB, textures, compression). A strong grasp of 3D math (vectors, matrices, quaternions, transforms, and cameras). Experience profiling and optimizing rendering performance and memory usage. A strong eye for visual quality, lighting, and detail. Nice to Have Gaussian splatting or radiance fields (Spark, Luma, 3D Gaussian Splatting, or NeRF-adjacent work). Experience with KTX2 and Basis, Draco, or meshopt compression. PBR materials, baked lighting and lightmap workflows, and HDR or image-based lighting. WebXR, VR, or AR (@react-three/xr or similar). Familiarity with DCC tools (Blender, 3ds Max, Maya) and capture or photogrammetry pipelines (RealityCapture, Postshot, and similar). Experience with Unreal Engine or another real-time engine. Experience with React, Next.js, or a monorepo (Nx, Turborepo). Architecture, AEC, BIM, or spatial-data background. Experience with PlayCanvas What We Offer The opportunity to work on cutting-edge digital twin and immersive visualization technology. A collaborative, product-driven engineering culture. Competitive compensation and benefits. A flexible work environment with real opportunities for growth. Originally posted on Himalayas

description: About Aubrant Aubrant Digital is a leader in multi-shore custom application development. Comfortable operating with ambiguity, capable of building test coverage in environments where requirements and behavior are still evolving. Contribute to release confidence by tying test outcomes to deployment decisions and feedback loops. Innovation & Quality Practice: Pilot and advance agentic automation patterns, AI-assisted test generation, and self-healing test approaches that improve coverage and reduce maintenance. Solid proficiency in .NET test automation , including writing test code in C# and integrating with .NET solutions; familiarity with frameworks such as xUnit, NUnit, or MSTest. Hands-on experience integrating tests into Azure DevOps pipelines, including build/release configuration, test parallelization, and results reporting. Working knowledge of Azure for running and troubleshooting test workloads in cloud-hosted environments. Solid skills in API testing, test data management, and writing maintainable, well-structured test code. Experience with version control (Git), code review practices, and test-related quality gates. Demonstrated interest in advancing QA practices, including agentic automation, AI-assisted test generation, or self-healing test patterns. If you see a better way to do something, you can change the process and build the system. People here have an opinion and they're expected to use it. Systems over heroics A core part of our advantage is treating marketing programs like a product: automate repetitive tasks, standardise workflows, and reserve human expertise for the work that actually needs it. We’re remote and async by default We meet weekly but most collaboration happens through written updates and documentation. Tools commonly include Notion, Slack, Google Docs/Sheets, and client CMS platforms (e.g., WordPress/Webflow). We care about craft and correctness Because our work is used by both humans and AI systems, details matter: factual accuracy, verifiable claims and clean structure. Everyone is held accountable to a high standard. What we expect from you This is what doing well typically looks like at Discovered Labs: Ownership + self-direction: You can take a goal and run with it, without needing constant oversight. High standards: You care about the small details because they compound into results. Strong async communication: You keep people unblocked with clear written updates, good documentation, and predictable handoffs. AI fluency (with judgment): You use tools like ChatGPT/Claude/Perplexity intelligently but you also verify, QA, and don’t ship untrusted output. Performance mindset: You don’t confuse output with outcomes. You look at what’s working, what isn’t, and changes what’s needed to get the desired results. Process improvement bias: When something breaks or slows us down, you document it and propose a better way. What you can expect from us Autonomy and trust: We hire for judgment and give people room to execute. A real feedback loop: We track visibility and results, and we share what’s changing (and why). Meaningful impact: Your work touches real go-to-market outcomes for well-known B2B companies. Front-row seat to a new category: You'll learn how LLMs actually work, how content influences AI answers, and how to build systems at speed. Originally posted on Himalayas

description: Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. But that’s just the beginning: Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities. Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing. Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity. Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways. Why Join Us? Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry. If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you. Are you ready to be part of the future? About the job We are seeking a Technical Content Creator to showcase the practical power of Tether's peer-to-peer stack. This is a builder-centric role designed for an engineer or highly technical creator who bridges the gap between low-level infrastructure, cryptography, and functional application. We are not looking for a social media marketer or an on-camera influencer. We are looking for a technical storyteller who can write code, spin up peer-to-peer nodes, build functional Bare-powered applications, and record polished, clear, screen-share demos. You will turn our core stack (Pear and Bare) into an ongoing series of visual, practical "build-in-public" prototypes that prove to the world what true decentralized, peer-to-peer infrastructure looks like. Responsibilities Build Practical Demos: Independently build functional peer-to-peer applications and infrastructure setups using the Pear platform and the Bare runtime with minimal engineering hand-holding. Record Technical Demos: Record clear, engaging, and high-quality screen-share walkthroughs and video demos of your builds, highlighting how the code works, how peers discover and sync with each other, and the value the systems deliver. Translate Code to Content: Turn complex protocol updates, cryptographic primitives, and technical documentation into highly visual, digestible developer content (such as code-along videos, step-by-step guides, and interactive repositories). Collaborate with Core Devs: Work closely with our P2P protocol and product engineering teams to stay ahead of upcoming Pear and Bare features. Prototypes: Rapidly prototype application concepts — such as spinning up a peer-to-peer chat, file-sync, or data-replication demo — to show how quickly developers can launch resilient, serverless products using our ecosystem. Fuel Influencer-Led Developer Adoption: Collaborate with technical influencers, developer advocates, and content creators to amplify our ecosystem. You will provide them with turn-key technical assets, co-create code-along challenges, and arm them with the high-quality demos and prototypes needed to inspire and onboard new developers to Pear and Bare. Requirements 3 to 6+ years of experience in a technical role such as Technical Content Creation, Solutions Engineering, or Backend/Systems Development. Strong Programming Skills: Proficiency in languages used across our ecosystem (such as NodeJS, C/C++) to interact confidently with peer-to-peer networking and runtime internals. Domain Expertise: Solid understanding of peer-to-peer (P2P) networking, distributed systems, hypercore/append-only-log style data structures, and decentralized application architecture. Demo/Video Production Skills: Experience recording and editing polished technical screen-shares, terminal recordings, or video tutorials (using tools like Loom, Camtasia, Screenflow, etc.). Developer Empathy: The ability to look at a complex P2P protocol or runtime and understand exactly what kind of demo or sample project will get developers and infrastructure operators excited to start building. Self-Starter Mindset: Comfortable working autonomously in a remote, distributed environment across global time zones. Important information for candidates Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles: Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website. title: Head of Finance
description: Industry: Web3 / Crypto / Infrastructure Compensation: Competitive with equity/token upside About Vana Vana is a layer-1 blockchain designed for user-owned data. Its mission is to build a decentralized data economy where individuals and communities can collectively own, govern, and earn from the data that powers artificial intelligence. By enabling data to exist as a new form of capital—liquid, composable, and verifiable—Vana provides the foundation for a more equitable and open AI ecosystem. Built with privacy-preserving architecture, Vana allows users to contribute and permission data through DataDAOs—decentralized data collectives that pool user-contributed data for specific use cases, from mental health to genomics to social media. The network’s proof-of-contribution mechanism ensures that every data provider is fairly rewarded, while developers can build new data applications and liquidity pools on top of the protocol. Following the launch of its mainnet and native token, $VANA, the network has become one of the fastest-growing ecosystems in Web3, with over a million contributors participating across hundreds of DataDAOs. As the ecosystem scales and token operations expand, Vana is seeking a Head of Finance to bring financial rigor, treasury management, and strategic discipline to a rapidly growing decentralized organization at the frontier of data and AI. The Opportunity This role is ideal for a technically sophisticated finance leader who combines the analytical rigour of traditional finance with a strong enough grasp of crypto market mechanics or a strong willingness to learn. The Chief Financial Officer will manage Vana’s capital strategy across fiat, token, and treasury holdings, bridging between the foundation, development company, and trading ecosystem. You’ll advise the founders on liquidity, market structure, and macroeconomic trends impacting digital assets, while maintaining strong relationships with market makers, investors, and partners. This is a hands-on, high-trust environment that demands precision, discretion, and excellent judgment. Key Responsibilities 1. Treasury Management Determine and manage the optimal allocation between $VANA, stablecoins, and fiat reserves. Design and execute treasury allocation, hedging, and yield strategies to minimize risk and preserve long-term runway. Develop and implement financial mechanisms (e.g., buybacks, liquidity programs, staking strategies) that enhance network stability and sustainability. 2. Token & Asset Management Manage liquidity across all exchanges where $VANA is traded, in coordination with market makers and liquid funds. Oversee relationships with market makers, funds, and trading desks to ensure adequate liquidity and orderly markets. Manage $VANA token and other digital asset holdings across the Foundation and affiliated entities, ensuring strategic alignment and market efficiency. 3. Financial Advisory & Tokenomics Strategy Assess macroeconomic and market conditions to inform treasury allocation, liquidity management, and capital strategy. Advise on internal tokenomics design, including $VANA supply schedules, on-chain liquidity, and token trading dynamics. Evaluate major financial transactions, investments, and partnerships across the Foundation and development company. Build financial models and scenario analyses to guide token and treasury strategy under varying market conditions. 4. Financial Management & Reporting Oversee accounting, budgeting, and cashflow management across the Foundation and development company. Maintain audit readiness and ensure compliance with all tax and regulatory reporting requirements. Implement disciplined internal controls and a consistent financial reporting cadence. Deliver accurate, timely, and actionable financial insights to support leadership decision-making. 5. Investor, Market & Partner Relations Partner with the founders on fundraising, capital strategy, and investor engagement. Build and manage relationships with market makers, trading desks, funds, exchanges, and other strategic partners. Track and manage relationships with major $VANA token holders to support strategic ecosystem alignment. Negotiate and structure liquidity, treasury, and investment deals to advance long-term financial objectives. 6. Web3 / Token-Specific Expertise (Nice to Have): Deep understanding of DeFi, token liquidity management, and market-making structures. Familiarity with major trading firms, funds, and counterparties across the crypto ecosystem. Ability to engage intelligently in token strategy discussions to protect and advance Vana’s financial and reputational interests. Ideal Profile Background in finance, investment banking, venture capital, or corporate finance, with direct exposure to crypto, DeFi, or Web3 markets. Demonstrated experience managing treasury strategy, liquidity, and investor relations in high-growth environments. Strong grasp of financial instruments, trading structures, and market mechanics relevant to digital assets. Deep integrity and discretion; understands incentive misalignment risks in crypto and acts with transparency and accountability. High emotional intelligence and relationship fluency; capable of managing investors, market makers, and partners with credibility and composure. Systems thinker who brings structure and discipline to complex, fast-moving financial ecosystems. Mission-aligned: motivated by building a sustainable data economy, not by short-term financial extraction. Additional Notes The ideal candidate should be comfortable navigating the intersection of traditional finance and crypto culture. Familiarity with liquidity provisioning, token flows, and KOL/MM dynamics is beneficial but not essential. Strong preference for candidates who can bring discipline and trustworthiness i.e. “grown-up energy”, to a space that often lacks both. Originally posted on Himalayas

description: Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder led, profitable and growing. Product marketers at Canonical sit between product and the market. They take deeply technical open source products and decide what they mean to a user and a buyer; which problem they solve, who should care, why we win, and what it should cost. That work shows up as positioning and messaging, launch plans, competitive intelligence, global campaigns, and the enablement that helps sales tell a coherent story. This is a role for someone who wants ownership rather than a brief. You will pick up a portfolio area, form your own point of view on the market, and defend it with evidence. We expect product marketers to talk to customers and community members directly, and to bring opinions to product and sales rather than waiting to be told what to say. We have a bias for action, focus effort on the most impactful activities, and take ownership of our results. We work across long buying cycles, balance storytelling with data, design experiments, track outcomes, and iterate rapidly to find what works. Location: This role is remote for anyone based in EMEA. The role entails You will own product marketing for one of our product areas, from the market thesis through to the assets that sales and campaigns run on. You will be accountable for whether the story lands, whether launches convert, and whether the sales team can repeat the message without you in the room. You will: Own positioning, messaging, and the narrative hierarchy for your product area, and keep it consistent from the website through to the sales deck Lead product launches end to end with tiering, timeline, cross-functional plan, assets, and post-launch reporting Build and maintain the competitive picture for your area: who we lose to, why, and what we say about it Support building the enablement that sales actually uses: battlecards, discovery questions, objection handling, demo narratives Run structured customer and community research, including win-loss, to keep the messaging grounded in real language rather than internal assumptions Partner with demand generation, content, web, and events to turn positioning into campaigns that move pipeline Raise the standard of the craft around you through review, mentoring, and shared frameworks What we are looking for in you Strong written and verbal communication in English An exceptional academic track record from high school and university Proven product marketing experience in B2B software, SaaS, or open source A track record of owning positioning and messaging for a product or portfolio, not just executing someone else's Evidence of launches you led that changed a business outcome such as adoption, pipeline, or win rate The technical curiosity to hold your own with product managers and engineers and to understand the product beyond the datasheet Comfort using data to test a hypothesis, evaluate a campaign, and change your mind Ability to influence and align stakeholders across product, sales, and marketing without formal authority Excellent storytelling skills applied to technical solutions, for both developer and executive audiences Skill at managing complex, cross-functional projects with title: DevOps Engineer (m/w/d)
description: was bieten wir? Bei DACHS IT sollst du nicht einfach nur „eine Stelle“ haben, sondern ein Arbeitsumfeld, das zu deinem Leben, deinen Stärken und deinen Zielen passt. Deshalb bieten wir dir: Remote-First als gelebtes Modell Wir arbeiten seit Jahren konsequent remote. Du entscheidest, von wo du am produktivsten bist – Homeoffice, Shared Office oder eine Mischung aus beidem. Flexible Arbeitszeiten mit Eigenverantwortung Du kannst dir deine Arbeit im Rahmen der Projekte zeitlich flexibel über die Woche einteilen. Uns sind Verlässlichkeit im Team und transparente Kommunikation wichtiger als Präsenz am Schreibtisch. Spannende Projekte statt Routine-Tickets Gemeinsam finden wir Projekte, die zu deinem Profil und deiner Entwicklung passen – z. B. Plattformaufbau, Cloud-Migration, Automatisierung, Operations oder technische Schulungen bei Kund:innen. Weiterbildung, Zertifizierungen & Wissensaustausch Regelmäßige Schulungen und Zertifizierungen sind fest eingeplant – mit Kostenübernahme und Freistellung. Dazu kommen interner Wissensaustausch, Sparrings auf Augenhöhe und Raum, dich fachlich wie methodisch weiterzuentwickeln. Moderne Ausstattung & Arbeitsumgebung Du erhältst moderne Hardware, die passende Software sowie das benötigte Equipment, damit du effizient und komfortabel arbeiten kannst. Attraktive Rahmenbedingungen Neben einem fairen Festgehalt bekommst du eine jährliche Beteiligung am Unternehmensgewinn. Je nach Rolle besteht zudem die Option auf einen Firmenwagen. Transparente Feedbackkultur & Entwicklung Wir setzen nicht auf jährliche Pflichttermine, sondern auf regelmäßige, ehrliche Gespräche auf Augenhöhe – du gibst uns Feedback, wir dir. So wissen wir alle, woran wir sind, und können unsere gemeinsamen nächsten Entwicklungsschritte gezielt unterstützen. Gesundheit, Freizeit & Sicherheit Du erhältst 30 Tage Urlaub pro Jahr, die nicht verfallen, sowie zusätzliche Absicherung, zum Beispiel durch eine Gruppen-Unfallversicherung. So bist du nicht nur beruflich, sondern auch privat gut aufgestellt. Teamkultur & gemeinsame Erlebnisse Trotz Remote-First ist uns persönlicher Austausch wichtig: Wir treffen uns regelmäßig zu gemeinsamen Aktivitäten – mal locker bei einem Get-together, mal zum gemeinsamen Workshop, mal aktiv bei Ausflügen – und sorgen so für echten Zusammenhalt abseits des Bildschirms. wen suchen wir? Wir suchen ein Teammitglied, das unsere Kunden im direkten Kontakt berät, gemeinsam mit ihnen bedarfsorientierte Lösungen entwickelt und sie bei der Umsetzung unterstützt. Du bringst idealerweise Begeisterung, Interesse und erste praktische Erfahrung mit Container- und Cloud-Technologien mit, bist motiviert, dich in neue Themen einzuarbeiten und verfügst über ein empirisch-agiles Mindset sowie ausgeprägte Problemlösungsfähigkeiten. Du arbeitest gern im Team, kannst dich aber auch selbst organisieren, Eigeninitiative zeigen und auf Deutsch wie auf Englisch sicher auf Business Level (C1/C2) kommunizieren. Freude am direkten Kundenkontakt – bei Bedarf auch in Rufbereitschaft oder vor Ort – rundet dein Profil ab. was machst du bei uns? Als DevOps Engineer betreust und berätst du unsere Kunden in technischen Fragen rundum die Themen Plattformaufbau, -operations und -integration: Du kümmerst dich um den Aufbau und die Konfiguration von Containerplattformen. Du verwaltest die Infrastruktur / Cloud / Containerplattform. Du automatisierst mittels CI/CD-Pipelines. Du übernimmst das Deployment von Anwendungen im Cluster und der Cloud. Du bist für Monitoring und Performance Bewertung zuständig. Du setzt dich regelmäßig selbstständig und in Schulungen mit den Themen rund um Container- und Cloudtechnologien auseinander und bildest dich weiter. was bringst du mit? Technical Skills Must-have Kubernetes Linux Kenntnisse mindestens eines der folgenden Cloud Stacks AWS GKE MS Azure OSP/Openstack Nice-to-have Grundkenntnisse in Terraform Grundkenntnisse in Ansible Grundkenntnisse der Go Language Erfahrung aus dem IT Betrieb (Operations) Soft Skills Must-have Deutsch und Englisch auf Business Level (C1/C2) in Wort und Schrift Berater-Mindset/-Skills Kommunikationsstark Scrum-Kenntnisse Nice-to-have Projekterfahrung im agilen Umfeld / mit Scrum Scrum Zertifizierung Kanban-Kenntnisse Moderations- und Deeskalationsmethoden Lernmethodiken/Didaktik zur Schulungsdurchführung wie sieht der bewerbungsprozess bei uns aus? Wenn du dich bei uns bewirbst, begleiten wir dich transparent durch mehrere klar strukturierte Schritte. Uns ist wichtig, dass du jederzeit weißt, wo du stehst – deshalb erhältst du in jeder Phase zeitnah Rückmeldung und alle nötigen Infos zum weiteren Ablauf. In der Regel durchläufst du dabei folgende Schritte: Screening Wir sichten deine Unterlagen sorgfältig und bewerten, ob deine Erfahrungen, Kompetenzen und Ziele zu der ausgeschriebenen Rolle und zu DACHS IT passen – auf dieser Basis entscheiden wir über eine Einladung zum Kennenlernen. Kennenlerngespräch In einem 30–45-minütigen Videocall lernst du ein Mitglied unseres Teams kennen. Ihr sprecht über deinen Hintergrund, unsere Kultur, Erwartungen beider Seiten und habt Raum für Fragen. Technisches Interview In einem 60-minütigen Termin löst du gemeinsam mit ein bis zwei unserer Consultants anspruchsvolle technische Aufgaben. Dabei geht es uns darum, deine Herangehensweise, dein Fachwissen und deine Zusammenarbeit im Team kennenzulernen. Persönliches Gespräch Anschließend triffst du unseren Geschäftsführer Alexander. Ihr besprecht verbleibende Fragen, Rahmenbedingungen und wie eine gemeinsame Zukunft bei DACHS IT konkret aussehen könnte. Angebot Stimmt die Vorstellung auf beiden Seiten, erhältst du ein Angebot von uns – transparent, nachvollziehbar und mit allen wichtigen Details. Originally posted on Himalayas
