description: Mission – Why we exist, what we do, and why we need you SpotMe is a leading B2B event platform that helps enterprises increase the impact of their events by delivering CRM-connected, high-quality experiences across in-person, virtual, hybrid events, and webinars. With a strong focus on life sciences, SpotMe powers Onomi: the Live HCP Engagement Platform: that enables medical and commercial teams to run impactful congresses, symposia, advisory boards, and webinars. Together, SpotMe and Onomi turn live events into a company’s most effective engagement channel. At SpotMe /Onomi, the Solution Architect reports to the Solutions Director and ensures seamless integration of SpotMe /Onomi within large enterprise ecosystems. Acting as both a customer-facing presales engineer and a post-sales integration leader, this role bridges business needs and technical execution. By advising on architecture, designing integration flows, and supporting implementation, the Solution Architect enables customers to maximize value from Onomi while driving continuous feedback into Product and Engineering. This role is the ideal challenge for an experienced Solution Architect, Presales Engineer, or Integration Consultant in life sciences technology (SaaS) who thrives in dynamic environments and wants to be the technical bridge between global life sciences enterprises and the Onomi platform reshaping how they engage with physicians. Role breakdown 20% Presales support & customer-facing architecture design Partner with Sales to position Onomi’s capabilities, validate technical feasibility with customers, deliver technical presentations, and support RFP responses. Lead customer discovery sessions to capture requirements, identify integration touchpoints, and translate them into high-level architectures. Build trust with enterprise stakeholders by articulating the value, feasibility, and compliance of proposed solutions. 60% Post-sales solution design & implementation support Produce detailed solution architecture documents, covering data flows, integration methods - APIs 2.0, SSO, internal connectors (Salesforce, Veeva apps etc…) and deliver iPaaS custom integrations setup - taking into account industry specific considerations. Work alongside the Program Manager in delivering new and innovative solutions to customers in a data centric environment Collaborate with internal teams building Product integration features to completion Ensure solutions meet both technical and business requirements through close collaboration with SpotMe Program Managers, customers and partners with a diverse range of stakeholder responsibilities (IT, Business, Compliance etc…). 20% Post-integration support & product feedback Act as escalation point for complex integration issues, working with engineering to resolve within SLA. Capture lessons learned from enterprise projects and feed structured insights back to Product for roadmap prioritization. Contribute to process improvements, templates, and best practices that raise integration quality and reduce recurring issues. Actively maintain up-to-date technical documentation for enterprise customer solutions as they are implemented or updated. Objectives – The problems you will solve Within 3 Months Platform: Get trained on the Onomi platform product and features, data model and administration Business Acumen: Understanding a typical user journey and system flows for the various Onomi Use cases managed through our platform and how does this translate into potential communication with 3rd party systems Sectorial: Familiarize yourself with life sciences CRM systems (Salesforce, Veeva, IQVIA, etc.), their common data models and integration requirements while grasping the compliance needs of the clients (data privacy, consent, audit trails, field force restrictions) if not part of a previous experience. Technical: Shadow experienced Solution Architects to learn SpotMe /Onomi’s integration ecosystem and practices: APIs 2.0, SSO, internal connectors (Salesforce, Veeva apps etc…), iPaaS custom integrations setup Methodology: Gain familiarity with the general methodology and various internal and external output needs such as customer documentation standards, and integration testing and deployment guidelines Lead presales calls independently: present SpotMe /Onomi’s integration capabilities, outline high-level architectures, and respond to common integration questions. Draft first Design Document for a customer integration project and achieve customer sign-off. Successfully support sales in responding to at least one RFP. Within 6 Months Deliver and own enterprise integration projects end-to-end, from scoping to Integration Acceptance Testing (IAT) without supervision. Provide first-line API 2.0 support to enterprise customers within SLA. Build strong partnerships with Product & Engineering by documenting gaps, bugs, or enhancement requests and specifications for new or enhanced native integration modules. Within 12 Months Be recognized by Sales as a trusted presales partner, capable of influencing customer technical decisions. Build and deliver architecture landscape evolution plans for enterprise customers expanding their SpotMe /Onomi integrations. Be the go-to person to person for your team for feasibility assessments and to the company about the customer integrations that you delivered What we are looking for Integration & technical expertise Solution Architect, Presales Engineer, or Integration Consultant roles (SaaS preferred) who worked in commercial/marketing applications: CRM, marketing automation Strong technical foundation with hands-on experience in building integrations: REST APIs, JSON, SSO, ETL, iPaaS (e.g., Mulesoft, Workato). Salesforce and/or Veeva integration expertise in life sciences/pharma is a strong plus: REST API, Apex, SOQL queries. Business & industry acumen Understanding of pharma compliance aspects: data privacy, consent, audit requirements, and compliance with field force usage is a plus. Customer focused and solution-oriented, the ability to articulate technical concepts and their value in business outcomes Ability to translate enterprise requirements and compliance constraints into scalable technical integration design and product improvements. Customer-facing & communication skills Proven experience in customer-facing technical roles: confident presenting, pitching, and negotiating with enterprise stakeholders. Skilled at simplifying complex technical concepts and presenting them clearly to C-level and enterprise architects. Experience running workshops to uncover business drivers, technical requirements, and integration challenges. Ability to tailor demos and prototypes to resonate with different customer personas. Languages Fluent in English (written and spoken); other languages are an asset. SpotMe recruits, compensates, and promotes regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, parental status, or veteran status. title: Creative Marketing Specialist
description: Location: Remote Type: Full-Time/Part-Time/Freelance About Vana: At Vana, we’re on a mission to build the foundation for a decentralized and sovereign data economy, empowering individuals and AI agents with ownership and control of their data. We’re looking for a creative and driven Creative Marketing Specialist to help design and execute bold, engaging campaigns that grow Vana’s reputation and mindshare among mass market and crypto-native audiences. If you’re passionate about storytelling, social media, and crafting compelling content, this is your chance to contribute to a movement shaping the future of data sovereignty and decentralized AI. What You’ll Do As the Creative Marketing Specialist, you’ll be responsible for bringing Vana’s vision to life through creative content and campaign execution, with a focus on social channels. Creative Campaign Development Collaborate with the leadership team to define and implement campaigns that elevate Vana’s brand, highlight its innovative technology, and inspire adoption across key communities. Support the planning and execution of marketing campaigns that grow awareness and drive engagement. Craft compelling narratives that resonate with diverse audiences, from crypto enthusiasts to mainstream users. Content Creation Identify emerging trends in Web3, AI, and technology to keep Vana ahead of the curve. Develop and produce engaging, high-quality content for social media, blogs, newsletters, and other platforms. Create content that highlights Vana’s mission, technology, and role in the decentralized data and AI ecosystem. Write captivating copy, design visuals (or work with design resources), and ensure all content aligns with Vana’s brand voice and guidelines. Campaign Execution Leverage current trends in crypto, AI, and Web3 to create timely and shareable content. Collaborate with the team to manage Vana’s social media accounts and schedule posts to ensure consistent, active engagement. Monitor and engage with Vana’s community across channels, responding to comments, questions, and conversations. Partner with influencers and ambassadors to amplify Vana’s reach and build a network of advocates. Analytics & Optimization Set clear KPIs and regularly analyze performance data to assess the impact of marketing campaigns. Track and report on content performance and campaign metrics. Continuously optimize strategies and content to improve engagement, conversions, and brand visibility. Use insights to optimize future content and campaigns for maximum impact. What We’re Looking For Experience: 2+ years in content creation, social media management, or digital marketing (crypto, Web3, or tech experience is a bonus). Creative Skills: Strong copy writing, editing, and visual content creation skills (basic design skills in Canva, Figma, or similar tools are a plus). Social Media Savvy: Proven ability to grow and engage audiences across platforms like X (Twitter), LinkedIn, Instagram, and Telegram. Trend Awareness: A keen eye for spotting trends and crafting content that resonates with diverse audiences. Detail-Oriented: Ability to manage multiple projects, stay organized, and deliver high-quality content on time. Passion: Interest in Web3, crypto, or AI, with a desire to learn and grow in the space. Why Join Vana? Collaborate with a forward-thinking team at the forefront of Web3 and AI innovation. Gain hands-on experience shaping the narrative for a visionary project. Flexible, remote work environment with opportunities for growth. Please indicate whether you are open to full-time, part-time or freelance engagement for this role. Originally posted on Himalayas

description: Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder led, profitable and growing. Canonical ’s product management team are technologists who have a passion for delivering products and solutions that help shape market demands while elevating open source software everywhere. This is a general application track for the product management positions at Canonical . You will set a clear vision, prioritize work effectively, and ensure the team delivers high-quality products that meet business and user needs. Apply here if you excel at leadership, communication, and technical vision, and believe you can drive product strategy for the business needs of tomorrow. During the interview process we will identify specific software products which would be a good fit for your interests. We believe that open source is transforming the way that enterprises solve their business needs. Although open source has been around for thirty years, it is only now fundamental to every corner of the software landscape. Going forward we believe open source will have an even bigger impact as it moves into specialised vertical markets. Our goal is to make open source easier, more reliable and more secure for deployment and development. We strive to be the provider of ‘most software to most companies’, starting with Ubuntu but expanding to cover every class of application on every class of compute. To deliver on that ambition, we select product managers for their intellect and strong drive to advance the open source community. Together, we aim to improve open source quality, outreach, and impact. Our product managers set the vision and the direction to ensure teams deliver the right products in the right markets at the right time. They push the boundaries of the technology landscape to identify and deliver products into new and existing market opportunities. Our product managers are technology professionals with a software engineering background who strive to become business executives and entrepreneurs. We discuss strategy, plan product development, drive engagement, and promote the open source way. We oversee the entire product lifecycle from conception to delivery, blending technical expertise, strategic thinking, analytics, project management skills and effective communication to ensure products meet both user needs and business objectives. We have open product manager roles across a wide range of product domains, including: Ubuntu Platform - Our Ubuntu experience on Desktop, Server, Windows (WSL), Multipass, Gaming, Enterprise, & Hardware Enablement Ubuntu Pro Services - Our key commercial offerings Ubuntu Pro, Compliance, Standards, Security Engineering, and Managed Services on cloud and on prem AI/ML & MLOps - Open source AI/ML solutions, AIOps automation, model lifecycle management, Kubeflow, MLFlow, KServe, and AI infrastructure on cloud and edge IoT - Ubuntu on embedded devices and/or edge servers, device management, and robotics Cloud - Ubuntu in public and private clouds, promoting automation frameworks, and including technologies such as Kubernetes, MAAS, and LXD Telco - Open source for Telco's including technologies and standards related to Core Network, RAN/vRAN, SoNIC, DENT, and SmartNICs Finance - Open source solutions for financial institutions including trading platforms, blockchain technologies, regulatory compliance, and AI-driven analytics Automotive - Open source solutions for autonomous driving, in-vehicle infotainment, connected vehicles, and compliance with automotive industry standards such as ISO 26262 and ISO 21434 Application Management - Open source solutions in the enterprise including Observability, IAM, App Stores and technologies such Grafana, GitOps, and Juju Charms If your domain of expertise isn’t listed above, yet you feel it’s relevant to Canonical , then feel free to apply anyway. We will route you to the most suitable team. Location: These roles are home based in the EMEA time zone. You will be expected to be located in this region. The role entails Lead the product development lifecycle, reviewing the priorities and goals for your product Collaborate with cross-functional teams such as engineering, design, marketing, and sales Address common challenges across projects, align on priorities, enable informed decisions, and keep business execution on track Conduct market research, analyse industry trends, and gather customer feedback to identify opportunities Communicate your product vision, status updates, and key decisions to ensure alignment and manage expectations Conduct usability testing, analyse user feedback, and iterate on the product to improve the user experience Collaborate with marketing, sales, and support teams to develop go-to-market strategies, create product documentation, and provide training Contribute to the success of our sales team in winning new opportunities, reviewing customer feedback and participating in customer meetings Oversee the work of a product line, ensuring consistency in strategy and execution across different teams Facilitate collaboration and resolve conflicts within different teams and across other departments What we are looking for in you Exceptional academic results at high school and university Understanding of Linux and the wider open source software community Understanding of computer architecture, application development, datacenters, cloud or devices Passion to write about technologies and the tech landscape A strong work ethic, and personal interests aligned with the open source movement Curiosity, and the habit of continuous learning A strong sense of ownership Problem solving and the ability to innovate Outstanding communications skills in English, both verbal and written For more senior positions, product management experience in the software industry Ability to manage multiple projects or product lines while maintaining focus on key priorities Demonstrated leadership in aligning diverse teams and driving consensus around product strategies Willingness to travel internationally up to 4 times a year for company events up to two weeks long Additional skills that we value Familiarity with a particular verticals (e.g. Telco, Finance, Industrial, Automotive) Familiarity with the technology ecosystem including Silicon, IHV, ISV, ODM/OEMs, cloud service providers and channel Familiarity with cloud native technologies such as Kubernetes, Docker containers & Snaps Familiarity with embedded and connected device technology and ecosystems Familiarity with networking technologies - ethernet, IPv4 and IPv6, routing, firewalling, overlays such as OVN/OVS, VPNs, SR-IOV, infiniband Familiarity with telco networking - RAN, Core, CPE Experience in leading distributed teams across different time zones Demonstrated ability to foster collaboration and innovation in team settings What we offer you We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally. Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year Annual compensation review Recognition rewards Annual holiday leave Maternity and paternity leave Employee Assistance Program Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events About Canonical Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical is an equal opportunity employer We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration. description: Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder led, profitable and growing. Canonical ’s product management team are technologists who have a passion for delivering products and solutions that help shape market demands while elevating open source software everywhere. This is a general application track for the product management positions at Canonical . You will set a clear vision, prioritize work effectively, and ensure the team delivers high-quality products that meet business and user needs. Apply here if you excel at leadership, communication, and technical vision, and believe you can drive product strategy for the business needs of tomorrow. During the interview process we will identify specific software products which would be a good fit for your interests. We believe that open source is transforming the way that enterprises solve their business needs. Although open source has been around for thirty years, it is only now fundamental to every corner of the software landscape. Going forward we believe open source will have an even bigger impact as it moves into specialised vertical markets. Our goal is to make open source easier, more reliable and more secure for deployment and development. We strive to be the provider of ‘most software to most companies’, starting with Ubuntu but expanding to cover every class of application on every class of compute. To deliver on that ambition, we select product managers for their intellect and strong drive to advance the open source community. Together, we aim to improve open source quality, outreach, and impact. Our product managers set the vision and the direction to ensure teams deliver the right products in the right markets at the right time. They push the boundaries of the technology landscape to identify and deliver products into new and existing market opportunities. Our product managers are technology professionals with a software engineering background who strive to become business executives and entrepreneurs. We discuss strategy, plan product development, drive engagement, and promote the open source way. We oversee the entire product lifecycle from conception to delivery, blending technical expertise, strategic thinking, analytics, project management skills and effective communication to ensure products meet both user needs and business objectives. We have open product manager roles across a wide range of product domains, including: Ubuntu Platform - Our Ubuntu experience on Desktop, Server, Windows (WSL), Multipass, Gaming, Enterprise, & Hardware Enablement Ubuntu Pro Services - Our key commercial offerings Ubuntu Pro, Compliance, Standards, Security Engineering, and Managed Services on cloud and on prem AI/ML & MLOps - Open source AI/ML solutions, AIOps automation, model lifecycle management, Kubeflow, MLFlow, KServe, and AI infrastructure on cloud and edge IoT - Ubuntu on embedded devices and/or edge servers, device management, and robotics Cloud - Ubuntu in public and private clouds, promoting automation frameworks, and including technologies such as Kubernetes, MAAS, and LXD Telco - Open source for Telco's including technologies and standards related to Core Network, RAN/vRAN, SoNIC, DENT, and SmartNICs Finance - Open source solutions for financial institutions including trading platforms, blockchain technologies, regulatory compliance, and AI-driven analytics Automotive - Open source solutions for autonomous driving, in-vehicle infotainment, connected vehicles, and compliance with automotive industry standards such as ISO 26262 and ISO 21434 Application Management - Open source solutions in the enterprise including Observability, IAM, App Stores and technologies such Grafana, GitOps, and Juju Charms If your domain of expertise isn’t listed above, yet you feel it’s relevant to Canonical , then feel free to apply anyway. We will route you to the most suitable team. Location: These roles are home based in the EMEA time zone. You will be expected to be located in this region. The role entails Lead the product development lifecycle, reviewing the priorities and goals for your product Collaborate with cross-functional teams such as engineering, design, marketing, and sales Address common challenges across projects, align on priorities, enable informed decisions, and keep business execution on track Conduct market research, analyse industry trends, and gather customer feedback to identify opportunities Communicate your product vision, status updates, and key decisions to ensure alignment and manage expectations Conduct usability testing, analyse user feedback, and iterate on the product to improve the user experience Collaborate with marketing, sales, and support teams to develop go-to-market strategies, create product documentation, and provide training Contribute to the success of our sales team in winning new opportunities, reviewing customer feedback and participating in customer meetings Oversee the work of a product line, ensuring consistency in strategy and execution across different teams Facilitate collaboration and resolve conflicts within different teams and across other departments What we are looking for in you Exceptional academic results at high school and university Understanding of Linux and the wider open source software community Understanding of computer architecture, application development, datacenters, cloud or devices Passion to write about technologies and the tech landscape A strong work ethic, and personal interests aligned with the open source movement Curiosity, and the habit of continuous learning A strong sense of ownership Problem solving and the ability to innovate Outstanding communications skills in English, both verbal and written For more senior positions, product management experience in the software industry Ability to manage multiple projects or product lines while maintaining focus on key priorities Demonstrated leadership in aligning diverse teams and driving consensus around product strategies Willingness to travel internationally up to 4 times a year for company events up to two weeks long Additional skills that we value Familiarity with a particular verticals (e.g. Telco, Finance, Industrial, Automotive) Familiarity with the technology ecosystem including Silicon, IHV, ISV, ODM/OEMs, cloud service providers and channel Familiarity with cloud native technologies such as Kubernetes, Docker containers & Snaps Familiarity with embedded and connected device technology and ecosystems Familiarity with networking technologies - ethernet, IPv4 and IPv6, routing, firewalling, overlays such as OVN/OVS, VPNs, SR-IOV, infiniband Familiarity with telco networking - RAN, Core, CPE Experience in leading distributed teams across different time zones Demonstrated ability to foster collaboration and innovation in team settings What we offer you We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally. Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year Annual compensation review Recognition rewards Annual holiday leave Maternity and paternity leave Employee Assistance Program Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events About Canonical Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical is an equal opportunity employer We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration. description: Founded in 2017, refurbed is Europe’s fastest-growing marketplace for refurbished products, active in 23 European countries and having surpassed €2Bn in GMV — all while being profitable. With beautiful headquarters in Vienna, we operate as a remote-first company and have been recognised as a Top DACH Employer by Kununu for four consecutive years. Our mission is to make sustainable consumption the easy choice by enabling customers to buy products up to 40% cheaper while significantly reducing CO₂ emissions. If you thrive in an environment that values momentum, ownership, and impact, you’ll feel at home here. We’re a fast-paced, high-performance team that works hard and challenges itself everyday. To enable this high-performance every team member enjoys full autonomy over their location (we’re remote-first). As our PR & Brand Manager (Maternity Cover), you’ll own the day-to-day relationship with our PR agencies across six markets, drive pan-European PR coordination across all our markets, and lead our brand tracking and PR research initiatives. Reporting to our Lead Brand Communications, you’ll be the go-to person for PR excellence, working cross-functionally with Marketing, Supply, Data and other teams to bring refurbed ’s brand story to life across Europe. This is a fixed-term, 18-month contract covering a maternity leave. WHO YOU ARE: You have 2-4 years of experience in PR, communications or brand roles, including experience owning relationships with PR agencies or external partners across multiple markets. You have highly professional written and spoken English, plus fluency in another major European language (Swedish is a strong plus, given the content and market responsibilities of this role). You can be based remotely anywhere in Europe; occasional travel to our markets and events is part of the role. Our Vienna HQ is available if you’d prefer to be based there. You take ownership end-to-end: you’re used to running a project or subarea on your own, and you don’t wait to be told what’s next — you spot gaps, improve ways of working, and raise the quality of what’s around you. You build strong cross-functional relationships; people come to you for PR and brand input because they trust your judgment and expertise. You’re highly organized and comfortable juggling multiple markets, agencies and stakeholders without losing sight of deadlines. You have a strong feel for written language and tone, and experience translating data and company priorities into external-facing stories. You have experience working with AI tools and are open to learning more about implementing AI into your daily work You’re passionate about sustainability, innovation and creating real impact. WHAT YOU'LL DO: PR Agency & Market Management: Own the day-to-day relationship with PR agencies across SE, DK, FI, IE, BE and NL, including briefing, approving PR materials, developing local angles and following up on performance/KPIs. Act as the main internal point of contact for these markets, ensuring agencies have the information, data and materials they need. Pan-European PR Coordination: Own and host the monthly editorial meeting across 16 PR agencies/markets, including agenda, preparation, follow-up and continuous improvement of the format. Drive cross-market sharing of PR ideas, opportunities and best practices. Manage the press pages across all markets, ensuring the latest press releases and relevant content are published and kept up to date. Data, Research & Brand Tracking: Source and analyse internal data for PR stories, identify relevant trends and coordinate internal data validation. Own the refurbed brand tracker, including planning waves, managing research, setting up surveys and reporting results. Manage PR consumer studies across markets, coordinating agency input, developing and delivering results and insights. Content & Language Support: Proofread and adapt content for Performance Marketing, CRM and other teams. Review and approve UGC/performance content. Events & Activations: Plan and manage PR and influencer events, including concept, budget, agency coordination, internal stakeholders, products and logistics. Represent refurbed at events, including presentations/keynotes, and manage post-event reporting. PR Project & Stakeholder Management: Manage PR projects from idea to execution, translating company priorities, data and initiatives into relevant external communications. Coordinate across PR agencies and internal teams including Marketing, Supply, Data and other stakeholders to ensure effective execution. WHY YOU WILL ENJOY WORKING WITH US: Our Culture and Values: Decisions should be made based on facts and not by hierarchy levels? We sure think so! We embrace giving and receiving feedback, testing and welcoming new ideas, as well as sharing our knowledge across the company. You fail sometimes? Well, so do we! We’re all just human, let’s learn from our mistakes to improve in the future! No matter who you love, where you’re from, who you pray to, whether you pee sitting down or standing up – we are a bunch of talented people who enjoy spending our time making a difference! Personal & Professional Development: You'll have access to a dedicated learning budget within your department to support your growth, whether it's courses, conferences, or other learning opportunities that matter to you. We partner with Likeminded, offering you private sessions with experts for your personal growth and mental health. We frequently host internal workshops, allowing our teams to further develop their skills in different areas and enhancing collaboration across departments. Flexibility: We care about a healthy work/life balance. We not only function and support a fully remote setting but also offer the possibility to work from our beautiful office in the vibrant heart of Vienna – we love dogs, so feel free to bring your furry little buddy too 😊 We trust you to do the best job, so we don't care so much when you do it – you are able to self-organize. You will also be invited to take part in our office weeks, happening three times a year, where you will have the chance to work side by side with your colleagues and enjoy the team-building events and on-site workshops …and much more! title: Content Specialist
description: Mayflower is a technology company building large-scale entertainment products for a global audience. Our platforms serve millions of users worldwide and rank among the top-50 most visited websites globally. For more than 10 years, we've been creating reliable, high-performance solutions at the intersection of product, engineering, and entertainment. We’re looking for a hands-on Content Specialist to help grow platforms’s audience by finding promising videos on our platform, editing them, and publishing them on third-party sites. Your main focus will be turning existing platform content into videos that attract viewers and bring new users to the platform. You’ll also experiment with original content and paid promotion to expand successful approaches. Job Responsibilities Find and select videos: Explore platform content to identify videos with strong potential for external distribution. Refine selection criteria based on performance. Edit and adapt content: Cut footage, improve pacing, add branding and calls to action, and adapt videos to each platform’s formats and audience. Prepare publication materials: Create engaging titles, descriptions, thumbnails, and tracking links. Test different approaches to improve visibility and click-through rates. Ensure proper content rights: Verify and document creator consent and redistribution rights, and follow platform requirements in coordination with Legal. Upload and manage videos: Publish content on tube sites, and relevant third-party platforms. Maintain a consistent publishing schedule and keep accounts and content organized. Optimize for growth: Track views, engagement, and registrations with support from analysts. Use these insights to improve content selection, editing, and distribution. Explore new opportunities: Find additional platforms and test new video formats and publication approaches. Produce original content: Propose ideas and collaborate with creators on exclusive videos tailored to promising formats and audiences. Run paid promotion tests: Find advertising opportunities, purchase placements within agreed budgets, and evaluate results with the team. Requirements You will thrive if you have… 2+ years of experience in content management, video production, or content distribution. Hands-on video editing skills: you can independently turn source footage into a publishable video. Good judgment in selecting engaging footage and creating effective titles and thumbnails. Understanding of how content can drive traffic and attract new users. Ability to use performance data to improve your work. Strong English communication skills, written and spoken. Ability to work independently, manage a regular publishing schedule, and meet deadlines. Access to reliable high-speed internet. Qualifications that can be a plus Experience uploading and optimizing videos for tube platforms. Familiarity with video SEO, platform discovery, and audience behavior. Experience with paid promotion, advertising placements, or media buying. Experience developing original content and working with creators or models. Availability for collaboration during European working hours. Conditions We know that great talent deserves great conditions, so here's what you can expect when joining us: Full remote work. Competitive compensation with a service contract. Transparent performance reviews twice a year, with bonus opportunities and salary adjustments. An annual allowance that you can use for home office improvements, sports activities, equipment upgrades, and more—tailor it to what benefits you most. Investment in your development: paid language courses, access to various learning platforms, and a mindfulness benefit, including psychological support with 50% coverage. Career growth in a fast-scaling project with opportunities to influence technical decisions. A culture of recognition: our peer reward program celebrates contributions from across the team. This opportunity is also available for those who already live in Limassol, Cyprus. EU-based employment contract and a 3-year Cyprus work visa. Private medical insurance for you and your family, a corporate mobile plan (unlimited in Cyprus with roaming included), and interest-free support for car purchases. 50% coverage of school and kindergarten fees for your children. Fully covered sports benefits, and also access to in-house electric scooters and bike rentals. A fully equipped office in Limassol’s city center, with everything you need for deep work and collaboration. Free catering in the office and an in-house coffee bar with high-quality drinks and a health bar stocked with nutritious snacks. Benefits are provided in accordance with the company’s policies and eligibility criteria. Recruitment process HR interview (40 min); Technical interview (1 hour); Test task; Final interview (1 hour); Recommendations check; Job Offer. Originally posted on Himalayas

title: Manager, Data Quality Assurance
description: Do you have a passion for children and education? Would you like to positively impact families in need of help? We want to speak with you! Step Up For Students empowers families to pursue and engage in the most appropriate learning options for their children. JOB SUMMARY As a member of the Internal Assurance team, you will play a critical role in translating data governance and controls standards into audit and consulting projects that improve data trust and usability across the enterprise. This role will help ensure that downstream business processes, analytics, reporting, and AI initiatives consume accurate, complete, consistent and valid data by implementing data quality controls, enabling Cloud Data Governance & Catalog (CDGC) capabilities, and driving visibility through data quality metrics and scorecards. This role is hands-on and execution-focused, requiring close collaboration with data stewards, governance leads, data engineers, and application teams to proactively identify, resolve, and prevent data quality issues at scale. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES ◦ Team Translate business-defined data quality rules into technical implementations using techniques including, but not limited to, SQL validations, profiling rules, scorecards, and pipeline controls. ◦ Implement data validation, cleansing, and standardization across enterprise data domains to prevent invalid data from propagating downstream. ◦ Partner with functional teams to implement and monitor data quality controls across our master data domains. ◦ Execute enterprise data quality frameworks, including rule standardization, threshold management, and alignment to critical data elements (CDEs). ◦ Perform data profiling and validation activities, including completeness checks, duplicate analysis, pattern validation, referential integrity checks, and anomaly detection. ◦ Configure and support CDGC capabilities, including dataset onboarding, metadata ingestion, catalog enrichment, governed asset management, and business glossary mapping. ◦ Develop, enhance, and maintain data quality rule mapping, scorecards, dashboards, and data health visibility within CDGC and related reporting tools. ◦ Support CDE classification, governed data asset onboarding, and data product registration within CDGC and data marketplace. ◦ Support and validate technical and business data lineage across our master data, analytics, and downstream platforms for traceability and impact analysis. ◦ Perform root cause analysis (RCA) over data quality errors to identify if they stem from system bugs or user entries, validate fixes through regression testing, and recommend structural and upstream process improvements to prevent recurring issues. EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE REQUIRED: ◦ A minimum of 8 years of related experience with a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Engineering, Statistics or a related field; or 6 years of related experience with a Master's degree; or 3 years of related experience with a PhD; or an equivalent combination of education and experience. ◦ Hands-on experience in data quality, metadata management, master data management, data engineering, or governance-focused technical roles. ◦ Strong hands-on experience with Informatica CDGC, including metadata curation, dataset onboarding, catalog management, data quality rule mapping, and data quality visibility. ◦ Hands-on experience with Purview, Alation, Collibra, CluedIn, or similar data quality solutions for profiling, validation, rule implementation, scorecards, and monitoring. ◦ Strong working knowledge of master data domains, including customer, supplier, and finance, with experience supporting data quality, governance, and lifecycle management processes across ERP environments. ◦ Solid experience with scripting languages (Python or R) for automation. ◦ Familiarity with ETL tools, data profiling software, or cloud data warehouses (e.g., Azure Data Stack, Microsoft Fabric, Azure Databricks). ◦ Experience working with business glossaries, CDEs, data lineage, and governed metadata management. ◦ Strong SQL skills and experience querying databases, developing or supporting ETL, Intelligent Data Management Cloud (IDMC), and SQL-based data pipelines. ◦ Experience performing data profiling, data validation, issue investigation, RCA, regression testing, and remediation tracking. ◦ Strong analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder collaboration skills. ◦ Experience in translating complex, technical data errors into actionable insights for nontechnical stakeholders. PREFERRED: ◦ Experience with enterprise master data management initiatives. ◦ Experience building or supporting data quality scorecards and dashboards using Power BI or similar visualization platforms. ◦ Experience with cloud data platforms such as SILK, Azure Data Stack, Microsoft Fabric, Azure Databricks, or equivalent modern data environments. ◦ Familiarity with master data management (MDM) concepts including match/merge, survivorship, validation rules, and reference data management. ◦ Experience supporting data product enablement, self-service analytics, or data marketplace initiatives. ◦ Basic scripting experience using Python, Spark, or related technologies. KEY COMPETENCIES ◦ Data Quality Management: Ensures data accuracy, completeness, consistency, and integrity through the implementation of data quality controls, validation rules, monitoring, and remediation processes. ◦ Data Governance: Supports enterprise data governance practices by maintaining data standards, metadata, business glossaries, critical data elements (CDEs), and data lineage to improve trust and usability. ◦ Technical & Analytical Expertise: Applies SQL, data profiling tools, governance platforms, and analytical techniques to identify issues, evaluate data health, and implement effective solutions. ◦ Root Cause Analysis & Problem Solving: Investigates data quality issues, identifies underlying causes, validates corrective actions, and drives sustainable process improvements to prevent recurrence. ◦ Reporting & Data Visualization: Develops and maintains data quality metrics, scorecards, dashboards, and reporting tools that provide visibility into data health and governance performance. ◦ Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partners effectively with data stewards, engineers, governance leaders, and business stakeholders to implement data quality initiatives and achieve organizational objectives. ◦ Communication & Influence: Communicates complex technical concepts and data issues clearly to diverse audiences, driving understanding, accountability, and adoption of best practices. ◦ Continuous Improvement: Identifies opportunities to enhance data quality, governance processes, and operational efficiency through ongoing evaluation, innovation, and process optimization. CORE VALUES Step Up For Students believes strongly in two key core values to carry out their mission of “We empower families to pursue and engage in the most appropriate learning options for their children.”: ◦ Everyone is an asset. ◦ Every event is an improvement opportunity. To maintain a positive and effective organizational culture, employees are expected to demonstrate these two core values in their everyday work. WORKING CONDITIONS & EQUIPMENT USE ◦ Work is performed indoors in a typical office environment - not substantially exposed to adverse environmental conditions. ◦ Must be able to lift up to fifteen (15) pounds. ◦ Frequent use of office machines to include telephone, computer, and printer. Step Up For Students is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity & inclusion in the workplace. Originally posted on Himalayas

title: Compliance Operations Manager (Traffic & Content)
description: Mayflower is an international technology company behind products used by millions of people worldwide. For more than 10 years, we've been growing profitable global businesses, bringing together talented professionals across technology, product, marketing, and operations. We are looking for a Compliance Operations Manager to take end-to-end ownership of traffic and content compliance across one of our digital platforms. You will develop and operate a scalable compliance framework for monitoring affiliate partners and digital traffic sources, identifying prohibited or risk activity, investigating incidents, and continuously improving preventive and detective controls. This is a hands-on ownership role for someone who can independently assess risks, establish effective processes, and turn compliance requirements into practical operational and technical solutions. You will work closely with Product, Engineering, Data, Legal, Risk, and commercial teams. Job Responsibilities Own, develop, and update the traffic and content compliance framework, policies, SOPs, and risk-scoring mechanisms. Audit digital traffic channels, landing pages, and promotional materials to detect prohibited content, cloaking, redirect manipulation, and suspicious attribution patterns. Lead root-cause investigations into compliance violations, coordinate corrective actions, enforce partner restrictions, and track remediation. Partner with Product, Engineering, and Data teams to define requirements for automated risk-scoring, internal compliance tools, and external monitoring solutions. Track compliance metrics, analyse recurring risk trends, and deliver clear, decision-ready reporting to management. Ensure documentation remains audit-ready for payment partners and regulators; stay updated on payment-network and industry regulatory shifts. Provide functional direction and quality standards for compliance analysts, and deliver internal training on monitoring and enforcement processes. Requirements You’ll thrive here if you have 5+ years in Compliance Operations, Risk, Fraud Prevention, or Traffic Quality (hands-on experience in traffic compliance, affiliate marketing, and ad networks required). Solid understanding of tracking signals (URLs, redirects, referrers, cookies, device fingerprints) and ability to assess risk using incomplete attribution data. Proven background conducting operational audits, implementing SOPs/compliance policies, and managing root-cause incident investigations. Experienced in team leadership, managing cross-functional initiatives, and translating compliance needs into Product, Engineering, and Data requirements. Ability to define compliance KPIs, build clear executive reports, and make sound, analytical decisions under pressure. Upper-Intermediate English or higher. Nice to Have: Knowledge of payment provider, acquiring bank, or card network compliance standards. Experience detecting cloaking, brand misuse, redirect manipulation, and prohibited content. Familiarity with OSINT, web scraping, SQL/Python, BI tools, or LLM-based automation. Relevant professional certifications (compliance, auditing, risk, or fraud prevention). What Success Looks Like A risk-based traffic and content compliance framework is actively implemented and enforced. High-risk traffic sources and compliance incidents are quickly identified, audited, and resolved. Automated and manual monitoring controls effectively reduce repeat violations. Management receives clear, data-driven visibility into traffic compliance risks. All processes, evidence, and records remain continuously audit-ready for external partners. Conditions We know that great talent deserves great conditions, so here's what you can expect when joining us: Full remote work. Competitive compensation with a service contract. Transparent performance reviews twice a year, with bonus opportunities and salary adjustments. An annual allowance that you can use for home office improvements, sports activities, equipment upgrades, and more—tailor it to what benefits you most. Investment in your development: paid language courses, access to various learning platforms, and a mindfulness benefit, including psychological support with 50% coverage. Career growth in a fast-scaling project with opportunities to influence technical decisions. A culture of recognition: our peer reward program celebrates contributions from across the team. This opportunity is also available for those who already live in Limassol, Cyprus. EU-based employment contract and a 3-year Cyprus work visa. Provident fund (Cyprus): a long-term savings plan co-funded by you and the Company together (available after probation) that grows throughout your time with us in Cyprus. Private medical insurance for you and your family, a corporate mobile plan (unlimited in Cyprus with roaming included), and interest-free support for car purchases. 50% coverage of school and kindergarten fees for your children. Fully covered sports benefits, and also access to in-house electric scooters and bike rentals. A fully equipped office in Limassol’s city center, with everything you need for deep work and collaboration. Free catering in the office and an in-house coffee bar with high-quality drinks and a health bar stocked with nutritious snacks. Benefits are provided in accordance with the company’s policies and eligibility criteria. Originally posted on Himalayas

title: Automation QA Engineer Internship
description: Overview: Quality and Test Automation The Automation QA Engineer is vital for ensuring the reliability, performance, and correctness of our entire supply chain e-commerce platform. You will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining comprehensive automated test suites across the e-commerce user interface, complex internal business workflows (MES, WMS, OMS), and the logic governing our next-generation AI agents. Internship Details Duration: 3 months Start Date: Immediate Location: Remote Stipend: None initially. Based on your first-quarter performance, you may be offered a paid full-time opportunity, or even be absorbed directly by the client as an FTE. Key Responsibilities & Core Projects You will embed quality assurance directly into the development and deployment lifecycle, serving as the gatekeeper for production releases. Test Suite Development: Develop and maintain robust, end-to-end automated test suites covering critical e-commerce flows (catalog navigation, checkout, payments, invoicing) and complex internal tool workflows (OMS/WMS operations). Quality Gates (CI/CD): Integrate automated test suites into the CI/CD pipeline (managed via Makefile) to enforce quality gates, ensuring no regressions are introduced and the platform adheres to performance standards before deployment. Performance & Load Testing: Implement and execute performance testing and load testing protocols to validate the scalability and resilience of the NestJS modular monolith, especially for high-traffic scenarios and intensive SCM transactions. API Integration Testing: Design and execute automated tests for API integrations between the core supply chain modules (e.g., testing the data contract integrity between WMS and OMS) and external payment services. Test Data Management: Create and maintain reliable test data factories to simulate complex multi-tenant and domain-specific scenarios (e.g., various HS codes, tenant feature flags). Regression Management: Continuously maintain and optimize the regression test suite to provide fast, reliable feedback to development teams operating within the Monorepo structure. Required Technologies & Tools Candidates must possess strong expertise in automated testing frameworks, CI/CD integration, and performance validation: Automation Frameworks: Experience selecting, building, and maintaining E2E (e.g., Playwright, Cypress) and API testing frameworks. Programming: Strong proficiency in TypeScript and Node.js for writing high-quality, maintainable test code. Performance/Load: Experience with tools for performance and load testing (e.g., JMeter, K6). CI/CD: Practical experience integrating tests into automated pipelines and working within a Monorepo environment. Data & Database: Ability to query PostgreSQL 15 directly to validate data integrity. AI Agent Focus You will be responsible for validating the behavior and accuracy of our AI systems. Agent Behavior Testing: Develop tests to validate the deterministic and non-deterministic behaviors of AI agents, ensuring they accurately process inputs, access data securely, and perform their intended functions (e.g., workflow optimization, customer support responses). Integration Validation: Verify the quality of data retrieval and the security of the API layers connecting AI agents (using LangChain/LlamaIndex) to the core WMS/OMS data. Success Metrics & Career Path Performance will be measured by: Test Coverage: Measurable increase in automated functional and regression test coverage across critical application paths. Defect Escape Rate: Reduction in the number of critical and high-severity defects escaping to production. Pipeline Reliability: Maintenance of stable, non-flaky test runs within the CI/CD pipeline. Mentorship Structure: Reports to the Technical Architect or Engineering Lead, working directly with development teams across the Catalog, OMS, and WMS modules. Originally posted on Himalayas

Demonstrated success driving explosive organic growth , ideally growing accounts from zero to hundreds of thousands of followers or generating millions of organic views. Deep expertise in TikTok and Instagram algorithms , including viral hooks, audience retention, completion rates, engagement signals, and content distribution mechanics. Hands-on experience building and scaling multi-account networks , clipping ecosystems, or high-volume content distribution strategies to maximize organic reach. Strong ability to identify, adapt, and capitalize on viral trends , translating emerging formats into creative concepts and rapid growth experiments. Proficiency with AI-powered content creation and automation tools , such as Opus Clip, generative video platforms, and scalable content production workflows. Experience developing creative strategies and actionable briefs for creators, influencers, or content production teams, enabling high-volume execution. Strong analytical and experimentation skills , using performance metrics, A/B testing, and rapid iteration to optimize content performance and replicate viral success. An entrepreneurial, creative, and results-driven mindset , with exceptional problem-solving skills, high ownership, and the ability to build unconventional growth strategies from scratch. description: About us Tameson is a global e-commerce business helping SMEs source industrial components. We are looking for a Marketing Analytics Specialist to join our Data Analytics team and bring statistical rigor to how we run and measure paid advertising. The role This is a hands-on ownership role where data and marketing meet. You set our paid acquisition strategy, make the business case, run the campaigns and prove the results with data. Experience with Google Ads or other ad platforms is a plus, but platforms can be learned. The analytical and entrepreneurial mindset is much harder to teach. You will work directly with the Data Analytics Lead and Marketing Lead in a team that sits at the center of how Tameson makes decisions. Your output will materially shape where marketing budget goes, how we measure its return, and how we test new ideas. A flavor of recent work Built a Markov-chain multi-touch attribution model to improve our early-funnel bidding in paid ads channels. Built LTV and cohort retention models that let us value customer segments differently, and feed those values back into bidding and targeting. Designed and ran A/B and CRO experiments to validate channel changes, on-site changes, and bidding strategies. Built the BigQuery and Looker Studio reporting layer that the business actually uses to track CAC, POAS, and LTV. Designed an experimental framework to measure the incremental effect of paid advertisement spend. What you would pick up Extend and improve our attribution work, challenge assumptions, try alternative models, quantify uncertainty. Take full ownership of our paid advertisement strategy, based on data insights and experimental results. Design experiments end-to-end: A/B, geo, holdout, CRO. All with proper power analysis, randomization, and evaluation. Build models that inform capital allocation across channels: saturation curves, diminishing returns, MMM, for example. Analyze complex datasets across customer journeys, search query data, marketplace performance, and CRM. Develop customer and audience models that inform who we should target, where, and how much we should pay to reach them. Paid Media & Business Sense: You understand how paid acquisition drives revenue and profit, and you turn analysis into a strategy you can execute. Outcome Owner: You are driven by results like revenue and profit rather than simple output. Collaborative Investigator: You work cross functionally with Product and Operations teams to provide data insights and measurement frameworks. A skeptical disposition: Uncomfortable with conclusions drawn from underpowered tests or last-click reports. Why Choose Tameson ? Direct Business Impact: Your work directly correlates to sales and bottom line profitability. You will build the analytics dashboards that allow you to point to a chart and say, "This ad drove that revenue growth". Innovation: We are an aggressive, modern company that values technical experimentation. We want you to test new channels, automate complex workflows, and deploy the latest data engineering tools to keep us ahead. Company culture: We value collaboration, professional growth, and fun. Our goal is to make open source easier, more reliable and more secure for deployment and development. We strive to be the provider of ‘most software to most companies’, starting with Ubuntu but expanding to cover every class of application on every class of compute. Together, we aim to improve open source quality, outreach, and impact. Our product managers set the vision and the direction to ensure teams deliver the right products in the right markets at the right time. Our product managers are technology professionals with a software engineering background who strive to become business executives and entrepreneurs. description: About Sparkfund Sparkfund is the utility services company unlocking capacity on the grid. By adding targeted capacity exactly where and when the grid needs it most, DCP helps meet demand, support reliability, and put downward pressure on rates. Sparkfund supports program design, grid value assessment, asset host engagement, and value chain management to ensure on-time, on-budget deployment with maximum system value and lowest cost. With more than 3,200 projects deployed across 43 states and more than 300MW of energized assets constructed, Sparkfund is transforming customer-sited assets into a valuable portfolio resource for the benefit of our society. description: About Customs Support Group Customs Support Group (CSG) is Europe’s leading independent customs services provider. Founded in 1964, we operate in 14 European countries with 100+ offices and a team of 1,700+ customs professionals . We help companies move goods across borders smoothly and compliantly, taking the pressure out of customs. What we do: We support more than 60,000 clients and process over 20 million declaration lines each year . From day-to-day customs declarations to compliance, duty optimization and trade advice, we make cross-border trade easier and more predictable. How we work: We combine local customs expertise with modern digital tools to handle complex customs and trade requirements accurately and efficiently. Our specialists work closely with clients to navigate regulatory complexity, identify risks, strengthen compliance frameworks, and optimize international trade processes. Why it matters: Customs, export controls, and international trade regulations are becoming increasingly complex. Regulatory changes, geopolitical developments, and growing compliance expectations create both risks and opportunities for internationally operating businesses. CSG helps clients stay compliant, manage these risks proactively, and build customs and trade processes that support sustainable business growth. Why Join Us At CSG, you will join a growing international organization at the heart of European customs and international trade. You will: Act as a trusted advisor to clients on complex customs, trade compliance, and export control matters. Take ownership of challenging consulting projects from initial analysis through implementation and delivery. Develop customized compliance strategies that have a direct impact on our clients’ international operations. Work closely with customers, authorities, internal specialists, and commercial teams across a broad range of industries. Use your expertise to turn commercial opportunities and qualified leads into valuable consulting engagements. Contribute to the development of our Customs & Trade Compliance offering, methodologies, and best practices. Share your expertise with colleagues and support the development of less experienced consultants. Build your professional network and play an active role in the continued growth of our consulting business. This is an opportunity for an experienced customs and trade professional who wants to combine deep subject-matter expertise with consulting, project leadership, client development, and commercial impact. Purpose of the Position As a Consultant Customs & Trade Compliance, you will independently advise and support clients on complex customs, export control, and trade compliance matters. You will lead consulting projects, assess existing customs and export control processes, identify regulatory risks and optimization opportunities, and develop practical, sustainable compliance solutions tailored to each client’s business. Your role goes beyond providing technical advice. You will be a trusted partner to clients, translating complex regulatory requirements into practical business solutions and ensuring their successful implementation. You will also have an important commercial role. Working closely with Sales, you will use your expertise to develop qualified opportunities into concrete consulting projects, support pitches and proposals, build trusted customer relationships, and identify opportunities for cross-selling and upselling. As a senior member of the Customs & Trade Compliance team, you will contribute to quality assurance, establish best practices, share knowledge, and support the professional development of other consultants. Main Responsibilities Customs & Trade Compliance Consulting Conduct detailed assessments of clients’ existing customs, export control, and trade compliance processes. Identify compliance gaps, operational risks, and opportunities to improve processes and controls. Advise clients on complex customs and international trade compliance matters at both strategic and operational levels. Develop practical recommendations that balance regulatory requirements with clients’ operational and commercial needs. Support the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of customs and trade compliance programs. Compliance Strategy Development Develop tailored strategies to ensure compliance with national and international customs and export control requirements. Design and improve compliance frameworks, internal controls, procedures, and governance structures. Support clients in embedding customs and trade compliance requirements into their day-to-day business processes. Translate regulatory requirements into clear, sustainable, and operationally effective solutions. Business Development & Client Growth Actively identify new business opportunities and contribute to building a strong professional network within Customs & Trade Compliance. Build trusted relationships with new and existing clients and act as a subject-matter expert throughout the commercial process. Identify cross-selling and upselling opportunities within existing customer accounts. Take ownership of qualified Sales leads and use your expertise to develop them into clearly defined consulting projects. Work closely with Sales on complex and consultancy-led opportunities where subject-matter expertise is critical to winning the client. Contribute to proposals, presentations, pitches, scopes of work, and other commercial materials. Support contract discussions and the successful closing of consulting engagements. Build long-term customer relationships that contribute to sustainable revenue growth. Project Management Lead and manage complex client projects within Customs & Trade Compliance from scoping through implementation and completion. Define project objectives, deliverables, responsibilities, and priorities together with clients and internal stakeholders. Ensure projects are delivered on time, at the required quality level, and in line with agreed objectives. Identify project risks and dependencies early and take appropriate actions to keep delivery on track. Coordinate internal specialists and external stakeholders involved in project delivery. Licences & Authorization Management Advise and support clients in applications for import, export, transit, and other customs-related licences and authorizations. Coordinate authorization procedures and ensure all relevant regulatory requirements are addressed. Support clients throughout communication and interactions with the relevant authorities. Help establish processes that ensure continued compliance with authorization requirements after implementation. Audits & Compliance Assessments Plan, conduct, and manage internal and external customs and trade compliance audits. Evaluate existing processes, controls, documentation, and governance against applicable regulatory requirements. Identify improvement opportunities and develop appropriate corrective measures. Support clients in implementing and monitoring remediation plans following audits or compliance assessments. Regulatory Monitoring & Advisory Continuously monitor developments in customs regulations, export controls, international trade agreements, and related compliance requirements. Assess the potential business impact of regulatory changes on clients. Proactively communicate relevant developments and recommend appropriate actions. Translate regulatory complexity into clear and actionable guidance for clients and internal stakeholders. Reporting & Documentation Prepare and analyze regular reports covering areas such as CBAM, Intrastat, authorizations, and other customs and compliance-related topics. Use analytical findings to develop clear recommendations and identify potential compliance risks or improvement opportunities. Review and prepare customs and export-related documentation. Ensure documentation meets regulatory requirements and the expectations of relevant authorities, including bodies such as BAFA. Stakeholder Management Act as a central point of contact between clients, internal teams, external partners, and relevant authorities. Build strong relationships with senior client stakeholders and become a trusted advisor on Customs & Trade Compliance matters. Coordinate closely with internal specialist teams to ensure integrated and high-quality client solutions. Work with customer organizations to ensure agreed compliance measures are implemented effectively. Support the integration of IT and compliance systems into existing customer processes where relevant. Training, Knowledge Sharing & Team Development Design and deliver customs, trade compliance, and export control training sessions and workshops for clients and colleagues. Actively share expertise and best practices across the organization. Support and mentor less experienced consultants in developing their technical and consulting capabilities. Contribute to building consistent standards, methodologies, and ways of working within the Customs & Trade Compliance team. Continuously develop your own expertise to remain up to date with regulatory and market developments. What to Expect A consulting role with genuine ownership of client relationships and complex projects. The opportunity to combine deep customs and trade compliance expertise with commercial responsibility and business development. A high degree of autonomy in how you manage projects, structure solutions, and advise clients. Exposure to challenging customs, export control, and international trade topics across different industries and customer environments. Direct interaction with customers, decision-makers, regulatory authorities, and internal specialists. A role where your expertise directly influences client decisions, compliance maturity, and business outcomes. The opportunity to shape and further develop CSG’s Customs & Trade Compliance consulting offering. A growing international environment where knowledge sharing and collaboration across borders are an integral part of how we work. Visible impact on the development of both clients and colleagues. Job Requirements Several years of relevant professional experience in customs, export control, international trade compliance, or a related advisory field , with the expertise required to independently advise clients on complex matters. Strong knowledge of customs regulations, customs procedures, trade compliance, and export control requirements. Demonstrated experience in advising internal or external stakeholders on complex regulatory and operational topics. Experience in independently leading and delivering complex projects. Ability to analyze existing customs and compliance processes, identify risks, and translate findings into practical improvement measures. Experience developing or implementing customs, export control, or trade compliance programs, processes, or internal controls. Strong client orientation and the ability to build credible, trusted relationships with senior stakeholders. Commercial mindset with the ability to identify business opportunities and develop client needs into concrete consulting projects. Experience supporting business development activities, proposals, pitches, or commercial negotiations would be a strong advantage. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to work confidently on complex and changing regulatory topics. Excellent project management and stakeholder coordination capabilities. Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex regulatory topics clearly and pragmatically. Experience dealing with customs authorities and other relevant regulatory institutions is an advantage. Experience with topics such as CBAM, Intrastat, customs authorizations, audits, and regulatory reporting is advantageous. Experience designing or delivering professional training and workshops is an advantage. Ability and willingness to support less experienced colleagues through knowledge sharing, coaching, and mentoring. A proactive, hands-on approach with a high degree of personal accountability and ownership. High quality standards, sound professional judgement, and a strong compliance mindset. What We Offer A competitive compensation package. An expert role within a leading European customs organization. A position combining consulting, project leadership, client relationship management, and business development. A high degree of autonomy and ownership in your day-to-day work. The opportunity to work on complex and strategically relevant customs and trade compliance projects. Direct exposure to a diverse portfolio of clients and industries. The opportunity to influence the further development of our Customs & Trade Compliance services, methodologies, and best practices. Career development opportunities within a growing international organization. Collaboration with experienced customs professionals and specialists across CSG’s European network. Ongoing professional development and the opportunity to deepen your expertise in an increasingly important area of international trade. Originally posted on Himalayas

description: Job Title: AI Response Evaluator for Cyber Security Threat Intelligence Location: Remote Job Type: Task-Based Contract (Make your own hours: 5 hours per week minimum) Overview: We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated individual to join our team as an AI Response Evaluator with a focus on Cyber Security Threat Intelligence. The successful candidate will be involved in evaluating AI-generated prompts using reinforcement learning with human feedback to grade and improve AI quality. This role is an exceptional opportunity to work at the cutting edge nexus of AI and Cyber Security, contributing to the development of smarter, more efficient systems capable of defending against the ever-evolving cyber threat landscape. Responsibilities: Evaluate AI-generated prompt responses for accuracy, relevance, and effectiveness in the context of Cyber Security Threat Intelligence. Use reinforcement learning with human feedback to grade AI prompt responses and guide the AI's learning process for improved performance. Collaborate with cybersecurity professionals and data scientists to refine AI models based on real-world cyber threat intelligence and incident data. Participate in the continuous improvement of AI training processes, including the selection of training data and feedback mechanisms. Stay abreast of the latest developments in cyber security threats, tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs) to ensure the AI's outputs are relevant and up-to-date. Provide insights and feedback on the AI's performance and potential areas for enhancement in detecting and responding to cyber threats.
