title: Executive Heartbeat Lean Leader, Office of Heartbeat
description: Job Description Summary Based in Europe, this executive role leads the enterprise-wide Lean transformation within GE HealthCare ’s Office of Heartbeat. It supports the development, deployment, and sustained alignment of the Heartbeat Business System with the company’s 2030 goals. Transformation Leadership: The role champions, coaches, and mentors Lean change; leads Heartbeat Lean Leaders; partners with stakeholders to prioritize improvement opportunities; and co-leads operating reviews, strategy, and priority planning across regions, segments, and functions. Business System Deployment: Responsibilities include supporting bootcamps, coaching, and training while embedding standard work, daily management, problem solving, kaizen, value stream mapping, and action planning into business operations. The position also builds Lean capability and manages the organizational change required to sustain these practices. Operational Impact: By analyzing work at the genba, diagnosing challenges, testing improvements, and executing Hoshin Kanri priorities, the role is expected to improve business results and culture, strengthen leadership capability, and contribute to improved EBITDA and Free Cash Flow. Required Profile: Candidates need a bachelor’s degree, at least 15 years of general management or Lean operational leadership experience, and at least 10 years of Lean capability-building experience. The profile also calls for regulated-industry knowledge, experience with AI-enabled tools, global Lean-system deployment, strong facilitation and program-management skills, executive communication, accountability, commercial focus, and change-management expertise, preferably using the ADKAR framework. Job Description Your Challenge The Executive Lean Leader is responsible for supporting the design, adoption, functional leadership, and execution of the enterprise-wide Lean transformation within the Office of Heartbeat at GE HealthCare . As a key member of the Office of Heartbeat team, the Executive Lean Leader contributes to the overall strategy of how we run, change, and act in the business, guided by the principles and processes of the Heartbeat Business System (HBS). This role is critical to ensure the Heartbeat Business System is developed, deployed, and sustained in direct alignment with the company’s 2030 goals. The Executive Lean Leader will lead impactful operating routines and drive execution of critical projects. The role is based in Europe. Your Responsibilities Our Heartbeat Business System is based on Lean thinking and practices and will be an integral part of the way we run, change, and act in our business for the long-term. Each Executive Lean Leader contributes to this progression within the organization. The Executive Lean Leader will focus on selecting, supporting, and assisting with the improvement efforts tied to the Office of Heartbeat’s most critical business processes (e.g., Hoshin Kanri), primarily in the innovation (STO), commercial, integrated supply chain, service, and functional areas. By analyzing work at the genba with our people, diagnosing our challenges, and testing process improvements through an action plan, the Executive Lean Leader will demonstrate continuous improvement and breakthrough performance — ultimately shaping the company culture and brand. The goal is to positively impact results and culture by establishing standards, institutionalizing daily management processes, adopting consistent problem-solving methods, and executing on Hoshin Kanri priorities. As a key member of the Office of Heartbeat team, the Executive Lean Leader will help strengthen and develop the evolving Heartbeat Business System and build people and leader capability in the Heartbeat fundamentals — standard work, daily management system, problem solving, kaizen, value stream mapping, and action planning — with a growth mindset that enables culture change. This will require significant change management to embed effectively throughout the organization. Expectations Lean Leadership & Transformation Provide overall Lean leadership at the appropriate Region / Segment / Function level and drive the Lean transformation by serving as a champion, coach, and mentor for change Lead and mentor the Region / Segment / Function teams of Heartbeat Lean Leaders across the organization Partner with global business stakeholders across segments and regions to identify, prioritize, and execute improvement opportunities through Kaizen events and Lean initiatives Co-lead Region / Segment / Function operating rhythms (operating reviews, long-term strategy, priorities planning) in partnership with subject-matter experts and senior leaders Heartbeat Business System Deployment Support the development and activities of the Heartbeat Business System, including bootcamps, leader coaching, and training on Heartbeat fundamentals Install the Heartbeat behaviors and fundamentals into how we run the business: standard work, daily management system, problem solving, kaizen, value stream mapping, and action planning Capability Building Establish a Lean capability program that ensures the application of globally recognized standards for Lean principles and practices, serves as a benchmark for achievement, and provides a common roadmap for continuous improvement and people development Develop capability across the spectrum — from the tactical (deployment and application of principles, concepts, and methods) to the strategic (a transformation that deeply impacts a key value stream) — with effective change management Leadership, Culture, & Change Management Demonstrate and commit to servant leadership and partnership with peers and leaders Align behaviors and practices to our shared Cultural Operating Principles and Heartbeat Behaviors Development and deployment of the Heartbeat Business System will result in improved EBITDA and Free Cash Flow Your Experience BS or BA Degree; Master’s Degree preferred Minimum 15 years of experience in a General Management or Lean/operational leadership role Minimum 10 years of capability building across a variety of Lean practices, including Hoshin Kanri, problem solving, daily management system, standard work, and value stream mapping Working knowledge of business processes within the medical equipment or other regulated industry Experience leveraging AI-enabled tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot, or similar platforms to accelerate the way work is done, and continuously learning new ways of using emerging technologies Ability to travel up to 40% across Europe and internationally. Desired Characteristics Ideally built and/or designed an organizational management system Ideally developed the playbook for the core processes of an organizational business system Demonstrated successful leadership and proficiency in installing and sustaining a Lean system for a global organization with operations and services teams Deep, hands-on experience with Lean principles and practices; credible with practitioners and executives alike Ability to accurately assess key business metrics and situations from a general manager’s or executive leader’s perspective Excellent time, program, and project management skills — brings order and structure quickly to initiatives and other critical, high-visibility programs Strong facilitation and ability to influence without authority across segments, regions, and functions High attention to detail in daily and visual management without losing the strategic thread Proven ability to hold senior leaders accountable to commitments with candor and respect Growth mindset with hands-on approach; comfortable at the genba and in the boardroom Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including executive storytelling Experience with Change Management (preferably the ADKAR framework) Deep commercial experience with a focus on the customer and end-user experience Additional Information Relocation Assistance Provided: No Originally posted on Himalayas

description: About CookUnity : Food has lost its soul to modern convenience. And with it, it has lost the power to nourish, inspire, and connect us. If that mission has you hungry in more ways than one, you’ve found the right job posting. About the Team: We are looking for a Real Time Analyst to work with the WFM Analyst. The ideal candidate will play a crucial role in maintaining service level agreements (SLAs), improving workforce allocation, and providing actionable insights to stakeholders in real time. The role: As a Real-Time Operations Analyst at CookUnity , you’ll play a key role in ensuring smooth daily operations across our CX teams. You’ll manage real-time data, support frontline teams, and help ensure we hit key performance targets. You don’t need to come in knowing everything about WFM—we’re ready to train the right person—but you do need to be analytical, action-oriented, and curious. If you love digging into data, thrive in fast-paced environments, and are excited to support both people and processes, we’d love to meet you. Monitor queue conditions, agent states, workload distribution, and available capacity throughout the assigned shift. Adjust resource allocation on the fly: reassign agents, manage breaks, redistribute workload, even skill our team dynamically to maintain performance. Collaborate with WFM Analyst and CX Leadership teams to ensure shift coverage and service targets. Maintain detailed logs of interventions, staffing changes, and performance shifts to support post-event analysis and process optimization. Provide KPI reporting and crisis management during outages or spikes, and maintain detailed logs for performance review. Participate in continuous improvement initiatives—help build dashboards, refine real‑time monitoring tools, and share best practices across teams What You Bring Understanding of customer support or contact center operational metrics, including service level, average speed of answer, occupancy, adherence, average handle time, abandonment, and backlog. Proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets, including filtering, pivot tables, lookup functions, conditional formulas, and data formatting. Ability to interpret live operational metrics and make logical, timely decisions. Strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities. Clear written and verbal communication skills. Ability to escalate issues appropriately and communicate with stakeholders at different levels. Ability to remain calm and organized in a fast-paced environment. Proactive problem-solving skills and willingness to act within established guidelines. 3+ months of experience in workforce management roles . 6+ months of experience in a call center or customer support environment . Nice-to-Haves Familiarity with Zendesk, Slack, Google Sheets, or similar operational tools. Experience with Workforce Management platforms such as NICE IEX, Verint, Calabrio, or similar systems. Preferred Requirements: Logical thinking: You back decisions with data, not just instincts. Time management: You can juggle tasks and adapt quickly. description: About Nebius : Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure. Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI. Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D. The role This position sits within Nebius Token Factory, our serverless platform for running and customizing open-source LLMs in production. Token Factory allows for serverless inference and fine-tuning backed by in-house optimizations like custom speculative decoding, quantization, cache-aware routing and dedicated endpoints. Customers come to us to move from prototype to scaled production without the cost and complexity of building and tuning their own inference stack. Our Solutions Architects own the technical delivery of customer engagements: deploying open-source models, tuning the serving stack, benchmarking against the customer's success criteria, and carrying the technical relationship through to production. Sales Engineers qualify and scope the opportunity; SAs execute it. Technical Account Managers take it from production onward. We're looking for a Manager, ML Solutions Architecture to lead our EU regional SA teams. Your scope is PoC delivery and post-sales technical support : the people who do it, the standard they do it to, and the operating cadence that keeps it predictable. You will report to the Head of Solutions Architecture and partner with a peer manager in the other region. We expect you to push people when they need pushing, make the uncomfortable call when deliverables don't land even though the effort was real, and take ownership of the documentation work: implement and monitor the following of the guidelines, ticket hygiene, and making sure the team actually uses all three. You're welcome to work remotely from any EU country. Your responsibilities will include: Lead the team Manage a team of 8 Solutions Architects, with continued growth planned: 1:1s, goal setting, performance reviews, promotion cases, and individual growth plans Build an accurate picture of each SA's strengths, gaps, and preferences, and allocate accounts and engagements against both expertise and interest Run the cadence that surfaces blockers early, then take them to the development, product, and business teams that can clear them, and stay on them until they do Hold people to outcomes: distinguish effort from delivered results, say so plainly when the two diverge, and reflect it in ratings and compensation decisions Onboard new joiners through to their first independently delivered engagement Coach SAs into stronger engineers and stronger communicators, and make deliberate calls about who is ready for more scope Own delivery Be accountable for your team's delivery outcomes: time from PoC kick-off to first optimized dedicated endpoint, success-criteria hit rate, and the quality of the technical relationship after the customer goes to production Review technical work before it reaches the customer: benchmarking methodology, serving configurations, results, closure documents; catch the wrong conclusion drawn from a metrics artifact before a customer sees it Ensure staffing and escalation coverage across accounts and timezones, including post-sales request load that does not respect sprint boundaries Call infeasibility early and with evidence, rather than letting the team burn iterations against requirements the platform cannot meet today Own the operating system of the team Maintain and extend the team's documentation: responsibilities, runbooks, guides, onboarding, definitions of done, engagement closure templates. Keep it accurate and reachable; link, don't copy Get it used , not just written: documentation nobody reads is a cost, not an asset Keep the ticket tracker the system of record, so PoC and production status is readable without asking anyone Instrument the work: define and report the metrics that show whether delivery is getting faster and more reliable over time Work across teams Development and research teams: convert recurring customer pain into prioritized platform work, and represent the customer's technical reality in roadmap discussions Pre-sales: hold the scoping-to-execution boundary: push back on under-scoped engagements, and feed feasibility signal back upstream Account management: make production handoffs uneventful, and keep post-sales technical requests moving Business and leadership: give a straight read on account health, technical feasibility, and capacity needs We expect you to have: 3+ years managing technical teams, including performance management and difficult conversations Experience managing a customer-facing team. Running a team whose work is visible to customers, on customer timelines, with customer escalations. Strong ML knowledge: LLM architectures, fine-tuning approaches (SFT/LoRA, RL-based), evaluation design, and a working command of inference internals — quantization, KV-cache management, batching, routing, speculative decoding — and of the frameworks the team works in (vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM) Enough technical judgment to review someone else's benchmark and find the flaw in the methodology, not just in the conclusion Python strong enough to read and review your team's code Excellent communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain technical concepts to diverse audiences, from engineers to executives, including in front of enterprise customers under pressure Genuine tolerance for operational work: documentation, process design, reporting, and the follow-through that makes them stick Comfort operating with ambiguity across distributed teams and timezones, and a bias toward writing things down It would be an added bonus if you have: References from both former managers and former direct reports Experience scaling a team through rapid growth (5 → 15+) without losing delivery quality Prior experience in a customer-facing technical function at a cloud, inference, or AI infrastructure provider Experience defining process and documentation for a team that had none Hands-on background running LLMs in production and debugging inference workloads at the framework level Work with multimodal AI models (vision-language, speech) Proficiency with DevOps tooling (Docker, Kubernetes) and infrastructure-as-code Preferred technical stack: Programming languages: Python ML frameworks and libraries: vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, SGLang, Transformers, OpenAI/Anthropic SDKs MLOps and DevOps tools: Kubernetes (K8s), Docker, Git Cloud platforms: AWS (SageMaker, Bedrock), GCP (Vertex description: Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder led, profitable and growing. We are hiring a senior software engineer to join our Kubernetes product team. As a member of that team, you will build the operators and addons; the former, offering complete lifecycle management of mission-critical components, and the latter, a zero-ops experience for seamlessly integrating projects into your Kubernetes. You will gain familiarity with the latest features in Kubernetes and look to incorporate the best of open-source to bring functionality to our end-users. You will collaborate with industry peers and partners to bring the right solutions to our customers. This is an exciting opportunity for a senior software engineer passionate about open source software, Linux, Golang, Python and Kubernetes. Location : This is a remote position available in EMEA and the Americas. What you will focus on Work closely with other leads, assuming joint responsibility for outcomes at the team, department, and company level. Mentor, develop, and advise colleagues on their career progression. Write high-quality code to create new features Debug issues and interact with a vibrant community Collaborate proactively with a distributed team Work from home with global travel 2 to 4 weeks for internal and external events What we are looking for in you You are a Golang developer also fluent in Python You have experience with Kubernetes You have strong written and verbal communication skills You have a Bachelor’s or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree You love technology and working with brilliant people What we offer you We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally. Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year Annual compensation review Recognition rewards Annual holiday leave Maternity and paternity leave Employee Assistance Programme Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events About Canonical Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical is an equal opportunity employer We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration. title: Counter-Threat Intelligence Engineer
description: Job Overview: Cambium Learning Group is seeking a Counter-Threat Intelligence Engineer to enhance the organization’s ability to identify, understand, and counter cyber threats that could impact our learners, educators, associates, platforms, data, and business operations. This role combines threat intelligence, ethical hacking, exposure validation, adversary emulation, and security engineering to turn emerging threat information into actionable defenses. The engineer will work closely with Security Operations, IT Operations, Risk, Legal Compliance, Product, Engineering, and business stakeholders to help reduce attack surface, improve detection logic, support incident response, and translate technical findings into clear recommendations. The ideal candidate brings hands-on offensive security experience, exceptional analytical judgment, and the ability to communicate threat context in a way that drives practical remediation and measurable risk reduction. Job Responsibilities: Collect, analyze, and operationalize strategic, tactical, and operational threat intelligence from trusted internal and external sources, including indicators of compromise, adversary tactics, techniques, and procedures, emerging vulnerabilities, and targeted threat activity. Perform adversary-focused research and ethical hacking activities, with authorization, to validate exposures, identify likely attack paths, and recommend defensive improvements across endpoints, cloud services, applications, identity platforms, networks, and third-party integrations. Partner with Security Operations to create, tune, and validate detections, playbooks, threat hunting hypotheses, and response workflows in data log pipelines, SIEM, XDR, EDR, vulnerability management, and related security tools. Support Continuous Threat Exposure Management efforts by helping scope assets, discover exposures, prioritize findings based on business risk, validate exploitability, and coordinate mobilization of remediation activities with IT, infrastructure, engineering, and business owners. Produce concise, actionable threat intelligence reports, briefings, and technical recommendations for audiences ranging from security analysts to senior leadership, emphasizing relevance, impact, urgency, and practical next steps. Contribute to incident response investigations by enriching alerts with threat context, malware or phishing analysis, infrastructure research, attack timeline reconstruction, and lessons learned. Maintain awareness of threat actor tradecraft, vulnerability exploitation trends, cloud and identity attacks, education-sector threats, data protection risks, and changes in attacker use of automation and artificial intelligence. Use independent judgment to make recommendations on defensive priorities, detection improvements, risk acceptance considerations, and escalation paths while staying aligned with Cambium policies, standards, and governance expectations. Job Requirements: 5+ years of progressive cybersecurity experience, with at least 2 years in threat intelligence, ethical hacking, penetration testing, detection engineering, security operations, incident response, vulnerability management, or a closely related role. Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH) certification is highly preferred; similar hands-on offensive security or threat intelligence certifications may be considered, such as OSCP, GPEN, CompTIA PenTest+, CPENT, eJPT, GCTI, CTIA, or equivalent practical experience. Proven working knowledge of the cyber kill chain, MITRE ATT&CK, common attack techniques, malware and phishing behaviors, cloud and identity threats, vulnerability exploitation, attacker infrastructure, and defensive countermeasures. Hands-on experience with security tools and data sources such as SIEM, XDR/EDR, vulnerability scanners, threat intelligence platforms, cloud security tools, identity logs, endpoint telemetry, network telemetry, and ticketing/workflow platforms. Ability to write clear threat intelligence summaries, detection recommendations, executive briefings, remediation guidance, and technical documentation that can be acted on by cross-functional teams. Experience conducting authorized security testing, adversary emulation, attack surface analysis, detection validation, or threat hunts in a disciplined, evidence-based, and policy-aligned manner. Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field preferred; equivalent professional experience and certifications may be considered. High judgment, strong ethics, discretion with sensitive information, collaborative communication style, and commitment to protecting confidential, proprietary, student, customer, associate, and business data. Preferred Qualifications: Experience in education technology, SaaS, cloud-first, remote-first, or regulated environments. Experience building threat hunting content, Sigma/YARA rules, KQL/SPL queries, detection-as-code, or automation for enrichment and triage. Familiarity with scripting or automation using Python, PowerShell, Bash, APIs, or SOAR-style workflows. Working knowledge of data privacy, secure software development, third-party risk, and compliance frameworks such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST CSF, or NIST SP 800-series guidance. To learn more about our organization and the exciting work we do, visit Remote First Work Environment Our Remote First approach gives employees the flexibility and trust they need to effectively balance work with life. It creates a culture in which all employees are valued and where success is measured in results. It allows us to work collaboratively, inclusively and for greater positive impact, regardless of our individual locations. If you will be working remotely, either occasionally or on a permanent basis, you must have a reliable internet connection through a cable or fiber-optic broadband service with minimum speeds of 10 Mbps download and 5 Mbps upload. The successful candidate will be expected to actively participate in video-based interviews during the recruiting process and ongoing virtual meetings with their camera on, as part of their role. To maintain confidentiality and ensure a fair evaluation process, the use of note-taking tools, reference materials, or AI-powered tools (including generative AI, language models, or similar technologies) during interviews or other selection activities is prohibited unless prior written approval has been obtained from the People Experience team. If you require an exception for medical, accessibility, or other reasons, please contact your Talent Acquisition team member to discuss accommodations in advance. As part of our Remote-First benefits, Cambium offers reimbursement to help cover the cost of setting up your home or remote office. An Equal Opportunity Employer We are dedicated to fostering a culture that celebrates unique backgrounds, ideas, and experiences. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without discrimination on the basis of race, color, age, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender, gender identity/expression, or sexual orientation), national origin, protected veteran status, disability, or genetic information (including family medical history). We will provide reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities. You may request an accommodation during the recruiting process with your Talent Acquisition team member. description: About IXOPAY IXOPAY is the enterprise-grade global payment infrastructure platform built for the era of agentic commerce. We equip merchants and enterprises with AI-driven intelligence, payment orchestration, advanced tokenization, and the tools to optimize every stage of the payments journey. From intelligent routing and compliance to customizable modules and enterprise-scale orchestration, IXOPAY helps businesses integrate faster, improve payment performance, and expand globally with confidence. At IXOPAY , our people are our greatest strength. Our collaborative culture is built on shared values that guide how we work, innovate, and support our customers. About the Role We're looking for a Partner Business Manager to help expand IXOPAY 's partner ecosystem across Europe and accelerate growth through strategic partnerships. In this role, you'll build and strengthen relationships with key technology, payments, and strategic partners throughout the European market while developing go-to-market initiatives that drive joint pipeline, customer acquisition, and long-term revenue growth. Working closely with regional Sales, Marketing, Product, Customer Success, and global teams, you'll identify opportunities for collaboration while navigating the unique complexities of Europe's payments landscape. This is an opportunity to help shape IXOPAY 's European partnership strategy while working with leading payment providers, technology companies, and industry partners across the region. What You'll Do Build Strategic Partnerships Develop and grow relationships with strategic partners across Europe, fostering long-term collaboration and mutual business growth. Identify opportunities to expand partnerships through new integrations, joint initiatives, and commercial opportunities. Serve as a trusted advisor and primary point of contact for regional partner organizations. Drive Go-to-Market Success Develop and execute localized go-to-market strategies that generate pipeline, increase revenue, and expand IXOPAY 's presence across European markets. Partner closely with Sales to support partner-sourced and partner-influenced opportunities throughout the customer lifecycle. Collaborate with Marketing to deliver regional campaigns, webinars, events, co-branded content, and demand generation initiatives. Enable Partner Success Lead partner enablement initiatives, ensuring partners understand IXOPAY 's platform, products, integrations, and value proposition. Drive account mapping, opportunity planning, and strategic alignment with partner sales teams. Continuously improve referral processes and operational workflows that strengthen collaboration across regional and global stakeholders. Measure and Optimize Performance Track and analyze key partnership metrics, including referrals, pipeline generation, ARR contribution, conversion rates, and partner engagement. Identify opportunities to improve partner programs, commercial models, and ecosystem performance. Share regional market insights and partner feedback with Product, Marketing, and Executive Leadership to help shape future strategy. What You'll Bring 3+ years of experience in strategic partnerships, channel management, alliances, business development, or ecosystem growth within SaaS, FinTech, payments, or enterprise technology. Experience building and growing strategic partnerships across European markets. Strong understanding of the European payments ecosystem, including regional payment methods, regulatory frameworks, and market dynamics. Understanding of SaaS go-to-market models, including referral, reseller, co-sell, and partner-led sales motions. Excellent communication, presentation, and relationship management skills. Fluency in English. Ability to collaborate effectively across multiple countries, cultures, and time zones. Willingness to travel throughout Europe for partner meetings, customer engagements, and industry events. Preferred Professional proficiency in one or more additional European languages. Experience within payments, payment orchestration, fraud prevention, e-commerce, or financial technology. Experience with CRM, PRM, and ecosystem platforms such as Salesforce, Crossbeam, PartnerStack, or similar technologies. Experience developing regional go-to-market and demand generation initiatives. Experience working with global technology partners or strategic alliance programs. Why Join IXOPAY ? At IXOPAY , you'll help build the partnerships that power the future of enterprise payments across Europe. You'll collaborate with leading payment providers, technology companies, and strategic partners to expand our ecosystem, create innovative go-to-market opportunities, and drive meaningful business growth. You'll work alongside experienced Sales, Marketing, Product, and Customer Success teams while helping shape IXOPAY 's long-term partnership strategy throughout one of the world's most dynamic payments markets. We offer: Competitive salary and performance-based incentive compensation Professional growth and development opportunities A collaborative, international team environment Flexible remote working with the tools and equipment you need to succeed Compensation: The compensation range for this position includes both base salary and on-target earnings (OTE). Our Commitment to Inclusion We know great candidates don't always meet every qualification. If you're excited about this opportunity, we encourage you to apply - we'd love to hear what you can bring to IXOPAY . What Makes an IXOPAY er? We are a global team bound by one standard, where every voice matters and initiative drives real change. We thrive on progress over perfection - choosing direction over motion, working smart with modern tech and AI, and constantly learning through continuous iteration. If you are tenaciously curious, empowered to take ownership, and passionate about delivering customer-first solutions in the fast-paced world of global payments, you’ll fit right in. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder led, profitable and growing. We are hiring a Senior Design Researcher for our Design Team. User Science is an evolving design discipline at Canonical . While we have long incorporated diverse research on user needs into our products, the mission of the newly formed User Science team is to expand beyond traditional models of UX research, integrating user needs end-to-end in development processes and quality standards across the company. This mission requires skillful advocacy as well as organizational learning and change. As process pioneers, we draw insights from others, foster collaborative user research cultures, and constantly innovate with frameworks and standards. This role sits in the design team reporting to the User Science Manager. Location: This role will be based remotely in the EMEA region. The role entails Conducting user research: Developing user insights in diverse formats, identifying and championing user needs across product areas. Sharing findings concisely and skillfully: Supporting different teams with well-matched research presentations and clear documentation systems. Promoting and shaping a data-informed culture: Working closely with process, product, and engineering teams to integrate user research into existing decision-making flows. Building research scalability and interoperability: Owning research ops infrastructure, making key methodologies more accessible, actionable, and repeatable. Fostering a learning culture: Contributing to the evolving definition of User Science through user-centered training, resource development, and outreach. What we are looking for in you Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a related field such as Design, Human-Computer Interaction, Engineering or similar, or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path. Deep research expertise: Proficiency in both qualitative and quantitative user research methodologies, including user interviews, usability testing, A/B testing, surveys, and data analysis. Exceptional depth in either qualitative or quantitative skills. Strong technical curiosity: An alignment with and interest in open-source culture and the ability to engage deeply with technical subjects and stakeholders. Proficiency in visual design and/or information design: Capability to translate complex data or ideas into strong, convincing visuals, ensuring that insights are both accessible and memorable. A talent for storytelling and collaboration: Outstanding ability to craft narratives that effectively explain research findings and resonate with diverse audiences. A knack for turning chaos into clarity: Meticulous organization and archivist skills, with the ability to transform scattered findings or disparate processes into cohesive, structured knowledge systems. Portfolio: A robust portfolio showcasing a range of user research and/or design projects that highlight the ability to derive actionable insights from research and directly influence 1) product design and strategy or 2) organizational change. What we offer you Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. In addition to the benefits below, certain roles are also eligible for additional benefits and rewards including annual bonuses and sales incentives based on revenue or utilisation. Our compensation philosophy is to ensure equity right across our global workforce. In addition to a competitive base pay, we provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. Please note that additional benefits may apply depending on the work location and, for more information on these, you can ask in the later stages of the recruitment process. Fully remote working environment - we’ve been working remotely since 2004! Personal learning and development budget of 2,000USD per annum Annual compensation review Recognition rewards Annual holiday leave Parental Leave Employee Assistance Programme Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues at ‘sprints’ Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events About Canonical Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004.​ Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business. Canonical is an equal opportunity employer We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration. title: Senior Backend Engineer

Create detailed and reproducible scenarios involving distributed systems, networking, Identity and Access Management (IAM), message queues, persistent storage, observability, rolling deployments, and disaster recovery. Develop deterministic validation tests and golden reference solutions to ensure the reliability and accuracy of reinforcement learning environments. Produce intentionally defective variants and failure scenarios to rigorously test AI model responses and recovery strategies. Document the architecture, edge cases, and operational flows for all developed environments, ensuring clarity and reproducibility for future use. Collaborate with technical leads and project participants to iteratively refine environment specifications and acceptance criteria. Apply DevOps and infrastructure automation practices to deliver scalable, secure, and maintainable solutions for cloud-based systems evaluation. Preferred Qualifications Proven expertise with backend programming languages, such as C++, Python, Rust, GoLang, JAVA, or JavaScript. Strong practical experience with DevOps, cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and automation tools. Demonstrated ability to architect, scale, and secure distributed systems in production-grade environments. Deep understanding of networking, IAM, queues, durable storage, and disaster recovery concepts. title: Director - Data Science, Customer Experience
description: What are we building? Hard Rock Digital is a fiercely focused team working to become the best online sportsbook, casino, and social gaming company in the world. We're building a deeply curious team with a passion for learning, operating, and building new products and technologies for millions of consumers. We're customer-obsessed — we care about each customer interaction, experience, behavior, and insight, and strive to ensure we're always acting authentically. Rooted in the kindred spirits of Hard Rock and the Seminole Tribe of Florida, Hard Rock Digital taps a brand known the world over as the leader in gaming, entertainment, and hospitality. We're taking that foundation of success and bringing it to the digital space - ready to join us? What's the position? We're looking for a Director, Data Science, Customer Experience to lead the pillar that decides how we engage every Hard Rock Bet customer after they sign up. At HRD, customer experience is driven by CRM: the messages, offers, and journeys a player receives across onboarding, engagement, cross-sell, retention, and reactivation. You'll own the science behind that experience, propensity and uplift models, next-best-action and offer optimization, send-time and channel decisioning, and the experimentation framework that proves what works. You'll lead a team of data scientists and applied AI engineers, and partner with CRM, VIP, Marketing, and Data Engineering to move HRD from rules-based campaigns to model-driven, increasingly automated decisioning. Success is measured in retention, engagement, cross-sell, and incremental revenue, delivered within responsible gaming commitments and state regulations. What will you do? Own the Customer Experience science roadmap and KPIs end to end: strategy, modeling, delivery, and production health for all CRM decisioning models at HRD Lead, grow, and develop a team of data scientists and applied AI engineers, setting scientific standards and a culture of shipping measurable outcomes Partner with CRM and VIP to power next-best-action, offer and bonus targeting, send-time and channel optimization, and lifecycle journeys Drive the automation of CRM operations with AI agents and LLM workflows, in partnership with Applied AI Engineering Partner with Marketing and Finance to measure the incremental impact of CRM and bonus spend and reconcile it to the P&L Build responsible gaming and compliance guardrails into every model: exclusion logic, state-specific rules, and safe targeting constraints Own model monitoring, drift detection, and retraining for the pillar, in partnership with AI Ops & Observability Report pillar KPIs monthly to leadership and participate in annual talent and headcount planning Requirements What are we looking for? 8+ years in data science or machine learning, with 3+ years leading data scientists or ML engineers and shipping production models Deep, hands-on expertise in CRM and lifecycle science: propensity, churn, uplift, next-best-action, offer and bonus optimization, send-time and channel optimization Strong experimentation and causal inference foundations: holdout design, power analysis, variance reduction, and incrementality measurement Experience applying LLMs and AI agents to marketing operations, from campaign generation and audience building to automated QA and journey orchestration Familiarity with real-time ML in production: feature pipelines, low-latency scoring, model monitoring and retraining, preferably on AWS Proven ability to build and scale a team: hiring, coaching, performance management, and succession planning Ability to turn ambiguous CRM and marketing problems into a prioritized science roadmap and communicate trade-offs to executives Master's or PhD in a quantitative field, or equivalent experience Bonus points if you have: Experience in online gaming, sports betting, fintech, or another high-frequency consumer business Experience with recommendation and personalization systems that extend CRM decisioning into the product Familiarity with our stack or equivalents: Braze, Amplitude, Segment, Snowflake, dbt, Airflow, AWS SageMaker, Bedrock Experience with multi-objective optimization that balances revenue, engagement, and customer wellbeing What's in it for you? Competitive pay and benefits Flexible vacation allowance Startup culture backed by a secure, global brand Roster of Uniques We care deeply about every interaction our customers have with us and trust and empower our staff to own and drive their experience. We foster a diverse and inclusive work environment where, regardless of background or beliefs, you feel able to be authentic and bring all your talent into play. We are an equal opportunities employer. Originally posted on Himalayas

description: As a Senior Data Analyst, Executive Analytics at Namecheap and Spaceship, you will be the go-to analyst for the C-level of both brands and for our board. You will take open-ended questions from leadership, figure out what's really being asked, get the data yourself and come back with a clear recommendation, which you will present yourself. This is a brand-new role: you will define the exec analytics function and the board reporting standard from day one, and your conclusions will go straight to the people making the decisions. Location: 100% remote from Europe (CET ±2h), B2B contract! Interview Process: 5 stages - 30 min intro call -> 1h conversation with the Head of BI -> 1h technical interview -> take-home case (up to 5h) -> 1h case presentation Tools: SQL (BigQuery, MSSQL, MySQL, Trino), Python (pandas, notebooks), Tableau, Looker / Looker Studio, Excel / Google Sheets Reporting to: Head of BI Team size: A global BI department of 7 teams, with LLM tools in daily use, and YOU as the dedicated analyst for the C-level and the board! What will make your journey with us amazing? A supportive manager who cares about your well-being and is invested in your professional growth. A culture of continuous learning, with clear targets and feedback. A global company with over 2500 employees located in more than 26 countries around the world, including offices in 3 countries: Ukraine, Portugal, and India. What will you do: You will be the single analytics point of contact for the leadership of two brands at different stages: established Namecheap and fast-growing Spaceship. You will run deep dives on whatever leadership needs answered (pricing, retention, product performance, growth), support FP&A with budgeting, plan vs. actual, financial models and forecasts for both brands, own the executive and board reporting pack on one consistent set of metrics, present your findings to the C-level and the board, and work on strategic cases like pricing changes, new products and M&A. What will you bring: You will have 5-8 years of experience in analytics, with real experience in SaaS, subscription or e-commerce You will be skilled in SQL across several engines and build your own data marts (we use BigQuery, MSSQL, MySQL and Trino, but you don't need hands-on experience with all of them) You have experience with Python for analysis, solid statistics and A/B testing You have working experience with forecasting: time series and cohort models You are experienced with financial modeling in Excel or Google Sheets and comfortable with unit economics You have domain expertise in subscription metrics (retention, LTV), pricing and product analytics You have working experience with Tableau and/or Looker / Looker Studio You turn a vague question into a sharp one, and numbers into a decision You can point to analyses that changed a business decision, with the numbers to prove it You have fluent English (C1+) and are confident presenting to senior leadership Experience with Trino or federated queries, dbt, LLM tools in your analytics workflow, or a background in domains, hosting or web infrastructure is a plus What’s in it for you: Embrace work-life balance with a 100% remote role. Get a direct line to the C-level and the board, where your work changes decisions. Work across two brands with different economics and different problems. Grow with a path to leading exec analytics. Participate in team-building activities and events. Utilize the best tools and technology for work, including LLM tools. #NamecheapCareers #SpaceshipCareers #HackYourCareer #equalopportunity Originally posted on Himalayas

title: Email Designer
description: PLEASE NOTE THIS ROLE IS FOR OVERSEAS APPLICATION, NON -U.S. ONLY. NO DOMESTIC (U.S.) APPLICATIONS WILL BE CONSIDERED. What defines our next Email Designer Scentbird is looking for a visionary Email Designer to help conceive and design our email marketing initiatives for Scentbird . The perfect candidate will have a clear understanding of email design, with partnered problem solving skills for enhanced marketing needs, as well as the highest level of craft for design, creating beautiful, modern experiences for both mobile and desktop email environments — comfortable using AI tools to help move quickly from concept to finished, on-brand designs. This Email Designer will be responsible for helping develop engaging experiences that allow ease-of use within our customer base, while telling an immersive story and eliciting an emotional response from our customers through rich visual design. The successful candidate will work closely with our Team Directors to deliver ideas and experiences that create a visionary future for Scentbird , while exceeding the expectations of our customers. They’ll also need to focus on using AI to help design entire emails and flows, and to have their AI tool be capable of helping them create conceptual AND finished email designs. What You’ll Be Responsible For: Have a deep understanding of how Claude Design and other design AI tools work, as a core part of this role is working with these tools to help ideate, sketch and completely create email designs. Use AI tools to help ideate and rough out email concepts and full campaign flows early, then carry those through to final, polished designs. Concept, design and manage email design initiatives from our weekly/monthly roadmap, understanding areas of opportunity for higher levels of engagement with our customers through design and marketing Present work by speaking through your ideas and vision, so all partners can understand your path and know how you're going to improve the design/experience. Gather design inspiration and be a leader of sharing new ideas/designs that can help push our email designs to new levels of fidelity. Build and maintain our email UI style guide using Claude Design & Figma, keeping it continuously updated and aligned with our latest brand and UI standards. Work harmoniously with the product design team, partnering and assisting when needed so that email communications and web communications feel seamless Meet with the Product Designer Director weekly to align on scope and vision for the ongoing projects and the future of email marketing Work with marketing product owners to help understand product initiatives, business requirements, and future company goals so that these may contribute to your work Work with Engineers to facilitate ease of transition from design to build, forming a collaborative partnership that's efficient and effective What We’ll Love About You : Comfortable using AI design tools to explore concepts and produce finished email designs and flows, without losing personal craft or brand voice along the way. Passion for design and beauty, you are a master graphic designer, it is your superpower, you look at every nuance of a design and help bring it to immersive life through every small-to-large detail of desig You're able to spot and help encourage new design trends in the email space Able to story-tell within the email design space The ability to think through high-level marketing and company goals to realize the scope of an email and know its emphasis on the entire Scentbird experience as a whole Ability to give and take creative direction Detail-oriented and a precision to your style of work Ability to prioritize and handle multiple projects in order to meet tight deadlines Excellent communication skills The ability to work with internal and external cross-functional teams both domestically and internationally What You’ll Need to Have: 2+ years experience in email design is required. A portfolio showcasing agency work as well as in-house work would be ideal. This portfolio should show an in-depth understanding of email design and use cases of at least 15 email projects you've defined. Comfortable using AI design tools to explore concepts and produce finished email designs and flows, without losing personal craft or brand voice along the way. Degree in Design, Arts, and/or Digital Design What You’ll Love About Us: Competitive base compensation Bonus program Paid Time Off and Work From Home A fun, creative and energetic work environment About Scentbird Scentbird inspires fragrance lovers to go beyond the ordinary and sample scents that evoke passion, confidence, and the unknown. Our mission is to revolutionize the way we perfume by bringing the ultimate fragrance playground right to your fingertips and offering a digital subscription service that lets members choose from over 1000+ designer perfumes each month. About the Brands: Scentbird : The easiest way for fragrance lovers to discover, try, and buy their favorite scented products without a commitment Deck of Scarlet: Deck of Scarlet is on a mission to break the clean category, redefining what clean fragrances should smell like. Composed entirely of vegan, cruelty-free ingredients, our fragrances bridge the gap between the clean and luxury categories, using the highest eau de parfum concentrations housed in sculptural, eye-catching bottles. You shouldn’t have to choose between being luxe and refined, or clean and vegan—now, you don’t have to. Confessions Of A Rebel: We were born in 2018, holding fast to the idea that the fragrance industry was in dire need of a change. When we looked around, all we saw was a sea of sameness: outdated archetypes of femininity and masculinity paired with unrelatable images of luxury that we had no say in. In truth, we are complex in ways that cannot be contained in the traditional heteronormative stereotypes, existing beyond the binary with raw, unfiltered voices that deserve to be heard. Goodhabit: Enriched with a blend of essential oils, Goodhabit’s clean, vegan, cruelty-free fragrances act as bottled intentions you set free with each mist. Our scents are designed to help you align with the good habits you’re building, while working to enhance and boost your mood. Inhale, exhale, and let the good energy flow through you. Sanctuary: Created for those who care about the fate of our planets, Sanctuary offers fragrance for a better future. Our clean, community-driven fragrances are inspired by endangered species and their habitats, each aimed at raising money and awareness for the preservation of their namesake. Drift: Drift began as an alternative to all of the tacky air care products on the market. Our products are designed to blend in, with amazing scents that stand out. We take pride in our fragrances, keeping them free from the traditional chemicals used in the fragrance industry. We are always phthalate and paraben free. We never skimp on quality of our scents or the products that deliver them. Our design ethos is simple but effective. We love our community, those who won’t settle for ordinary, and we want to deliver a best in class experience. Scentbird is committed to bringing individuals from different backgrounds and perspectives into the Nest. We strive to uphold an inclusive environment where individuals of all different backgrounds, ages, colors, ethnicities, gender, or gender identities, genetics, physical or mental abilities, protected veteran status, race, religious or sexual orientation, thrive. We respect the laws enforced by the EEOC and are dedicated internally to going above and beyond in fostering diversity. Come as you are - we’re excited to meet you. Originally posted on Himalayas

Someone that can inspire others, taking our creative experiences — and our creative process — to a new level, as we continue to grow. Understand areas of opportunity for higher levels of engagement with our customers, using AI to help surface trends and opportunities from research and product data. Lead reviews by articulating your ideas and vision, so all partners can understand the path and know how to enhance the designs/experience. Know how to manage multiple projects at one time, effortlessly. Align with our Director to establish best practices when it comes to research, testing, UX, UI, and AI tooling, and how to manage internal processes with the Marketing, Copy, Dev, and Creative teams Gather design inspiration and be a leader in sharing new ideas/designs that can help push our UX and UI designs to new levels of fidelity. Work with product owners to help understand all the scopes of work, plus any surveys, customer interviews, and usability testing, so that these may contribute to your work. Work with Engineers to facilitate ease of transition from design to build, forming a collaborative partnership that's efficient and effective — including exploring AI-assisted handoff and design-to-code workflows. Actively identify and champion new AI tools and workflows across the design team to help us work more smartly and efficiently. What We’ll Love About You: Your core focus is building experiences that help convert new customers and also retain them. Your entire vision is creating experiences that help enable our customers, while at the same time, creating profit opportunities for the company. Passion for design and beauty, you are a master UX Product Designer, it is your superpower, you look at every nuance of UX and design, and help bring it to immersive life through every small-to-large detail of UI design. You're able to spot and help encourage new design trends in the web and app space, including AI-driven shifts in how people interact with digital products. Able to solve complex User Experience problems, smoothly and efficiently — using AI as a thought partner for problem framing and solution exploration. title: Director of International Business Development & Sales
description: Hydrosat is a space and data analytics company building a new Earth observation constellation and software platform to unlock the power of thermal infrared imagery. We deliver high-resolution thermal insights that help governments, defense agencies, and agribusinesses better manage water resources, agricultural production, national security threats, and critical infrastructure. We grow through two distinct routes to market – government programmes, and commercial data and subscription products – and our product and engineering teams build the platform that powers both. Hydrosat is hiring a Director of International BD & Sales to bost growth, identify and develop strategic opportunities, and strengthen our position across international government markets. This is a senior, hands-on role combining channel leadership, business development, and market intelligence. You will own Hydrosat ’s international partner ecosystem, shape market-entry strategies, and identify relevant government programs before they reach formal procurement. Working closely with the VP Global, Government Programs, you will represent Hydrosat with senior customers and partners, make recommendations on where the company should invest its resources, and coordinate early-stage opportunities into qualified captures. Responsibilities Channel Strategy and Management Audit, improve and execute Hydrosat ’s international channel strategy. Identify, recruit, negotiate with, and onboard resellers and strategic partners. Establish reseller agreements for satellite data, IrriWatch, and other relevant Hydrosat solutions. Manage partner pipelines and hold resellers accountable against clear activity, pipeline, and revenue targets. Provide partners with the use cases, marketing materials, pricing guidance, training, and commercial support needed to generate and maximize revenue. Structure the global reseller network through partner tiers and performance reviews Grow partner-generated pipeline and revenue while addressing underperforming relationships. International Strategy and Market Development Develop market-entry strategies for priority countries and regions. Map government landscapes, including end users, buyers, budget owners, procurement processes, funding sources, and existing capabilities. Identify and engage relevant local partners, institutional stakeholders, and decision-makers. Produce actionable country and market strategies for leadership decision-making. Represent Hydrosat in selected customer, partner, and institutional engagements. Opportunity Intelligence and Early Capture Establish a systematic approach to monitoring relevant RFIs, tenders, funding programs, and institutional initiatives worldwide. Track national and international procurement platforms. Qualify opportunities based on strategic fit, funding, customer access, competitive position, timing, and probability of success. Develop preliminary capture strategies and make clear go/no-go recommendations. Position Hydrosat with key stakeholders before formal procurements are released. Advance qualified opportunities into structured captures Contribute to the development and adoption of Hydrosat ’s value proposition across government markets. Maintain accurate partner, market, and opportunity intelligence in CRM. Requirements At least eight years of experience in international business development, partnerships, channel management, market strategy, or capture. Demonstrated success building commercial partnerships and developing complex government or institutional opportunities. Strong commercial judgment and the ability to operate independently across multiple markets. Confidence engaging senior government, institutional, and industry stakeholders. A proactive, resourceful personality with strong analytical ability, intellectual curiosity, and attention to detail. Ability to turn fragmented market information into clear strategies, priorities, and actions. Excellent written and spoken English. French, Spanish, Portugeuse, or another European language is a strong plus. Experience in Earth observation, space, geospatial intelligence, government markets, water management, agriculture, climate technology, or deep tech is preferred. Willingness to travel internationally. Originally posted on Himalayas

title: Senior Performance Marketing Manager Paid Social – Meta & TikTok (m/w/d) · Remot
description: Das ist dein Job bei uns Mittwochmorgen. Du öffnest den Business Manager und siehst zwei neue Hooks laufen, deutlich über Benchmark. Du erhöhst direkt die Budgets. Anschließend briefst du Anna, unsere Creative Strategistin, auf die Iteration der Best Performer. Anna baut mit Alex, Mona und Tobi aus dem Creative Team ein neues Set. UGC, Founder Ads und mehrere Statics. Wenige Tage später gehen sie live. Am Donnerstag präsentierst du dem Kunden die Entwicklung der Performance und die nächsten Schritte. Dazu deine Vorschläge für den nächsten Produktlaunch. Rabatte allein reichen dir nicht. Jede Bestellung muss einen positiven Deckungsbeitrag tragen. Danach briefst du dein Team. Jeder Schritt der Kampagne ist klar verteilt. Am Launchtag knackst du für den Kunden 50.000 € Ad Spend an einem Tag, profitabel. Genau das ist dein Job. Wofür wir arbeiten Wir wollen der stärkste ganzheitliche Wachstumspartner für E-Commerce-Brands im DACH-Raum sein. Denn was wir immer wieder sehen: Agenturen und Dienstleister betreuen Brands nischig und siloartig, Kanal für Kanal, ohne Blick aufs Ganze. Dabei bleiben enorme Potenziale auf der Strecke. Wir verstehen uns deshalb nicht als Dienstleister, sondern als Teil des Unternehmens unserer Kunden. Dafür arbeiten bei EVOLVE 30 Spezialisten in sechs Fachbereichen zusammen, vollständig remote und seit dem ersten Tag. Wir denken Paid Social anders Dass das Creative über die Performance entscheidet, ist kein Geheimnis mehr. Das ist Standard. Wir setzen zudem eine Ebene höher an und entwickeln conversionstarke Angebote und Funnel mit. Denn ein starker ROAS entsteht selten nur aus guten Ads. Er entsteht aus dem Angebot dahinter: Angebotslogik und Preisstruktur gehören für uns zum Kanal. Jedes Angebot rechnen wir auf Deckungsbeitrag durch, bevor es live geht. Landingpages und Funnels bauen wir mit. Ein Creative verkauft nur so gut wie die Seite dahinter. Creative Strategist, Copywriter, Grafiker und Videografen im eigenen Haus. Kein Warten auf externe Zulieferer, dazu ein AI-Stack für mehr Output. Genau dafür suchen wir jemanden. Was dich hier erwartet Du übernimmst nicht ein paar Werbekonten. Du übernimmst Verantwortung für das Wachstum deiner Kunden über Social Ads und entwickelst eigenständig die richtige Strategie. Denn wir arbeiten nicht mit Kunden zusammen, um Kampagnen zu verwalten. Wir arbeiten mit ihnen, um sie zum Wachsen zu bringen. Was das im Alltag heißt: Du planst und steuerst die Paid-Social-Kampagnen auf Meta und TikTok, von der Strategie bis zur täglichen Optimierung Du skalierst Accounts auf hohe fünf- bis sechsstellige Monatsbudgets. Die Zielmetrik ist Profitabilität, nicht Ad Spend. Du entwickelst die Creative-Konzepte mit Anna und dem Creative Team. UGC, Founder Ads und Statics entstehen aus Testdaten, nicht aus Bauchgefühl. Du lieferst die Ideen für Ads und Funnels nach Direct-Response-Prinzipien. Unser Team setzt sie um und arbeitet sie im Detail aus. Du sorgst dafür, dass Hooks, Formate und Narrative laufend getestet werden. Ein Gewinner-Creative hält auf hohen Ad-Spend-Leveln nicht lange. Du führst die wöchentlichen Kundenreportings und berätst auf Entscheiderebene, nicht nur zum Kanal Du baust den Social Ads Bereich weiter aus, über SOPs, Qualitätsmanagement und die fachliche Führung neuer Teammitglieder Der letzte Punkt ist uns wichtig. Diese Rolle gibt es bei EVOLVE einmal. Deshalb suchen wir jemanden, der die Verantwortung für das gesamte Paid Social Team übernehmen will und sich perspektivisch als Paid Social Lead entwickelt. Das solltest du mitbringen Mindestens drei Jahre Erfahrung im Performance Marketing mit Schwerpunkt Paid Social, als Hauptkanal und nicht nebenbei Nachweisbare Skalierung von E-Commerce-Accounts auf hohe fünf- bis sechsstellige Monatsbudgets Tiefes Wissen im Meta Business Manager, idealerweise auch im TikTok Ads Manager. Dazu Routine mit Tracking-Tools wie Triple Whale, Admetrics oder Tracify Sicherer Umgang mit Margen, Deckungsbeiträgen, CAC und POAS. Ohne diese Zahlen lässt sich profitabel nicht skalieren Strategisches Verständnis für E-Commerce. Du denkst über den Werbekanal hinaus und steuerst Projekte entlang des gesamten Kundengeschäfts Verständnis für Direct-Response-Mechanismen, UGC-Formate und Founder Ads. Du erkennst, warum ein Creative verkauft, und nicht nur, dass es verkauft Deutsch auf Muttersprachniveau für Kundenkommunikation und Copy-Bewertung. Englisch fließend für die Arbeit in den Ad-Managern Sehr gute Selbstorganisation, auch weil wir 100 % remote arbeiten Idealerweise erste Erfahrung in fachlicher Führung oder im Mentoring von Junioren Direkt gesagt: Dieser Job passt nicht zu jedem Du solltest dich nicht bewerben, wenn du keine E-Commerce-Erfahrung mitbringst. Wir suchen jemanden, der Accounts auf exzellentem Niveau steuert. Fachlich challengen wir dich gern. Das E-Commerce-Know-how solltest du jedoch schon mitbringen. Der Rahmen 100 % Remote seit Tag 1, kein Hybrid-Kompromiss 30 Tage Urlaub Betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Jobrad und Firmenfitness über Wellpass Laptop deiner Wahl und hochwertige Homeoffice-Ausstattung Weiterbildungsbudget sowie Unterstützung durch interne und externe Quellen und Mentoren an deiner Seite Voller Zugriff auf unseren internen AI-Stack Zweimal jährlich Teamevents und Workations So läuft der Prozess Deine Bewerbung. Dein Lebenslauf reicht. Wenn wir Rückfragen haben, schicken wir dir einen kurzen Fragebogen. Erstgespräch. Ein kurzes Video-Gespräch mit Vanessa aus unserem HR: gegenseitiges Kennenlernen, Rahmen und Erwartungen. Fachgespräch. Hier geht es in die Tiefe, mit der Geschäftsführung oder dem Lead deines Fachbereichs. Finales Kennenlernen. Mit der Geschäftsführung und deinem zukünftigen Ansprechpartner, persönlich und fachlich. Hier definieren wir deine Stelle noch einmal genau auf Basis deiner Stärken und Interessen. Entscheidung und Start. Wir entscheiden schnell und planen dein Onboarding gemeinsam. Deine Entwicklung bei uns Kurzfristig, die ersten zwei Monate. Einarbeitung in die EVOLVE-Methodik und unsere Prozesse. Du übernimmst erste Accounts gemeinsam mit dem Team. Mittelfristig. Volle Verantwortung für mehrere High-Budget-Accounts. Du steuerst das Paid-Social-Team fachlich und onboardest ein weiteres Teammitglied. Langfristig. Du führst als Paid Social Lead den gesamten Social Ads Bereich, fachlich und disziplinarisch, bis zu zehn Personen. Deine Ansprechpartnerin Vanessa, unsere HR Managerin, ist dein erster Kontakt und freut sich auf deine Bewerbung. Originally posted on Himalayas

description: If you're an Embedded / Firmware Engineer who is just as comfortable on a Linux board as on a microcontroller, and you know that a boot hang or a flaky BLE connection is rarely "just a software bug," we'd love to talk. We're looking for a freelancer with a strong embedded foundation: C/C++, hardware-aware debugging, and real embedded Linux experience (Yocto or Buildroot, U-Boot, kernel, device tree, drivers). The role is not tied to one platform: depending on the project, you might work on a Cortex-A SoC, a Raspberry Pi-class board, or a Cortex-M microcontroller next to it. You'd join us on a freelance, time & material basis: you're paid for the hours you actually work on real client projects. We're ready to start right away. The first three months are about getting to know each other, and if it works, we'd love to bring you into our core team with a fixed salary and the full benefits package. Not a promise, a real possibility we actively root for. About intent We've been designing and co-creating connected devices since 2008. Wearables, smart audio, health-tech hardware, and IoT products for clients like Oura, BOSE, Neurable, and McIntosh. We're a 60+ person, fully remote team that works at the intersection of physical and digital products. At intent , firmware is not treated as an isolated layer. It sits right in the middle of hardware, mobile, cloud, QA, and product decisions. That means you'll work with people who care about what actually happens on the device, not just what the ticket said should happen. Who this role is NOT for If you only want to be handed a perfectly written spec, disappear for two weeks, and return with a pull request, we're probably not your people. Embedded work at intent means dealing with real-world constraints: imperfect hardware, changing client needs, boards that boot on the bench and not in the enclosure, radios that behave differently in the lab than in the field, power trade-offs, vendor BSPs, datasheets, errata, and edge cases that don't always show up on day one. We're looking for someone who asks "why?" before jumping into implementation, who can read a schematic and question it, and who understands that "it works on my desk" is not the same as "it works in the product." Requirements 4+ years of professional experience in embedded or firmware development. Strong hands-on experience with C / C++ for embedded systems. Hands-on experience with embedded Linux build systems such as Yocto Project or Buildroot. Good understanding of the Linux kernel, device drivers, and the device tree. CI/CD experience for embedded projects (e.g., GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI). Experience with bootloaders, particularly U-Boot. Experience with embedded constraints: timing, memory, peripherals, boot time, and power consumption. Ability to debug firmware and hardware-adjacent problems using practical tools: JTAG/SWD, serial logs, logic analyzers, and oscilloscopes. Comfort reading schematics, datasheets, technical documentation, and errata. Familiarity with common embedded interfaces such as UART, SPI, I2C, GPIO, or similar. Proficiency with Bash and/or Python for automation and testing. Solid Git skills and comfort collaborating on GitHub: pull requests, code reviews, shared repos. Good command of written and spoken English, minimum B2. Ownership, self-reliance, and responsibility for assigned work. Clear communication, with engineers, PMs, QA, and clients. A problem-solving mindset over line-counting. Nice to have Experience with different platforms (even exotic ones). Embedded Linux toolchains, drivers, and user-space apps. Experience with microcontrollers (ARM Cortex-M) and RTOS such as FreeRTOS or Zephyr. Bluetooth / BLE beyond the basics: GATT design, pairing and bonding, connection parameters, throughput and power trade-offs, and secure OTA/DFU. Networking: TCP/IP, Wi-Fi, Ethernet, and IoT protocols such as MQTT. Multimedia and audio: GStreamer, V4L2, ALSA, I2S, codecs, graphics acceleration. Security: Secure Boot, OP-TEE, TrustZone, encrypted filesystems, cryptography. Sensor integration (IMU, PPG, biosignals) and power profiling. Containerization on embedded devices (e.g., Docker). A portfolio of personal projects on a GitHub or GitLab profile. What you'll do Design, develop, and maintain a custom embedded Linux distribution using Yocto or Buildroot. Bring up new hardware platforms, working closely with the hardware team to debug issues from schematics to software. Develop and maintain the BSP and bootloaders (e.g., U-Boot), and customize the Linux kernel, including writing and debugging drivers (e.g., I2C, SPI, UART, MIPI-CSI/DSI). Write robust, efficient C/C++ code for system services and applications. Optimize system performance: boot time, memory usage, and power consumption. Implement and maintain system security features such as Secure Boot and encrypted filesystems. Debug firmware and hardware-adjacent issues using JTAG/SWD, serial logs, logic analyzers, oscilloscopes, and vendor tooling. Collaborate with hardware, mobile, QA, backend, product, and client-side engineering teams to solve cross-functional device problems. Participate in requirements discussions, technical planning, architecture decisions, estimations, and delivery planning. Test firmware releases, investigate issues found during development or QA, and maintain technical documentation. Share knowledge and contribute to better engineering practices within our Firmware & Hardware chapter. How we work Fully remote. We have an office in Warsaw. The team operates between 10:00 and 18:00 CET, and that's when most meetings happen. Depending on the project, occasional evening calls with US-based clients (up to ~20:00) may happen, always scheduled in advance, never a surprise. You'll be part of the Firmware & Hardware chapter for knowledge-sharing, and simultaneously on a project squad led by a PM for day-to-day delivery. What we offer 120-180 PLN/h net B2B, depending on your experience Truly flexible hours (most of the team works 10-18 CET, but you organize your day) Fully remote (all Europe) Access to our internal knowledge-sharing: tech talks, experiments, side projects No sugarcoating: during the freelance period there's no paid leave or medical benefits. Those come with the permanent contract, and we're transparent about that upfront. Your first weeks We don't throw you into the deep end on day one. New engineers go through a structured ramp-up period before landing on target projects: you'll work alongside the team, get paired with a technical buddy, and tackle progressively bigger tasks so both sides can see how the collaboration feels. Feedback comes early and often, no one waits three months to tell you something isn't working. We believe in fast, honest signals: if it's great, you'll know. If something needs adjusting, you'll hear about it while there's still time to adjust. Recruitment process The entire process is in English. All interviews are recorded for internal evaluation purposes. HR call (~45 min, casual) Technical meeting (~90 min, with the technical team) Final feedback within a few days Originally posted on Himalayas
